title: Graduate Quantitative Researcher 2028 – Expression of Interest
description: <p>Register your interest below. This is an expression of interest, not a job application, and it does not start an assessment process.</p> <p>Looking to start full-time in 2027? Our Graduate Quantitative Researcher (2027 Start) role is currently open.<a href="https://www.optiver.com/join-us/jobs/quantitative-research-and-machine-learning/amsterdam/graduate-quantitative-researcher-2027-start/?gh_jid=8585609002"> Apply here.</a></p> <p>If you enjoy using mathematics and code to investigate difficult questions, you could make a direct contribution to Optiver’s success in global markets. As a Graduate Quantitative Researcher, you’ll work across the full research process, from framing the question and choosing the data to building, testing and deploying models. Machine Learning is central to the work, whether you’re extracting signals, forecasting prices or modelling relationships. Our data, compute and production infrastructure let you test ideas quickly, understand where they fail and decide what to investigate next.</p> <p>Our researchers believe in academic discourse and invite fellow researchers, traders and engineers to challenge each hypothesis. Different perspectives help improve the question, the model and how it performs in production. Through constant testing, analysis and refinement, you’ll help our quantitative models adapt as markets evolve.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO</strong></p> <p><strong>Your onboarding </strong></p> <p>You’ll participate in <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ONPObMHh-k8">Global Optiver Academy</a>, a structured onboarding programme for graduates. It gives new joiners a shared foundation in how Optiver trades, builds systems, and manages risk before they move into their teams. As part of your onboarding, you'll gain exposure to the AI tools and technologies that support research and development across the business. </p> <p><strong>Your responsibilities </strong></p> <p>Depending on the team you join, you'll own the research end to end. That could include:</p> <ul> <li>Building models for pricing, forecasting and signal discovery, choosing the statistical, mathematical or Machine Learning methods that best fit the problem.</li> <li>Working across petabytes of market, order-flow and unstructured data to find signals that improve strategies as conditions change.</li> <li>Monitoring models in production and using live behavior to refine your assumptions and decide what to investigate next.</li> <li>Using deep learning and AI-enabled workflows to shorten the loop from hypothesis to evidence.</li> <li>Working directly with researchers, traders and engineers to shape problems and understand how system constraints affect performance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHO YOU ARE</strong></p> <p>We're looking for aspiring Quantitative Researchers who are versatile and creative in innovating and suggesting new solutions. In return, we'll give you the freedom to pursue your ideas and implement them right into our production systems. </p> <p>In terms of skills and qualifications, we're looking for:</p> <ul> <li>An academic degree in Engineering, Physics, Maths, Econometrics, Computer science or equivalent, with outstanding academic achievements</li> <li>Programming experience in any language (preferably Python, but C, C++, Basic, JAVA, etc. are also a plus)</li> <li>Ability to apply concepts of probability, calculus and linear algebra</li> <li>Competitive attitude and eagerness to constantly improve</li> <li>Ability to learn quickly</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written English language skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL GET</strong></p> <p>You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talent colleagues, working collaboratively to tackle the toughest problems in the financial markets.</p> <p>In addition, you’ll receive:</p> <ul> <li>A performance-based bonus structure, enabling all of our employees to benefit from our global profit pool</li> <li>The opportunity to work alongside best-in-class professionals from over 50 countries</li> <li>25 paid vacation days in your first year, increasing to 30 from your second year onwards</li> <li>Training opportunities, discounts on health benefits, and fully paid first-class commuting expenses</li> <li>Extensive office perks, including breakfast, lunch and dinner, world-class barista coffee, bi-weekly chair massages, Friday afternoon drinks, a bicycle to explore Amsterdam and much more</li> <li>Training and continuous learning opportunities, including access to conferences and tech events</li> <li>Competitive relocation packages and visa sponsorship where necessary for expats</li> </ul> <p><strong>HOW TO REGISTER</strong></p> <p>Are you interested in furthering your career on one of the most dynamic and exciting trading floors in Europe?</p> <p>Complete the short form below with your details and upload your CV in English. Registering your interest is not a job application, and it does not start an assessment process. We'll contact you when we have opportunities that match your profile.</p> <p>Kindly note that we do not require any assistance from third-parties including agencies in the recruitment of this role. If you have any questions feel free to contact our Recruitment team via our <a href="https://optiver.com/contact-eu-recruitment/">recruitment inquiry form.</a></p> <p><strong>Diversity statement</strong></p> <p>Optiver is committed to <a href="https://optiver.com/diversity-statement/">diversity and inclusion</a>.</p> <p>We encourage applications from candidates from any and all backgrounds, and we welcome requests for reasonable adjustments during the process to ensure that you can best demonstrate your abilities. Please let us know if you would like to request any reasonable adjustments by contacting the Recruitment team via the <a href="https://optiver.com/contact-eu-recruitment">contact form</a>, selecting "Reasonable Adjustments" as the subject of your inquiry</p> <p>For answers to some of our most frequently asked questions, refer to our <a href="https://www.optiver.com/join-us/stories/optiver-europe-recruitment-faq/">recruitment FAQ</a>.</p> <p>For applicants based in India, our entry route is via the placement office internship hiring season (July/August).</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
description: <p>At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?</p> <p>As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.</p> <p>This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.</p> <p>Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.</p> <h2>What You'll Work On</h2> <p>You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:</p> <ul> <li>Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events</li> <li>Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them</li> <li>Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading</li> <li>Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise</li> <li>Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible</li> <li>Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales</li> <li>Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models</li> <li>Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper</li> <li>Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems</li> <li>Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge</li> </ul> <p>No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist.</p> <h2>What Success Looks Like</h2> <p>Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable.</p> <h2>Who We're Looking For</h2> <p>We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious.</p> <ul> <li>Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning</li> <li>No active backlogs</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++</li> <li>Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects</li> <li>Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking</li> <li>A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly</li> </ul> <p>Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before.</p> <h2>Our Culture</h2> <p>More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. We look for people who are curious enough to keep asking why, analytical enough to separate signal from noise, persistent enough to pursue difficult problems, intellectually honest enough to abandon an idea when the evidence says so, and humble enough to keep learning.</p> <p>At Graviton, researchers sit alongside technologists on specialized trading teams that operate with significant autonomy. You'll have meaningful ownership of research problems from day one: forming your own hypotheses, challenging existing approaches and following the evidence wherever it leads, with the infrastructure and datasets to test ideas at scale, competitive compensation, and a culture where the best idea wins regardless of who proposed it.</p> <p>Markets are among the most complex systems humans have ever created, and they never stop changing. Neither should our thinking. Every day, someone asks a better question and finds an answer nobody had. That someone could be you.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Accuracy Checking Dispenser (ACD)
description: Looking for something a little different from traditional pharmacy? At Montu, pharmacy works differently. No retail counter, no walk-in patients and no OTC sales. Instead, you will be part of a busy, growing digital pharmacy focused entirely on getting medication safely and efficiently to our patients. We are moving into a newly renovated, purpose-built pharmacy at Winnersh Triangle, giving our growing team a modern working environment with free parking on site. If you are an experienced Accuracy Checking Dispenser who enjoys working at pace, takes pride in getting things right and wants to be part of a pharmacy environment that is continuing to grow and evolve, we would love to hear from you. What is the role? hat is the job?As an Accuracy Checking Dispenser at Montu, you will play an important part in making sure every prescription leaving our pharmacy is accurate and ready to reach the patient safely. You will carry out the final accuracy check on dispensed prescriptions, working alongside our dispensers, pharmacy technicians, ACTs and pharmacists as part of a large and supportive pharmacy team. This is a busy environment and we operate at significant scale, so you will need to be comfortable working at pace without compromising on accuracy. Attention to detail is incredibly important, as is having the confidence to stop, question something and escalate when it does not look right. You will be trusted to use your judgement, take ownership of your work and understand the responsibility that comes with being the final check before medication reaches our patients. Behind every prescription we dispense is a person relying on us to get it right. What will you be doing? Carrying out final accuracy checks on dispensed prescriptions before medication is supplied to patients. Checking the right patient, medicine, strength, formulation, quantity and directions. Ensuring all labelling is accurate and appropriate. Checking that medicines have been assembled in line with prescriptions, SOPs, legal requirements and our internal processes. Identifying and escalating discrepancies, near misses and potential dispensing errors. Using your professional judgement and knowing when something needs to be referred to the Responsible Pharmacist. Supporting the safe checking of controlled drugs, unlicensed medicines and higher-risk medications in line with relevant procedures. Completing expiry date, batch number and packaging integrity checks where required. Maintaining clear and accurate records of checks completed. Working closely with dispensers, pharmacists and the wider pharmacy team to resolve queries quickly and safely. Supporting quality improvements and helping us continually improve the way we work. Sharing your knowledge and supporting colleagues across the pharmacy. Keeping up to date with SOPs, regulatory requirements and best practice. What do you need? We are looking for someone who is confident in their ability, comfortable working in a busy environment and takes real pride in accuracy. You will need: An accredited Accuracy Checking Dispenser qualification recognised for pharmacy dispensing practice. Previous experience carrying out final accuracy checks within a pharmacy environment. A strong understanding of the dispensing process and the importance of each stage in preventing medication errors. Good knowledge of pharmacy legislation, SOPs, governance and patient safety. Excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy when working at pace. Confidence to challenge something when it does not look right and escalate concerns appropriately. The ability to work independently while understanding the boundaries of your role. Strong communication skills and the ability to work well within a busy pharmacy team. A proactive approach and willingness to take ownership. A genuine focus on the patient and the quality of care they receive. Experience within digital, online, high-volume or private pharmacy would be great, but it is not essential. What matters is that you are comfortable adapting to a different way of working and are keen to learn. What do we offer? Full-time position: 40 hours per week. Working pattern: Monday to Friday, with Saturdays either worked as part of the shift pattern or available as overtime. Annual leave: 25 days, increasing to 27 days after one year and 30 days after three years, plus 8 bank holidays. Pension: Employer contribution of up to 5%. Private healthcare. Free onsite parking at our Winnersh location. Cycle to work scheme. Enhanced maternity and paternity leave. Career development: Opportunities to develop your skills and progress as Montu continues to grow. About Montu Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines. We are focused on improving patient access to treatment by bringing together clinical care, technology and pharmacy services to create a better experience for our patients. Our patients come to us for a wide range of conditions and many have already spent years navigating different treatments before reaching us. That is why the quality, safety and reliability of the service we provide really matters. We have grown quickly and continue to evolve, which means life at Montu can be fast paced. Processes improve, teams grow and the way we work continues to develop as we learn more about what our patients need. For our pharmacy team, that means combining pace with accuracy, working together and never losing sight of the person waiting for their medication at the other end. If you are looking for a pharmacy role that feels a little different and you want to be part of a growing area of healthcare, we would love to hear from you. description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. Perform test campaigns, analysing in real-time, through different test parameters and ensure test results with timely resolution of any anomaly arising during testing. Conduct pre-test and post-test reviews and elaborate the test reports. Update and correlate the fluidic models based on test results. Provide actionable insights to identify key performance indicators and potential critical scenarios What we would love to see from you: A minimum of a bachelor's degree in a related Engineering discipline. +3 years of related experience in complex fluid systems, fluidic modeling, data analysis and data post processing. Strong engineering fundamentals in thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, and combustion principles. Familiarity with test facilities, or storable propulsion systems is an asset Experience in propulsion systems storable or cryogenic fluidic systems is a plus. Proficiency in python for fluid analyses, data post processing and model anchoring. Experience in EcosimPro (or similar software) for the high fidelity analysis of numerical twins. Proficiency in conducting fluid analyses using classical hand calculations Excellent collaboration skills for working effectively across multidisciplinary teams. Fluency in English. Strong team player with a proactive mindset. Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done. Ability to communicate at all levels of the business. title: Intraday Power Trader (m/w/d)
description: Wir sind Impuls Energy Trading – ein junges, profitabel wachsendes Stromhandelsunternehmen mit Fokus auf erneuerbare Energien. Du erkennst Muster, interpretierst Erzeugungs-, Verbrauchs- und Wetterdaten und triffst Entscheidungen unter Zeitdruck, hochkonzentriert und mit einem Auge fürs Detail. An handelsfreien Tagen (rund ein Tag pro Woche) analysierst du Märkte, vertiefst dein Verständnis der europäischen Strommarkt-Mechanik und entwickelst und testest eigene Handelsstrategien. Du arbeitest im strukturierten Zwei-Schicht-System (Früh-/Spätschicht, keine Nachtschichten), dafür volle Präsenz zu den entscheidenden Marktzeiten. Du teilst relevante Marktbeobachtungen schnell und klar im Team, sorgst für saubere Übergaben und trägst dazu bei, dass wir als Trading-Desk gemeinsam besser werden. Qualifikation Du denkst in Wahrscheinlichkeiten und Erwartungswerten und entscheidest rational, auch wenn es schnell gehen muss. Du behältst unter Druck einen klaren Kopf : ohne Angst, ohne Gier, und ohne dich aus der Ruhe bringen zu lassen, wenn eine Entscheidung einmal gegen dich läuft. Du bringst echten, nachweisbaren Wettbewerbsgeist mit – idealerweise sichtbar in deinem Werdegang (z. B. Leistungssport, Poker, kompetitives Gaming, Wettbewerbe oder andere Felder, in denen Leistung zählt). Eine gewisse „positive Verrücktheit“ und die Fähigkeit richtig tief in eine Sache abtauchen zu können sind in diesem Markt ein entscheidender Vorteil. Du arbeitest eigenständig und verlässlich , übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst deine Ideen aktiv ins Team ein. Du bist kompetitiv, aber nicht ego-getrieben: Du willst gewinnen, teilst Informationen offen, gibst und nimmst Feedback und stellst die Qualität des Teams über den einzelnen Trade. Analytisches Denken, Mustererkennung und ein Gespür für Details gehören zu deinen Stärken. Ein quantitatives Studium (z. B. Mathematik, Physik, Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften) ist von Vorteil. Noch wichtiger ist uns aber der richtige Kopf – auch starke Quereinsteiger mit einem ansonsten starken Lebenslauf sind ausdrücklich willkommen. Benefits Steiler Lernpfad in einem agilen, technologiegetriebenen Team 30 Tage Urlaub und den 24. und 31. Märkte oder Performance, leitest daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ab & entwickelst auf dieser Basis Präsentationen für das Top-Management. description: Hi, we’re Back Market. We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . You will provision and run platform services as code, depending on the team, with a focus on Entra ID automation, a data platform on Azure or a Kafka platform on Kubernetes. Your tasks Provision platform services with infrastructure as code, using Terraform, Helm and GitLab Automate build, test and release processes and run CI/CD pipelines Operate and develop Azure Kubernetes and storage accounts Depending on the team, automate Entra ID, build a data platform on Azure Postgres with lakehouse technologies, or upgrade Confluent Kafka on Kubernetes Your profile German at C1 level or higher, the project language is German. Understanding of Swiss German is expected Very good Azure skills and experience with Kubernetes Infrastructure as code with Terraform DevOps toolchain with Git, GitLab, Docker and CI/CD Experience applying cloud security technologies Several years of experience at senior level Nice to have Go, Python or Bash OAuth, SAML, OpenID Connect and Conditional Access Iceberg or Delta, Denodo Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description: Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Senior System Engineer, der die Gestaltung, den Betrieb und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung moderner Datacenter-Umgebungen aktiv mitgestaltet. In dieser Position verbindest du fundiertes technisches Know-how mit operativer Verantwortung und treibst die Automatisierung, Optimierung von Services sowie die Weiterentwicklung zuverlässiger Infrastruktur-Lösungen voran. Aufgaben & Verantwortlichkeiten Du übernimmst die technische Verantwortung für definierte Infrastrukturplattformen, Services und Kundenumgebungen und fungierst als kompetente technische Ansprechperson. Du stellst die Verfügbarkeit, Leistungsfähigkeit und Sicherheit der Datacenter-Systeme und Managed Services sicher und optimierst diese kontinuierlich. Du identifizierst Potenziale zur Effizienzsteigerung durch Automatisierung, Standardisierung und die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Prozesse. Du gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung von Infrastruktur-Services aktiv mit – von technischen Konzepten über Service-Vorlagen bis hin zu Self-Service-Lösungen. Du koordinierst die Bearbeitung komplexer Incidents, Service Requests und Infrastrukturänderungen und bringst dich zudem im 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Support, in Kundenprojekten sowie beim Wissensaustausch ein. Anforderungen & Qualifikationen Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium im Bereich Informatik, IT oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Eine weiterführende technische Ausbildung ist von Vorteil. Du bringst mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Datacenter-Umfeld mit, insbesondere in den Bereichen Windows Server, Virtualisierung und komplexe Unternehmensinfrastrukturen. Du besitzt fundierte Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Backup & Recovery, Netzwerktechnologien und Infrastruktur-Lösungen. Erfahrung mit Veeam oder Fortinet ist ein Plus. Du hast Erfahrung im 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Support und verfügst über ein solides Verständnis von IT-Sicherheit, Datenschutz und Systemverfügbarkeit. Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert, verfügst über ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz und hast Freude an Automatisierung, kontinuierlicher Verbesserung und technischer Verantwortung. Benefits & Unternehmenskultur Ein kollegiales und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Eigeninitiative, Wissensaustausch und gemeinsamer Erfolg gefördert werden. Vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung durch Weiterbildungen, technische Schulungen und neue Herausforderungen. Flexible Arbeitsmodelle, eine positive Teamkultur und attraktive Zusatzleistungen, die eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance unterstützen. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Sentinel System Engineer - Post Launch Support
description: We are looking for a Sentinel System Engineer on behalf of the European Space Agency (ESA) for their location in Noordwijk, the Netherlands. Please note, the successful candidate will be employed by ATG Europe (or one of its subsidiaries). Furthermore, upon selection, they will be subject to a general security screening performed by an external provider (further information will be provided at the interview stage). ATG is dedicated to diversity and inclusion and is an equal opportunity employer. Regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, or any other reason protected by relevant state or municipal legislation, we are pleased to consider all eligible candidates for employment. The successful candidate will be tasked with, but not limited to: Coordinate the internal & external support to PLS (ESA Space Segment Development Team, TEC experts, Mission Analysis & System Support, Industry); Coordinate with the ESA Space Segment Development Team (where relevant) to exchange technical status on the flying- and non-flying satellite(s), identifying coordination issues of relevance and following them to conclusion; Support PLS at the regular (weekly) Operations Boards; Support the Operations Team(s) by providing or facilitating responses to technical support requests from either the Flight Operations Segment (FOS) or Payload Data Ground Segment (PDGS); Maintain & distribute the PLS On-Call lists to the FOS (& other parties where relevant) in a timely manner; Support the Mission Manager and his/her team by providing technical advice related to issues of Satellite(s) performance; Support the Space Segment Development Team(s) by providing timely & pertinent feedback on any issue detected in-flight with potential impact on satellite(s) still under development; Provide specific technical expertise to support Performance Monitoring, Analysis & Optimisation tasks and Anomaly Investigations, with overall aim to improve mission quality and/or lifetime; Preparation of Technical Documentation, such as Reports, Technical Notes and other requested documentation; Review and synthesis of Technical Reports and documents produced by Industry, and extraction of relevant technical information for use in generation of PLS Performance metrics and reports; Organise and support the 6-monthly Satellite In-Orbit Performance (SIOP) Technical Meetings in cooperation with the Industrial Prime contractor, including associated follow-up activities (eg. administration, actions follow up etc); Respond to Anomaly Warnings received from the Flight Operations Segment (FOS) in an appropriate & timely manner, providing support and facilitating the necessary follow-on actions; Support and lead complex investigations that arise as a result of satellite performance and anomalies, ensuring adequate coordination with involved partners (Mission Management, Operations Team(s), Industry, Space Segment Development Team(s), Management); Prepare, coordinate & follow-up on engineering requests for the Industrial contractors in support of Anomaly Investigations and other technical analyses; Support satellite configuration control including the Configuration Control Board (CCB); Support Satellite Decommissioning & Disposal activities as required; Monitor, track and report the status of activities performed by the Industrial contractors in support of the PLS function (technical, commercial and schedule status); Review commercial payment requests & the associated justifications submitted by Industry (regular milestones or as result of ad-hoc Cost Reimbursement activities); Bring innovation to satellite performance analysis by investigating emerging technologies that enhance the ability for early detection of performance trends and deviations; Maintain the relevant PLS technical records, databases & documentation in accordance with established procedures; Maintain a regular reporting in coordination with the Technical Officer. Please ensure that your CV clearly explains how you meet the mandatory requirements . If it doesn’t align completely with the essential criteria, it could result in rejection. Requirements University degree in a relevant Engineering discipline; Minimum 10 years of experience and a significant background in one or more of the following domains: Satellite Operations, Spacecraft Development (including Project Engineering, Equipment/Subsystem Procurement, Assembly Integration & Test); Minimum 3 years’ experience working as a System Engineer or with a System Coordination function in any of the above domains; Good understanding of the Satellite Phase E2 Routine Operations Organisation and the typical activities performed; Good understanding of the factors affecting the short- and long-term performance of Satellites and their main subsystems or payloads; Experience managing and leading technical meetings and discussions with multiple stakeholders; Proven experience & ability at working in an environment with multiple external interfaces; Good at working in a team and a proactive attitude to solving problems Autonomy in writing technical notes, specifications and reports in English; Good interpersonal skills and team spirit; Demonstrable multidisciplinary or system-level experience in the satellite engineering domain; Previous working experience in a multinational environment is desirable; Very good knowledge of MS Office tools; Fluency in English, both written and spoken; Candidates must be eligible to work in the EU. Please submit your application in English via the apply button below. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Data Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Du möchtest nicht nur Daten verarbeiten, sondern eine moderne Datenplattform entwickeln, die Analysen, Reporting und datengetriebene Entscheidungen im gesamten Unternehmen ermöglicht? Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für dich sein. Unser Kunde, ein dynamisch wachsende E-Commerce Service Agentur in Berlin , zählt zu den erfolgreichsten Amazon-Händlern Deutschlands und vertreibt tausende Produkte Für den weiteren Ausbau der Data & Analytics Landschaft wird eine Persönlichkeit gesucht, die moderne Datenarchitekturen entwickelt und den Weg zu einer datengetriebenen Organisation aktiv mitgestaltet Deine Benefits Attraktive Vergütung: Ein leistungsgerechtes Fixgehalt, das deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation entspricht. Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit 2 Home-Office Tagen, einer 40-Stunden-Woche, Gleitzeit mit Arbeitsbeginn zwischen 6:00 und 10:00 Uhr. Langfristige Sicherheit: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag sowie 30 Urlaubstage in einem wirtschaftlich erfolgreichen und zukunftssicheren Unternehmen. Weiterentwicklung: Ob fachlich oder persönlich – deine Entwicklung wird aktiv gefördert und langfristig begleitet. Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Freue dich auf ein modernes Büro im Berliner Bezirk Lichtenberg. Mobilität: Ob mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln oder dem Auto – profitiere von einem bezuschussten Jobticket oder kostenlosen Parkplätzen direkt am Büro. Teamkultur: Flache Hierarchien, offene Kommunikation, eine gelebte Du-Kultur und regelmäßige Team- sowie Firmenevents wie „Grill & Chill“ sorgen für ein starkes Miteinander. Verpflegung: Kostenlose Getränke sowie frisches Obst stehen dir im Arbeitsalltag jederzeit zur Verfügung. Mitarbeitervorteile: Profitiere von attraktiven Mitarbeiterrabatten auf das Sortiment sowie weiteren Corporate Benefits. Deine Aufgaben Als Data Engineer entwickelst und betreibst du moderne Datenplattformen in Microsoft Azure und Microsoft Fabric und sorgst dafür, dass hochwertige Daten zuverlässig für Analysen, Reporting und Machine-Learning-Anwendungen bereitstehen. Data Engineering: Konzeption, Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung moderner Datenpipelines in Microsoft Azure und Microsoft Fabric. Datenqualität: Sicherstellung einer hohen Datenqualität, Vollständigkeit und Reproduzierbarkeit sowie Implementierung effizienter inkrementeller Datenladeprozesse. Datenintegration: Entwicklung und Pflege effizienter ETL-/ELT-Prozesse sowie API-basierter Datenintegrationen. Plattformbetrieb: Entwicklung robuster Monitoring-, Logging- und Fehlerbehandlungskonzepte sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung von Performance, Kosten und Datenworkflows. Data Architecture: Mitarbeit am Aufbau einer skalierbaren Datenarchitektur inklusive Test-, Staging- und Produktionsumgebungen sowie moderner Technologien wie CI/CD, Fabric Pipelines, dbt oder Airflow. Zusammenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung mit dem Head of Data & Analytics und den Data Analysts zur Bereitstellung hochwertiger Daten für Power BI Dashboards und Machine-Learning-Modelle. Dein Profil als Data Engineer Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von Datenpipelines oder Datenplattformen – idealerweise auf Senior-Level, motivierte Mid-Level-Profile sind ebenfalls willkommen. Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Azure Data Services , insbesondere Data Factory und/oder Azure Synapse ; idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung mit Microsoft Fabric . Sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL und Python , insbesondere im Bereich ETL-/ELT-Prozesse und Automatisierung. Erfahrung in der Datenmodellierung , idealerweise mit Bronze-, Silver- und Gold-Layer-Architekturen . Kenntnisse im Datenqualitätsmanagement sowie in Monitoring, Logging und Performance-Optimierung . Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Umsetzung technischer Projekte sowie eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise. Ausgeprägte Teamorientierung sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld. Fließende Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse. Bei geringeren Deutschkenntnissen (ab B1) werden dafür sehr gute Englischkenntnisse vorausgesetzt. Nice-to-haves – jedes zusätzliche Know-how ist ein Pluspunkt: Erfahrung mit inkrementellen Ladeprozessen und Delta-Verarbeitung . Erfahrung in der Datenintegration für Power BI sowie im Umgang mit semantischen Modellen. Kenntnisse im E-Commerce- oder Amazon-Umfeld . Erfahrung mit API-basierten Datenintegrationen . Kenntnisse in CI/CD , z. B. mit GitHub Actions oder Azure DevOps . Interesse an Machine Learning und dem Aufbau datengetriebener Organisationen. Erfahrung mit Openbridge . Die Rolle als Data Engineer klingt genau nach dir? Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und wir geben dir in einem kurzen Telefonat alle weiteren Infos zu Stelle und Unternehmen. description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h2>What You’ll Do:</h2> <p>The Southern Europe Sales organization is responsible for establishing CoreWeave as the preferred AI cloud platform for enterprises, AI labs, digital-native companies, and emerging AI builders across France, Italy, Iberia, and the wider Mediterranean region. The team creates new markets, develops strategic customer relationships, and helps customers use CoreWeave’s infrastructure and software platform to build, deploy, and scale the next generation of AI.</p> <p><strong>About the role: </strong>The Senior Director of Sales, Southern Europe reports to the VP and Managing Director of EMEA. As the senior sales leader for the region, you will own CoreWeave’s commercial strategy and execution across all customer segments, with responsibility for both new-logo acquisition and the growth of existing customers. You will inherit an established customer base and a team spanning Account Executives, Account Managers, and Account Solutions Architects, while carrying a significant mandate to design and build the broader regional coverage model. This is a hands-on, first-on-the-ground leadership role for someone who can build the business, recruit and develop exceptional talent, and support market growth in coordination with EMEA leadership, and personally lead the region’s most strategic customer opportunities.</p> <ul> <li>Own the Southern Europe business, including regional strategy, revenue performance, consumption growth, pipeline creation, customer acquisition, retention, and expansion.</li> <li>Develop and execute a multi-year market-capture plan across France, Italy, Iberia, and the wider Mediterranean region, aligned to CoreWeave’s EMEA and global priorities.</li> <li>Design the regional segmentation, territory, account, and coverage model across Enterprise, AI Labs, Digital Natives, and Startup customers.</li> Account Executives and Account Managers, establishing clear expectations, strong inspection disciplines, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Partner closely with Account Solutions Architects to connect customer business objectives with CoreWeave’s infrastructure, platform, and developer capabilities.</li> <li>Personally develop relationships with senior executives, founders, technical leaders, and strategic stakeholders across the region.</li> <li>Lead from the front on the region’s most strategic opportunities, remaining actively involved from initial engagement through solution development, commercial negotiation, and closure, with final contracting execution by EMEA/HQ.</li> <li>Own the acquisition of new strategic customers while developing account strategies that increase adoption, consumption, retention, and long-term customer value across the existing customer base.</li> <li>Build a high-quality, appropriately covered pipeline and establish a consistent operating cadence for opportunity inspection, account planning, forecasting, risk management, and corrective action.</li> <li>Deliver accurate and transparent forecasts, with clear visibility into customer demand, consumption, commercial risk, capacity requirements, and execution dependencies.</li> <li>Develop and close, subject to HQ review and execution, capacity, investment, and go-to-market decisions reflect the opportunities and needs of Southern Europe.</li> <li>Establish CoreWeave’s reputation in the region through active participation in the AI, technology, business, research, and investment communities.</li> <li>Build a regional culture that reflects CoreWeave’s values, rewards ownership, develops talent, encourages collaboration, and delivers best-in-class customer experiences.</li> </ul> <h2>Who You Are:</h2> <ul> <li>15+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, including significant experience selling cloud sales talent, including leaders and senior individual contributors.</li> <li>The ability to engage credibly with both commercial and deeply technical audiences, translating customer objectives into infrastructure and platform strategies.</li> <li>Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience structuring complex agreements and balancing customer requirements with capacity, risk, margin, and long-term strategic value.</li> <li>A hands-on leadership style and willingness to remain personally involved in strategic selling, executive engagement, and critical negotiations.</li> <li>Proven <li>The ability to travel frequently across the region and internationally as required.</li> </ul> <h2>Preferred:</h2> <ul> <li>Leadership experience within an AI cloud, hyperscale cloud, Reporting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop forecasting and demand analysis reports.</li> <li>Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs) such as:</li> <li>Identify trends and recommend corrective actions to improve supply chain efficiency.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, Engineering, Operations Management, Business, or related field.</li> <li>5+ years of experience in supply chain planning, customer service, operations, or engineering support.</li> <li>Experience working in a customer-facing or cross-functional planning role.</li> <li>Strong understanding of inventory management, demand planning, and supply chain processes.</li> <li>Proficiency in ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics.</li> <li>Advanced Microsoft Excel and data analysis skills.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities.</li> <li>Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>APICS/ASCM CPIM, CSCP, or similar certification.</li> <li>Experience in semiconductor, industrial equipment, manufacturing, tools.</li> <li>Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Apply today to be part of title: Supply Data Analyst
description: Location: Any MSF office* Contract: 100% Duration: 12 months Starting date: 04th of January 2027 Deadline to apply: 01st of December 2026 Compensation and Benefits: MSF practice is to offer the compensation and benefits package in line with the MSF entity offering the contract *By default, the successful candidate will be offered a contract in the MSF office, able to issue a contract, of their country of residence at the time of application. If no MSF office exists in their country of residence, the successful candidate will be expected to relocate to a country where an MSF office can issue a contract, provided the local legislation allows for that. At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics. MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. The successful candidate will be expected to comply with the organisation’s safeguarding policies and standards of professional behaviour. We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process. MSF International Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 26 sections, 28 associations and 16 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested. I. CONTEXT MSF consists of 6 Operational Centres (OCs) and 3 European Supply Centres (ESCs). In the supply domain there is a joint Supply Tansformational Topics Roadmap composed by several inter-OC and inter-ESC projects, and their number is growing due to the need to increase cooperation between MSF entities while improving the quality of MSF's supply chain. The capacity to measure performance and analyse data across different entities is therefore essential and is contributing to MSF ambitions on interoperability and climate. The role of the International Office is to foster cooperation and coordination between MSF entities. The Supply Data Analyst will therefore act as a facilitator between the OCs and ESCs: bringing their representatives together, helping them build shared approaches on supply data and performance, and turning these agreements into concrete deliverables. The Global Supply Data & Analytics (GSDA) team (previously SCPM) has been actively working to build the analytical and data foundations needed to support a global approach to supply chain performance management, and to contribute to the governance of supply data across entities. The team is led by the Supply Chain Analytics Manager and includes one Data Analysts and one data governance specialist; the Supply Data Analyst will join it as an additional analyst. Reporting hierarchically and functionally to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager, the Supply Data Analyst will: collaborate closely with the supply chain professionals responsible for BI and performance management within the 6 OCs and 3 ESCs; work in close link with the ShARP (Shared Analytics and Reporting Project) team in SITS (Shared IT Services); on the existing UniField intersection reports; work alongside the GSDA team and the IO Supply team on projects related to supply chain data analytics; and interact with stakeholders across MSF, including finance, IT, medical, pharmacy, logistics and operations teams. II. PURPOSE OF THE JOB The Supply Data Analyst supports supply chain performance analysis and decision making across MSF by delivering reliable data, KPIs, reports and actionable recommendations. The position also fosters cooperation between the OCs and ESCs around shared supply data, turning agreements into concrete deliverables. Within GSDA, the Supply Data Analyst will support the growing need for data management, reporting and analytics from the supply chain teams, including the monitoring of KPIs and the analysis of data coming from MSF information systems (such as UniField, Isystock or Akiba). III. ACCOUNTABILITIES The Supply Data Analyst is accountable for the following expected results and the activities deployed to achieve them. 1. UniField intersection reports are reliable, relevant and meet the needs of the OCs a. Take over the existing UniField intersection reports in close link with the ShARP team and improve them (reliability, relevance, usability) based on users' feedback and identified gaps b. Collect the reporting needs of each OC and consolidate them into a clear, prioritised set of requirements c. Design and deliver new intersection reports in coordination with the ShARP team, with validation from the OC representatives 2. Supply data is available and of reliable quality for analysis a. Extract, clean and consolidate supply data from UniField and other information systems b. Check data consistency and quality, and report anomalies to the relevant teams c. Document data sources, definitions and calculation methods 3. KPIs and reporting solutions support decision making a. Calculate and update a set of KPIs on a regular basis, in coordination with the teams concerned b. Build and maintain ad hoc data reporting solutions (Power BI) providing visuals that accurately summarise supply chain activities while providing actionable insights c. Support the teams in the definition of additional KPIs as needs arise 4. Stakeholders receive relevant data analysis and actionable recommendations a. Support stakeholders on supply data analysis b. Respond to ad hoc data and analysis requests using supply data from different stakeholders (supply, finance, medical…) c. Present analysis results and recommendations in a clear way to non-technical audiences 5. Cooperation between the OCs and ESCs on supply data produces concrete deliverables a. Convene and facilitate working groups and meetings with representatives of each OC and ESC, from preparation (agenda, pre-alignment of positions) to follow-up (minutes, actions, deadlines) b. Lead discussions between entities with different needs and practices, and build compromises and consensus on shared definitions, KPIs and ways of working c. Turn agreements into concrete deliverables (e.g., shared KPI definitions, dashboards, documentation) and follow their delivery 6. Data-related tools and processes improve continuously and stakeholders are kept informed a. Contribute to the improvement of data-related tools and processes within the team b. Proactively identify data needs, risks and improvement opportunities, and propose solutions autonomously c. Manage stakeholders and expectations: identify their needs, keep them informed, and escalate blockers to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager when needed IV. AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY Challenges and decisions that the job faces to achieve the accountabilities: Autonomy to think and act: works with limited supervision; takes initiative, prioritises and drives work to completion, proactively identifies data needs, risks and improvement opportunities, and escalates blockers to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager when needed. Complexity of the environment: works across 6 OCs and 3 ESCs with different needs, practices and information systems (UniField, Isystock, Akiba); builds compromises on shared definitions and KPIs, handles multiple priorities at once, and interacts with technical and non-technical stakeholders (finance, IT, medical, pharmacy, logistics, operations) in a cross-cultural and cross-functional environment. SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others. Education Bachelor's level or above in data analytics, statistics, business management, supply chain or a related field, or a combination of relevant education and professional experience (essential) Experience Minimum of 2 years of experience as Data Analyst (essential) Direct work experience involving significant data management (essential) Experience in facilitating meetings or working groups involving multiple stakeholders and in delivering concrete outputs from them (essential) Supply chain, logistics and Finance experience in NGO's operational settings (desirable) Previous work experience with UniField, MSF's main ERP software (desirable) Skills Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills: ability to bring together representatives of different entities, lead effective meetings, negotiate compromises and deliver concrete outcomes Strong analytical skills Good organisational skills, ability to handle multiple priorities at one time Autonomous and proactive: ability to take initiative, prioritise and drive work to completion with limited supervision Good level skills in Excel, Power BI and database management Ability to work in a cross-cultural and cross-functional environment Drive for change, improvement and innovation Languages Fluent spoken and written English (essential) Good command of French (strongly desirable) Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms their understanding and acceptance of these recruitment procedures. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Chief Business Officer (gn) @ Clean Data Centres Venture, France (hybrid)
description: This is an Atlantic porfolio company. The opportunity Demand for AI compute is outrunning the infrastructure to deliver it, and the environmental bill is growing with it: more fossil power, more freshwater, more land. New capacity on land also means waiting years for power, sites and permits. We take a different route: we bring compute to the power. Far offshore, the wind blows stronger and steadier than anywhere on land, and no grid will ever reach it. Using it lets AI scale without adding carbon or competing with communities and nature for water and land. We're building fleets of autonomous ships that turn that wind into AI compute at sea. Each ship carries its own wind turbines and computing on board, and navigates on its own across the open ocean, following the strongest and steadiest winds. No mooring, no cables to shore: the fleet goes where the energy is. It's AI infrastructure built from the ground up for the open ocean, from power systems and autonomy to high-density computing, engineered to run in one of the harshest environments on Earth. No grid queue. No freshwater. No land. Zero-carbon compute that scales with the fleet. Firm, low-carbon power at a target cost of ~€50/MWh, one of the biggest costs in running AI compute 70%+ capacity factor: offshore wind that behaves like baseload First demonstrator at sea in late 2027 Founded in 2025 by repeat entrepreneurs and industrial leaders. Backed by major international investors. The mandate You'll work directly with the CEO and the board and own the company's business strategy as we go from first demonstrator to fleet. Our platform opens several paths to value across compute and infrastructure, from capacity to hardware to the services around them. You'll decide which to pursue first, build them into the core of the company, and open new ones as the fleet grows. What you'll own Business model & strategy. Shape the business model and evolve it as we scale: products, markets, pricing and unit economics. Turn a breakthrough technology into a bankable one. Strategic partnerships. Decide which partners and customers we build the company with, from AI labs and cloud providers to chipmakers and sovereign compute programmes, and secure the relationships that shape our first fleet. Capital strategy. Work with the CEO on how the business case underpins project finance and fundraising, and own that story with investors and the board. Product direction. Make sure what we build at sea is shaped by where the market is going, working hand in hand with our marine, power and systems engineers. Ecosystem & alliances. Build the partnerships a new infrastructure class needs: chip and systems vendors, cloud platforms, data center operators, ports and financiers. Category leadership. Be our external voice on summit stages, with policymakers and in the press, and make us the reference for AI infrastructure at sea. The business organisation. Build and lead the team across strategy, partnerships and commercial that takes us from demonstrator to fleet. Who you are You've built businesses in deep tech or infrastructure. You've led strategy, business development or a P&L in AI, cloud, data centers or semiconductors, and shaped large, multi-year partnerships. You've taken frontier technology to market. You've brought new, capital-intensive technology to its first major customers and closed the off-take agreements, capacity reservations or long-term contracts that made it bankable. You build, not just run. You've built something from zero, whether a company, a business line or a market, and you're at your best when the playbook doesn't exist yet. You see the whole board. You move between unit economics, partnerships, financing and long-term strategy in the same afternoon. You know AI infrastructure from the inside. Compute economics, workload constraints, and where the market is heading. Compute and infrastructure are your world. GPUs, data centers, power and the economics that tie them together. You hold your own with engineers and turn technical depth into business strategy. The mission matters to you. A business built on AI infrastructure at sea excites you, and you want your work to help AI grow without costing the planet. You work in English. Fluent English is required; French is a plus. How you operate Ownership. You treat the company's outcomes as your own, well beyond your remit. First principles. You reason from the economics and the physics, not from how the market has always worked. Bold and rigorous. You make big bets and do the work to back them. AI-native. You use modern tools to think, decide and move faster. Why this role A C-level mandate across strategy, product and capital, working directly with the CEO and the board The chance to define how compute infrastructure at sea becomes a business, and to keep redefining it as it scales An uncompromising team of repeat entrepreneurs and industrial leaders, backed by top-tier international capital Based wherever you do your best work, with a global mandate and flexible hours. title: Offre de stage de recherche Master 2 ou dernière année d’école d’ingénieur
description: Dates : 6 mois à partir de février ou mars 2027 Contexte du projet : L’allègement des structures automobiles reste un levier majeur pour réduire la consommation et les émissions des véhicules, tout en répondant à des exigences croissantes de rigidité et de tenue au crash. Les pièces de caisse en blanc sont en grande majorité réalisées à partir de tôles d’acier mises en forme, dont la conception repose encore largement sur l’expertise et sur des itérations successives entre calcul et dessin. L’optimisation topologique permet de déterminer la meilleure répartition de matière dans un domaine de conception donné. Appliquée à un domaine volumique 3D, elle conduit cependant à des structures massives ou de type treillis, difficilement transposables en pièces embouties d’épaisseur quasi constante. Le défi scientifique consiste à formuler une méthode capable de faire émerger, à partir d’un domaine volumique, des géométries représentatives de tôles (structures à parois minces), en maîtrisant l’épaisseur et la fabricabilité, sous chargements statiques puis dynamiques. Ce stage s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une collaboration de recherche entre le LTDS et ArcelorMittal Global R&D. Il a vocation à se poursuivre par une thèse CIFRE en cas de résultats concluants. L’objectif du stage sera de développer et d’évaluer une première méthodologie d’optimisation topologique 3D aboutissant à une solution en tôle d’acier, en s’appuyant sur une structure automobile. Les missions pourront comprendre : •Un état de l’art des méthodes d’optimisation topologique conduisant à des structures minces de type coque (contrôle d’épaisseur par filtrage et projection, contraintes de longueur caractéristique, approches par composants explicites ou level-set). •Le développement d’un algorithme d’optimisation 3D appliqué à une pièce automobile soumise à des chargements statiques. •L’extension de la méthode à des solutions plus avancées proposées par ArcelorMittal. Les missions pourront être adaptées en fonction du profil du candidat et de l’avancement du projet. Profil recherché : étudiant(e) en Master 2 ou équivalent (stage ingénieur) dans le domaine de la mécanique numérique, du calcul des structures ou des mathématiques appliquées. Compétences souhaitées : méthode des éléments finis, optimisation numérique, programmation scientifique (Python, MATLAB ou C++). Des connaissances en optimisation topologique ou en dynamique rapide (LS-DYNA, Radioss) seront appréciées. Encadrement : Frédéric Gillot (LTDS, École Centrale de Lyon) ; Daoming Yu, Alexandre Blaise et Cristian Alvarez (ArcelorMittal Global R&D). L’accueil au laboratoire est soumis à une autorisation préalable (procédure FSD, 2 à 3 mois de délai) : les candidatures (CV, lettre de motivation, relevés de notes) sont à adresser dès que possible. title: CDI - Senior AI Engineer - Paris
description: <h2>Mission</h2> <p>De nouveaux modèles, ouverts ou fermés, sortent chaque mois : encore faut-il choisir ceux qui sont assez bons pour la production, et le démontrer. Applications et agents s’appuient sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), et la partie modèle de ces systèmes est entre vos mains. Nos clients s’en servent pour répondre à leurs propres clients, traiter des documents et interroger leurs connaissances.</p> <p>Ce que le modèle voit, la manière dont il retrouve les connaissances, les outils qu’il peut appeler : ces choix vous appartiennent, de même que la mesure de la qualité des réponses. Le modèle retenu doit tenir l’objectif de coût et de qualité.</p> <p><strong>Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez savoir si un système d’IA donne des réponses justes, et pas seulement s’il tourne.</strong></p> <p>Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype AI Engineer.</p> <p> </p> <h2>Activités et responsabilités</h2> <p>Les Product Engineers construisent l’application autour du modèle ; le comportement du modèle à l’intérieur vous revient. Les Context & Analytics Engineers préparent les connaissances que vos agents retrouvent, et les Platform Engineers exploitent le serving, le harness et l’observabilité sur lesquels vous vous appuyez.</p> <p>Avec l’AI Product Manager et les experts métier du client, une bonne réponse se définit, puis les résultats s’examinent ensemble. La relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues font partie du quotidien.</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Construire des applications et des agents LLM : conception du contexte, appel d’outils, workflows multi-étapes.</li> <li>Concevoir la façon dont les agents exploitent les connaissances : requêtes de retrieval, re-ranking, citations.</li> <li>Construire des jeux et des pipelines d’évaluation : réponses de référence, scoring automatisé, relecture par des experts métier.</li> <li>Suivre la qualité des réponses en production et corriger ce qui se dégrade.</li> <li>Choisir les modèles selon la qualité, le coût et la latence ; faire du fine-tuning ou de la distillation sur un modèle plus petit quand le prompting ne suffit pas.</li> <li>Ajouter des garde-fous contre les mauvaises réponses, les fuites de données et le prompt injection.</li> <li>Traiter des documents avec des LLM : extraction, classification, résumés.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>Profil recherché</h2> <p><strong>Les indispensables :</strong></p> <ol> <li>Vous avez construit une application ou un agent qui appelle un LLM, et vous savez expliquer ce qui a fonctionné et ce qui a échoué.</li> <li>Votre code est testé et maintenable.</li> <li>Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.</li> <li>La qualité des sorties d’IA se mesure chez vous avec des jeux de test et des métriques, et vous savez limiter les hallucinations, le prompt injection et les fuites de données.</li> <li>Mettre en production une application LLM et la maintenir (déploiement, monitoring, coût, latence) n’a pas de secret pour vous.</li> <li>Le point de départ, pour vous, est le problème métier plutôt que le modèle ; reconnaître que l’IA n’est pas toujours le bon outil, et l’expliquer à des personnes non techniques, fait partie de votre pratique.</li> </ol> <p><strong>Un plus, pas un prérequis :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Du fine-tuning ou de la distillation de modèles de langage.</li> <li>Une formation en machine learning ou en statistiques, par exemple en data science.</li> <li>Des frameworks ou des protocoles d’agents, comme MCP.</li> <li>Des entrées multimodales : documents, images, voix.</li> <li>Des outils d’observabilité LLM : tracing, suivi des coûts.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler</strong> : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.</p> <p> </p> <h2>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</h2> <p>Dans ce métier, la difficulté est moins de faire parler un modèle que de savoir s’il dit juste. L’AI Engineer répond à cette question par la mesure : jeux de test, évaluations, suivi en production, plutôt que par l’impression d’une démonstration réussie.</p> <p>Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.</p> <p>Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.</p> <p>Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.</p> <p>Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.</p> <p>Le reste s’approfondit sur les projets : évaluation, conception d’agents, adaptation de modèles, avec l’appui de la communauté AI Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype AI Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (responsabilité en production, bases de la sécurité de l’IA).</p> <p>Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.</p> <p> </p> <h2>Processus de recrutement</h2> <p>Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.</p> <ol> <li><strong>Entretien RH</strong> (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.</li> <li><strong>Appel avec le CTO</strong> (15 à 30 min, à distance).</li> <li><strong>Screening technique</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.</li> <li><strong>Code review et live coding</strong> (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.</li> <li><strong>Cas technique</strong> (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.</li> <li><strong>Entretien final</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.</li> </ol> <p>Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Rémunération </strong>: 53 000€ à 70 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + variable selon expérience et séniorité</p> <p> </p> <p><em>Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.</em></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Solutions Architect, APJC (Developer Platform) - Mandarin Speaking
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. title: Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer
description: Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously. About the Job The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. You will build control modules that run on many different machines , across many sites, with different soil conditions. We’re looking for a roboticist with data driven planning and/or control background, deep python expertise and good level of C++ proficiency. To be successful in this role you should have experience working with real robots, tackling the challenges of sim2real transfer, and deploying robotic systems in a production environment. What you will do Learning-Based Planning and Control for Real Systems Develop data driven planning and control systems for autonomous excavation that generalize across machine models and soil conditions Contribute to simulation improvements that reduce or address the sim2real gap Define data collection and curation pipelines for incorporating real data in policy training Design experiments focused on continuous performance and robustness improvements. Explore the usage of adaptive and online reinforcement learning in deployed systems Provide mentorship and supervision for junior team members, interns, and students. System Integration Integrate learned components into a larger software stack Collaborate with excavation and motion planning engineers Build tools for analysing and evaluating the behavior of learned components What we’re looking for We recognize that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with various combinations of skills. If you meet most of the core qualifications below, we highly encourage you to apply. Core qualifications 2–5 years industry experience developing Reinforcement learning systems for control and/or planning and deploying them on real robots with a customer. If you only have experience with simulation, you’re most likely not a good fit for this position. Experience with GPU accelerated simulation environments (e.g. IsaacSim/IsaacLab, CARLA, MuJoCo) Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch or similar libraries Proficiency in C++ Comfortable debugging real-world system behavior Ability and willingness to travel as required by business projects. Great-to-Have Skills & Experience Experience with hydraulic machinery Experience with supervised learning or imitation learning Research experience in reinforcement learning Experience deploying robotic systems at scale (e.g. hundreds of units) Familiarity with ROS or similar robotics frameworks Experience with feature-flagged deployments, staged rollouts, or long-lived platforms Experience with data curation for ML applications Experience guiding, mentoring, or leading junior colleagues, students, or project teams. Familiarity with or interest in utilizing AI coding tools. This Role is a Great Fit If You are passionate about building systems that work reliably in the real world You want to help build a long-lived excavation planning and control system intended to scale and positively impact the entire construction industry. You are comfortable working with the realities of imperfect data and noisy measurements. You have a keen interest in bridging the sim2real gap and understanding the differences between simulation and physical environments. You are excited to help drive technical direction in a growing team transitioning from prototyping to the product stage. description: Ekimetrics est un leader mondial de l'efficacité marketing et commerciale et des solutions d'IA à l'échelle. Depuis 2006, nous aidons les entreprises à optimiser leur marketing et leurs opérations en combinant IA avec expertise business et technologique dans 4 domaines : Marketing & commercial effectiveness, Customer analytics, Operational excellence, ESG & sustainability. Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous concevons des solutions sur mesure qui transforment les données en impact positif concret, grâce à une combinaison unique de technologie et de services. Notre force est de déployer une IA à impact, à grande échelle. Notre mission : mobiliser cette puissance pour répondre aux défis les plus urgents de notre temps. Nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un impact constant à grande échelle, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN. Contexte Les modèles marketing sont mis à jour à mesure que de nouvelles données arrivent : ventes hebdomadaires, résultats de campagnes, comportement des clients. Ils comprennent les marketing mix models (MMM), qui estiment le retour sur investissement de chaque canal média, ainsi que les modèles de demande et de promotion et les modèles de réponse client. Chaque mise à jour fait bouger les estimations, et la première question des métiers est : pourquoi ont-elles bougé ? Notre équipe a développé une méthode qui y répond de façon exacte pour les modèles bayésiens. Elle répartit le déplacement de toute quantité a posteriori entre des groupes d'observations : semaines, campagnes, régions, segments de clients ou expériences. La méthode est en cours d'évaluation par les pairs. Un premier prototype sur le MMM suit déjà une estimation semaine après semaine et lève une alerte quand une mise à jour la déplace plus que prévu. Sujet : pourquoi l'estimation a-t-elle bougé ? Attribution bayésienne en ligne pour les modèles marketing. Volet recherche (environ 3 mois) • Étendre l'attribution à l'apprentissage bayésien en ligne : mises à jour séquentielles, effets variables dans le temps (modèles linéaires dynamiques, filtre de Kalman), oubli des données anciennes. • Distinguer les trois causes d'un déplacement à chaque mise à jour : les nouvelles données, un vrai changement du marché et une erreur dans un flux de données. • Calibrer l'alerte de mise à jour : taux de fausses alertes et délai de détection, sur des données simulées dont la vérité est connue et sur des données publiques, pour le MMM et pour au moins un autre modèle marketing. • Rédiger un article destiné à un public de statistique ou de marketing science. Volet produit (environ 3 mois) • Transformer la méthode en un module Python testé, compatible avec nos outils de modélisation bayésienne (le MMM en premier). • Construire les sorties destinées aux métiers : une vue « ce qui a fait bouger l'estimation » et une alerte de mise à jour. • Les valider avec des consultants sur des cas réels, puis les documenter et les transmettre à l'équipe produit. Livrables attendus • Un article soumis à une revue ou une conférence à comité de lecture. • Un module Python testé et documenté, intégré à nos outils de modélisation. • Un guide court pour les consultants : comment lire et expliquer une attribution. Profil • Étudiant ou étudiante en dernière année de master ou d'école d'ingénieurs, en statistique, science des données ou probabilités. • Statistique bayésienne (prior, posterior, MCMC), et idéalement séries temporelles ou modèles à espace d'états. • Bonne maîtrise de Python (NumPy, une librairie de programmation probabiliste comme PyMC ou NumPyro), Git, tests unitaires. • Intérêt pour l'application de la statistique au marketing et pour l'explication des résultats à des non-spécialistes. Aucune connaissance préalable en marketing n'est requise. Rédaction claire en anglais. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
