Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu , que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte. Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même. En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations. Nous sommes également certifiés Great Place to Work© en France, au Royaume-Uni et aux Etats-Unis, et notre bureau de Hong Kong a reçu le prix Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2023©. Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 !Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux. title: Intern AI Researcher: Anomaly Detection for Predictive Maintenance in Distributed Storage
description: About Scality Scality builds data infrastructure software for enterprise AI, cyber resilience, and sovereign control at multi-petabyte to exabyte scale. Its AI Data Infrastructure platform reduces operational burden through AI-powered autonomous operations while aligning the right storage media, performance, and protection to each workload through human-approved lifecycle policies. Built on CORE5 cyber resilience and open-code principles, Scality software delivers extreme performance, operational simplicity, and sustainable economics. The world's most demanding enterprises and government organizations depend on Scality to power AI initiatives, defend critical data, and build infrastructure that lasts for decades. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality is where AI remembers, learns, and thinks. F Follow us on LinkedIn. Visit www.scality.com and our blog. Context & Motivation A distributed storage cluster continuously emits telemetry at every level, from the platform and S3 service down to each server and disk. A failing disk, server or storage node leaves traces in these multivariate time series, from subtle shifts in a few metrics to system-wide disruption. Detecting and diagnosing these anomalies early is critical for: Predictive maintenance: isolating or replacing a component before it impacts service Faster diagnosis: pointing support engineers to the root cause, not just to an alert Higher availability and durability of customer data This internship is part of a joint research project between Scality and an INRIA research team. The project released SHAD (Scality High-dimensional Anomaly Detection), an open benchmark published at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations & Datasets Track). It contains 215 real 171-dimensional time series from Scality RING clusters, annotated for injected disk, server and storage-node failures. SHAD's baselines show the problem is far from solved. No detector handles every failure type, per-dimension attributions find root causes no better than chance, and off-the-shelf LLMs cannot interpret the anomalies. This internship builds on SHAD to close these gaps. More details on the project: scality.github.io/shad Your Mission As part of our R&D team and in close collaboration with INRIA researchers, you will develop AI models that detect, explain and interpret anomalies in storage-cluster telemetry. Your work will include: 1. State of the Art Review the literature and open-source projects on multivariate time series anomaly detection, root-cause attribution and LLM-based interpretation of time series. Also survey recent work on AI agents that automate research and experimentation. Starting points include SHAD and the TSB-AD benchmark. 2. Anomaly Detection & Diagnosis Models Design, train and benchmark models that improve on SHAD's baselines at each stage of the pipeline: Detection that stays accurate across disk, server and storage-node failures (e.g., ensembles, hybrid models, time series foundation models) Explanation: attributing each anomaly to the dimensions that actually cause it Interpretation: turning detections into actionable diagnoses (failure type, criticality, affected component) Early detection of progressive degradations, the core of predictive maintenance 3. Fleets of AI Agents for Research Set up and manage fleets of AI agents that run your studies at scale: Design agent workflows that launch experiments, run benchmarks and compare methods Orchestrate and monitor many agents working in parallel Build safeguards for rigor: experiment tracking, reproducibility, independent verification of results Assess what agent-driven research changes in practice: speed, coverage, failure modes 4. Evaluation & Validation Evaluate every model with rigorous, reproducible protocols. Use them to: Measure each stage with SHAD's metrics (VUS-PR for detection, NDCG for explanation, a questionnaire for interpretation) Quantify performance per failure family and scenario Identify which approaches are ready to transfer to production monitoring Expected Outcomes & Valorization Depending on results, the work may be valorized through: A scientific publication with the Scality and INRIA researchers New methods and baselines contributed to the open-source SHAD benchmark Reusable agent-based research workflows for the R&D team Technical Stack Python (primary language for modeling, experimentation and analysis) PyTorch and scikit-learn (deep learning and classical models) SHAD benchmark (github.com/scality/shad) and TSB-AD (github.com/TheDatumOrg/TSB-AD) for data, detectors and evaluation LLM-based AI agents and their orchestration tooling Candidate Profile Final-year student in a Master's program or Engineering school (Bac+5), in machine learning, data science or computer science Solid foundations in machine learning; experience with time series or anomaly detection is a strong plus Strong interest in LLMs and AI agents, and curiosity for new ways of doing research Good Python skills and hands-on experience with a deep learning framework such as PyTorch Rigorous and critical with experimental results, especially when agents produce them Autonomous and curious, able to communicate results clearly in written and spoken English Interest in distributed systems or storage is a plus, not a prerequisite Work Environment You will join a fast-paced, lean AI R&D team. French and English is our primary working language. You will benefit from: Mentorship from R&D engineers Close collaboration with INRIA researchers working on time series anomaly detection Access to real telemetry from Scality RING clusters and to the AI agent tooling the team uses for its studies A high-trust environment where your findings will directly influence engineering decisions Why Join Scality? Work on a concrete research problem with real-world industrial impact Build on a benchmark published at NeurIPS and contribute to open research Practice a new way of doing research, with fleets of AI agents as research assistants Be part of a team building infrastructure trusted by Fortune 500 companies Potential to publish research or continue as a full-time engineer after the internship Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Asset Manager
description: ABOUT US P3 is a long-term investor, manager and developer of European warehouse properties with more than 10.2 million m² of assets under management and land bank of 1.7 million m² of future gross lettable area for further development. P3 has commercial activities in 11 countries and has been investing and developing in European markets for over two decades. And because we care about our customers and communities where we operate, we develop environmentally friendly, sustainable warehouses to the highest international standards. Headquartered in Prague, P3 employs more than 320 people with 25+ nationalities across 11 offices in key European cities, offering integrated development, asset and property management services. P3 has an investment grade BBB credit rating by Standard & Poor’s. Attracting the right talents is key for our future. We are looking for ambitious and passionate experts who can help us make P3 THE leading logistics warehouse provider in Europe. OUR CULTURE Our company values - Integrity, Teamwork, Excellence, Ambition - are embedded deeply within the organisation, and guide our steps every single day. P3’s size and stability enable us to take a global view and yet at the same time we are just the right size to maintain our agile and flexible approach on local real estate markets. Together, we create an environment that encourages personal growth because we know we are successful mainly thanks to the people who make P3. We recognise and reward outstanding performance and motivate people to contribute to our mutual goals and turn their good ideas into great outcomes. We encourage people to have ownership, make decisions and accept responsibility for them. WE ARE LOOKING FOR A Senior Asset Manager who would be responsible for maximizing the value and performance of P3’s logistics real estate portfolio in France. The role focuses on strategic asset planning, value creation, leasing performance, capital investment management, and stakeholder coordination across the full lifecycle of the assets. The role is set to drive asset-level business plans, executes value-enhancing initiatives, manages leasing strategies, and coordinates cross-functional teams to optimize financial, technical, and operational performance while aligning with P3’s overall investment strategy. SOME OF THE INTERESTING CHALLENGES AHEAD OF YOU Asset Strategy & Investment Develop and execute asset business plans aligned with P3’s investment strategy, driving NOI, occupancy and long-term value. Identify value-creation opportunities: leasing optimisation, repositioning, redevelopment and cost efficiencies. Perform hold/sell analyses and support acquisitions and disposals. Prepare investment memos, financial models and recommendations for the Investment Committee. Financial Performance & Reporting Own the financial performance of assigned assets, including revenue growth and cost control. Prepare budgets, reforecasts and long-term business plans, and track performance against KPIs and underwriting. Manage valuation inputs and support external valuations. Report on asset and portfolio performance to senior management in line with internal governance. Leasing & Tenant Management Define leasing strategies to maximise occupancy, tenant quality and rental growth. Work with leasing teams, brokers and Legal to secure new leases and renewals. Build strong relationships with key tenants and identify lease restructuring opportunities. Technical, Capex & ESG Oversee technical performance, capex projects and lifecycle planning against budgets, timelines and market standards. Ensure compliance with local regulations, safety and environmental requirements. Drive ESG initiatives such as energy efficiency, solar PV, EV infrastructure and certifications. Stakeholders & Market Work closely with Development, Construction, Finance, Leasing, Property Management and Legal. Supervise external property and facility managers, brokers and technical advisors. Monitor logistics market trends and competitor activity, and represent P3 at industry events. WHAT YOU NEED TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE Min 7 years of experience in asset or investment management within logistics/industrial real estate. Strong analytical and financial skills, including cash flow modeling and performance analysis. Commercial acumen, solid knowledge of french commercial lease and negotiations skills Proven experience driving asset business plans, leasing strategies, and value creation initiatives. Solid exposure to technical asset management, including capex planning, asset performance, and lifecycle management. Good understanding of building systems, technical due diligence, and property/facility management. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Fluent in French and English WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US These are some of the benefits we offer: Stability of an international company (one of the leading industrial real estate developers on the European market) Dynamic collaborative working environment with a passionate team of colleagues across 11 countries Attractive annual bonus Generous budget for trainings and continuous development opportunities Individual language courses Employee assistance programme (individual coaching/mentoring opportunities in wellbeing area) Flexible/hybrid working policy Extra paid days off (vacation, sick days – based on local legislation) Meal allowance We care and we like spending time together so we enjoy company events, team buildings and networking opportunities connected with the support of various charity causes Delicious coffee, refreshments and healthy snacks at workplace Attractive employee referral bonus in case you make a successful referral for any of the job roles we have open Benefits are regulated by P3 internal policy which contains the full details regarding the entitlement and conditions for the benefits. Benefits policy and components may vary by location. Come and join us and allow your career to flourish in line with the strong and stable growth of the P3 business. Build your career in a way which is meaningful to you! IMPORTANT: PLEASE PROVIDE YOUR APPLICATION AND RESUME IN ENGLISH LANGUAGE. Benefits Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: CDI - Senior AI Engineer - Paris
description: <h2>Mission</h2> <p>De nouveaux modèles, ouverts ou fermés, sortent chaque mois : encore faut-il choisir ceux qui sont assez bons pour la production, et le démontrer. Applications et agents s’appuient sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), et la partie modèle de ces systèmes est entre vos mains. Nos clients s’en servent pour répondre à leurs propres clients, traiter des documents et interroger leurs connaissances.</p> <p>Ce que le modèle voit, la manière dont il retrouve les connaissances, les outils qu’il peut appeler : ces choix vous appartiennent, de même que la mesure de la qualité des réponses. Le modèle retenu doit tenir l’objectif de coût et de qualité.</p> <p><strong>Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez savoir si un système d’IA donne des réponses justes, et pas seulement s’il tourne.</strong></p> <p>Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype AI Engineer.</p> <p> </p> <h2>Activités et responsabilités</h2> <p>Les Product Engineers construisent l’application autour du modèle ; le comportement du modèle à l’intérieur vous revient. Les Context & Analytics Engineers préparent les connaissances que vos agents retrouvent, et les Platform Engineers exploitent le serving, le harness et l’observabilité sur lesquels vous vous appuyez.</p> <p>Avec l’AI Product Manager et les experts métier du client, une bonne réponse se définit, puis les résultats s’examinent ensemble. La relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues font partie du quotidien.</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Construire des applications et des agents LLM : conception du contexte, appel d’outils, workflows multi-étapes.</li> <li>Concevoir la façon dont les agents exploitent les connaissances : requêtes de retrieval, re-ranking, citations.</li> <li>Construire des jeux et des pipelines d’évaluation : réponses de référence, scoring automatisé, relecture par des experts métier.</li> <li>Suivre la qualité des réponses en production et corriger ce qui se dégrade.</li> <li>Choisir les modèles selon la qualité, le coût et la latence ; faire du fine-tuning ou de la distillation sur un modèle plus petit quand le prompting ne suffit pas.</li> <li>Ajouter des garde-fous contre les mauvaises réponses, les fuites de données et le prompt injection.</li> <li>Traiter des documents avec des LLM : extraction, classification, résumés.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>Profil recherché</h2> <p><strong>Les indispensables :</strong></p> <ol> <li>Vous avez construit une application ou un agent qui appelle un LLM, et vous savez expliquer ce qui a fonctionné et ce qui a échoué.</li> <li>Votre code est testé et maintenable.</li> <li>Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.</li> <li>La qualité des sorties d’IA se mesure chez vous avec des jeux de test et des métriques, et vous savez limiter les hallucinations, le prompt injection et les fuites de données.</li> <li>Mettre en production une application LLM et la maintenir (déploiement, monitoring, coût, latence) n’a pas de secret pour vous.</li> <li>Le point de départ, pour vous, est le problème métier plutôt que le modèle ; reconnaître que l’IA n’est pas toujours le bon outil, et l’expliquer à des personnes non techniques, fait partie de votre pratique.</li> </ol> <p><strong>Un plus, pas un prérequis :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Du fine-tuning ou de la distillation de modèles de langage.</li> <li>Une formation en machine learning ou en statistiques, par exemple en data science.</li> <li>Des frameworks ou des protocoles d’agents, comme MCP.</li> <li>Des entrées multimodales : documents, images, voix.</li> <li>Des outils d’observabilité LLM : tracing, suivi des coûts.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler</strong> : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.</p> <p> </p> <h2>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</h2> <p>Dans ce métier, la difficulté est moins de faire parler un modèle que de savoir s’il dit juste. L’AI Engineer répond à cette question par la mesure : jeux de test, évaluations, suivi en production, plutôt que par l’impression d’une démonstration réussie.</p> <p>Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.</p> <p>Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.</p> <p>Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.</p> <p>Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.</p> <p>Le reste s’approfondit sur les projets : évaluation, conception d’agents, adaptation de modèles, avec l’appui de la communauté AI Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype AI Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (responsabilité en production, bases de la sécurité de l’IA).</p> <p>Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.</p> <p> </p> <h2>Processus de recrutement</h2> <p>Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.</p> <ol> <li><strong>Entretien RH</strong> (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.</li> <li><strong>Appel avec le CTO</strong> (15 à 30 min, à distance).</li> <li><strong>Screening technique</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.</li> <li><strong>Code review et live coding</strong> (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.</li> <li><strong>Cas technique</strong> (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.</li> <li><strong>Entretien final</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.</li> </ol> <p>Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Rémunération </strong>: 53 000€ à 70 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + variable selon expérience et séniorité</p> <p> </p> <p><em>Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.</em></p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.</p> <p>The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.</p> <p> </p></div><p style="text-align: justify;"><strong>What you’ll do at Jamf:</strong></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"> </p> <div style="text-align: justify;"> <p>The <strong>Enterprise New Logo Account Executive MEA </strong>is a results-driven hunter responsible for identifying, pursuing, and closing new enterprise logos for Jamf. Focused exclusively on net-new acquisition within the enterprise segment (organizations with 1,000+ employees), this role requires strong prospecting discipline, the ability to manage complex multi-stakeholder sales cycles, and the consultative acumen to position Jamf's Apple Enterprise Management solutions at the executive level. Success in this role is defined by consistent pipeline generation, new logo attainment, and laying the foundation for long-term customer partnerships.</p> <p>This role is offered in <strong>The Netherlands only</strong>, preferably for candidates located in the Randstad and used to travel to MEA #LI-Remote</p> <p> </p> <p><strong data-renderer-mark="true">What you can expect to do this role:</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>New Logo Prospecting & Pipeline Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and manage a targeted outbound prospecting motion to identify and engage net-new enterprise accounts within an assigned segment or territory.</li> <li>Develop segment fluency — understanding buyer personas, common objections, industry-specific compliance needs, and Apple ecosystem maturity within target accounts.</li> <li>Partner with Marketing, Business Development, and Channel partners to execute coordinated account-based prospecting that feeds a healthy, qualified pipeline.</li> <li>Maintain consistent pipeline coverage and hygiene, ensuring sufficient volume and stage diversity to meet and exceed quota targets.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Enterprise Sales Cycle Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage the full sales cycle from initial outreach and discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close — navigating the complexity typical of enterprise buying processes.</li> <li>Identify and engage multiple stakeholders across IT, Security, Finance, Legal, Procurement, and executive leadership to build multi-threaded relationships within target accounts.</li> <li>Apply a structured qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC) to assess deal health, prioritize effort, and improve forecast accuracy.</li> <li>Navigate enterprise procurement processes, including security reviews, DPAs, and SLAs, with support from Jamf Legal and internal stakeholders.</li> <li>Develop and deliver compelling business cases, demonstrations, and ROI presentations tailored to the priorities of diverse buying audiences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Commercial & Deal Execution</strong></p> <ul> <li>Structure initial commercial agreements that are competitive, value-aligned, and appropriately sized to facilitate a strong land — with long-term expansion in mind.</li> <li>Negotiate contract terms with support from Jamf Legal and Finance, maintaining deal momentum while protecting Jamf's commercial interests.</li> <li>Maintain competitive positioning in deals where incumbents or alternatives are present; articulate Jamf's differentiated value with confidence.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Partner & Ecosystem Engagement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build productive working relationships with Apple's enterprise sales team and Jamf's channel and reseller partners to generate introductions and support deal execution.</li> <li>Engage partner resources appropriately to accelerate pipeline and strengthen account access, especially within named accounts or complex organizations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Forecasting, Reporting & Team Contribution</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in Salesforce, including account activity, pipeline stage, and deal notes, to support individual and team forecasting.</li> <li>Provide consistent, reliable monthly and quarterly forecasts, with clear visibility into deal status and expected close timelines.</li> <li>Share learnings from the field — win/loss patterns, competitive intelligence, objection themes — to contribute to team and segment knowledge.</li> </ul> <p> </p> </div> <p style="text-align: justify;"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">What we are looking for:</strong></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"> </p> <ul> <li>Minimum of 5 years of B2B SaaS or technology sales experience with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding quota (Required)</li> <li>Professional working proficiency in English is required and Arabic is preferred.</li> <li>Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, including IT and executive-level buyers (Required)</li> <li>Proven ability to generate pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner engagement, and marketing collaboration (Required)</li> <li>Familiarity with a structured sales qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN) and ability to apply it to assess deal health (Required)</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to work effectively in both direct and indirect (channel/partner) selling models (Required)</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to deliver clear and persuasive presentations to technical and business audiences (Required)</li> <li>Proficiency with Salesforce or equivalent CRM for pipeline tracking, forecasting, and activity documentation (Required)</li> <li>Consultative, solutions-oriented selling approach with the ability to connect technology to business outcomes (Preferred)</li> <li>Familiarity with Apple enterprise ecosystem, endpoint management, or SaaS security solutions (Preferred)</li> <li>Experience navigating enterprise procurement processes including DPAs, SLAs, and security reviews (Preferred)</li> <li>Self-directed and resilient; able to manage long sales cycles and ambiguous buying processes with discipline and focus (Preferred)</li> <li>Travel in the MEA territory around 40%.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS</strong><span class="markedContent"><br></span></p> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.</li> <li>Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches.</li> <li>Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">Why Jamf?</strong></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"> </p> <ul> <li style="text-align: justify;">Named a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, 2021.</li> <li style="text-align: justify;">We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf.</li> <li style="text-align: justify;">We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.</li> <li style="text-align: justify;">You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.</li> <li style="text-align: justify;">We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.</li> <li style="text-align: justify;">You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 70,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.</li> <li style="text-align: justify;">We put people over profits – which is why our customers keep coming back to us.</li> <li style="text-align: justify;">We encourage you to simply be you. We constantly seek and value different perspectives to ensure Jamf is a place where everyone feels comfortable and can be successful.</li> <li style="text-align: justify;">23 of 25 world’s most valuable brands rely on Jamf to do their best work (as ranked by Forbes).</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What it means to be a Jamf?<br></strong>We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.  </p> <p>Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.  </p> <p>Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement. </p> <p><br><strong>What does Jamf do?</strong><strong><br></strong>Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><h2><strong>What we offer you:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Work-life-balance:</strong> Teamwork and personal collaboration in the office are central to us, but we also offer a regular remote work day for added flexibility. In addition, you can compensate for overtime.</li> <li><strong>Vacation mode on:</strong> You receive 26 days of paid leave plus an additional 4 compensation days.</li> <li><strong>Wellbeing first:</strong> Health benefits and dedicated Mental Health Awareness Days put your health and well-being front and center.</li> <li><strong>Practice makes perfect:</strong> Grow through our diverse training programs and leverage internal career initiatives for your personal development across the WPP network.</li> <li><strong>More than just a job:</strong> Look forward to unforgettable team events, exclusive employee discounts, and many more highlights.</li> <li><strong>Be yourself:</strong> Everyone is warmly welcome here – diversity and equal opportunities are at the core of who we are.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>This is what you move:</strong></h2> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">As <strong>Manager Media Solutions | Engagement (m/f/d),</strong> you are the key contact for our agencies on programmatic and Media Solutions topics. You collaborate closely with internal teams, drive product adoption, and support agencies in identifying new business opportunities.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Agency Relationship Management:</strong> Acting as the main programmatic contact for assigned agencies, providing guidance, building strong relationships, and supporting their daily programmatic activities.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Team Collaboration:</strong> Working closely with your fellow Engagement Manager, Product Management, and Campaign teams to ensure seamless coordination, shared responsibilities, and reliable agency support.</li> <li><strong>Product Development & Enablement:</strong> Collaborating with Product Management to develop and enhance Media Solutions products, understanding their functionalities, and introducing new solutions to agencies.</li> <li><strong>Training & Knowledge Sharing:</strong> Preparing and delivering engaging onboarding sessions, product trainings, and workshops to strengthen agency expertise and drive product adoption.</li> <li><strong>New Business & Strategic Support:</strong> Supporting agencies in new business opportunities and pitches, conducting competitor and benchmark analyses, and identifying opportunities for growth.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Communication & Reporting:</strong> Keeping relevant stakeholders informed about product developments, progress, and roadmaps while preparing clear, insightful reports and presentations when needed.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>The following qualities distinguish you:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Digital Media Experience:</strong> At least 3–4 years of professional experience in digital media, ideally with exposure to programmatic advertising, media technology, or agency collaboration.</li> <li><strong>Media & Programmatic Expertise:</strong> Solid understanding of the digital media landscape, marketing concepts, and programmatic advertising, combined with a genuine interest in emerging media technologies.</li> <li><strong>Presentation & Communication Skills:</strong> Strong ability to explain complex topics clearly, deliver engaging presentations and workshops, and communicate confidently with different stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:</strong> A structured, solution-oriented mindset with the ability to analyze information, identify opportunities, and develop practical recommendations.</li> <li><strong>Organizational & Technical Skills:</strong> Confident use of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook, with strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain quality in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li><strong>Language & Collaboration Skills:</strong> Fluent English and German, combined with a collaborative, proactive approach and enthusiasm for working with agencies and cross-functional teams.</li> </ul> <p>Furthermore you are: <strong>#media-tech-enthusiast #solution-finder #team-player</strong></p> <p>If this job sounds exciting to you, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don't have every qualification listed above.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Life at WPP Media:</strong></h2> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</p> <p>Please read our privacy policy <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">Privacy Policy</a> for Germany, Austria and Switzerland for further information on how we process the data you provide. #LI-Promoted 14520</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><em>Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité, en considérant tous les candidats sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.</em></p> <p><em> </em></p> <p><strong>A propos de WPP Media :</strong></p> <p><strong><em>WPP est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes marques mondiales pour assurer leur croissance. </em></strong>Nous réunissons une intelligence média de pointe, une créativité de classe mondiale, une production de nouvelle génération, des solutions pour transformer le marketing à l’ère de l’IA et un conseil stratégique d’expert au sein d’une seule compagnie. <br>Propulsés par des talents exceptionnels et WPP Open, notre plateforme de marketing agentique, nous déployons l’IA à grande échelle pour aider nos clients à naviguer dans un monde en pleines mutations et à optimiser leurs investissements marketing. <br>Pour plus d’informations, visitez <a href="http://www.wpp.com/">www.wpp.com</a>.</p> <p>WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/">wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p>Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes. Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :</p> <ul> <li>Être <strong>Extraordinaire</strong> en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.</li> <li>Créer un environnement <strong>Ouvert</strong> en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.</li> <li>Diriger avec <strong>Optimisme</strong> en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Le contexte</strong> :</p> <p>Au sein de StudioM, l’agence de brand content de WPP Media, vous rejoindrez la Business Unit dédiée à une marque leader de la grande consommation (FMCG) et contribuerez à ses stratégies d’influence en France.</p> <p>Aux côtés de l’équipe Influence, en lien avec les équipes clients, média, créatives et les agences partenaires, vous participerez à des campagnes pour des marques iconiques, entre création de contenu, entertainment et pop culture : musique, gaming, sport, food ou lifestyle.</p> <p><strong><br>Vos missions :</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Contribuer aux stratégies d’influence :</strong> participer à la construction des recommandations stratégiques et créatives, proposer des idées d’activation et assurer une veille sur les tendances, la culture Gen Z, les usages des plateformes sociales, les créateurs émergents et les activations concurrentes.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Participer au casting des</strong><strong> créateurs de contenu :</strong> identifier des profils, de la nano-influence aux célébrités, et analyser leurs performances, leurs audiences, leur univers éditorial et leur affinité avec les marques.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Accompagner le suivi opérationnel des campagnes :</strong> participer à la rédaction des briefs, au suivi des agences partenaires, à la préparation des scripts et contenus soumis à validation, aux rétroplannings ainsi qu’au suivi budgétaire, administratif et contractuel.<br><br></li> <li><strong>Participer aux activations et aux productions de contenus :</strong> accompagner l’équipe lors des tournages, événements, expériences immersives et activations terrain avec les créateurs de contenu.</li> <li><strong>Contribuer à la mesure des performances et à l’innovation :</strong> suivre les KPI organiques et paid, notamment via CreatorIQ, participer aux bilans de campagne et aux pistes d’optimisation, et explorer l’apport des outils d’intelligence artificielle dans nos réflexions et méthodes de travail.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compétences requises :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Formation Bac +4/+5 en communication, marketing ou publicité, à la recherche d’une alternance.</li> <li>Un vif intérêt pour l’influence, l’entertainment et la pop culture, et une bonne connaissance des créateurs de contenu et des plateformes sociales (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Twitch, Snapchat).</li> <li>Curiosité, créativité, réactivité, rigueur et sens de l’organisation pour suivre plusieurs sujets en parallèle.</li> <li>Aisance rédactionnelle et relationnelle, esprit d’analyse et de synthèse, bonne maîtrise de PowerPoint et d’Excel, et bon niveau d’anglais (B2 souhaité).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Un plus :</strong> la connaissance d’outils de marketing d’influence (comme CreatorIQ) et de social listening.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Pourquoi nous rejoindre :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Contribuer à des campagnes d’influence d’envergure nationale pour des marques iconiques à dimension internationale.</li> <li>Évoluer au sein d’une Business Unit dédiée, dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire.</li> <li>Travailler aux côtés de créateurs de contenu, d’agences partenaires et d’experts média et créatifs.</li> <li>Acquérir une vision complète du marketing d’influence, de la stratégie à la mesure de la performance.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages</strong></p> <p>Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Cette démarche s'accompagne d'une vision responsable dans nos stratégies d'investissement médiatique, reflétant ainsi notre double priorité : valoriser nos collaborateurs tout en adoptant des pratiques durables dans notre secteur. Les collaborateurs de WPP Media ont un accès privilégié aux réseaux internationaux de WPP Media et WPP, leur permettant de développer leurs passions, d'étendre leur réseau professionnel et de rester à la pointe des innovations en marketing et publicité.</p> <p>Nous disposons de ressources vastes et variées au service de nos collaborateurs, notre entreprise cultive activement l'inclusion des talents de tous horizons. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Ce que nous offrons :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Une <strong>expérience professionnelle unique</strong> au sein d'une compagnie média renommée, où vous pourrez acquérir des compétences précieuses et développer votre réseau professionnel.</li> <li>L'opportunité de travailler avec des <strong>clients de premier plan</strong> et de contribuer à la création de campagnes publicitaires de grande envergure.</li> <li>Un <strong>accompagnement personnalisé</strong> pour tous les Padawans (stagiaires/alternants chez WPP Media) de votre intégration à votre départ … ou pas !</li> <li><strong>Des déjeuners, cafés, afterworks</strong> ainsi que différents évènements qui rythmeront votre année chez nous.</li> <li>Un <strong>campus</strong> à Levallois-Perret qui rassemble toutes les agences WPP (WPP Media et ses sœurs) au terminus de la ligne 3 !</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Process de recrutement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Entretien avec l’équipe recrutement : Un premier pré-entretien téléphonique de 5mn, puis un entretien de 30mn en visio-conférence par un membre de notre équipe recrutement. Cela nous permettra de mieux connaître vos compétences et votre expérience, et vous donnera l'occasion de poser des questions sur le poste et l'entreprise.</li> <li>Entretien opérationnel : Pour évaluer l'adéquation de vos compétences et de votre profil par rapport aux exigences du poste.</li> <li>Étude de cas : Une étude de cas vous sera proposée afin d’évaluer vos compétences techniques liées au poste. Une restitution vous sera proposée.</li> </ul> <p>Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process.</p> <p> </p> <p>WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle.</p> <p>Consultez notre politique de confidentialité pour tout savoir sur la protection de vos données <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">politique de confidentialité</a>.</p> <p>Bien que nous étudiions toutes les candidatures reçues, nous ne contactons que les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW22719

description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.</p></div><p><strong>Consultant(e) Stagiaire – Business Consulting</strong></p> <p>Vous souhaitez découvrir le conseil en travaillant sur des problématiques concrètes de transformation ?</p> <p>Au sein de la BU <strong>Business Consulting de WPP Enterprise Solutions</strong>, vous accompagnerez de grandes entreprises dans leurs enjeux de <strong>stratégie, transformation marketing et expérience client</strong>, au croisement du business, de la data, de la technologie et de l’IA.</p> <p>Ce stage de fin d’études est pensé comme une <strong>véritable première expérience du métier de consultant</strong>, avec une responsabilisation progressive.</p> <p><strong>Vos missions</strong></p> <p>Totalement intégré(e) à l’équipe, vous contribuerez à différentes étapes de nos missions : analyse, réflexion stratégique, recommandations et accompagnement de leur mise en œuvre.</p> <p>Selon les projets, vous pourrez notamment travailler sur des problématiques de :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Stratégie & expérience client</strong> : stratégies omnicanales, parcours clients, fidélisation, plans de contact, go-to-market ;</li> <li><strong>Transformation & performance</strong> : évolution des organisations Marketing, Ventes et Services, optimisation des processus et accompagnement au changement ;</li> <li><strong>Data, IA & innovation</strong> : nouveaux usages de l'IA appliqués au marketing et à l'expérience client, exploitation de la data, services et expériences digitales.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Concrètement</strong>, vous réaliserez des analyses et benchmarks, participerez à des entretiens et ateliers, contribuerez à la construction de recommandations et de livrables, et serez progressivement exposé(e) à nos clients.</p> <p><strong>Le profil que nous recherchons</strong></p> <p>Vous êtes en dernière année d'une <strong>école de commerce, d'ingénieurs, d'un IEP ou d'un Master universitaire</strong>, et recherchez un stage de fin d'études en 2027.</p> <p>Vous avez :</p> <ul> <li>Un réel intérêt pour le <strong>conseil, la title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. </p> <p>On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business,  generating opportunities via outbound outreach. </p> <p>We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.</p> <p><strong>This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world: </strong>Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.</li> <li><strong>You are the architect of your own career: </strong>If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.</li> <li><strong>You love talking to people: </strong>In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.</li> <li><strong>You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: </strong>One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.</li> <li><strong>You treat rejection as a learning experience:</strong> In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara’s mission.</li> <li><strong>You want to be with the best: </strong>Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>In this role, you will:</strong> </h4> <ul> <li>Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin</li> <li>Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.</li> <li>Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling</li> <li>Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)</li> <li>Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles</li> <li>6-12 months sales experience as a minimum</li> <li>Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales</li> <li>Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, verbal and written</li> <li>Curious and able to ask insightful questions</li> <li>A champion of a Growth Mindset</li> <li>Highly proficient in English and fluent in French</li> </ul> <p><strong>An ideal candidate also has:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in closing-sales roles</li> <li>Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)</li> <li>Willingness to collaborate and influence in a “win as a team” environment</li> <li>Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways</li> <li>Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADR pathways</strong></p> <p>Through Samsara’s ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs’ understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.</p> <ul> <li><strong>ADR I</strong> representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>The next level in the program is <strong>ADR II</strong>, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>The highest level within our organization is <strong>ADR III</strong>. These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why <a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a> are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.</p> <p>Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.</p> <p><strong>Flexible Working </strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.</span></p> <p><strong>Belonging at Samsara</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.</p> <p><strong>Accommodations </strong></p> <p>Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email <a ---------- or <a href="https://forms.gle/DrM6DFQUiSgfPtCVA">click here</a> if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.</p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Authenticity</strong></p> <p>We use <a href="https://hiretofu.com/privacyPolicy">Tofu</a>, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and all

title: Senior Paid Marketing Strategist
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Who we are</h3> <p>Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.</p></div><p><span class="s1" style="font-size: 14pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Portugal, Spain or The Netherlands</span></span></p> <h3>About the role</h3> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We’re looking for a Senior Paid Marketing Strategist to help us rethink how Typeform approaches paid acquisition.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You’ll own and grow key channels including TikTok, YouTube, Google Performance Max and Uber Ads, while helping us test new opportunities across areas such as audio and CTV.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">This is a hands on role with real ownership. You’ll manage significant media budgets, build channel strategy, develop campaigns, work closely with our creative teams, and help us understand the true business impact of our investment through MMM, incrementality testing and other measurement approaches.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You’ll join the Acquisition team within Marketing and partner closely with Creative, Product Marketing, Data, RevOps and Finance.</p> <h3>What you’ll do</h3> <ul data-spread="true"> <li>Own the strategy and day to day performance of key paid social and display channels, including TikTok, YouTube, Google Performance Max and Uber Ads.</li> <li>Build a multichannel strategy that helps Typeform reduce its reliance on paid search and find new sources of efficient growth.</li> <li>Manage six figure monthly media budgets, making decisions based on customer acquisition, revenue, CAC and LTV to CAC performance.</li> <li>Build, launch and optimise campaigns that drive Typeform signups and new paid customers.</li> <li>Turn creative ideas into campaigns by briefing and partnering closely with copywriters and designers.</li> <li>Run A/B tests across creative, copy, landing pages, placements, audiences and bidding strategies.</li> <li>Explore and test new channels such as audio and CTV.</li> <li>Own and develop our paid marketing measurement approach, including Marketing Mix Modelling, incrementality studies and alternative measurement frameworks.</li> <li>Design experiments that help us understand the incremental impact of our campaigns rather than relying solely on traditional attribution.</li> <li>Work closely with our Tracking and Data teams to strengthen our measurement capabilities as digital advertising continues to change.</li> <li>Share insights, results and recommendations across Marketing and the wider business.</li> <li>Contribute to Typeform’s broader full funnel acquisition strategy across demand creation and demand capture.</li> </ul> <h3>What we’re looking for</h3> <ul data-spread="true"> <li>Around six or more years of hands on and strategic experience in performance marketing and media buying.</li> <li>Strong experience managing paid social and video channels, ideally including TikTok, YouTube and Meta.</li> <li>Experience owning campaigns from initial idea and creative brief through implementation, optimisation and measurement.</li> <li>A track record of managing six figure budgets and delivering efficient performance.</li> <li>Experience working with MMM, incrementality testing or other measurement methods beyond traditional attribution.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and confidence working with campaign performance, conversion funnels, CAC and LTV.</li> <li>A strong understanding of digital measurement, from tagging and attribution through to incrementality.</li> <li>Experience developing creative and UGC assets for paid social channels.</li> <li>The ability to balance creative thinking with strong commercial judgement.</li> <li>Curiosity and a willingness to figure things out. When you do not know the answer, you know how to find it, whether that means speaking to the right person, digging into documentation or using AI tools.</li> <li>Confidence working across teams and influencing partners in Creative, Product Marketing, Data and Finance.</li> <li>Comfort operating with uncertainty. You are happy testing ideas, learning from the results and changing direction when the data tells you to.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to have</h3> <ul data-spread="true"> <li>Experience working in SaaS or B2B lead generation.</li> <li>Experience across sales technology or marketing technology.</li> <li>Experience managing external agencies or digital production partners.</li> <li>Experience with ad servers and campaign trafficking.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>*Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We <strong>move as one team</strong>, empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters <strong>strong bonds</strong> grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We <strong>champion our diverse customer base</strong> by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we<strong> hold high expectations </strong>for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results.</p> <p>We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Everyone is welcome here.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Chief Operating Officer COO
description: At Vio , we believe booking accommodation should feel fair and effortless, never overwhelming or unclear. As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites so that they can find the best place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. Our goal is to help travelers book like an insider. That means cutting through the noise and complexity of hotel booking and surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays, booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology that travelers can trust. Who we’re looking for We are looking for an experienced Chief Operating Officer (COO) to join our Leadership Team and help us scale our booking operations, drive efficiency and deliver a best-in-class experience for our travelers. Reporting to Oz , Our CEO, and joining Vio's Leadership Team, you'll be hired into the full organisation with a clear first focus: our booking (OTA) business. You'll lead Customer Support, OTA Finance, Payments and Legal, and work closely with our Product and Tech leads to optimise how we scale, simultaneously reducing our transactional and operational costs. What you will do: Scale our booking operations from ~4k bookings per day towards 20k–40k by 2028 Reduce our transactional and operational costs through continuous improvement, automation and smarter processes Raise the quality of our user experience to match the best in the industry Make sure our business operates smoothly across multiple jurisdictions Support the scaling of our booking operations while limiting our risk exposure Lead and develop your team: our Heads of Customer Support, OTA Finance and Payments and our Legal Counsel Who you are: A senior operations leader with experience scaling – not just operating at scale – ideally in a leadership position at a 500+ FTE organisation Highly structured and analytically strong; data-fluent and comfortable making complex decisions in ambiguous situations A proven track record of driving efficiency through continuous improvement, ideally in an online travel marketplace or accommodation distribution organisation A pragmatic, flexible problem solver who fits operations to business needs rather than following frameworks or 'what we've done before' Someone who simplifies for others, builds strong relationships and can hold critical lines Experienced working in founder-led organisations and stepping into new, previously unowned areas Travel industry experience is a big plus (especially flights / packages); B2C experience preferred, B2B welcome Experience collaborating with enterprise partners is a real plus Why join us now? title: Senior Product Manager, Financial Statement Suite
description: Before a company publishes its annual report, finance teams have to turn financial data into a complete set of statements and disclosures. Balances need to be mapped, figures carried forward and updated, and supporting information brought together into a draft. Auditors then check that the notes match the primary statements, this year reconciles with last year, and every total adds up. Preparing and reviewing those statements takes days of detailed work, and errors can carry through into a published report. Today, audit teams rely on Financial Statement Suite (FSS) to read statements, run checks, and show reviewers what it found and where, so they can make the call and stand behind it. The opportunity goes beyond reconciliation: helping auditors and financial professionals review drafts, connect figures to supporting evidence, and manage changes through to sign-off. You'll own what FSS becomes across preparation and review cycles. You'll decide what sits on the teams roadmap and define strategy for this high opportunity area working with engineering, design, audit experts and the firms who use FSS every day. About DataSnipper The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. What impact you will have Own the end-to-end strategy and decisions for our financial statements product, with clear domain ownership Lead product direction in a key area with direct and clear business impact Reimagine how auditors and financial professionals work, making their workflows more defensible Why it's an exciting challenge Reviewers are sceptical, and they should be. A finding they can't trace is a finding they check again by hand. Statements differ by country, by standard and by firm. FSS has to be right on all of them, not just the ones in front of you this week. Firms use FSS when the stakes are highest. Every change has to make their next busy season better, not riskier. Everyone has a request: firms, sales, partners and engineering. You'll decide which ones the evidence supports, and say no to the rest. What you'll own The full FS experience: how a team moves through a draft, from the first finding to sign-off Trust in every check: each finding shows what it compared, where the figures came from, and who reviewed it Quality: what "ready to ship" means for each check, and how the team knows a change helps without breaking something else Where FSS goes next: which statement types, standards and markets come first, and why What you'll do Set the plan and make trade-offs explicit, including new checks versus improving the ones customers already rely on Spend time with auditors: watch real reviews, see where they double-check by hand, and turn that into product decisions Work with engineering and audit experts on sets of real statements that every change has to pass Use product data to title: Senior Platform Engineer, Replicate
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet.
