title: Engineering Manager
description: <p>We’re on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing.</p> <p>With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we’re Europe’s largest student rental platform. You’ll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors.</p> <p>As an Engineering Manager at HousingAnywhere, you will play a critical role in leading the evolution of our platform with your vision. You will join the Product Engineering team, leading one of our product teams that owns a key part of the renter journey, from finding and applying to booking, moving in and staying. You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers.</p> <p>We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them.</p> <p><strong>Our Tech Stack</strong></p> <p>At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Your role</strong></p> <p>In your daily role, your impact will be defined by key pillars: Delivery, Direction, Talent, and Culture.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Delivery</strong>: Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience. </li> <li><strong>Direction</strong>: Create alignment and a sense of urgency through well-crafted strategies and goals. You will direct your team to relate their work to organizational goals and provide a clear sense of purpose.</li> <li><strong>Talent</strong>: Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent.</li> <li><strong>Culture</strong>: Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture.</li> <li><strong>Craft</strong>: Equip your team to solve problems with pragmatic, sustainable solutions. You will foster engineering excellence, support knowledge-sharing, and keep the team up to date with the latest technical trends.</li> <li><strong>AI-first engineering</strong>: Make AI a core part of how your team works, not an experiment on the side. You will drive adoption of AI-assisted development and review, define what good practice looks like, and measure the effect on delivery speed and quality. You will keep the team’s standards high while the way of working changes.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Your profile</strong></p> <ul> <li>3 years minimum of experience in the field managing a team, focused on building and maintaining complex domains and distributed architectures.</li> <li>Strong recent experience in managing high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams.</li> <li>Strong knowledge in Distributed Systems and Domain Driven Design.</li> <li>Ability to set technical direction without getting bogged down in heavy hands-on work.</li> <li>Real, recent experience using AI tools in your own day-to-day work and getting your team to do the same. For us AI is central to how we deliver, so if you see it as a nice-to-have, this role is not the right fit.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum!</li> <li>Position based in our Rotterdam office with hybrid working policy (2 office days).</li> <li>Flexibility to work remotely for up to 2 months per year!</li> <li>1,000 EUR personal development budget.</li> <li>Complete coverage for commuting.</li> <li>Personal equipment, including laptop and ergonomic setup.</li> <li>Gym membership discount with Wellhub.</li> <li>Dutch/English classes budget.</li> <li>Variable pension scheme.</li> <li>Diverse international community (46+ nationalities).</li> <li>Pet-friendly office in Rotterdam city centre. </li> <li>Team-building events and after-work drinks every Friday.</li> </ul> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

You will be at the intersection of quantum photonics, cryogenic systems engineering and embedded systems to create scalable, maintainable architectures for autonomous 24/7 detector operations.</p> <p>You will take ownership of the end-to-end system architecture of the SNSPD platform, ensuring alignment with a shared long-term product vision while translating product requirements into clear system-level designs and specifications. Real-world quantum-safe systems are hybrid systems: classical and post-quantum algorithms operating side by side, with careful key management, crypto agility and migration paths. You will be the senior authority for this classical and hybrid layer, working alongside our PQC architecture leadership. The role demands fluency on both sides of the transition: deep classical mastery combined with a solid working command of the post-quantum algorithms and standards the products are built around.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong>:</p> <p>You will own the architecture and implementation strategy of the classical cryptographic functions of the product line: symmetric ciphers and modes (AES/GCM and beyond), hash functions (SHA-2/SHA-3, HMAC/KDF constructions), RSA/ECC offload, and true random number generation and entropy architecture (SP 800-90A/B/C). Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.</p> <ul> <li>Proven architect of classical cryptographic subsystems with certification experience (FIPS 140-3, CAVP, Common Criteria)</li> <li>Practical knowledge of hybrid classical/PQC schemes, crypto agility and key-management architecture, with working command of the NIST PQC standards</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications:<br></strong></p> <p>You believe that quantum-safe security is only as strong as the classical foundations it stands on. description: Help fix customer-centricity at scale Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our fully remote team of 100+ TheyDoers represents 30+ nationalities across 27 countries, united by a customer-led, people-first culture. Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world. If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together. The role Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act. Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter. You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan . You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe. Why this role, now The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it. Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next. This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do. What you'll do This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does. Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book. Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature. Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook. Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates What this role isn't We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in. It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role. It isn't inbound-led. Marketing and SDR will support you, but you'll be expected to create most of your own pipeline. It isn't a finished machine. If you need fully built enablement, years of territory data and a playbook that tells you what to do next, you'll find this frustrating. If you want to help build those things, you'll find it energizing. What we're looking for 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with most of that in enterprise new-business roles selling into enterprise organizations. A track record of exceeding annual quotas, where the majority of your closed revenue came from net-new logos you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through the numbers. Proven ability to land mid-to-high six-figure first deals with enterprises that weren't customers before. Experience selling a platform or new-category product, where you had to create the need rather than respond to an RFP. A value-selling methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) you actually use, not just know. Confidence engaging C-level buyers, building consensus across stakeholders and navigating enterprise procurement, security and legal You'd rather start with a blank target list than a handed-over book, and you're energized by a scale-up where the product and playbook move fast Bonus points if you have experience selling to CX, Product, Digital or Design leaders What we offer our permanent employees: 💰 Competitive compensation and pre-IPO equity - we like to give our team members ownership with our stock package. When TheyDo succeeds, we all succeed! 🌍 Fully remote working with flexible hours - we're staunch advocates for autonomy and flexibility. 🩺 Health Insurance benefit - at TheyDo our team’s health and wellbeing are a priority. We include tailored support for every employee, regardless of location. 🌴 Flexible holiday days – We love what we do and equally love taking a break. You'll have a minimum of 25 days of paid holiday per year (pro rata), in addition to public holidays and an extra three days during our annual company-wide winter shutdown in December. 🧠 Learning and Development budget we encourage everyone to take ownership and invest in their growth and development, providing financial support to benefit you in your role and career. 🧘‍♂️Wellbeing budget - nurture your mind and body. We’ll support you in looking after you, whether it's meditation, mindfulness, or a yoga/gym membership. 👪 Paid parental leave - we'll ensure financial support and time off for you to bond with the newest little members of your family (6 months for the primary carer, and 6 weeks for the secondary carer - fully paid). We provide paid childcare leave when you need to take time out to help your little one recover. 👨‍💻Home office or co-working support - choose your ideal workspace with our home office or co-working budget. Whether you prefer the comfort of your home office or the collaborative atmosphere of a co-working space, we've got you covered. 🗺️ Company events - we regularly connect in-person to strategise, reflect or simply have fun. Our most recent company retreats were held in Spain, Portugal and France. ⚒️ Latest tech & tools - MacBook Air or Pro, we want you to have the equipment that you’re most comfortable with. We use tools such as Gather, Slack, Notion, Loom, G:Suite and naturally TheyDo to work collaboratively and asynchronously. 🚀 Continuous growth of our benefits package as we continue to grow in size To any recruitment agencies, we appreciate you would like to support us but we do not accept any unsolicited CVs or introductions. About TheyDo Our core values are the driving force behind every decision we make. We ‘Journey together’ along a path of collaboration and synchronization. In everything we do, we ‘Own it’ , never shying away from taking action or making decisions. Our ‘Cloaks off’ mentality ensures that transparency and integrity reign supreme. We ‘ Simply to accelerate ', cutting through complexity to focus on what truly matters and moving forward with clarity and speed Moreover, ‘Customer Fueled’ innovation is at the heart of our work, as we know that the success of our product is directly linked to how we involve our customers in the process. description: Job Title: People Partner - Paris France Location: Hybrid About Radiant Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments. We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software . As we scale our platform and expand our engineering organisation, we are looking for leaders who can build strong teams, uphold high standards, and deliver reliably at pace. Job Summary: You’ll act as a trusted advisor to managers and employees, providing practical guidance and support across employee relations, performance management, manager coaching and the wider employee lifecycle for our team in France . Combining hands-on HR expertise with a solutions-focused approach, you’ll help managers navigate complex people matters confidently, ensure consistent and compliant People practices in line with French employment law across our Paris office and global teams, and drive continuous improvement through data, technology and automation as Radiant continues to scale. Key Responsibilities: What you'll do Act as the day-to-day point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions across the full employee lifecycle: onboarding, policy interpretation, benefits, working time and leave (forfait jours, congés payés, RTT) and performance management. Managing employee relations under French law and the applicable convention collective, providing expert support and recommending appropriate actions to address queries or problems. Proactively reviewing data to spot employee relations trends and suggest solutions, coaching Managers to tackle issues early on. Serve as the local first line of defence for compliance, ensuring strict adherence to French labour law (Code du travail), the applicable collective bargaining agreement (convention collective), site-specific contracts and health and safety obligations, including keeping the DUERP (workplace risk assessment) up to date. Act as an escalation point for complex, sensitive or high-impact situations, monitor recurring issues and operational risks, and ensure that incidents are resolved at their root cause, with appropriate care for the employees involved. Help coordinate and run core HR cycles: performance reviews, compensation planning, and engagement surveys, for the Paris office. Draft, review and interpret French employment contracts, amendments (avenants), non-compete clauses with their required financial compensation, and working time arrangements such as forfait jours for cadres. Manage hiring formalities and onboarding under French law, including the DPAE, the registre unique du personnel, the initial occupational health visit (visite d’information et de prévention), and probation periods (périodes d’essai) and their renewal. Support pre-litigation and litigation before the Conseil de prud’hommes, working closely with our external employment lawyers (avocats en droit social). Review, update and maintain Radiant’s French people policies.Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems, and help build out People processes and documentation as the team grows. Ensure compliance with French employment legislation, collective agreements, internal policies and regulatory requirements. Partner with our external payroll provider on monthly payroll and DSN filings, and manage mandatory benefits, including the mutuelle and prévoyance schemes, and occupational health (médecine du travail) follow-up. Manage training obligations, including the plan de développement des compétences, working with our OPCO, and supporting employees’ use of their CPF (compte personnel de formation). Compliance Help ensure compliance with French employment law and best practice across France and the wider EU, in consultation with the UK-based People team and external French employment counsel as needed. Compliance and risk. Make sure People processes meet French employment law, GDPR and CNIL requirements, our ISO requirements and Radiant's own policies. Ensure the team keeps policies and manager guidance up to date as legislation changes. Monitor headcount thresholds (11, 50 and 250 employees) and prepare Radiant for the obligations each one triggers, such as the CSE, the règlement intérieur, gender equality reporting and mandatory profit-sharing (participation). Act as the main point of contact for the labour inspectorate (inspection du travail) and the occupational health service, and keep mandatory registers and workplace notices (affichages obligatoires) up to date. Employee representation (CSE) Set up the CSE once the Paris office reaches 11 employees for 12 consecutive months, including negotiating the protocole d’accord préélectoral and organising professional elections. Run information and consultation processes with the CSE on reorganisations, policy changes and other matters that require it, and set up the BDESE once we reach 50 employees. Build a constructive relationship with employee representatives and prepare for collective bargaining, including the mandatory annual negotiations (NAO) where union delegates are appointed. Immigration and visas Advise on global mobility as we expand across Europe, including UK–France moves, secondments and posted worker (détachement) requirements. Workforce planning Partner with leaders to build headcount plans aligned to business priorities and budget. Advise on organisation design, team structures and spans of control as teams scale, including the CSE consultation and French legal requirements that apply to any reorganisation. Use people data from HiBob and Ashby to inform hiring, retention and capacity decisions. Performance Help design and run the performance reviews and calibration process, alongside the mandatory entretiens professionnels every two years and the six-yearly summary review (état des lieux récapitulatif). Support managers to set clear goals, give regular feedback and manage underperformance (insuffisance professionnelle) through fair, well-documented processes that would stand up before the Conseil de prud’hommes. Link performance outcomes to development, promotion and reward decisions. Qualifications: 5+ years in a People Partner, HR Business Partner or senior generalist role in France, ideally in a scaling tech or high-growth business. Deep, current knowledge of French employment law (Code du travail, conventions collectives, CSE obligations, working time rules) and confidence applying it to real situations. Hands-on experience running disciplinary and dismissal procedures, ruptures conventionnelles and CSE information and consultation processes. Familiarity with French payroll (DSN), mandatory benefits and statutory reporting. Fluent French and strong professional English, written and spoken. A degree in HR or employment law (e.g. Master 2 RH or droit social), or equivalent experience. Confident and knowledgeable enough to manage employee relations issues independently, with sound judgement on when to escalate to external counsel. A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and a track record of taking initiative. Exposure to multi-jurisdiction employment matters, particularly working alongside a UK headquarters, is an advantage. Strong technical capability and data literacy, and comfort using data and technology to inform decisions and drive efficiency Our values: Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same. Why should you join us? What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive. Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us: 25 days of annual leave A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work. Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together. title: Technical Project Manager - France
description: Build something monumental for Healthcare! At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care. We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you! About the Role You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped. At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our France office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners. You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind. This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem. What You'll Do Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations. Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners. Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in France and the integrations team in Stockholm. Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables. Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform. Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity. Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery. Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly. Support our sales organisation in answering technical questions from our customers. What You Bring Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment. Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders. Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers. Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum. Ability to anticipate, assess, and manage risk in projects, from scoping through to delivery. Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction. A product mindset - you care about building the right thing, not just delivering on time. Native level french speaking. Bonus Points Experience in tech sales, enterprise sales, or enterprise software delivery Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards Experience working with platform or API products Some hands-on technical experience (e.g. scripting, debugging, light coding) Experience scaling integration processes or working with multiple external partners Location We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based in our Paris office, where you will work primarily on-site with the local team, while collaborating closely with colleagues at our HQ in Stockholm. How to Apply We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English. Our interview process consists of 4 stages: Screening interview with Talent Acquisition Technical interview with some of our Engineering team Follow-up interview with one of our Team Leads Home case and presentation at our Paris office - Join us for a lunch, a discovery meeting and a presentation to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action. Culture at Tandem At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started. Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together. Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection. We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

At Mirakl, AI is a core part of our product strategy - from Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce. This is where you come in.</p> <p><strong>The position is a permanent contract, based in Paris or Bordeaux, with up to 1 day of remote work per week. <br><br></strong></p> <h2><strong>2. Your Impact</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design, build and scale the core capabilities of the Mirakl Assistant, including RAG, LLM orchestration, tool use, memory and context engineering, from rapid prototype to robust production feature</li> <li>Own the full production lifecycle of the assistant: automated data pipelines, CI/CD, deployment, load testing, latency and resilience</li> <li>Run technical discovery and feasibility studies for new capabilities and integrations across Mirakl products</li> <li>Drive quality improvement through rigorous offline and online evaluation, data-driven experimentation and iteration</li> <li>Collaborate cross-functionally with Software, Data Engineering, SRE and Product teams to evolve the agentic foundations and translate user needs into capabilities<br><br></li> </ul> <h2><strong>3. What You'll Bring to the Role</strong></h2> <p><strong>Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer with strong software engineering skills, or as a Software/Data Engineer with hands-on AI and ML experience</li> <li>Proven track record of deploying AI/ML systems in production products, with an automation-first approach</li> <li>Proven experience building AI agents with LLMs, RAG, MCP and related technologies, including architectural design</li> <li>Strong experience in data-driven iteration, from experimentation to evaluation</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>LLM orchestration and agentic systems design (RAG, MCP, LangChain, etc.)</li> <li>Software engineering proficiency in Python</li> <li>Solid grounding in machine learning algorithms and fundamental</li> <li>Rigorous metrics-driven evaluation and experimentation</li> <li>A "0 to 1" mindset: able to thrive in ambiguity and take an idea from exploration to production</li> <li>Product sense: understanding end users’ pain points and balancing technical excellence with customer impact </li> <li>Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills</li> <li>Frontend development (TypeScript, React) is a plus<br><br></li> </ul> <h2><strong>4. Tech Stack</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Python, SQL, TypeScript</li> <li><strong>Backend:</strong> FastAPI, LangChain, OpenSearch, Kafka, PostgreSQL</li> <li><strong>Frontend:</strong> React (micro-frontend architecture)</li> <li><strong>AI:</strong> LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)</li> <li><strong>Data Platform & Orchestration:</strong> Spark, Delta Lake, Databricks Workflows</li> <li><strong>Observability:</strong> Langfuse, MLflow</li> <li><strong>Infrastructure:</strong> Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, AWS, GCP<br><br></li> </ul> <h2><strong>5. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.</p> <p>Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:</p> <ul> <li>💡<strong> Work Hard Together:</strong> Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success</li> <li>🏆 <strong>Get Things Done: </strong> We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results</li> <li>🚀 <strong>Go Above & Beyond:</strong>  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence</li> <li>🎓 <strong>Succeed Through Expertise:</strong> Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture</li> <li>🤝 <strong>Satisfy & Empower Clients:</strong> We're committed to our clients' success</li> </ul></div><h2><strong>1. The Team You'll Join</strong></h2> <p>You'll be part of our <strong>Mirakl Assistant</strong> team, led by <strong>Remi Takase, Senior Data Science Manager</strong>. The team is part of a passionate and skilled data organisation of Data Scientists, Research Scientists, Data Engineers and SREs, building on a state-of-the-art Machine Learning and Data platform. The Mirakl Assistant team is a new team that runs like a start-up inside a scale-up. Together, you'll be designing, building and scaling the conversational AI assistant that changes how our users work across Mirakl products.</p> <p>The assistant knows the platform and the users, and helps them get the most out of Mirakl, from finding their way around the product, to understanding their business and growing it. We're taking it from conversational to action-oriented: users ask, and the assistant gets it done.</p> <p>AI agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software: what customers expect from it, how they interact with it, and how they integrate it into their business. At Mirakl, AI is a core part of our product strategy - from Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce. This is where you come in.</p> <p><strong>The position is a freelance contract, based in Paris or Bordeaux, with up to 1 day of remote work per week. <br><br></strong></p> <h2><strong>2. Your Impact</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design, build and scale the core capabilities of the Mirakl Assistant, including RAG, LLM orchestration, tool use, memory and context engineering, from rapid prototype to robust production feature</li> <li>Own the full production lifecycle of the assistant: automated data pipelines, CI/CD, deployment, load testing, latency and resilience</li> <li>Run technical discovery and feasibility studies for new capabilities and integrations across Mirakl products</li> <li>Drive quality improvement through rigorous offline and online evaluation, data-driven experimentation and iteration</li> <li>Collaborate cross-functionally with Software, Data Engineering, SRE and Product teams to evolve the agentic foundations and translate user needs into capabilities<br><br></li> </ul> <h2><strong>3. What You'll Bring to the Role</strong></h2> <p><strong>Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer with strong software engineering skills, or as a Software/Data Engineer with hands-on AI and ML experience</li> <li>Proven track record of deploying AI/ML systems in production products, with an automation-first approach</li> <li>Proven experience building AI agents with LLMs, RAG, MCP and related technologies, including architectural design</li> <li>Strong experience in data-driven iteration, from experimentation to evaluation</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>LLM orchestration and agentic systems design (RAG, MCP, LangChain, etc.)</li> <li>Software engineering proficiency in Python</li> <li>Solid grounding in machine learning algorithms and fundamental</li> <li>Rigorous metrics-driven evaluation and experimentation</li> <li>A "0 to 1" mindset: able to thrive in ambiguity and take an idea from exploration to production</li> <li>Product sense: understanding end users’ pain points and balancing technical excellence with customer impact </li> <li>Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills</li> <li>Frontend development (TypeScript, React) is a plus<br><br></li> </ul> <h2><strong>4. Tech Stack</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Python, SQL, TypeScript</li> <li><strong>Backend:</strong> FastAPI, LangChain, OpenSearch, Kafka, PostgreSQL</li> <li><strong>Frontend:</strong> React (micro-frontend architecture)</li> <li><strong>AI:</strong> LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)</li> <li><strong>Data Platform & Orchestration:</strong> Spark, Delta Lake, Databricks Workflows</li> <li><strong>Observability:</strong> Langfuse, MLflow</li> <li><strong>Infrastructure:</strong> Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, AWS, GCP<br><br></li> </ul> <h2><strong>5. Languages</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>English:</strong> Fluent</li> <li><strong>French:</strong> Fluent</li> </ul> <h2><strong>7. Our Hiring Process</strong></h2> <p>We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.</p> <p>Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application - this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.</p> <ol> <li>A 30-minute conversation with one of our Tech Recruiters to discuss your background, expectations, and what Mirakl can offer you</li> <li>A 1h30 technical interview with two members of the Labs team</li> <li>A 1h10 interview with the Hiring Manager</li> <li>A 1-hour STAR interview with future Mirakl colleagues to explore our values and culture</li> </ol><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.</em></p> <p><em>As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, <a href="https://www.mirakl.com/recruitment-privacy-notice" target="_blank">here</a> in English and <a href="https://www.mirakl.com/fr-FR/recruitment-privacy-notice" target="_blank">here</a> in French. </em></p> <p><em>We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our </em><a href="https://info.mirakl.com/ai-guidelines-for-candidates-and-interviews" target="_blank"><em>AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews</em></a><em>.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

maintenance or incident response</li> <li>Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and integrating developer tools, code repositories, CI/CD pipelines, issue trackers or documentation platforms</li> <li>Experience evaluating AI systems and improving their reliability, quality and level of autonomy, through appropriate evaluation frameworks and human-in-the-loop mechanisms</li> <li>Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments</li> <li>Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate closely with engineers and cross-functional teams</li> <li>Curiosity, pragmatism and a strong product mindset, with a passion for turning real developer pain points into useful AI-powered solutions</li> <li>Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can better understand what you have built and worked on!</li> </ul> <h2> </h2> <h2><strong>Tech Stack</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Java, Python, TypeScript</li> title: Senior Product Manager - Connect (x/f/m)
description: Set a new pulse for healthcare! We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Doctolib Connect team in Amsterdam. Doctolib Connect is a secure medical communication app designed for healthcare professionals. More than 1M healthcare professionals use Doctolib Connect to discuss and coordinate patient care with colleagues, both within and beyond their organizational walls. Today, Doctolib Connect is the largest medical network in Europe. You'll work closely with a talented team to develop user-friendly products that meet market demands, such as tele-expertise or patient referral flows. What you'll do As a Senior Product Manager on the Doctolib Connect team, you will drive the development of products that strengthen care cooperation among healthcare professionals. Working at the heart of a cross-functional team, you will shape products that serve over 900,000 users across our network, combining a user-centric and data-driven approach with a focus on network effects and long-term impact. Success in this role means growing Doctolib Connect's network, launching products that achieve product-market fit, and delivering measurable value for both our users and the business. Your responsibilities include but are not limited to: Contributing to our product strategy to grow Doctolib Connect , identifying opportunities that strengthen the network and deliver user and business value Defining, shipping, and iterating on new products and features by analysing data, conducting user interviews, researching competitors, and leveraging cross-functional insights Continuously measuring adoption, impact, and network health, iterating as needed to achieve desired outcomes for your product and company goals Collaborating with engineering, design, and research teams to translate insights into hypotheses, experiments, and features that delight users and grow Doctolib Connect's network Working closely with cross-functional teams including sales, marketing, support, and company leadership to ensure solutions serve users and meet business needs across target markets Who you are Are you convinced that you have exactly what it takes for the position? Then we encourage you to apply. Even if you don't meet every requirement, you might be exactly the right future Doctoliber for this or other positions! You could be our next team mate if you: Have 4+ years of Product Management experience, including at least 1 year working on mobile applications, with a track record of shipping products that have delivered meaningful business results and proven user value Have experience developing SaaS or mobile products, ideally including a network effect component such as social networking, communication services, or collaborative workplace tools Approach problems with an analytical mindset, balancing quantitative and qualitative insights to make data-informed decisions Communicate with clarity and conviction to align diverse stakeholders, both technical and non-technical, driving vision and articulating user value and business impact Are highly organised and disciplined in project management, with strong attention to detail and the confidence to ask tough questions and say no when needed Now, it would be fantastic if you: Have experience with health tech, marketplace, or platform products Are familiar with operating in multi-market environments Have worked in a scale-up or fast-paced product organisation Our AI vision We believe in the responsible use of AI to improve healthcare. Find out more about our approach here . What we offer: Company pension scheme through our partner Allianz 27 days of annual leave per year (and the ability to accrue more days on your work anniversary!) Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care Free breakfast and lunch plan every day on-site Bike lease scheme with our partner Lease a Bike, 35% price below the market Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth Discounted membership with Urban Sports Club Continuous training programs on all key competencies (English, soft skills, expertise) Reimbursement of public transportation if you live outside the Amsterdam highway ring Parent Care Program: Various initiatives supporting parenthood, including 100% paid parental leave up to 16 weeks, including bonuses, for mothers and up to 5 weeks for the co-parent, flexible return and 3 days of leave per year for child sickness Relocation support for international mobilities The interview process Recruiter Interview Manager Interview Case Study Final Interview Criminal background check and a copy of your Certificate of Good Conduct ("Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag, VOG") (if required) Job details Permanent position Full-Time Amsterdam Start date: As soon as possible Compensation: fix + bonus on objectives (according to your profile) At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination. The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability. To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g. pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process. Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of! title: HRBP (x/f/m)
description: Rejoindre Doctolib en tant que HR Business Partner pour les équipes Customer Care en France, c'est rejoindre une équipe RH et travailler en binôme sur ce périmètre. Vous serez le/la partenaire RH de confiance des responsables Customer Care, en étroite collaboration avec votre binôme, avec pour mission d'aider à façonner l'organisation, pas seulement de la soutenir, et de faire avancer la transformation de manière pragmatique et terrain. Ce fonctionnement en binôme nécessite un fort esprit d'équipe, une réelle capacité de collaboration et l'envie de construire ensemble des solutions adaptées aux enjeux du business. Ce rôle offre une combinaison rare d'influence stratégique et de proximité opérationnelle réelle. Vous travaillerez directement avec les managers et responsables Customer Care sur les sujets qui définissent la performance et la croissance durable : design organisationnel, coaching managérial, talent et succession, cycles de rémunération et situations individuelles complexes. Si vous êtes stimulé(e) par des environnements où les priorités évoluent vite et où les décisions se prennent avec données et discernement, vous trouverez ici la portée et l'autonomie pour avoir un impact visible. En tant que HR Business Partner, vous jouerez un rôle central dans l'une des phases de transformation les plus importantes de Doctolib. Rattaché(e) directement à la HR Director France, vous travaillerez auprès d'une population Customer Care dans un environnement international et en mouvement constant. Vous serez à la fois stratégique et opérationnel(le) : vous façonnerez le design organisationnel, piloterez des projets de transformation à grande échelle et accompagnerez les managers dans leurs défis de croissance. Vous bénéficierez d'une réelle autonomie pour laisser votre empreinte sur la façon dont nous construisons et développons l'excellence au sein de nos équipes Customer Care. Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à : Transformation business & efficacité organisationnelle Collaborer avec les managers et responsables Customer Care pour influencer les décisions clés en matière de design organisationnel, de gestion de la performance et d'initiatives de changement, pas seulement les exécuter Allier conseil stratégique et soutien opérationnel, en restant proche du terrain tout en accompagnant les managers dans la complexité et en pilotant des transformations significatives Conseil RH & gestion du changement Piloter des programmes de conduite du changement en local Coacher et guider les managers pour améliorer l'efficacité collective et la santé organisationnelle de leurs équipes Gérer les situations individuelles complexes avec le support juridique, en garantissant conformité, agilité business et équité Excellence RH Développer une compréhension approfondie du business et de la culture Doctolib, et être l'ambassadeur(rice) du modèle opérationnel et des produits People Contribuer à la meilleure expérience collaborateur possible en apportant un soutien RH de premier plan aux équipes Customer Care Piloter les cycles RH de bout en bout, performance, revues de talent, rémunération, avec rigueur ; élaborer les plans de développement, de rétention et de succession qui élèvent le niveau sur l'ensemble du périmètre Construire et entretenir des relations solides avec les équipes transversales, TA, L&D, C&B, Juridique, tout en assurant l'alignement entre les besoins locaux et les initiatives People globales Les qualités attendues en tant que HRBP Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos aspirations, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler. connaissance du droit social français Justifiez d'au moins 4 ans d'expérience RH, dans des environnements de transformation ou en forte croissance, avec une pratique du partenariat business Excellez dans l'influence sans autorité : vous construisez de vraies relations partenariales au-delà de la simple application des politiques RH, challengez vos interlocuteurs de façon constructive et pilotez le changement grâce à des insights data-driven Vous vous épanouissez dans des environnements rapides et ambigus, avec de solides compétences en gestion du changement et la capacité à piloter des projets complexes impliquant de multiples parties prenantes Faites preuve d'un solide sens du business et d'une orientation terrain : vous comprenez les dynamiques organisationnelles, parlez le langage des responsables Customer Care et savez concilier conformité et solutions pragmatiques favorisant la performance Ce serait fantastique si : Vous avez une expérience dans des fonctions Customer Care ou commerciales, et comprenez les enjeux spécifiques de talent et de performance de ces équipes Vous avez un parcours démontré dans la conduite de transformations à grande échelle, en pesant sur les décisions stratégiques dès leur conception Notre offre Une mutuelle avantageuse prise en charge à 100 % par Doctolib, régime de base, pour les employés et leurs enfants 25 jours de congés payés et 12 à 14 jours de RTT par an Un programme de santé mentale et de coaching personnalisé gratuit avec notre partenaire Moka.care 10 jours par an de télétravail à l'étranger possible Des tickets restaurant d'une valeur de 8,50 € par jour, dont 4,50 € pris en charge par Doctolib Une subvention du comité d'entreprise pour le remboursement partiel d'adhésions à des activités sportives ou de loisirs Un remboursement à 50 % de l'abonnement aux transports en commun Programme ParentCare : bénéficiez d'un congé de naissance couvert par Doctolib à 100 % le premier mois et à 75 % le deuxième mois Pour les salariés en situation de handicap ou proches aidants, un package comprenant une adaptation du télétravail, des jours d'absence autorisée payés pour les rendez-vous médicaux et un soutien description: Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place! Overview We are expanding our optomechanical capabilities, and the success of our projects depends on optical designs that are precise, manufacturable, and verified through rigorous analysis and testing. As a Senior Optical Design Engineer, you will own optical designs from concept through lab validation, turning requirements into lens designs and optical assemblies that perform reliably in the real world. This position is central to our mission of delivering cutting-edge free-space optical systems for space applications, and it will support successful pre-production runs and strong collaboration with our suppliers. This position reports to our Responsible Engineer, Optical Systems, and is based in our Toulouse, France office. Our working language is English. Carry out tolerance analysis and Monte Carlo simulations to predict manufacturing and assembly yield, and define realistic tolerances with suppliers. Conduct STOP (Structural-Thermal-Optical Performance) analysis with mechanical engineers, verifying performance and margins across operating conditions. Conduct stray light analysis. Produce lens and optomechanical drawings, and work with mechanical engineers to ensure designs are manufacturable and assemblable. Define assembly, alignment, and bonding procedures, and support their implementation in clean room environments. Plan and execute lab assembly and test, covering alignment, characterization, and performance verification of prototypes and flight-representative hardware. Characterize components and assemblies through optical metrology, and identify discrepancies . D rive root-cause investigations and design iterations. Work with suppliers on design for manufacturing, tolerancing, inspection, qualification, and pre-production runs. What you bring to this role A Master’s degree in Optical Engineering, Physics, or a related field, with a strong foundation in geometrical and physical optics. 5+ years of experience in optical design, including lens and optical system design , optimization and STOP analysis. Proficiency in Zemax OpticStudio, including sequential ray tracing and optimization. Hands-on lab experience in optical assembly and test, with working knowledge of metrology instruments such as interferometers, wavefront sensors, MTF benches, autocollimators, and centration measurement tools. Experience with spaceborne optics or qualification to space-relevant standards, such as ECSS. Selection of adhesives, coatings and optics materials. Strong analytical skills and the ability to troubleshoot problems across simulation and hardware. A proactive mindset and a commitment to high standards of quality and performance. Bonus points Experience with free space optical communication systems . Python and ZOS-API skills for automating analysis or processing data. Experience with ANOVA methodology, including Gauge R&R studies and statistical post-processing in tools such as JMP. Practical knowledge of cleanroom practice, optics cleaning, adhesive bonding . title: Systems Engineer - Network Data Plane Software
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Locations: Austin TX, Champaign IL, Lisbon Portugal, London England, Atlanta GA, Washington DC, </strong></p> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Cloudflare is redefining the way networks are run at scale, and some of the largest networks in the world now run their traffic through us. Cloudflare's network runs in hundreds of cities on general-purpose Linux servers, not dedicated routers, so the routers, firewalls, load balancers, and proxies that carry our customers' traffic are software that we write, ship, and operate ourselves.</p> <p>Our Packet Processing team builds and operates that software: high-performance code that processes customer traffic at the packet level as it moves through Cloudflare's network, in every Cloudflare data center. That includes the L4 load balancer at the front door of every server, a per-customer routing and forwarding data plane, a stateful network firewall, and a TCP/UDP reverse proxy (the engines behind products like Magic Transit, Cloudflare WAN, Cloudflare Network Firewall, and Spectrum).</p> <p>We are a team of engineers who obsess over performance, correctness, and reliability at massive scale. We own what we build in production, a lot of our work happens close to the kernel and the NIC.</p> <h2>About the role</h2> <p>We're looking for engineers who want to build the software that forwards, filters, and load-balances packets for a meaningful fraction of the internet. If you've worked on routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, or SDN data planes, and you'd like to do that in software, at Cloudflare's scale, this is the role.</p> <p>We're moving towards a unified data plane platform that all of our L3/L4 products share. Instead of each product having its own data path, with its own configuration, performance work, and failure modes, we build a feature once and every product gets it.</p> <p>Some of the things you'd work on:</p> <ul> <li>The shared platform: packet I/O, a graph of processing stages, per-core steering, per-customer isolation, and upgrades that don't drop traffic</li> <li>A userspace forwarding plane that gives each customer their own routing and forwarding, with traffic arriving and leaving over tunnels (GRE, IPsec) and direct connections</li> <li>A stateful packet firewall written in Rust: rule evaluation, rate limiting, intrusion detection, packet capture, and dual-stack IPv4/IPv6</li> <li>An XDP-based L4 load balancer that touches nearly every connection into Cloudflare and forwards packets between servers and between data centers</li> <li>A fast path that uses XDP and eBPF to forward very large single flows at multiple Gbps</li> <li>Host networking: classifying each packet once and using that result everywhere on the server, instead of separate configs that can disagree</li> <li>Chasing down packet drops, latency, and throughput problems across a fleet of servers in hundreds of cities</li> </ul> <p>We write mostly Go and Rust (plus C for eBPF) on Linux, and the work ranges from XDP and the kernel network stack to userspace packet pipelines and the control planes that configure them.</p> <p>You'll build, deploy, and operate these systems on top of one of the largest edge networks in the world. You'll partner with some of the best engineers and product managers, on our team and across Cloudflare, to solve big problems that have a meaningful impact in the lives of our customers and users.</p> <p>We're looking for curious, empathetic engineers who are excited to join us in changing the way networking is done!</p> <h2>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge, and experience</h2> <ul> <li>Systems programming experience in Rust, Go, C, or C++</li> <li>A solid understanding of L3 and L4 networking: IP, TCP, UDP, routing and forwarding, tunneling (GRE, IPsec), NAT, connection tracking, and anycast</li> <li>Experience building data plane software: routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN gateways, or SDN/NFV systems</li> <li>Linux networking: eBPF/XDP, tc, netfilter/nftables, network namespaces, sockets, etc.</li> <li>High-performance packet processing in user space or the kernel (e.g., AF_XDP, DPDK, VPP)</li> <li>Debugging, profiling, and optimizing systems where throughput and latency matter</li> <li>Building and operating large-scale, reliable, distributed systems</li> <li>Operating what you build: on-call, incident response, and root cause analysis</li> <li>Reading unfamiliar code and safely evolving systems that have been in production for years</li> <li>Owning work end to end, from design through deployment, and working across teams to land shared solutions</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication; we design in written specs and review each other's work</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus points</h2> <ul> <li>Router, switch, or network OS development (e.g., at a network equipment vendor or cloud provider)</li> <li>Network firewalls, IDS/IPS (e.g., Suricata, Snort), or rate limiting</li> <li>L4 load balancing (e.g., Maglev-style consistent hashing, Katran, IPVS)</li> <li>Running large networks: ISPs, data center networks, or backbone operations</li> <li>Contributions to open-source networking projects (e.g., the Linux kernel, DPDK, VPP, FRR)</li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="1"><strong data-path-to-node="1" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="2"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,0,0">Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,1,0">For Champaign IL based hires: Estimated annual salary of $168,000 - $210,000.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,2,0">For Washington, DC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $230,000.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,3,0">For Seattle, WA based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $230,000.</p> </li> </ul> <ul data-path-to-node="4"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="4,0,0">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €66,000 - 83,000.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="5"><strong data-path-to-node="5" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="6"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="6,0,0">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="7"><strong data-path-to-node="7" data-index-in-node="0">Benefits</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="8"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,0,0">Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,0">Health & Welfare Benefits</p> <ul data-path-to-node="8,1,1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,0,0">Medical/Rx Insurance</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,1,0">Dental Insurance</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,2,0">Vision Insurance</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,3,0">Flexible Spending Accounts</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,4,0">Commuter Spending Accounts</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,5,0">Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,6,0">On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,1,1,7,0">Global Travel Medical Insurance</p> </li> </ul> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,2,0">Financial Benefits</p> <ul data-path-to-node="8,2,1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,2,1,0,0">Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,2,1,1,0">Life & Accident Insurance</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,2,1,2,0">401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,2,1,3,0">Employee Stock Participation Plan</p> </li> </ul> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,3,0">Time Off</p> <ul data-path-to-node="8,3,1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,3,1,0,0">Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="8,3,1,1,0">Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</p> </li> </ul> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</

title: Senior Media Relations Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Help make the world more hospitable </strong></h4> <p>The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p>You would own Mews' relationships with the press, turning company news, product launches and leadership insight into credible coverage across hospitality, travel, technology and business media. This is a new role, the first dedicated media relations seat at Mews, so the contacts you build and the way you work will set the standard for how we deal with the press. Hospitality technology offers good stories and unusual data to pitch, and leaders here respond to press requests within about a day.</p> <p>You would join the Communications team within Marketing and work closely with the communications lead, the colleagues who shape our stories, and leadership, product marketing and regional marketing. Day to day you would pitch journalists directly, host press briefings, handle inbound enquiries and prepare leaders to speak well in front of the press. The role is remote first in Europe, ideally near London, Berlin or Paris where many of the journalists we work with are based, with about 10% travel to meet press and attend events such as Unfold.</p> <p>Journalists respond to people they know and trust, not to mass pitches, and the strongest coverage comes from a specialist who holds those relationships personally. Mews has strong stories and data to offer, and this role exists so that someone owns that conversation: choosing the right journalist for each story, answering inbound questions quickly and accurately, and knowing when to escalate something sensitive. Done well, it builds the company's reputation with the people who cover our industry over the long term.</p> <h4>What you would do</h4> <ul> <li>Build and maintain direct relationships with journalists across hospitality, travel, technology and business media: develop stories with the communications team, pitch them proactively by phone and email, host press briefings and invite journalists to events such as Unfold.</li> <li>Respond to inbound press enquiries (currently two to three a week and growing) quickly and accurately, and escalate anything potentially sensitive to the communications lead straight away.</li> <li>Brief and coach executive and local spokespeople, and share what you learn from journalists with leadership.</li> <li>Redesign how media monitoring, journalist research and coverage reporting work using AI, and set the workflows up so the rest of the team can use them.</li> <li>Own and improve the team's media management tool, and check every AI-assisted pitch, briefing or summary before it reaches a journalist.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Fluency Level 3:</strong> in this role that means you have gone well beyond using AI to draft copy. You have redesigned parts of how media relations work gets done, such as monitoring, journalist research or coverage reporting, you have built approaches that colleagues now follow, and you actively question and check what AI gives you, including target lists, summaries and quotes, before anything reaches a journalist or a spokesperson.</p> <p><em>For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to <a href="https://mews.atlassian.net/wiki/x/XQOskg">AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates</a> on Confluence.</em></p> <h4>What you would bring</h4> <ul> <li>Seven to ten years in PR and communications with depth in B2B media relations, including time in a PR agency.</li> <li>Your own journalist contacts and hands-on experience pitching by phone, email and in person, with fully fluent English, written and spoken.</li> <li>A record of handling reactive and sensitive press enquiries under time pressure, with clear habits about when to escalate.</li> <li>Confidence preparing senior and non-expert spokespeople for press conversations.</li> <li>AI Fluency Level 3 or the equivalent hands-on experience, shown through tools or workflows you have built for media relations work, not only content you have written with AI.</li> </ul> <h4>Nice to have</h4> <ul> <li>French or German alongside fluent English, or existing relationships with journalists in the UK, France, Germany or the US.</li> <li>Experience with B2B technology clients or in hospitality.</li> <li>Experience measuring coverage and coordinating local expertise in markets where you have fewer contacts.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">UK</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£59,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£77,000 We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.</p> <p>A few things that define how we work:</p> <ul> <li>High autonomy means high responsibility. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.</li> <li>Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.</li> <li>We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.</li> <li>AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.</li> </ul> <p>If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.</p> <p>We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.</p> <p>One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.</p> <p>If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Social & AI Marketeer
description: Jouw impact als Senior Social & AI Marketeer Als Senior Social & AI Marketeer bij Indicia ben je het strategische aanspreekpunt voor grote klanten en vertaal je hun commerciële doelstellingen naar effectieve socialmediastrategieën. Je combineert strategisch advies met een hands-on aanpak en ontwikkelt en optimaliseert campagnes op platforms als Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok. Daarbij werk je met grote mediabudgetten en krijg je volop ruimte om impact te maken. AI speelt een belangrijke rol in jouw werk. Je benut slimme tools en automatisering om campagnes, content en processen continu te verbeteren. Daarnaast signaleer je proactief commerciële kansen bij klanten en deel je jouw kennis en ervaring met junior marketeers. Zo draag je niet alleen bij aan het succes van klanten, maar ook aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het team en de dienstverlening van Indicia. Over Indicia Indicia is een onafhankelijk tech, data en AI-bureau dat sinds 1996 organisaties helpt om digitaal te groeien. Vanuit de overtuiging dat succesvolle digitale oplossingen beginnen bij een goed begrip van de business, combineert Indicia technologie, data en ondernemerschap om organisaties verder te brengen. Met ruim 250 digitale specialisten biedt Indicia een breed scala aan diensten, waaronder online marketing, webdevelopment, HubSpot, AI en design. Van het ontwikkelen van websites en digitale platforms tot het realiseren van effectieve marketingcampagnes en slimme automatiseringen. Indicia bedient klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren en richt zich steeds meer op grotere organisaties en langdurige samenwerkingen. De organisatie bevindt zich in een fase van verdere professionalisering, waarbij de focus ligt op het verdiepen van specialismen, het versterken van de strategische klantrelaties en het realiseren van meetbare resultaten. AI speelt hierin een belangrijke rol. Indicia ontwikkelt eigen AI-tools om processen slimmer en efficiënter in te richten, waardoor meer ruimte ontstaat voor strategisch advies, innovatie en klantontwikkeling. De bedrijfscultuur is informeel, familiair en ondernemend. Collega's werken nauw samen, krijgen veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en worden gestimuleerd om zich zowel persoonlijk als professioneel te ontwikkelen. Tegelijkertijd groeit de ambitie om resultaatgerichter te werken en als organisatie verder te professionaliseren. https://www.indicia.ai/ Jouw verantwoordelijkheden: Ontwikkelen en presenteren van socialmediastrategieën voor grote klanten, waarbij je commerciële doelstellingen vertaalt naar concrete campagnes en meetbare resultaten; Actief bijdragen aan commerciële voorstellen, pitches en pre-salesgesprekken, waarbij je klanten adviseert over de mogelijkheden van social advertising; Fungeren als strategisch en inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor klanten, waarbij je periodiek campagneresultaten presenteert en proactief kansen voor upsell en cross-sell signaleert; Zelfstandig opzetten, beheren en optimaliseren van paid social campagnes op platforms als Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok, inclusief het bewaken van instellingen, KPI's en budgetten; Analyseren van campagneresultaten, uitvoeren van A/B-testen en continu verbeteren van performance, conversies en rendement; Samenwerken met het interne AI-lab om AI en automatisering slim toe te passen binnen campagnes, contentcreatie, budgetoptimalisatie en werkprocessen; Signaleren en toepassen van nieuwe ontwikkelingen binnen social advertising en AI, waarbij je ook de verbinding legt met andere online marketingdisciplines, zoals SEO en SEA; Coachen en begeleiden van junior social marketeers, kennis delen en bijdragen aan hun professionele ontwikkeling; Aanbrengen van structuur, stimuleren van eigenaarschap en bewaken van de kwaliteit binnen het social team. Jouw plek binnen de organisatie: Als ervaren collega ben je een vraagbaak en sparringpartner voor de junior social marketeers. Je deelt je kennis over social en AI, en helpt hen zo verder te groeien. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan Sophie Mees, Delivery Manager Online Marketing. Requirements Je bent een enthousiaste en ondernemende persoonlijkheid die energie brengt, initiatief neemt en het team weet mee te nemen in nieuwe ideeën. Je voelt je thuis in een informele en familiaire werkomgeving en draagt met jouw commerciële drive en resultaatgerichte instelling bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het team. Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met paid social advertising, bij voorkeur binnen een groter marketingbureau, waarbij je gewend bent te werken met aanzienlijke mediabudgetten; Uitgebreide kennis van advertentieplatforms zoals Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok en ervaring met het zelfstandig opzetten, beheren en optimaliseren van campagnes; Een analytische instelling en aantoonbare ervaring met campagneanalyse, A/B-testen en performanceoptimalisatie; Een sterke strategische en commerciële blik, waarbij je businessdoelstellingen vertaalt naar effectieve socialmediastrategieën en kansen voor klantgroei signaleert; Ervaring als strategisch gesprekspartner voor klanten op management- en directieniveau, gecombineerd met sterke communicatieve en presentatievaardigheden; Een AI-minded en tech-savvy instelling, waarbij je AI actief inzet voor contentontwikkeling, campagneoptimalisatie en het automatiseren van werkprocessen; Ervaring met het coachen en begeleiden van junior collega's en het delen van vakinhoudelijke kennis; Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal. Benefits Bij Indicia kom je terecht in een informele en ambitieuze werkomgeving waar je de vrijheid krijgt om initiatief te nemen en écht impact te maken. Je werkt voor aansprekende klanten, krijgt de ruimte om te experimenteren met de nieuwste AI-tools en draagt actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de dienstverlening. Een passend salaris; Een dienstverband van 32 tot 40 uur per week; 25 vakantiedagen, aangevuld met extra vrije dagen voor gezamenlijke bedrijfsactiviteiten; Arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd; Pensioenregeling 100% bijdrage door werkgever; Reiskostenvergoeding voor zowel auto als openbaar vervoer; Laptop van de zaak (MacBook of Windows); Dagelijks lunch, regelmatig leuke borrels, en de (buitenlands) bedrijfstrip! description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Our Purpose<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.</p> <h3>About Us<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity.
