By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.</p> <p>Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.</p> <h3><strong>What Are We Looking For?</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. You will partner with the EMEA South Leadership Team on GTM design, business analysis, and metrics while managing the day-to-day rhythm of the business, with field productivity as your north star. This role is based in Amsterdam, Prague, or Milan, and is ideal for someone who wants to be an active voice driving change rather than a passive spectator.</p> <h3>What Will You Do?</h3> <p>Primary description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. The heart of a spacecraft lies in its engines, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours. We are seeking a talented Thermo-Mechanical Engineer to join our Future Project division. As a key member of our engineering team, you will be responsible for designing, analyzing, and optimizing combustion devices for cryogenic rocket engines, with a focus on the main thrust chamber assembly. Key Responsibilities Support structural and thermal analysis of combustion device hardware including injector heads, faceplates, combustion chambers, manifolds, and structural interfaces. Perform finite element analysis (FEA) and establish practical design suggestions and establish design recommendations, and margin assessments for hardware development. Develop and apply analytical and reduced-order models to estimate heat transfer, structural loads, and thermal boundary conditions to inform design trades and hardware maturation. Support hardware development and maturation, including design iteration, development planning, test definition, and post-test assessment of structural and thermal performance. Drive life assessment activities, including low-cycle fatigue, thermal fatigue, cyclic loading, margin tracking, and damage accumulation for reusable hardware. Own structural reliability and lifecycle assessments of combustion hardware, including low-cycle fatigue, thermal fatigue, cyclic loading, and thermo-mechanical failure risk evaluation. Collaborate with combustion and fluid engineers to translate predicted heat flux distributions, pressure fields, and flow characteristics into structural and thermal design requirements Define structural and thermal instrumentation strategies for development testing and participate post-test data reduction, model validation, and correlation activities. Contribute to material selection and design trades considering temperature capability, strength, fatigue resistance, oxidation compatibility, and cryogenic behavior. Prepare technical documentation and contribute to design, and test reviews with clear technical justification and risk assessment. What we would love to see from you Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Experience (academic, internship, or professional) in structural or thermal analysis of high-performance mechanical systems. Strong fundamentals in solid mechanics, heat transfer, and pressure-loaded structures. Experience with FEA tools such as ANSYS, NASTRAN, Abaqus, or equivalent. Ability to interpret complex thermal and pressure boundary conditions and apply them appropriately in structural models. Understanding of fatigue, temperature-dependent material behavior, and nonlinear structural response. Exposure to high-temperature or cryogenic systems is advantageous. Familiarity with CAD (NX ideally) tools and ability to work directly with geometry. Experience with Python or similar scripting tools for analysis automation or data processing is beneficial. Skills and Behaviours Methodical and structured approach to problem solving. Strong attention to detail and analytical rigor. Clear written and verbal communication of technical rationale. Ability to iterate analyses as design and test data evolve. Interest in propulsion systems and combustion device development. title: Interim Senior Community Manager
description: Who we are We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves. With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another. Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth. We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands. We’re on the search for... Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it. In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other. The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp. This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues. What you’ll be doing You’ll be part of the Brand team, reporting to the Brand Lead who owns the Community Program. You’ll lead the community from launch to a community that’s live, safe, well populated and growing, online and offline. The community isn’t a loyalty scheme or a fan club. It’s where travellers tell the truth about their journeys, inspire others and help the next person go and experience it. You’ll work closely with Product (Social Connection and Loyalty team), Customer Experience, Legal and Privacy, PR & Partnerships, Social, and our Creator Partnerships and Creative colleagues. You’ll be: Shaping the community vision, values and member code with the Brand Lead, and laying the foundations for Interrail as a cultural movement, online and offline. Building the community strategy: who we bring in first, which journeys launch first and how the community grows after launch. Bringing our existing members across as founding voices, and working with Content and Marketing to onboard our Pioneers. Launching the first community rituals, and making the community a source of real traveller stories for the brand. Designing and running a first pilot of real-world moments, such as gatherings at stations or partner places, with PR & Partnerships and Social. Building good relationships with the independent Interrail communities on Facebook, Reddit and beyond. We partner with them; we never try to replace them. Keeping the community safe: setting guidelines, the moderation approach with Customer Experience, and working with Legal, Privacy, and Safety so nothing goes live until it’s signed off. Being the members’ voice in our Product team, measuring community health with Analytics and CRM, and creating a playbook so what you build lasts. What we’re looking for Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you. 8+ years building communities for brands, including at least one you grew from launch. Experience running community both online and in real life, such as events, meet-ups or ambassador programs. You have written a community vision or strategy and turned it into a plan that others follow. A track record of building early momentum, so people join and champion the community, not just follow it. Experience setting moderation and safety policies, and comfort working with Legal and Privacy on consent, safeguarding and GDPR. A clear point of view on what makes a community healthy, and the confidence to defend it with product teams. Organised, good at documenting and comfortable working across many teams, so what you build outlasts your contract. A genuine interest in train travel, meeting locals, new experiences and other cultures. Bonus points for experience with community platforms or social SDKs, multilingual moderation, or a long rail trip through Europe of your own. Curious to apply? Apply directly through our careers page . We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through. For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice. If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you. To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential. In the meantime If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values? Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com . Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>In this role, you will contribute to Cloudflare's revenue generation engine by delivering pipeline at scale to the Sales counterparts. With flawless execution, we believe the Business Development organization will be a competitive differentiator for Cloudflare.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>In this role, your primary qualification.</li> <li>Prospect and research potential leads or target accounts</li> <li>Initiate outbound calls to introduce Cloudflare products/services</li> <li>Qualify leads based on interest, The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.</p> <h2>Equity</h2> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Medical/Rx Insurance</p> </li> <li> <p>Dental Insurance</p> </li> <li> <p>Vision Insurance</p> </li> <li> <p>Flexible Spending Accounts</p> </li> <li> <p>Commuter Spending Accounts</p> </li> <li> <p>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</p> </li> <li> <p>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</p> </li> <li> <p>Global Travel Medical Insurance</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</p> </li> <li> <p>Life & Accident Insurance</p> </li> <li> <p>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</p> </li> <li> <p>Employee Stock Participation Plan</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li> <p>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</p> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. title: Senior Software Engineer, Customs
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport: </strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. </p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h3><strong>Why Customs Matters More Than Ever</strong></h3> <p>International trade is under more pressure than ever before. With tariffs, shifting regulations, and geopolitical uncertainty, customs has gone from a back-office function to a boardroom priority. The recent trade crisis—sparked by Trump-era tariffs—has made customs the single most complex challenge for global businesses. For many, it’s the difference between keeping supply chains moving or grinding them to a halt.</p> <p>That’s where we come in. The <strong>Customs Technology team</strong> at Flexport is leading the charge. We are building the systems that help entrepreneurs and global brands navigate complexity, stay compliant, and keep the world’s goods flowing.</p> <h2>The opportunity: </h2> <p>Customs brokerage is one of the largest, most under-innovated opportunities in logistics. Legacy customs brokers are stuck with outdated systems and manual processes—they simply can’t adapt fast enough.</p> <p>Flexport is growing fast because we’re different. We are the only big tech company in the space, and the only freight forwarder that got founded after the launch of Netscape. Being a tech company, we can move much faster than our competitors, and give our customers the service they expect in this day and age. We can deploy things like LLM agents at scale, in an industry that is ripe to be disrupted by this technology.</p> <p><strong>Things we ❤️</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leveraging AI in a safe way to eliminate mundane work for customs brokers and automate customs every step of the way</li> <li>Modeling complex and ambiguous domains into fully automated workflows</li> <li>Building highly performant and reliable Kotlin services on our cutting-edge infrastructure platform</li> <li>Collaborating with end users across the globe to create the best possible product: removing toil and surfacing interesting cases</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You will:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Work closely with business partners and product managers to distill complex business problems into elegant technical solutions.</li> <li>Work on systems that represent the real-world intricacies of logistics entities and the process of moving cargo in and out of countries.</li> <li>Build and launch products rapidly and incrementally. We ship to production dozens of times per day.</li> <li>Geek out about shipping, customs regulations and logistics. (We do this often.)</li> <li>Figure out the most efficient way for our customers and partners to participate in the process of moving freight across borders.</li> <li>Design and build deep, complex integrations with government agencies and partners.</li> <li>Automate archaic customs filing processes and save the operations team thousands of phone calls per week.</li> <li>Deliver supply chain insights to logistics teams via a world-class analytics experience.</li> <li>Create beautiful and efficient domain models for the incredibly complex world of freight forwarding.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You should have:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>≥ 5 years of experience writing software, and a strong engineering background.</li> <li>A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.</li> <li>The ability to convey technical ideas in common terms to business partners, product managers, designers and engineers alike.</li> <li>A bias for action. When you see a problem, you solve it.</li> <li>A desire to develop your tooling repertoire. We are tech-agnostic regarding candidate background, but our platform is built with Ruby.</li> <li>Non-optional: an aptitude for learning quickly.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>How we work:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>We come to the office at two to three times a week to hang out, have lunch, white board, and collaborate</li> <li>We have the latest and greatest hardware and software for you to work with</li> <li>We’re agile, but not married to a single doctrine like scrum. The teams decide how they work best.</li> <li>Stack: we’re coming from a React/Flow + Ruby on Rails monolith, and moving to React/Typescript, Kotlin Microservices on Kubernetes. We also use and love GraphQL, GRPC, Postgres, Kafka and Snowflake</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's in it for you?</strong></p> <ul> <li>An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment </li> <li>Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis </li> <li>Commute expenses: Flexport will cover  home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam</li> <li>25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment.</li> <li>Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. Your monthly premium is fully paid by Flexport. </li> <li>A defined pension contribution scheme</li> <li>Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members</li> <li>Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-onsite</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div id="1704749847.557549" class="c-virtual_list__item" data-qa="virtual-list-item" data-item-key="1704749847.557549"> <div class="c-message_kit__background p-message_pane_message__message c-message_kit__message" data-qa="message_container" data-qa-unprocessed="false" data-qa-placeholder="false"> <div class="c-message_kit__hover" data-qa-hover="true"> <div class="c-message_kit__actions c-message_kit__actions--default"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter__right" data-qa="message_content"> <div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <h4>Commitment to Equal Opportunity</h4> <p>At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. title: Hardware Systems Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX</p> <p><strong>About The Department</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare’s Infrastructure group is responsible for building our global network. Our Hardware Engineering team helps research, develop, test, and deploy new equipment enabling 20% of the world’s internet traffic to be served smoothly. Deployed across 330 cities in 120+ countries, the hardware we select helps improve the security, reliability, and performance of the Internet.</p> <p><strong>About The Role</strong></p> <p>We need to make thoughtful infrastructure choices affecting a significant portion of the Internet. Hardware we work with includes servers and components, as well as PDUs and network hardware. As a Hardware Systems Engineer, you will work with colleagues on the Engineering teams, Product and Performance Optimization teams, and Hardware Sourcing teams to design, qualify and maintain Cloudflare’s worldwide fleet of servers</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with product teams at Cloudflare to gather product requirements for next generation of servers, and work with silicon vendors to assess performance and select the components (CPU, memory, disk, NIC, GPUs etc) </li> <li>Collaborate closely with strategy, sourcing, and capacity planning teams to steer server infrastructure initiatives in alignment with Cloudflare’s business goals</li> <li>Execute the end to end server product qualification from concept to deployment, ensuring hardware designs (electrical, thermal and mechanical) are optimized for seamless, large-scale implementation by the Infrastructure Operations team.</li> <li>Collaborate with the Site Reliability Engineering team to title: Engineering Manager
description: We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing. As an Engineering Manager at HousingAnywhere, you will play a critical role in leading the evolution of our platform with your vision. You will join the Product Engineering team, leading one of our product teams that owns a key part of the renter journey, from finding and applying to booking, moving in and staying. You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers. We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them. Our Tech Stack At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development. Your role In your daily role, your impact will be defined by key pillars: Delivery, Direction, Talent, and Culture. Delivery : Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience. Direction : Create alignment and a sense of urgency through well-crafted strategies and goals. You will direct your team to relate their work to organizational goals and provide a clear sense of purpose. Talent : Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent. Culture : Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture. Craft : Equip your team to solve problems with pragmatic, sustainable solutions. You will foster engineering excellence, support knowledge-sharing, and keep the team up to date with the latest technical trends. AI-first engineering : Make AI a core part of how your team works, not an experiment on the side. You will drive adoption of AI-assisted development and review, define what good practice looks like, and measure the effect on delivery speed and quality. You will keep the team's standards high while the way of working changes. Your profile 3 years minimum of experience in the field managing a team, focused on building and maintaining complex domains and distributed architectures. Strong recent experience in managing high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams. Strong knowledge in Distributed Systems and Domain Driven Design. Ability to set technical direction without getting bogged down in heavy hands-on work. Real, recent experience using AI tools in your own day-to-day work and getting your team to do the same. title: Performance Marketing Manager (w/m/d) 80-100%
description: Jobbeschreibung Mach mit uns Schweizer Kleinunternehmen noch erfolgreicher! Klingt nach einer grossen Vision? Genau das treibt uns jeden Tag an. Wir bei bexio leben die Philosophie, dass erstklassige, effiziente und smarte Softwarelösungen für jedes KMU zugänglich und erschwinglich sein müssen. Mit dieser Mission sind wir heute die führende Anbieterin für webbasierte Business-Software in der Schweiz. Unser Expansionskurs geht steil nach oben: Über 100'000 zufriedene Kunden, mehr als 7'000 Treuhand-Partner und ein starkes Team von über 150 motivierten Mitarbeitenden sprechen für sich. Um diese Erfolgsgeschichte weiterzuschreiben, suchen wir tatkräftige Unterstützung. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel! Wir suchen eine kreative und analytisch starke Persönlichkeit, die bereit ist, die nächste Stufe des Performance Marketings mit uns zu erklimmen. Wenn Du den Mut hast, den Status Quo in Frage zu stellen und innovative, AI-gestützte Kampagnen zu realisieren, dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Stellenanforderungen Was du bei uns bewegst Selbstständige Konzeption, Umsetzung und Skalierung unserer mehrsprachigen Paid-Social-Kampagnen (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest) – von der Akquise bis zum Retargeting. Unterstützung bei der operativen Aussteuerung in Paid Search Channels (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads) und Generative Engine Advertising Channel (Chat GPT Ads). Datenbasierte Analyse und Optimierung von Kampagnen und Landingpages (CRO, A/B-Testing) zur kontinuierlichen Generierung qualifizierter Leads (SQLs) und als Beitrag zum ARR-Wachstum von bexio. Eigenständige Überwachung zugewiesener Mediabudgets im Rahmen unserer Performance-Roadmap sowie Übersetzung von Kohortenanalysen in konkrete Optimierungsmassnahmen. Steuerung des gesamten Kreativprozesses, von der initialen Ideengenerierung über die Erstellung detaillierter Briefings bis zur erfolgreichen Ausspielung der Kampagnen-Assets. Kontinuierliche Beobachtung aktueller Marketing- und AI-Trends (z. B. Generative Engine Advertising) sowie die schnelle Umsetzung innovativer Ansätze im eigenen Verantwortungsbereich. Enge Zusammenarbeit und Austausch mit internen Stakeholdern (z. B. Content-, Social-Media- und Produkt-Marketing-Teams) sowie externen Plattform-Partnern und Agenturen für ganzheitliche Performance-Strategien. Dein Rucksack für diese Stelle Du besitzt einen Hochschulabschluss in BWL (Vertiefung Marketing/Analytik), Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung inklusive relevanter Plattform-Zertifizierungen (z. B. Google, Meta Blueprint). Du verfügst über erste bis mehrjährige Praxiserfahrung (ca. 1–4 Jahre) in der Planung, Umsetzung und Optimierung von Search-, Display- und Paid-Social-Kampagnen – idealerweise im B2B-SaaS-, E-Commerce- oder Agenturumfeld. Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis für moderne MarTech- und Tracking-Infrastrukturen (z. B. Google Analytics 4, Tag Management, CRM-Integrationen wie Salesforce) sowie Disziplinen wie SEO und CRO mit. Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für performanceorientierte Assets und liebst die analytische Arbeit sowie datenbasierte Entscheidungen. Du bringst eine hohe Eigenverantwortlichkeit und Lernbereitschaft mit, arbeitest auch in dynamischen Phasen strukturiert und möchtest dich persönlich wie fachlich weiterentwickeln. Du bist ein engagierter Teamplayer, hast Mut zu neuen Ideen und interessierst dich aktiv für neue Technologien und AI-Tools. Du kommunizierst sehr gut in Deutsch und Englisch (Französisch- oder Italienischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil). Darauf kannst du dich freuen Hybrid-Modell und Arbeitszeiten, die sich deinem Leben anpassen. 5 Wochen Ferien plus Option auf unbezahlten Urlaub. Yoga, Bootcamps, Massagen und legendäre Grill-Sessions. 16 Wochen Mutterschafts- und 3 Wochen Vaterschaftsurlaub. bexio übernimmt 63 % deiner Pensionskassenbeiträge – für mehr Netto vom Lohn. title: Testeur QA / Recette fonctionnelle (H/F) – Mission à mi-temps - FREELANCE
description: ImaginePartners recherche, pour l’un de ses clients, un testeur QA fonctionnel (H/F) pour une mission de 6 mois à mi-temps . Vous interviendrez sur plusieurs projets d’évolution du système d’information, dans un environnement principalement Microsoft. Votre rôle sera de valider les applications avant leur mise en production, de la préparation des tests à la vérification des corrections. Modalités de la mission Démarrage — Dès que possible Durée — 6 mois Rythme — Mi-temps, avec une répartition des jours à convenir Localisation — Région de Marseille, avec possibilité de travailler à distance TJM — À proposer Vos missions Analyser les besoins métiers et les spécifications, identifier les parcours à tester et définir la stratégie de test de chaque projet. Concevoir les scénarios, les cas de test et les jeux de données. Préparer et maintenir les plans de test. Exécuter les tests fonctionnels, d’intégration, de non-régression et de bout en bout. Participer aux campagnes de recette avant les mises en production. Qualifier et documenter les anomalies, suivre leur correction avec les développeurs et effectuer les contre-tests. Prioriser les campagnes entre les projets, communiquer les résultats aux équipes métiers et techniques et contribuer à harmoniser les pratiques de test. Profil recherché Vous avez une expérience significative en tests logiciels ou en recette fonctionnelle d’applications web ou de systèmes d’information d’entreprise. Vous savez mener une campagne de test en autonomie, documenter vos résultats et gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle. Vous avez utilisé Azure DevOps, Jira ou un outil équivalent, dans un environnement Agile/Scrum ou en cycle en V. Une expérience sur Power Platform, Dynamics 365 ou SharePoint , la certification ISTQB Foundation et la pratique de l’ automatisation des tests sont appréciées. Pour postuler Joignez votre CV à votre candidature sur JOIN et indiquez votre date de disponibilité , votre localisation , v otre TJM HT et votre disponibilité à mi-temps . title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the Role As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach. We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London. This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less. You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily. You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact. You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. In this role, you will: Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners. Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com) Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices Minimum requirements for the role: 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles Excellent communication skills, verbal and written Curious and able to ask insightful questions A champion of a Growth Mindset Highly proficient in English and fluent in French An ideal candidate also has: Experience in closing-sales roles Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …) Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space ADR pathways Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program. ADR I representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them. The next level in the program is ADR II , where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. After building their skills in outbound sales and earning sales certifications, our representatives graduate to the final level of the program. The highest level within our organization is ADR III . These ADRs work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers at Samsara. They partner closely on large accounts, implementing detailed territory plans, participating in weekly strategy meetings, and scheduling and attending customer demos. Additionally, ADR IIIs partake in a mentorship program to learn from leadership on the Account Executive team who provide exposure and training ahead of their interview for an Account Executive position. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Accommodations Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. Our Commitment to Authenticity We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. Fraudulent Employment Offers Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here . description: <p>Build and own a self-service, multi-tenant platform that keeps the critical data of 20+ customers recoverable<br><br>Do you like building platforms that other teams consume, at scale, across private and public clouds, with security and tenant isolation as non-negotiables? Your customers are internal and external engineering teams, and your product is the platform they build on.<br><br>You’ll join a dedicated group of data security experts within our larger Services Team and work closely with our sbp.cloud team, who operate our self-built sovereign cloud solutions. With our plan-build-run approach, you take end-to-end ownership: you design it, you build it, you run it.<br><br>The Challenge<br><br>Running one platform for 20+ customers means solving the hard problems of platform engineering:</p> <ul> <li>Multi-tenancy by design: strict isolation of data, access, and performance between customers, on shared infrastructure.</li> <li>Self-service at scale: APIs, guardrails and automation that let customer teams onboard and operate independently, without tickets.</li> <li>Scale and resilience: 4,000+ protected endpoints and more than 25,000 recovery points generated daily, on a dedicated private cloud spanning multiple availability zones.</li> <li>Heterogeneous workloads: Oracle, MS-SQL, SAP, Sybase, PaaS, container platforms and VMs across VMware VCF, OpenStack, AWS, Azure and Kubernetes.</li> <li>Modern storage back-ends: public cloud services and S3-compatible object storage built on Pure FlashBlade//S and NetApp StorageGRID in our own datacenters, plus a long-term archiving tier.</li> <li>Security first: immutability, segregation and hardening in a highly secure environment where recoverability is the ultimate guarantee.</li> </ul> <p>Your Role<br><br>As a Platform Engineer, you take full responsibility for the lifecycle of the platform: architecture, deployment, evolution and reliability. A passion for data protection, security and resilience is a plus, and you’ll grow it here.</li> <li>You enjoy teamwork, thrive on challenges and like collaborating with both peers and customers.</li> <li>You’re comfortable in highly secure, complex environments.</li> <li>You have a solid understanding of multi-tenant architectures and security concepts.</li> <li>You are proficient in Linux and/or Windows ecosystems.</li> <li>You have experience across private (VMware/OpenStack) and public cloud platforms (Azure, AWS).</li> <li>You’re skilled in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible and/or Chef) and in scripting and automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell, etc.).</li> <li>Experience with data management/protection tools is valuable, whether Commvault, Rubrik or similar, but not a must. title: Engineering Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p>About the department</p><p>Cloudflare's Engineering team builds and runs the software that handles a large share of the Internet's requests. We also build the internal tools and platforms that software depends on. Teams own large areas with real impact and work autonomously within them, whether their customers are external or other Cloudflare engineers.</p><p>About the team</p><p>Developer Productivity builds the internal tools and platforms Cloudflare engineers use to take code from commit to production. We own developer infrastructure (CI/CD, build systems), developer insights and ADLC metrics, AI-assisted development, and Cloudflare-on-Cloudflare dogfooding.</p><p>We're responsible for AI-assisted development across all of Cloudflare engineering, and adoption has grown 4 to 6 times over in the last year. We also own the tooling behind Cloudflare's Engineering Codex, the standards every engineering team is expected to meet.</p><p>About the role</p><p>This is a front-line engineering manager role leading a team of 6+ engineers in Bengaluru. The team's initial focus will be on two areas:</p><ul><li><p><strong>AI tools for engineers.</strong> Agents, agentic systems, MCP servers, evals, and context engineering that change how Cloudflare engineers write, review, and ship code.</p></li><li><p><strong>Engineering standards and the tooling that enforces them.</strong> Continuing to transform our Engineering standards into automated guardrails, paved paths, and feedback engineers can act on, instead of checklists and manual review.</p></li></ul><p>You'll own the product direction for both areas. There are no dedicated product managers on the team. Our users are Cloudflare engineers, and our engineers work as product engineers who talk to users, watch how tools get used, and help decide what to build next. You'll lead that work, deciding what to build and why, and making sure it gets adopted and solves real problems.</p><p>You don't need to write code every day, but you should be able to review a design, debug a broken pipeline, or prototype an agent when the team needs it.</p><p>We move fast. AI tooling changes month to month, so a six-month plan is stale in six weeks. We ship small, put it in front of engineers early, and change course based on what we hear. We'd rather ship a rough version this week and improve it next week than spend a month polishing a design doc. We add process only when it solves a real problem.</p><p>You'll partner closely with engineering managers and principal engineers in the US, UK, and Europe, and work with teams across Cloudflare's global organization. The team starts in Bengaluru. As it grows, it may include engineers in other regions.</p><p>What you'll do</p><ul><li><p>Hire, onboard, and grow your team. Coach engineers to think like product engineers, run career conversations, give direct feedback, and handle performance.</p></li><li><p>Own the product roadmap. Spend time with the engineers who use your tools, decide which problems matter most, and say no to the rest.</p></li><li><p>Keep the team shipping. Release in small increments, get feedback from users quickly, and cut process that slows the team down without adding value.</p></li><li><p>Deliver in both focus areas: agents, MCP servers, and evals the rest of engineering relies on, and Codex standards turned into CI/CD checks, templates, and policy-as-code, with remediation and exception workflows to match.</p></li><li><p>Measure whether the work is landing: tool adoption, Codex compliance, and what engineers actually think of the experience.</p></li><li><p>Own operations for the platforms your team runs, including on-call and incident response.</p></li></ul><p>What we're looking for</p><ul><li><p>3+ years managing software engineers, including hiring, onboarding, and developing people.</p></li><li><p>8+ years of total software engineering experience, with enough recent hands-on work to hold your own in code and design reviews.</p></li><li><p>Hands-on experience with AI in engineering organizations, such as building agents, running agentic systems in production, or governing how a company uses AI. This is not a model-training or ML research role.</p></li><li><p>Experience building or running developer tools, internal platforms, or CI/CD systems.</p></li><li><p>Product and user thinking. You've owned a roadmap, with or without a PM, and you can point to decisions you made because of what users told you or how they actually used what you built.</p></li><li><p>A bias to action. You've led teams that shipped often and changed direction when the evidence called for it, while still delivering on commitments.</p></li><li><p>Clear judgment and clear writing. You make sound trade-offs and explain the "why" as well as the "how". Much of your work with partners will happen asynchronously across time zones.</p></li></ul><p>Bonus points</p><ul><li><p>You've built MCP servers or LLM evals, or worked on context engineering for agents.</p></li><li><p>Experience with policy-as-code or compliance automation.</p></li><li><p>Experience measuring developer productivity, using frameworks such as DORA or SPACE, or developer surveys.</p></li><li><p>You've built a team from scratch or started an engineering presence in a new location.</p></li><li><p>Familiarity with TypeScript, Go, or Kubernetes-based systems.</p></li></ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. title: Représentant(e) commercial(e) - Marseille
description: Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun. Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine. Notre ancrage dans la région marseillaise est déjà un succès incontestable . Face à une demande qui explose et pour soutenir cette dynamique, nous passons à la vitesse supérieure et agrandissons notre équipe à Marseille. L'opportunité Rejoins notre équipe en tant que représentant(e) commercial(e) et deviens l'un des visages de la révolution digitale du secteur. Chez Salonkee, tu as l'opportunité unique de piloter des projets ambitieux, de collaborer avec des experts passionnés et de marquer de ton empreinte l'expansion d'une scale-up en plein essor. Tes missions Maîtrise du cycle de vente (A à Z) : tu pilotes l'intégralité du parcours d'acquisition de nouveaux clients pour Salonkee. Cela inclut la chasse initiale, la prise de rendez-vous qualifiés, la réalisation de démonstrations percutantes et le closing des contrats. Ambassadeur(rice) de terrain : tu mènes des présentations produits directement sur site pour démontrer, avec clarté et conviction, la valeur ajoutée de nos solutions pour le business de tes clients. Conseil stratégique & optimisation : tu accompagnes tes prospects avec expertise en leur proposant des solutions digitales sur mesure pour optimiser leurs processus et libérer tout leur potentiel de croissance. Stratégie multicanale : tu utilises différents canaux de communication pour approcher les clients potentiels et développer des relations de confiance durables. Accompagnement & formation : tu assures la formation de tes nouveaux clients pour garantir une adoption parfaite de l'outil et un succès immédiat dès le premier jour d'utilisation. Ton profil Expérience sales : pas besoin d'un CV parfait; ce qu'on cherche avant tout, c'est quelqu'un avec la fibre commerciale et le drive pour aller chercher le client. Une première expérience en vente terrain B2B ou en prospection téléphone/physique est un vrai atout: tu sais ce que c'est que d'aller chercher le client là où il est Tempérament chasseur : tu as le goût du challenge, une résilience à toute épreuve et une appétence naturelle pour la prospection active Autonomie & organisation : véritable self-starter, tu planifies tes journées de façon stratégique et trouves les meilleurs leviers pour établir Salonkee dans ton secteur Excellent relationnel : tu sais instaurer une confiance immédiate et créer un lien fort avec des entrepreneurs indépendants Digital native : tu es à l'aise avec les outils SaaS et les environnements tech: la maîtrise d'un CRM est un vrai plus. Mobilité : le permis B est indispensable. Tu gères en totale autonomie la région Marseille . Langues : français natif. Un anglais professionnel est apprécié pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales. Ce que nous offrons Un salaire fixe entre 28.000 € et 34.000 € brut annuel + variable déplafonné (OTE cible : 39.000 € – 45.000 €). Ton succès, ton revenu Véhicule de fonction + carte essence + badge télépéage Organisation autonome. Tu gères ton agenda dans un cadre de confiance 25 jours de congés + repos supplémentaire (sous conditions) Mutuelle Tickets-restaurant Un parcours d'intégration structuré : formation produit, accompagnement terrain avec ton manager les premières semaines, et accès à l'expérience de nos équipes déjà en place dans 6 autres pays Un accès direct au leadership et une vraie capacité d'influence sur la stratégie commerciale dès tes premiers mois L'opportunité de participer à une success story et d'avoir un impact tangible sur l'avenir du secteur de la beauté et du bien-être Des événements d'entreprise réguliers pour renforcer la cohésion d'équipe et créer des opportunités de networking et de collaboration Chez Salonkee, nous sommes convaincus que l'innovation s'épanouit dans un environnement où chacun se sent inclus et valorisé. Nous bâtissons une équipe diversifiée à l'image de l'industrie que nous servons : créative, passionnée et riche de perspectives variées. Peu importe qui tu es ou d'où tu viens, tu trouveras ici ta place pour grandir, contribuer et être toi-même. Salonkee promeut l'égalité des chances et la diversité. Nous accueillons toutes les candidatures, indépendamment du genre, de l'origine, de l'âge, du handicap ou de l'identité. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Procurement Specialist
description: Why This Role Exists Pennylane’s growth and international expansion are increasing the volume of suppliers, contracts and renewals. Within the Procurement team, you will strengthen operational execution and strategic sourcing, while helping improve purchasing processes, tool adoption and approval workflows. Your work will help control costs and risks, simplify supplier management and improve the internal purchasing experience. 🌍 About Pennylane Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms. Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising their clients. Key Figures and Ambition 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe What You'll Do Define and implement purchasing strategies for software, freelancers and subcontracting. Lead high-value supplier renewals, negotiations, tenders and contracting processes. Coordinate with business owners, Finance, Legal, IT and Security from requirements definition to contract signature. Manage our external provider, by delegating non-strategic topics and monitoring delivery. Challenge internal needs and identify opportunities to consolidate suppliers and reduce complexity. Structure and track savings, cost avoidance, renewals and supplier consolidation. Manage laptop and employee equipment procurement, subject to final scope confirmation. What You Bring Experience in operational strategic sourcing and category management. Ability to define category-specific purchasing strategies and conduct competitive processes. Strong negotiation skills, with the ability to secure contracts and generate measurable savings. Experience managing suppliers, renewals, contracts and cross-functional stakeholders. Ability to lead purchasing projects from tender to contractualisation. Ability to prioritise independently in a fast-growing environment. Strong communication skills and a proactive, solution-oriented approach. What You Can Expect Join the Procurement team alongside the Procurement Lead. Own priority categories with direct impact on Pennylane’s costs, risks and operational efficiency. Work across France and international activities in a constantly evolving environment. Contribute to purchasing process digitalisation and adoption of P2P tools. title: Clinical Data & Quality Manager (CDD 18 mois)
description: 🏨 The Company Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care. Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources. Our solutions optimize patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring, and in-depth analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across more than 200 healthcare facilities, as well as within the framework of around twenty academic and industrial clinical trials. Through this, we put data at the service of healthcare and therapeutic innovation, driven by the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine. 📝 Your Role In a few words Within QARA, you oversee Good Clinical Practice compliance across Resilience’s sponsored studies and studies conducted with pharmaceutical partners. You combine clinical quality, data integrity and system qualification, working closely with the teams running studies and building data workflows. Your impact You help keep studies inspection-ready, data reliable and traceable, and compliance embedded in everyday work. Your role is to safeguard the framework and help teams apply it, rather than produce the data yourself. Your day-to-day work Oversee study GCP compliance, manage deviations and corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and conduct quality and Trial Master File (TMF) reviews. Maintain inspection readiness and support CRO oversight in line with ICH E6(R3). Qualify systems, assess test environments and review data extractions, audit trails and Data Management Plans. Work with Data and Clinical teams to build compliance into data workflows from the outset. Maintain clinical quality procedures, train teams and monitor regulatory developments. This is not a site-monitoring, data-engineering, study-project-management or routine clinical data-production role. ✨ Your Team Here, we don’t work in silos. You’ll join an agile structure where compliance is truly a team sport: Your Manager: Yasmine, the guardian of regulatory compliance for our medical devices. She will share her strategic vision of the healthcare sector with you and will be your go-to for the most sensitive decisions. Your core team: A trio of passionate experts. They’re your daily contacts for everything related to the quality management system, technical files, and audit preparation. The team’s little extra: A unique context where safety, clinical, and regulatory aspects come together to better serve patients, led by a team that combines rigor and kindness. You join QARA and report directly to Yasmine. You work with Clinical Operations, Clinical Scientists, Data and Translational Research, as well as the DPO, CROs and pharmaceutical partners. 👤 Candidate Profile ⚙️ You are the right person if you know how to Apply ICH E6(R3), Annex 11 and 21 CFR Part 11 to clinical studies and systems. Manage deviations, CAPAs, audits and inspection preparation, beyond data cleaning alone. Qualify systems using CSV/CSQ approaches and apply ALCOA+ principles. Work with EDC systems and ePRO/eCOA solutions, translating their requirements into practical controls. Communicate and write fluently in English. 🙂 You are the right person if you have A rigorous approach that takes operational constraints into account. Practical judgement to turn requirements into workable processes. The ability to influence and train colleagues rather than impose rules. Confidence working across clinical and technical teams and with external partners. 📃 You are the right person if you have already Gained at least five years of relevant experience in Clinical Data Management and GCP compliance within a pharmaceutical company or CRO. Handled clinical quality topics such as deviations, audits, inspections or procedures. Contributed to computerised system qualification. Worked with EDC systems, such as Medidata Rave, Veeva or Oracle, and ePRO/eCOA solutions. It’s a plus if you Understand pipelines, ETL and databases, without needing to be a developer. Know CDISC standards for regulatory submissions. Want to move from data production to compliance oversight and help build quality practices. 💛 Why join us? Contribute to reliable studies and data that support clinical research in oncology. Combine clinical quality, data integrity and collaboration with technical teams. Work remotely from France and meet colleagues at internal company events. 🤝 Recruitment Process Initial conversation with Elena. Interview with Yasmine, your future manager. Case study with Sarah and Yasmine from QARA. Team conversation with Nicoleta, Bertille and Alric. Strategic interview with Raph. title: Talent Acquisition Lead
description: Ben jij ready voor Change? Bij Change zoeken we een Talent acquisition Lead die recruitment naar een hoger niveau brengt. Je werft zelf actief mee en bent daarnaast de senior op de afdeling: je coacht junior recruiters, brengt structuur aan in de dagelijkse operatie en helpt het team groeien in eigenaarschap, kwaliteit en resultaat. Daarmee maak je meteen helder: dit is geen gewone recruiterrol, maar een combinatie van zelf doen, richting geven en mensen beter maken . Hier ga je werken: Bij Change kom je terecht in een energieke en snelgroeiende organisatie waar ontwikkeling, samenwerking en beweging centraal staan. We werken voor bekende merken zoals Marktplaats, Odido en Eneco en zorgen iedere dag voor de beste klantbeleving. Onze organisatie groeit hard en recruitment speelt daarin een belangrijke rol. We zoeken daarom iemand die zelf stevig in de werving staat, maar ook het recruitmentteam verder helpt ontwikkelen. Je werkt nauw samen met teamleads, management, HR en collega-recruiters. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid, ruimte om mee te denken en de kans om zichtbaar impact te maken op de groei van Change. Waar ben je verantwoordelijk voor? Actieve sourcing en hunting Je zoekt actief naar commercieel talent via LinkedIn, jobboards en netwerken. Je weet latent werkzoekenden te vinden en te enthousiasmeren voor Change. Coaching en ontwikkeling van het recruitmentteam Je begeleidt en coacht recruiters in sourcing, selectie, stakeholdermanagement en kandidaatcommunicatie. Je deelt kennis en helpt het team groeien in kwaliteit en eigenaarschap. Operationele aansturing Je brengt structuur aan, bewaakt de voortgang van vacatures en helpt het team prioriteiten stellen. Businesspartner voor sales en operatie Je werkt nauw samen met teamleads, management en HR en vertaalt personeelsbehoeften naar effectieve recruitmentacties. Candidate experience Je zorgt voor een professioneel en persoonlijk recruitmentproces waarin kandidaten zich gezien voelen. Procesverbetering en data Je optimaliseert recruitmentprocessen en gebruikt data om resultaten en effectiviteit te verbeteren. Talentpools Je bouwt aan talentpools voor commerciële en specialistische functies, zodat we ook op de lange termijn succesvol kunnen blijven werven. Wij vinden het belangrijk dat wij bij elkaar passen. Herken jij jezelf in onze kernwaarden? Eerlijk – Je communiceert open, duidelijk en betrouwbaar. Beweging – Je pakt aan, denkt vooruit en brengt energie in elk project. Anders – Je ziet mogelijkheden, durft te vernieuwen en houdt het praktisch. Expertise – Je werkt gestructureerd, deelt kennis en maakt dingen af. Wat breng je mee? Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen recruitment, bij voorkeur in een dynamische, commerciële of snelgroeiende organisatie. Je hebt ervaring met actieve sourcing en weet hoe je latent werkzoekenden benadert en overtuigt. Je vindt het leuk om junior recruiters te coachen, te begeleiden en beter te maken in hun vak. Je hebt ambitie om leiding te geven. Je bent sterk in stakeholdermanagement en schakelt makkelijk met teamleads, management, HR en recruiters. Je brengt structuur, overzicht en rust in een omgeving waar veel tegelijk gebeurt. Je hebt ervaring met interviewtechnieken, ATS-systemen en recruitmentdata. Je weet hoe je commercieel talent herkent en kunt beoordelen op salesdrive, overtuigingskracht, eigenaarschap en resultaatgerichtheid. Je bent zelfstandig, proactief en krijgt energie van targets, groei en resultaat. Je durft mensen aan te spreken op eigenaarschap, opvolging en kwaliteit. Je denkt mee over processen, maar blijft niet hangen in plannen. Jij zorgt dat dingen gebeuren. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend in de Nederlandse taal. Ervaring met employer branding of doelgroepgerichte arbeidsmarktcommunicatie is mooi meegenomen. Wat wij jou bieden! Een uitdagende functie binnen een snelgroeiende en dynamische organisatie. Een salaris tussen €4.500 en €5.500 per maand (op fulltime basis). Een aantrekkelijke bonusstructuur op basis van prestaties en resultaten. Een contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week. Km vergoeding of NS businesscard voor jouw woon- werk verkeer. Veel ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. Een ambitieus en energiek team waarin samenwerking centraal staat. De mogelijkheid om écht impact te maken op de groei van onze commerciële organisatie. Ready for Change? Zie jij het als een uitdaging om zelf sterke commerciële kandidaten aan Change te verbinden én een recruitmentteam verder te ontwikkelen? Dan leren we je graag kennen.
