title: Responsable Marketing Digital
description: 🎯 Ton objectif : Définir et piloter la stratégie marketing digital d'un groupe de centres de radiologie, pour développer sa visibilité, son acquisition et l'expérience de ses patients en ligne. En 5 hashtags , ça donne 👉 #StratégieDigitale #Acquisition #SEOGEO #Contenus #Santé 🍒 sur le 🎂 : ce job est une création de poste ! Tu arrives avec une vraie latitude pour poser les bases de la stratégie digitale, définir tes priorités et construire un dispositif qui aura un impact concret sur le développement des centres. 🚀 Tes missions principales : Définir la stratégie marketing digital du groupe et sa feuille de route : objectifs, priorités et actions à mener pour développer la visibilité des centres et l'acquisition de patients. Identifier, tester, activer et optimiser les leviers digitaux les plus pertinents, dans le respect des contraintes propres au secteur médical. Développer le SEO et expérimenter le GEO pour renforcer la visibilité du groupe sur les moteurs de recherche et les outils d'IA générative. Optimiser Doctolib comme partenaire stratégique d'acquisition : visibilité des centres, qualité des fiches et des informations transmises, positionnement et bon fonctionnement du parcours de prise de rendez-vous. Tu travailleras avec le support d’un account manager. Optimiser la stratégie “ Google My Business” des centres pour que leurs fiches Google soient complètes et attractives, et les avis traités positivement. Faire évoluer le site web pour améliorer la visibilité des centres, l'information des patients et leurs parcours en ligne. Définir le calendrier éditorial et créer des contenus et relayer les actualités du groupe et des centres sur les canaux digitaux. Développer la présence du groupe sur les réseaux sociaux, en définissant les sujets, les formats et les actions adaptés. Mener des appels d’offres pour choisir les prestataires en marketing digital les plus pertinents (ex : agence SEO, freelances…). Analyser les données du site, les parcours utilisateurs et la performance de chaque levier, notamment leur rentabilité, pour orienter les décisions et améliorer les résultats. Coconstruire des tableaux de bord à co-construire avec Doctolib. 💛 Ton équipe : 🏙️ L'entreprise : un acteur majeur de l’imagerie médicale France, en plein développement. Le groupe rassemble une quarantaine de centres de radiologie et s'est construit par rapprochements successifs de cabinets. Au siège, une équipe support accompagne les centres dans leur fonctionnement et leur développement. Le groupe se dote aujourd'hui des compétences digitales nécessaires pour accompagner sa croissance. 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Ton équipe : tu rejoins une équipe support à taille humaine au siège. En tant que référent·e marketing digital, tu disposes d'une grande autonomie pour définir et mettre en œuvre tes actions, en lien avec les autres équipes. 👩 Ta manager : l’une des membres du CODIR du groupe, avec un périmètre lié au développement. Tu travailles à ses côtés pour définir les priorités digitales et apporter ton expertise dans les décisions. 🙌 Tes principaux interlocuteurs : l'équipe support au siège (30 personnes), le call-center qui traite les appels entrants, des partenaires externes, comme l'agence SEO et bien sûr les centres de radiologie. En interne, les équipes reconnaissent l'utilité du marketing digital : ton arrivée sur ce poste clé est attendue ! 💻 Tes Conditions de travail : 📍 Ton bureau : actuellement à La Défense, avec un déménagement prévu sur Saint-Lazare au printemps. 🖥️ Modalités de travail : sur site, possibilité de télétravail de façon ponctuelle. Package de rémunération : 📄 Contrat : cadre au forfait jours 💰 Salaire fixe : entre 45 et 55k€, payés sur 13 mois, selon ton expérience. 💸 Salaire variable : jusqu’à 15% de ta rémunération fixe, versés chaque trimestre. 💎 Autres avantages : prise en charge à 100% de ton Pass Navigo, à 67% de ta mutuelle (mono, duo ou famille) et à 60% de ta carte tickets resto. 🌴 Repos : 8 semaines par an : 5 semaines de congés payés + 3 semaines de RTT/an Tes expériences & compétences : Tu as au moins 5 ans d'expérience post-études en marketing digital et tu sais définir une stratégie autant que la mettre en œuvre. Tu maîtrises le SEO et tu sais le travailler sur un secteur contraint, comme ici dans le médical. Tu as expérimenté de premiers tests ou projets en GEO et tu as envie d'aller plus loin sur le sujet. Tu as déjà piloté un partenariat online stratégique de génération de leads ou un partenariat avec une marketplace qui vendait tes produits ou services : comprendre son fonctionnement et ses algorithmes, optimiser la visibilité et veiller à la qualité des flux, des contenus et des informations transmis. Tu sais analyser les données de chaque levier et du site, suivre les parcours utilisateurs et transformer les résultats en arbitrages concrets. Tu as un profil 360 : évolution de site, création de contenus et développement des réseaux sociaux font partie des sujets que tu sais aborder. Ta personnalité : Autonome et débrouillard·e, tu sais prendre des initiatives, structurer tes priorités et faire avancer tes projets. Proactif·ve et curieux·se, tu testes, tu mesures, tu recommences, et tu sors volontiers des sentiers battus quand le levier classique ne donne rien. Changer de cap ne te fait pas peur : tu es une personne agile, qui sait rebondir rapidement si c’est nécessaire. Pragmatique, tu aimes mettre les mains dans le cambouis et construire ce qui n'existe pas encore plutôt que d'optimiser l'existant à la marge. Pédagogue, tu sais adapter ton discours au niveau de connaissances de tes interlocuteurs sur tes sujets et vulgariser les concepts du marketing digital. Mon avis de recruteuse sur ce job : C'est un poste rare : toute la stratégie marketing digital est à construire, avec un enjeu fort d'acquisition mais aussi de visibilité, de contenus et d'expérience en ligne. Tu auras une vraie latitude pour décider par où commencer et faire avancer des sujets variés, dans une structure en croissance où ton expertise est attendue. Un beau terrain de jeu pour un profil 360 qui aime autant définir un cap que le concrétiser. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior PMO Analyst
description: About the Role Imagine this. You are joining Destinus at a pivotal moment, helping build a Project Management Office (PMO) from the ground up while supporting multiple fast-moving aerospace and defense programs. As a Senior PMO Analyst, you will play a key role in bringing structure, visibility, and execution discipline to complex programs, ensuring our Program Managers can focus on delivering groundbreaking technologies. Destinus is scaling multiple aerospace and defense programs in parallel, and we are looking for a proactive, hands-on professional who can take real workload off our Program Managers from day one. You will be embedded directly in our programs while helping establish the cross-functional processes, tools, and governance needed to support our growth. Reporting to the Head of PMO and working in close collaboration with C-level leadership, you will have the opportunity to shape how our programs are planned, monitored, and delivered. From building integrated schedules and managing risks to introducing AI-powered tools and automations, your work will have a direct and visible impact across the organization. At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations. What You'll Do Program Planning & Execution Proactively step in alongside Program Managers and take ownership of core PMO activities, including integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, and schedule control. Support one or several programs simultaneously, ensuring effective coordination and acting as a connector between teams and programs. Track program dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple initiatives, identifying potential conflicts and escalating issues early. Help Program Managers maintain clear visibility over progress, priorities, and delivery commitments, enabling them to focus on critical program execution. PMO Development & Cross-Functional Processes Work closely with the Head of PMO to build the PMO foundation from scratch, developing standards, templates, governance frameworks, and practical ways of working that teams actually use. Lead the development and implementation of cross-functional processes spanning programs and departments, from Engineering and Supply Chain to Production, Quality, and Delivery. Establish scalable processes that improve collaboration, consistency, and operational efficiency as Destinus continues to grow. Help create a structured yet pragmatic PMO environment that supports fast decision-making without introducing unnecessary complexity. Risk, Issue & Performance Management Drive program risk and issue management by proactively identifying, assessing, tracking, and escalating potential challenges. Coordinate and follow up on mitigation actions, ensuring risks and issues are addressed effectively and on time. Prepare clear program reports, dashboards, and decision-making materials for program reviews and senior leadership. Provide accurate and actionable insights into program performance, highlighting key milestones, risks, dependencies, and areas requiring management attention. AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement Develop and apply AI-supported tools and automations to make PMO activities faster, more efficient, and more reliable. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities, including reporting, status consolidation, and action tracking. Explore and implement practical solutions using AI tools, workflow automation, scripting, and low-code platforms where appropriate. Continuously improve PMO tools, processes, and reporting methods to reduce administrative workload and increase visibility across programs. Stakeholder Management & Leadership Collaboration Work closely with Program Managers, the Head of PMO, and C-level leadership to support program execution and strategic decision-making. Act as a central point of coordination across programs and functions, ensuring information, priorities, and dependencies remain aligned. Translate complex program information into structured, concise, and actionable updates for different stakeholders. Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and other business functions to drive effective collaboration. Requirements What You'll Need Required Qualifications & Experience At least 5 years of experience in PMO, Program Management, or Project Controls. Strong command of PMO fundamentals, including scheduling, risk management, reporting, and stakeholder management. A proactive, structured, and pragmatic approach to work, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate at pace. Confidence working from a blank page and building structure in a fast-moving, ambiguous scale-up environment. Fluency in English and German, both written and spoken. Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as MS Project, Jira, Microsoft Dynamics and other ERP systems, Smartsheet, Confluence, or similar platforms. Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create clear reports, dashboards, and leadership presentations. Eligibility to work in Switzerland. Willingness to travel occasionally to other Destinus locations. Strong Plus Previous consulting experience, ideally involving PMO setup, transformation, or hands-on PMO support for client companies. Practical experience using AI tools and automation technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), workflow automation, scripting, or low-code platforms. Experience designing, implementing, and improving cross-functional business processes. Understanding of hardware development and engineering environments, including product lifecycle management, gate reviews, and change management. Nice to Have Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe. Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or other complex hardware industries. Technical skills in Python, SQL, Power BI, or API-based integrations. Who You Are You are proactive by nature and do not wait for instructions to make things happen. You identify what needs to be done, take ownership, and deliver results. You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly, ambiguity is part of the challenge, and building structure from scratch is an opportunity rather than an obstacle. You combine strong analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach, knowing when to dive into the details and when to focus on the bigger picture. You enjoy bringing clarity to complexity, transforming scattered information, competing priorities, and challenging timelines into actionable plans. You are comfortable working closely with Program Managers and senior leadership, communicating confidently and turning complex program information into clear recommendations. You are naturally collaborative and know how to connect people, teams, and functions to keep programs moving forward. You challenge inefficient processes and actively look for smarter ways of working, especially through technology, AI, and automation. You are organized, detail-oriented, and reliable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of deadlines or deliverables. You bring a continuous improvement mindset, balancing the discipline of structured program management with the flexibility required in a rapidly growing company. You are comfortable taking initiative, making decisions, and working independently while knowing when to involve others or escalate critical issues. You value transparency, accountability, and teamwork, and you are motivated by making a tangible impact on complex aerospace and defense programs. What We Offer A founding role in building the PMO of a fast-growing aerospace company, with the opportunity to shape its structure and future direction. The freedom to develop and influence the tools, processes, standards, and ways of working that will support our continued growth. Direct access to senior leadership, including close collaboration with the Head of PMO and C-level executives, and the opportunity to make a visible impact across multiple programs. The chance to join a high-performing, international team working on advanced aerospace and defense technologies that matter. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

You work on site with our engineering development partner in the Maastricht area and steer their team on our behalf. This is a hands-on senior role: you design yourself, review the work of others and make sure the hardware is safe, verifiable and ready for design transfer.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and own the mechatronic system architecture: robotic device, drives, force and torque sensing, real-time controllers, safety supervisor, power supply and the interface to commercial TEE probes.</li> <li>Translate user and system requirements into subsystem and interface specifications and keep them traceable through verification.</li> <li>Act as technical counterpart to our engineering development partner, from ideation, technology and part selection through design reviews and approval of design outputs. Challenge cost and effort and make the make-or-buy call per subsystem.</li> <li>Work closely with the System Software Architect on the hardware/software split, real-time control, and safety title: Control & Estimation Intern
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. About the Role We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on. These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation. Your mission The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions. Responsibilities Literature review: Survey existing approaches to disturbance estimation and adaptive control Algorithm implementation: Develop and implement the selected estimation and compensation algorithms within our simulation environment. Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and robustness of the developed methods against classical baselines. Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware. Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results and conclusions. Flight test participation: Actively take part in flight test sessions to validate the developed algorithms in operational conditions, and contribute to their real-time deployment. Candidates Requirements Educational background: Strong academic record in automatic control, applied mathematics, or a related field. Knowledge of state estimation (Kalman filtering, observers) and nonlinear or adaptive control is a strong plus. Technical skills : Solid understanding of control theory fundamentals and proficiency in Python or C++ is a plus. Experience with drones is a major plus. Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous, rigorous and able to take initiative. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. title: Senior People Ops Manager (International)
description: About us Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator’s Summer 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading AI photo and video solution for e-commerce, helping businesses sell at first sight. Backed by Series B funding, we’ve reached 300M+ downloads and now process around 7 billion images a year for businesses of every size, from solo sellers to global brands and marketplaces like Amazon, Decathlon, and Depop. We serve them through our mobile app, web platform, and API, with tailored solutions for enterprise catalogs. We’re an international team of 130+, with offices in Paris and New York. We take ownership of what we build, move quickly to learn what works, and speak candidly, united by our ambition to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide. The role We are looking for a Senior People Operations Manager to own and improve the systems, processes and operational foundations behind our People function, across all of our markets. You will own the core People Operations scope: payroll, HRIS, contracts, compliance, benefits, employee lifecycle operations, immigration, people data and our HR tooling. But this is not simply a role about running existing processes - your job is to make them better. You will build the people workflows, automation, documentation and self-service mechanisms that allow Photoroom to keep moving quickly as we grow, without creating unnecessary complexity. This scope has so far sat within a small generalist People team. You will be the first person to own it as a dedicated senior scope, giving you the opportunity to shape this operating model. We are also an AI-native company, and we want our People function to operate the same way. We expect you to actively use automation and AI to improve speed, reliability and employee experience, while maintaining a high bar for privacy, compliance and trust. You will report to our VP People. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports today. Why this role exists We have built a lot quickly. Today, our People Operations environment includes: French and USA payroll and entity obligations European employees through an EOR setup Growing Paris and New York offices Multiple benefits providers and external partners An HR technology stack that has grown alongside the company The foundations work. Now they need a clear owner and regular improvements. We want to move from processes that depend on individual knowledge and manual intervention to an operating model that is documented, automated, measurable and more self-service for our employees . Your goal is to strengthen our foundations with proven best practices and build a model that scales comfortably with the company. What you will own Payroll Own and Run monthly payroll for France and our European population, and twice-monthly US payroll, working closely with our external providers Manage relationships with payroll, EOR and employment providers Compliance Maintain our French statutory obligations and HR compliance calendar, including employee records, social declarations, DUERP and employee data requirements Own the operational administration of our CSE, including convocations, agendas, meeting preparation, PV review, annual budget administration and mandatory timelines Monitor relevant employment law developments and translate changes into concrete actions Coordinate compliance across our European and US setups, with deep expertise expected in France primarly Contracts and People documentation Employment contracts, amendments, offer letters, attestations and standard HR letters, maintaining and improving templates as our organisation and legal environment evolve Setting clear service levels for recurring People Ops requests Building practical People playbooks and documentation that employees and managers can actually find, understand and use Employee lifecycle Onboarding administration from signed offer through day one, coordinating payroll, benefits, declarations, IT access, equipment, manager actions ect.. Offboarding and exit administration, including documentation, payroll, benefits, access removal and final employment documents Promotions, compensation changes, employment changes, contract amendments, leaves, parental leave and other employee changes Immigration and visa administration, including external providers, applications, renewals and deadline tracking Benefits & Compensation Administer benefits and manage providers across France, Europe and the US Run annual renewals with Finance and the VP People, using cost, usage and employee value to inform decisions Support compensation benchmarking and salary band maintenance HRIS, data and automation Our HRIS is Hibob today, which may or may not change. You will own the reliability and evolution of our People systems. This includes: HRIS configuration, permissions, workflows, integrations and data quality Making the HRIS the reliable source of truth for employee data Assessing opportunities to consolidate or improve our HR technology stack Automating repetitive workflows wherever doing so improves speed and reliability Employee support You will help us move from a People team that repeatedly answers standard questions to one that builds systems people can use themselves. You will build the documentation, workflows, processes and self-service infrastructure that make the majority of standard People requests easy to solve without intervention, while personally handling the exceptions and escalations that genuinely require expertise. What we are looking for You have already owned a meaningful People Operations scope in a fast-moving company of +100 employees. In particular, we are looking for: Hands-on experience with French payroll and employment compliance Experience owning People Operations processes, workflows, and controls HRIS experience. Hibob is a plus, but experience configuring and improving a comparable system matters more A systems mindset and a strong instinct for automation Excellent operational judgement. You know which issues you can solve yourself and which require specialist advice High standards of accuracy, discretion and follow-through Comfort operating independently in a small team where you will both design the process and run it Fluent French and English. English is our working language, while much of our payroll and employment law environment is French Based in Paris and able to work from our office at least three days per week. The person who will thrive here likes that combination: build it, simplify it, automate it and own it. Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds. That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. description: Lieu : Sud de Nantes (44) Salaire : 55 à 65 K€ brut annuel selon profil Rythme : 1j de télétravail par semaine Nous recherchons pour notre client, acteur national spécialisé dans les services : un Ingénieur Data & IA – DevOps / MLOps (H/F) dans le cadre d'une création de poste en CDI. Environnement technique : -Cloud & Infrastructure : Scaleway, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes -DevOps : GitLab CI / GitHub Actions, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code -Data & IA : Airflow, LLM, RAG, bases vectorielles, plateformes Data -Développement & Intégration : API REST, Python / Java / Node.js, architectures événementielles -Sécurité & Observabilité : IAM, SSO, API Gateway, monitoring, logs et alerting VOUS : De formation supérieure en informatique (Bac+5 ou parcours équivalent), vous justifiez d'au moins 6 années d'expérience en DevOps, SRE ou ingénierie plateforme, avec une solide expérience de l'exploitation d'infrastructures Cloud en production. Vous maîtrisez les environnements conteneurisés (Docker, Kubernetes), l'Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), les pipelines CI/CD ainsi que les problématiques d'intégration et de développement d'API. Une expérience en MLOps, dans l'exploitation de solutions d'IA générative ou sur des plateformes Data modernes constitue un véritable atout. Une connaissance de Scaleway, OVHcloud ou d'environnements Cloud souverains sera également appréciée. Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, vous êtes reconnu pour votre autonomie, votre rigueur et votre capacité à prendre en charge un environnement technique stratégique. Ce qui rend ce poste intéressant : -Une création de poste au cœur d'une transformation complète de la DSI. -Une plateforme Data & IA à industrialiser, avec de véritables enjeux de production. -Un environnement technique moderne et des projets autour de l'IA générative. -Un rôle transverse avec une forte autonomie et un impact direct sur les choix d'industrialisation. -L'opportunité de contribuer à la construction d'un SI moderne, évolutif et maîtrisé en interne. title: Infrastructure & Cybersecurity Project Manager (f/m/d)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span data-teams="true">PHENOGY AG is a leading innovator of battery energy storage technologies and solutions for the green electrification of the planet. Our team members work on future-proof and sustainable battery systems that are powerful, safe, and robust – with circularity as a central principle. Our technology partner network spans leading battery research institutes. PHENOGY is an environmentally and socially conscious enterprise. We are committed to fostering prosperity for the people and our planet, ensuring sustainable growth – starting in the area of our greatest expertise and impact: energy storage solutions.</span></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><strong>We energize the future.</strong></span></p> <div class="content-intro"> <p><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);">PHENOGY is seeking curious, entrepreneurial-minded energy pioneers to help shape our vision, systems, and growth; playing a key-role as we launch into our ambitious future. If you’re inspired by our mission, values, and drive to change how we energize the future — we’d love your application.</span></p> </div></div><p>Purpose/Mission - The role owns the infrastructure, network and cybersecurity workstream for</p> <ul> <li>PHENOGY's corporate IT infrastructure (cloud, network, endpoints, identities and access) and its interfaces with the Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) product environment. It translates business, product, operational, customer and regulatory requirements into secure, resilient and auditable infrastructure and security controls across the BESS lifecycle.</li> <li>Cybersecurity governance and the Information Security Management System (ISO/IEC 27001)</li> <li>Security architecture of BESS connectivity (EMS, BMS, gateways, IoT, APIs) and secure data exchange with partners such as Heidelberg</li> <li>Backup, business continuity and disaster recovery for critical systems (BESS/EMS, ERP, CRM)</li> <li>Project management of infrastructure and cybersecurity projects</li> </ul> <p>Your Tasks & Responsibilities</p> <ul> <li>Act as internal-facing and technical owner of the IT infrastructure and security landscape: network, firewalling and web filtering, Microsoft 365/Azure tenants, identity and access management, endpoints, backup, and secure remote/supplier access to BESS sites.</li> <li>Maintain the asset and configuration inventory, network and security architecture documentation, risk register, vulnerability backlog, security policies and the infrastructure/security roadmap.</li> <li>Run the risk management and vulnerability management cycle: periodic assessments, prioritisation, patching and remediation tracking across IT systems, applications, APIs and BESS connectivity.</li> <li>Define and operate security monitoring, incident response, escalation paths, maintenance windows and problem management, together with external service providers (MSP/MSSP).</li> <li>Define backup and retention policies (daily, monthly, yearly; 10+ years for critical data), offline/immutable backups, disaster-recovery runbooks and regular restore and DR tests.</li> <li>Define secure segmentation between corporate IT and the OT/BESS environment and secure remote access for O&M and field service, aligned with IEC 62443 concepts.</li> <li>Provide infrastructure, system-integration and cybersecurity support to the After Sales & Service framework once operational responsibility moves to the Service Manager.</li> <li>Support B2B customer and audit requests: security questionnaires, tender requirements and compliance evidence.</li> <li>Hands on when required: configure firewall rules, endpoint and identity policies, backup jobs and cloud security settings.</li> </ul> <p>Key Projects (2027 portfolio)</p> <ul> <li>Risk Management & Vulnerability Assessment (Jan–Feb 2027): assess risks and vulnerabilities across all systems and deliver a prioritised remediation plan.</li> <li>BESS Security Architecture II (Jan–Mar 2027): secure the BESS architecture and data exchange with Heidelberg, building on the current BESS security baseline.</li> <li>Business Continuity & Recovery System (Feb–Apr 2027): offline backup and disaster recovery for critical systems such as BESS/EMS, ERP and CRM.</li> <li>Network Improvements (Feb–Jun 2027): introduce firewalling and web filtering, which are not yet in place.</li> <li>Advanced Threat Protection – ISO 27001 (Mar–May 2027): protect network and application traffic, including APIs and IP-based access.</li> <li>ISO 27001 Enhancements (ongoing): close control gaps, maintain policies and evidence, and prepare for audits.</li> <li>Take over operation of granular backup and advanced endpoint management, and provide security input to the PHENOGY IoT solution POC (BMS/EMS communication and REST APIs).</li> </ul> <p>Core Competencies</p> <ul> <li>Lead assigned infrastructure and cybersecurity projects from initiation through closure, using structured scope, schedule, budget, dependency, risk, issue, decision and change control.</li> <li>Create project charters, work breakdown structures, delivery plans, security requirements, test and DR-test plans, cutover plans, acceptance records and handover packages to operations.</li> <li>Coordinate external suppliers (MSP/MSSP, network and firewall vendors, cloud providers, BESS/EMS partners) to resolve cross-functional blockers and escalate material decisions to the Head of IT and relevant governance bodies.</li> <li>Provide concise status reporting on progress, milestones, risk posture, vulnerabilities, incidents, suppliers and compliance.</li> </ul> <p>Required Qualifications & Experience</p> <ul> <li>Degree or equivalent professional experience in information technology, computer science, information security, engineering or a related discipline.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience in IT infrastructure and cybersecurity management, including responsibility for delivering projects, ideally in an international mid-sized company.</li> <li>Practical experience with network security (firewalls, VPN, segmentation, web filtering, IDS/IPS), Microsoft 365 / Entra ID / Intune / Defender, and backup and disaster recovery.</li> <li>Experience running risk assessments, vulnerability management and security incident response.</li> <li>Hands-on experience implementing or maintaining an ISMS according to ISO/IEC 27001.</li> <li>Experience coordinating technical suppliers and multidisciplinary stakeholders across business, IT and engineering.</li> <li>Ability to understand operational technology and industrial-system boundaries without assuming ownership of safety engineering or embedded-control design.</li> <li>Strong documentation, risk management and executive-status reporting skills.</li> <li>Professional English; German or another relevant operating language is an advantage.</li> </ul> <p>Strongly preferred</p> <ul> <li>Experience securing Battery Energy Storage Systems, EMS, BMS, SCADA, PLC, PCS/inverters, industrial gateways, IoT or energy-data platforms.</li> <li>Working knowledge of IEC 62443, NIS2 and the EU Cyber Resilience Act in mixed IT/OT environments.</li> <li>Experience with Azure networking and security, Microsoft Sentinel / Defender XDR and enterprise firewall platforms (e.g. Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point).</li> <li>Familiarity with industrial protocols and secure integration patterns, including Modbus TCP, OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs, API gateways and certificate/PKI management.</li> <li>Experience with backup and DR solutions for cloud and hybrid environments, including immutable and offline backups.</li> <li>Recognized credentials such as CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, GICSP, PMP, PRINCE2 or ITIL are advantageous</li> </ul> <p>Decision-making authority: Approves infrastructure and security changes, firewall and access rules and security exceptions within the agreed policy framework and budget; may isolate systems or accounts during a security incident; escalates risk acceptance and major investments to the Head of IT.</p> <p>Reporting Line: Reporting to Head of IT Direct reports: none (functional lead of external infrastructure and security providers)</p> <p>Workload: 100% - Hybrid</p> <p>Travel: approx. 10% – PHENOGY offices, BESS customer sites and partner/supplier sites as required</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><strong>We offer you:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);">Join a high-caliber environment that enables you to develop your full potential, shape your job, and take ownership.</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);">Participate in the development of PHENOGY and inspire the world to transition to sustainable energy.</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);">Become part of our eco-passionate expert team - a first-class team all around. </span></li> <li style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);">Benefit from flexible work hours as well as remote and on-site working in a modern sustainable office</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);">Enjoy various events, an amazing coffee machine, and the occasional coffee from our CEO (acting Barista)</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);">At PHENOGY, we highly value diversity, equality, and inclusion. It makes our company stronger. <strong>Our philosophy: one mindset, many minds.</strong></span></p> <p> </p> <h6><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">For recruitment and staffing agencies: PHENOGY works exclusively with selected recruitment partners under formal agreements. </span></span><span style="color: rgb(26, 0, 120);"><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">We do not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from agencies and assume no liability for claims made by unauthorized recruiters regarding our recruitment processes.</span></span></h6></div> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior IT Engineer
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. Mission Alan is scaling internationally (800+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Engineers to build and own the internal technology platform every Alaner works on: identity and provisioning, endpoint and SaaS security, the tooling behind our clinics, and the automation that keeps IT from scaling linearly with headcount. The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. You'll be staffed on one or two of these areas at a time, according to your strengths and interests, and it will evolve through time based on company needs and personal appetite. Staying close to users keeps us building the right things: you'll spend up to 2-3 days a month on IT support, seeing first-hand where friction lives and what's worth automating next. Scope ⚙️ Platform & automation Own and extend automations on Alan Home, our internal provisioning engine Maintain, extend and improve helpdesk automation, SaaS provisioning flows, and onboarding/offboarding pipelines Own the meeting room AV and room-booking platform as a product, replicable across offices 🔑 Identity & access Own the IT side of the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, mobility between jobs and countries) across Google Workspace, SSO/SAML and our SaaS ecosystem. Grow our role-based access model: extend it to more tools and refine the permission groups, so access is granted by role rather than case by case Make employee lifecycle events reliable, fast and auditable end-to-end Own access reviews and least-privilege models; produce and maintain the evidence our auditors rely on Own SaaS procurement and license management: vendor relationships, renewals, and cost optimization across our stack 🔒 Endpoint & SaaS security Own the Mac fleet in Kandji: enrollment at scale, role-based blueprints, fleet compliance Cloudflare WARP, SaaS security controls Maintain and strengthen our ISO 27001 certification and drive ACPR and pentest remediation on the endpoint and platform scope 🩺 Health Professionals IT The IT layer behind Alan's clinics: practitioner tooling, equipment, access Role and permission automation for healthcare professionals, and their support and escalation process 🌍 Internationalisation Make international expansion something IT accelerates, not something it slows down: a repeatable process where every new market (Canada, KSA, Armenia...) launches on our standard stack from day one Bring acquired entities onto that same platform Milestones First 3 months Acquire technical knowledge on Alan's platform: Alan Home, Google Workspace/SSO, Kandji, Cloudflare WARP Take one project end-to-end and ship a first increment Join the IT oncall team as technical escalation First 6 months Own a workstream end-to-end Deliver one automation or hardening initiative end-to-end Take up documentation and automation on your scope and reduce significantly the bus factor on it Mentor IT teammates on your core expertise First year Deliver measurable IT toil reduction on your scope Set the technical standards on your domain: how we build, document and review it Build strong cross-functional partnerships (Engineering, Security, Workplace, Clinic, People, Audit) Contribute to hiring and onboarding new teammates 3 years Lead major projects end-to-end across several communities Be the reference the team relies on across at least two domains Mentor the IT team and beyond, and scale IT without a linear increase in manual work As title: Technical Marketing Engineer
description: The role Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories. You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market. Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications. This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams. Your mission Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable. You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it. The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate. What you will do Drive technical co-builds with partners Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept. Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks. Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure. Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories. Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets. Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility. Produce technical marketing content Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives. Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations. Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets. Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember. Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity. Build for the audience Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work. Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype. Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance. Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology. Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication. What we are looking for A strong engineering background The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred. Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems. Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video. A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation. Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value. Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams. The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept. Excellent written and spoken English. This role may suit you if You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing. You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value. You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market. You prefer building a convincing prototype and narrative over maintaining production systems. You can challenge a technically impressive idea when it does not serve the audience or the message. This role is probably not for you if Your primary interest is delivering reliable customer implementations or maintaining production integrations. You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it. You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete. You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes. How the role complements Product Marketing Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity. The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content. What success looks like Within the first year, you will have: Established a repeatable technical co-build motion with NVIDIA and other priority partners. Produced partner demonstrations that create concrete content, event and relationship opportunities. Built a steady flow of high-quality technical articles, demos and videos. Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance. Become the bridge between Marketing, Engineering and partner technical teams. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: HR Operations Specialist, APAC (Full-time)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: Singapore</strong></p> <p><strong>What You Would Do Here:</strong></p> <p>Our focus is getting the best people to work at Cloudflare and then allowing them to do their best work. In this vital role, you will be the first point of contact for our employees, ensuring their journey is smooth and positive. Partner with regional teams to implement scalable solutions that improve the overall People Operations function across APJC.</li> <li><strong>Support strategic HR initiatives and projects:</strong> Contribute to HR system implementations, vendor management, and regional programs such as annual performance and compensation cycles, benefits enrollment, and year-end Payroll preparation, making them easy to understand and navigate for our employees.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills/experience</strong> </p> <ul> <li>5+ years in HR administration and comfortable handling sensitive employee information with discretion.</li> <li>Highly organized with strong attention to detail, excellent problem-solving abilities, and effective time management skills. </li> <li>Proficient in working with data and skilled in Excel or Google Sheets for analysis and reporting.</li> <li>Customer-focused mindset with a genuine passion for supporting colleagues and delivering exceptional service.</li> <li>Effective communicator, able to clearly articulate information both verbally and in writing to employees across the APJC region.</li> <li>Adaptable and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with the ability to manage shifting priorities efficiently.</li> <li>Familiarity with Workday or Zendesk would be an advantage.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

Connaissances Qualité : Une connaissance des systèmes de management de la qualité, de l’environnement GxP , des SOPs et des exigences de traçabilité documentaire constitue un véritable atout. Coordination de projets : Expérience dans le pilotage d’actions transverses, le suivi de plans d’actions ou la coordination de groupes de travail impliquant plusieurs parties prenantes. Compétences techniques : Maîtrise des outils Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) ainsi que de SharePoint . Une expérience de gestion documentaire ou de suivi de processus qualité est appréciée. Qualités personnelles : Excellent sens de l’organisation, rigueur, autonomie, esprit de synthèse et capacité à gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle. Vous faites preuve de proactivité et savez assurer un suivi efficace des actions confiées. Benefits Chez Excelya, nous associons passion pour la science et esprit d'équipe afin de redéfinir l'excellence dans le secteur de la santé. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'experts reconnus et contribuerez concrètement à l'amélioration du parcours patient. Vos défis deviennent notre mission collective. Ensemble, nous transformons les idées ambitieuses en réalisations concrètes, à la manière d'Excelya. title: Candidate Experience Specialist, Team Lead (APJ)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As the Candidate Experience Team Lead for [Region], you'll own how candidates experience GitLab across your region by raising the capability of the specialists around you. You'll set the quality bar, balance workloads, onboard and develop specialists, and serve as the first escalation point when a process breaks down or a candidate situation needs judgment. You'll stay hands-on with interview coordination, background checks, and offers, while spending most of your time making the regional function run well. You'll use candidate experience data to surface patterns and risks to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement, and partner with leads in other regions to maintain one global process. At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Lead Candidate Experience Specialists in [Region], setting and modeling standards for interview coordination, candidate communication, contract and offer accuracy, and data hygiene in the applicant tracking system.</li> <li value="2">Balance coordination work across the regional team, monitor capacity against hiring volume, and flag resourcing gaps to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement before they affect candidates.</li> <li value="3">Resolve escalated scheduling conflicts, candidate issues, and process gaps, bringing clear recommendations to leadership when further support is needed.</li> <li value="4">Own onboarding, ramp, and ongoing development for new specialists through documentation, shadowing, and direct feedback on work quality.</li> <li value="5">Coordinate interviews, prepare offers and employment contracts, manage background and reference checks, and partner with People Operations on the handoff to onboarding.</li> <li value="6">Build and maintain reporting on candidate satisfaction, specialist response times, scheduling turnaround, and data accuracy to identify patterns, bottlenecks, and risks.</li> <li value="7">Partner with leads in other regions to maintain one global coordination process, contribute regional evidence to process and tooling improvements, implement agreed changes, and keep documentation accurate in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories.</li> <li value="8">Collaborate with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, Information Technology, and People Operations across time zones to keep hiring moving, modeling GitLab's values, culture, and all-remote approach in every interaction.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Substantial experience in candidate experience or recruiting coordination, covering interview scheduling, offer and contract preparation, background checks, and onboarding handoffs, including serving as a senior or go-to team member.</li> <li value="2">Ability to lead and develop team members without formal authority through mentoring, onboarding, direct feedback, and influence.</li> <li value="3">Attention to detail in scheduling, contracts, and candidate data, with a record of professionalism, responsiveness, sound judgment under pressure, and maintaining confidentiality.</li> <li value="4">Experience anticipating risks, resolving scheduling and process problems early, prioritizing competing demands, and setting clear expectations about timelines, next steps, and trade-offs.</li> <li value="5">Experience building and maintaining candidate experience or scheduling reports, using data to identify bottlenecks and make a case for change.</li> <li value="6">Experience working across regions or functions to standardize processes, with the judgment to distinguish genuine regional requirements from inconsistent practices.</li> <li value="7">Clear written and verbal communication with candidates and stakeholders at all levels, including executives, and the ability to build collaborative relationships across functions and time zones.</li> <li value="8">Proficiency with an applicant tracking system or interview tool for scheduling, tracking, and stage management, plus Google Workspace and scheduling tools, and a willingness to learn additional tools. Greenhouse and ModernLoop experience is beneficial but not required.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Our Candidate Experience team supports candidates through interview coordination, offers and contracts, background and reference checks, and the transition to onboarding. As regional leads and specialists, we partner with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, Information Technology, and People Operations to deliver a consistent global candidate experience. We work across time zones, using transparent documentation in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories to collaborate asynchronously. Our regional leads work together to resolve process differences and bring regional evidence into global improvements.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

</li> <li> <p>Construire et exploiter des plateformes de données : entrepôts et lakehouses, orchestration, traitement batch et streaming.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire des pipelines CI/CD et l’outillage MLOps et LLMOps.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire le harness des agents : runtime, frameworks d’évaluation, observabilité.</p> </li> <li> <p>Servir les modèles et maîtriser leur coût et leur latence.</p> </li> <li> <p>Poser les fondations de sécurité : IAM, réseau, secrets, droits d’accès des agents, protection contre le prompt injection.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire des connecteurs et description: <p><strong>Mission</strong></p> <p>Des groupes de premier plan font tourner leur IA sur ce que vous construisez. Infrastructure cloud, plateformes de données, chaînes de delivery, serving de modèles, runtime des agents : ces fondations portent à grande échelle les applications et les agents de nos clients, et vous les concevez et les exploitez. Grâce à ce travail, les équipes produit livrent sans risque, tandis que les coûts, la latence et la sécurité restent sous contrôle.</p> <p><strong>Ce poste est fait pour vous si vos utilisateurs sont d’autres équipes d’ingénierie et si la robustesse d’un système sous charge vous intéresse.</strong></p> <p>Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Platform Engineer.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Activités et responsabilités</strong></p> <p>Les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers déploient sur les plateformes que vous construisez ; leurs besoins se définissent avec eux, et leur accompagnement se poursuit jusqu’en production.</p> <p>Sur une plateforme de données, les fondations vous reviennent : infrastructure, sécurité, réseau, calcul. Ce qui y circule relève des Context & Analytics Engineers. Le travail se mène aussi avec les équipes IT, sécurité et cloud du client, sous le regard desquelles chaque choix d’architecture doit pouvoir se défendre ; le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités :</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Déployer l’infrastructure cloud en infrastructure as code et conduire les migrations cloud.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire et exploiter des plateformes de données : entrepôts et lakehouses, orchestration, traitement batch et streaming.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire des pipelines CI/CD et l’outillage MLOps et LLMOps.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire le harness des agents : runtime, frameworks d’évaluation, observabilité.</p> </li> <li> <p>Servir les modèles et maîtriser leur coût et leur latence.</p> </li> <li> <p>Poser les fondations de sécurité : IAM, réseau, secrets, droits d’accès des agents, protection contre le prompt injection.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire des connecteurs et des serveurs MCP que plusieurs agents réutilisent.</p> </li> <li> <p>Garantir la fiabilité : monitoring, gestion des incidents, suivi des coûts.</p> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Profil recherché</strong></p> <p><strong>Les indispensables :</strong></p> <ol> <li> <p>Vous avez construit et exploité de l’infrastructure cloud sur Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS, en infrastructure as code.</p> </li> <li> <p>Des pipelines CI/CD et des déploiements conteneurisés, par exemple sur Kubernetes, font partie de votre pratique.</p> </li> <li> <p>Les bases de la sécurité (IAM, règles réseau, gestion des secrets) s’appliquent chez vous au quotidien.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ce que vous exploitez, vous le surveillez, et vous prenez part à la gestion des incidents.</p> </li> <li> <p>Le code et la documentation que vous écrivez restent maintenables pour les équipes qui utilisent votre plateforme.</p> </li> <li> <p>Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.</p> </li> </ol> <p><strong>Un plus, pas un prérequis :</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Une expérience de plateformes de données, par exemple sur Databricks, BigQuery ou Snowflake.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience MLOps ou LLMOps : serving de modèles, model registry, pipelines d’évaluation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience d’observabilité d’agents ou de LLM gateway : tracing, suivi des coûts, routage.</p> </li> <li> <p>FinOps : suivi et optimisation des coûts.</p> </li> <li> <p>Sécurité de l’IA : droits d’accès des agents, red teaming, guardrails.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une certification cloud.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler</strong> : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</strong></p> <p>Une plateforme n’est jamais terminée : chaque nouvel agent déployé chez un client soulève de nouvelles questions de coût, de latence et de droits d’accès. Le Platform Engineer travaille à l’endroit où ces questions se posent en premier, au plus près des équipes techniques et de sécurité du client.</p> <p>Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.</p> <p>Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.</p> <p>Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.</p> <p>Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.</p> <p>Le reste s’apprend sur les projets : serving de modèles, observabilité des agents, sécurité de l’IA, avec l’appui de la communauté Platform Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Platform Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).</p> <p>Une spécialisation en sécurité de l’IA (red teaming, guardrails, conformité à l’AI Act) est possible : elle relève aujourd’hui de l’archétype Platform Engineer. Plus tard, un rôle transverse s’ouvre (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), et les Platform Engineers seniors peuvent rejoindre le chapter AI Architect.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Processus de recrutement</strong></p> <p>Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.</p> <ol> <li> <p><strong>Entretien RH</strong> (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Appel avec le CTO</strong> (15 à 30 min, à distance).</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Screening technique</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Code review et live coding</strong> (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Cas technique</strong> (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Entretien final</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.</p> </li> </ol> <p>Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Rémunération </strong>: 66 000€ à 85 000€ brut annuel (fixe) selon expérience et séniorité</p> <p> </p> <p><em>Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.</em></p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

À partir de 2027, l’archétype Context & Analytics Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).</p> <p>Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Processus de recrutement</strong></p> <p>Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.</p> <ol> <li><strong>Entretien RH</strong> (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.</li> <li><strong>Appel avec le CTO</strong> (15 à 30 min, à distance).</li> <li><strong>Screening technique</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.</li> <li><strong>Code review et live coding</strong> (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.</li> <li><strong>Cas technique</strong> (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.</li> <li><strong>Entretien final</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.</li> </ol> <p>Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Rémunération </strong>: 53 000€ à 70 000€ brut annuel (fixe)  + variable selon expérience et séniorité</p> <p> </p> <p><em>Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes.
