title: CDI - Senior AI Strategist - Paris
description: <p><strong>Prenez en main un stream de transformation IA, au contact direct des clients, de la vision aux résultats mesurables.</strong></p> <p>L’IA, et en particulier l’IA agentique, figure parmi les priorités des comités de direction.<br>Chez Artefact, nous sommes des makers. “We Make AI Work” : notre métier n’est pas de commenter l’IA, c’est de la faire fonctionner, à grande échelle, au cœur des grands groupes. </p> <p>Et tout commence par vous.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Mission</strong></p> <p>En tant que <strong>Senior AI Strategist</strong>, vous prenez en main un stream ou une mission bien cadrée, avec autonomie sur votre périmètre et au contact direct des clients : vous cadrez, analysez, prototypez et recommandez, vous coachez les consultants juniors, et vous voyez vos recommandations prendre vie avec nos équipes Engineering.</p> <p>Vous commencez là où débute toute transformation IA : par l’ambition du client, son secteur d’activité et ses processus métier, et non par la technologie. Et vous restez un maker : vous ne vous arrêtez pas au slide. Vous construisez vous-même analyses, business cases et démos fonctionnelles (vibe coding, low-code, no-code) que le client peut toucher, et vous développez un domaine d’expertise solide dans un secteur ou une fonction métier.</p> <p>Vous travaillez main dans la main avec nos équipes Engineering (qui construisent et livrent des solutions d’IA agentique) et nos équipes AI Adoption (qui favorisent leur adoption) : vous cadrez les processus cibles et la roadmap de votre stream, Engineering les construit et les livre, et AI Adoption accompagne les personnes dans le changement, dès le premier jour.</p> <p><br><strong>Activités & Responsabilités</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Conception de la stratégie et de la transformation IA</strong></li> </ul> <p>Vous contribuez à cadrer la vision IA et à la roadmap du stream, qualifiez et priorisez les cas d’usage, et arbitrez entre solutions IA et non-IA. Vous investiguez les processus métier, identifiez les irritants et les causes racines, et proposez des pistes de refonte priorisées, en pensant d’abord lean et en n’utilisant l’IA que là où elle apporte de la valeur. Vous contribuez également à la conception du modèle opératoire cible et à ses conditions de succès.</p> <ul> <li><strong> Analyses, business cases & prototypage</strong></li> </ul> <p>Vous concevez et pilotez les travaux d’analyse du stream afin de sécuriser des décisions fondées sur les données et sur les faits : vous collectez et validez les données, revoyez les analyses des consultants juniors, construisez des business cases de bout en bout et formulez des recommandations. Vous prototypez des cas d’usage avec des outils agentiques pour illustrer la valeur par la démo et aider les clients à se projeter dans la solution finale.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Delivery, livrables & collaboration</strong></li> </ul> <p>Vous pilotez au quotidien la livraison d’un stream ou d’une mission cadrée : vous construisez le rétro-planning, identifiez les risques et blocages, proposez des solutions et donnez de la visibilité au N+1 et aux équipes du client. Vous coordonnez votre stream avec les équipes Engineering pour la faisabilité technique et avec les équipes AI Adoption pour ancrer l’adoption sur le terrain.</p> <ul> <li><strong> Relation client & développement commercial</strong></li> </ul> <p>Vous construisez une relation de proximité avec votre interlocuteur direct, élargissez le réseau de parties prenantes aux équipes opérationnelles et au middle management, anticipez les résistances et animez des ateliers en autonomie. Vous identifiez des opportunités, soutenez le plan de compte avec le Manager et le Directeur et participez aux propositions et aux événements de networking.</p> <ul> <li><strong> Équipe & connaissances</strong></li> </ul> <p>Vous déléguez avec des instructions claires, donnez des feedbacks constructifs, animez des 1to1 avec les consultants juniors et participez aux rétrospectives et aux entretiens de candidats. Vous contribuez à la base de connaissances interne par des articles et des retours d’expérience, et animez des sessions d’onboarding et des formations internes.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Profil recherché</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Vous vous reconnaissez si</strong>… vous aimez avoir la main sur un périmètre, structurer des problèmes complexes et voir vos recommandations se concrétiser, et si vous préférez mettre une démo entre les mains du client plutôt que lui décrire une vision.</p> <ul> <li>2 à 5 ans d’expérience au sein d’un cabinet de conseil en stratégie, en d’un Comex.</li> <li>Bonne compréhension des enjeux opérationnels de l’IA (IA générative et agentique, gouvernance, cas d’usage métiers)</li> <li>Aisance dans la construction de business cases et dans la restitution à des équipes opérationnelles et au middle management.</li> <li>Première expérience d’analyse ou de refonte de processus métier, avec une appétence pour certains domaines métier.</li> With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong><em><span data-contrast="auto">Please note: this position is only available for students who are proficient in the Dutch language! </span></em></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p>Bij WPP Media zijn we het wereldwijde mediacollectief van WPP, volledig gebouwd voor het AI-tijdperk. We bundelen het beste platform, de meest getalenteerde mensen en de sterkste partners om innovatieve oplossingen te creëren. Ons doel? Merken elke dag ongeëvenaarde groei bieden. Dit fundament vinden we in onze gedeelde kernwaarden:</p> <p><strong>We’re Extraordinary:</strong> We verleggen grenzen, dagen het gewone denken uit en doorbreken de status-quo in ons streven naar innovatie en groei.</p> <p><strong>We’re Open:</strong> We bouwen vertrouwen en begrip door naadloos samen te werken – met onze teams, klanten en partners.</p> <p><strong>We’re Optimistic:</strong> Een 'growth mindset' zit in ons DNA. We omarmen verandering als dé manier om het beste uit onszelf te halen.</p> <h3><strong>Klaar om de social media-wereld te veroveren? Word onze Stagiair Social Media bij StudioM!</strong></h3> <p>Droom jij ervan om te werken voor A-merken als Mentos, Katja en Tempo-Team? Krijg jij energie van het creëren van viral content en het spotten van de nieuwste TikTok-trends? Dan hebben we de perfecte match! Bij StudioM, het creatieve hart van WPP Media, zoeken we een gedreven Stagiair Social Media die ons team komt versterken.</p> <h3><strong>Wie zijn wij?</strong></h3> <p>StudioM is een uniek collectief van creatievelingen die verslaafd zijn aan digital design, contentcreatie en influencer marketing. We zijn onderdeel van WPP Media en werken vanuit die basis voor de gaafste merken. Je komt terecht in ons jonge, dynamische en supergezellige social media team. Verwacht flexibele kantoordagen, legendarische teamuitjes en een sfeer waar jouw input écht telt.</p> <h3><strong>Jouw missie, mocht je die accepteren:</strong></h3> <p>Als Stagiair Social Media ben jij de motor achter de online aanwezigheid van onze klanten. Je mond dichthouden? Geen optie! We willen jouw frisse ideeën.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Content is King (or Queen):</strong> Je werkt mee aan ijzersterke contentkalenders en strategieën.</li> <li><strong>Trendspotting:</strong> Jij bent onze ogen en oren online. Je weet wat er speelt in de community, welke trends booming zijn en hoe we daarop kunnen inspelen.</li> <li><strong>Community Love:</strong> Je helpt mee met het managen van de social communities en bent de stem van het merk.</li> <li><strong>Create & Activate:</strong> Je brainstormt mee over de vetste activaties en campagnes die engagement door het dak laten gaan.</li> <li><strong>Data-Driven:</strong> Je duikt in de data om insights te vinden die onze strategieën nóg slimmer maken.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Dit ben jij (toch?):</strong></h3> <p>Jij bent allesbehalve een muurbloempje. Social media is jouw natuurlijke habitat en je schermtijd bewijst dat.</p> <ul> <li>Je ademt social media, kent alle ins en outs van TikTok en Instagram en wordt wild van het creëren van nieuwe content.</li> <li>Je hebt een proactieve, ‘hands-on’ mentaliteit. Een nieuwe update of trend? Jij ziet kansen en wilt meteen aan de slag.</li> <li>Je bent creatief, zelfstandig en leergierig (HBO-denkniveau).</li> <li>De Nederlandse taal heeft voor jou geen geheimen.</li> <li>Je staat te popelen om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen in een high-paced omgeving.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Wat bieden wij? De beste start van je carrière!</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Een uitdagende stage</strong> voor minimaal 5 maanden (4-5 dagen per week), startend in <strong>januari/februari 2027</strong> (startdatum in overleg).</li> <li><strong>Stagevergoeding:</strong> Een mooie vergoeding van €450 bruto per maand (op basis van fulltime).</li> <li><strong>Flexibiliteit:</strong> De mogelijkheid om deels thuis te werken en je uren flexibel in te delen.</li> <li><strong>Toplocatie:</strong> Werken in een inspirerende omgeving in Amsterdam met bijna 120 leuke collega's, inclusief voordelige lunch en een barista voor je dagelijkse cafeïneshot.</li> <li><strong>Fantastische merken</strong> om je portfolio een enorme boost te geven.</li> </ul> <p><em>Let op: een vereiste voor deze stage is dat je gedurende de gehele periode ingeschreven staat bij een onderwijsinstelling.</em></p> <h3><strong>Ben jij onze nieuwe social media rockstar?</strong></h3> <p>Voel je de energie? Wacht dan niet langer! Klik op die solliciteerknop en stuur ons je cv en een motivatie waar de passie vanaf spat. Vertel ons waarom jij dé perfecte aanvulling bent op ons team.</p> <p>We kunnen niet wachten om van je te horen!</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

You’ll lead the day-to-day account operations and media planning delivery across markets, creating clarity, momentum and quality from brief through to measurement.</p> <p>As part of our Global Client Solutions team in the Netherlands, you’ll work closely with the Senior Client Leadership Director, Client Manager and specialists across strategy, investment, activation, data and measurement. You’ll also bring diverse market teams together, helping them deliver connected, locally relevant work.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <h3>Lead planning across markets</h3> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end media planning process, establishing clear planning cycles, ways of working, timelines, milestones, responsibilities and approval processes.</li> <li>Turn client briefs into actionable media briefs. Challenge gaps and align objectives, audiences, budgets, KPIs, deliverables and timings before planning begins.</li> <li>Translate global strategy and priorities into clear direction for local markets, creating consistency where it adds value while allowing for local insight and relevance.</li> <li>Bring strategy, audience insights, channel planning, investment, activation, data and measurement teams together to shape integrated recommendations.</li> <li>Review and challenge market plans, ensuring they’re strategically sound and clearly explain channel roles, audiences, investment levels, phasing and expected outcomes.</li> </ul> <h3>Keep delivery and learning on track</h3> <ul> <li>Own the planning calendar and keep global and local teams aligned on deadlines, dependencies and next steps.</li> <li>Maintain visibility of media budgets, ensuring investment decisions and changes are clearly documented and communicated.</li> <li>Identify risks, missing inputs and potential delays early—and take action to keep delivery moving.</li> <li>Embed KPIs and measurement requirements into plans from the start, then turn results and market learnings into improvements for future planning.</li> <li>Continuously improve planning templates, workflows and governance to raise quality, consistency and efficiency.</li> </ul> <h3>Lead the client relationship and support growth</h3> <ul> <li>Act as a senior day-to-day client contact, providing clear updates on planning progress, decisions, risks and next steps.</li> <li>Build strong relationships across client marketing, media, procurement and specialist teams, involving the right people at the right stages.</li> <li>Listen to client feedback and turn it into practical actions. Resolve issues proactively and escalate when needed, while keeping ownership clear.</li> <li>Support the Client Growth Plan by identifying opportunities to improve and expand the services WPP Media provides.</li> <li>Partner with commercial and investment leads on scope, resourcing, forecasting and profitability. Spot additional requirements early and ensure they’re appropriately scoped.</li> <li>Identify where WPP Media’s tools, platforms, data and specialist capabilities can strengthen the client’s planning and delivery.</li> </ul> <h2>A global mindset</h2> <p>Every market is different. Media landscapes, consumer behaviour, costs, channel maturity and local requirements vary from country to country. You’ll know how to create a consistent approach without applying a one-size-fits-all plan.</p> <p>You’ll also bring markets together—sharing best practice and making sure individual market learnings help improve planning across the wider account.</p> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li>At least five years’ experience in client leadership, account management or media planning, ideally working with international or multi-market clients.</li> <li>A strong understanding of the end-to-end media planning process, from brief and strategy through channel planning, investment, activation and measurement.</li> <li>Experience coordinating planning processes, budgets, timelines and deliverables across multiple markets.</li> <li>The confidence to review and challenge media plans, and translate strategic direction into practical requirements for local teams.</li> <li>An understanding of how strategy, planning, investment, activation, data and measurement work together on an integrated media account.</li> <li>A structured, hands-on approach—and the ability to create clarity and accountability across multiple teams.</li> <li>Strong client, communication and presentation skills, with fluency in English.</li> <li>A collaborative, curious and commercially minded approach to problem-solving.</li> </ul> <p></p> <h2>What we offer</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Flexible working:</strong> Enjoy hybrid working, flexible hours and the opportunity to work temporarily from another EU country.</li> <li><strong>Salary:</strong> €5,150 – €8,150 depending on your experience</li> <li><strong>Room to grow:</strong> Develop your skills in an innovative, dynamic team with a strong focus on AI transformation.</li> <li><strong>Learning and development:</strong> Access to M Academy for a wide range of hard- and soft-skills training, workshops and AI-focused courses.</li> <li><strong>Wellbeing:</strong> Get access to the Headspace app and a monthly €10 Epassi allowance to spend on personal wellbeing.</li> <li><strong>Time off:</strong> 26 days of annual leave, with the option to purchase up to 9 additional days, plus 8% holiday allowance.</li> <li><strong>Travel and hybrid-work support:</strong> Travel expenses fully reimbursed, plus a €30 net monthly hybrid-working allowance for full-time employees.</li> <li><strong>Phone allowance:</strong> A monthly BYOD allowance of €57.50 net.</li> <li><strong>Lunch and coffee:</strong> Affordable lunches in the staff canteen and freshly made coffee from our barista.</li> <li><strong>Healthcare:</strong> Access to our collective health insurance plan.</li> </ul> <p></p> <p>If you enjoy bringing people and plans together, creating order in complex environments and title: Stage Consumentengedrag
description: Waarom pak je in de supermarkt het ene product wel uit het schap en het andere niet? Ligt het aan de verpakking? De prijs? Smaak? Gemak? Of simpelweg omdat het precies op de juiste plek staat? Bij Growy telen we verse sla, kruiden en microgreens in Amsterdam in onze vertical farm. Vertical farming klinkt misschien ingewikkeld, maar het idee is simpel: we telen planten in lagen boven elkaar, midden in de stad en helemaal los van het weer buiten. Nu onze producten in steeds meer Nederlandse supermarkten te vinden zijn, willen we onze consumenten nóg beter leren begrijpen. Daarom zoeken we een nieuwsgierige en commercieel ingestelde stagiair die zich wil verdiepen in consumentengedrag en inzichten kan vertalen naar echte commerciële kansen. En nee, dit wordt geen stageproject wat ergens in een lade verdwijnt en niemand ooit nog bekijkt, jouw stage gaat voor ons echt een verschil maken! 🌱 Wat ga je doen? Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat meer consumenten Growy ontdekken, proberen én opnieuw kopen? Tijdens je stage ga je bijvoorbeeld: consumenten interviewen en/of focusgroepen organiseren; onderzoeken wat mensen belangrijk vinden bij het kopen van verse salades en kruiden; ontdekken welke drempels consumenten ervan weerhouden een product te proberen; onderzoeken wat juist zorgt voor een herhaalaankoop; kijken naar kansen rondom prijs, assortiment, verpakking, positionering, promoties en zichtbaarheid; kwantitatief onderzoek, zoals enquêtes, opzetten om ideeën te testen; jouw inzichten vertalen naar concrete commerciële en marketingaanbevelingen. Aan het einde van je stage presenteer je jouw belangrijkste inzichten en aanbevelingen aan ons Sales & Marketing team. En als het binnen je stage past, kun je misschien zelfs één van je ideeën in de praktijk testen. De precieze inhoud stemmen we af op de duur van je stage en de eisen vanuit jouw opleiding. Goed om te weten; onze farm is nog volop in ontwikkeling, we zitten nog in onze start-up/scale-up fase. Dit betekent dat je naast je onderzoek ook tijd zult besteden aan andere zaken in onze farm. Dit geldt niet alleen voor jou als stagiair maar voor ons hele team. Zo draait iedereen uit kantoor maandelijks een shift in de farm, waarbij we helpen met zaaien, oogsten of verpakken. 🌱 Wat kun je van ons verwachten? Een unieke stageplek; wij bouwen aan de toekomst van voedselproductie; Je wordt onderdeel van een klein team, er wordt naar je ideëen en input geluisterd; We werken fulltime vanaf onze farm in Amsterdam; Een maandelijkse stagevergoeding van 500 euro, we vergoeden geen andere zaken; Veel ruimte en tijd voor creativiteit en een ‘ga het maar proberen!' mentaliteit Een gezellige werksfeer waarin we graag samen na werk nog leuke dingen ondernemen 🌱 Wat breng jij? Je volgt een HBO of WO opleiding in Nederland en staat daar ingeschreven gedurende de hele stage periode. Qua studies denken wij in de richting marketing, bedrijfskunde of (commerciële) psychologie, maar wie weet volg jij een andere studie die ook goed aansluit 🙂 Fulltime beschikbaar voor 4 of 5 maanden, startdatum december 2026 of januari of februari 2027 Je hebt je rijbewijs B; je zult veel op pad zijn om supermarkten te bezoeken Een flinke portie nieuwsgierigheid Je bent sociaal; je stapt makkelijk op mensen af en maakt een praatje met ze Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en kunt je ook goed redden in het Engels Je bent een zelf-starter; we zullen je uiteraard begeleiden tijdens je stage, maar het initiatief voor de invulling en aanpak ligt bij jou Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Cybersecurity Intern
description: SwissBorg is building the future of crypto wealth management, making investing more accessible, transparent and intuitive for everyone. At the core of our platform is the Meta-Exchange (MEX). This smart routing engine connects multiple exchanges and liquidity sources to deliver optimal execution in a single, seamless app. We're Swiss-engineered, regulated, and trusted by nearly one million users managing over $1B in crypto assets. But beyond the numbers, what drives us is the people behind every wallet and a commitment to continuously improving how they experience and interact with crypto. Join us! title: Product Manager Insurance P&C
description: Insify is looking for a smart, ambitious and relentlessly driven Insurance Product Manager to join our team. In this role you’ll be a driving force behind our product expansions and building the digital platform for SME insurance. A rare opportunity to take real ownership in a fast-scaling European insurtech and shape outcomes that matter. At Insify, we build insurance for entrepreneurs because we are entrepreneurs ourselves. We know what it’s like to build something from scratch, to take risks, and to carry responsibility that doesn’t switch off at 5 pm. Our mission is simple but ambitious: to make business insurance 10x simpler, faster, and fairer for entrepreneurs and SMEs across Europe . No paperwork. No fine print. No legacy complexity. Just modern software, smart automation, and a relentless focus on the customer. We are a high-growth European scale-up , backed by €43M from world-class investors , on a mission to become a global leader in digital insurance for entrepreneurs and SMEs. Starting in the Netherlands, we’ve expanded into France and Germany, and we’re only accelerating from here. At our core, we’re a tech company . We build our own insurtech platform and rely heavily on data, automation, and AI to redesign the end-to-end insurance experience: from underwriting to claims. Combined with a fully digital customer portal and strong UX, we’re turning insurance into something surprisingly simple, transparent, and fair. We’re led by seasoned entrepreneurs who’ve built and scaled companies before, and we bring that same ambition, urgency, and ownership mindset to everything we do. What you'll be doing: Insify is looking for an entrepreneurial and analytical Product Manager to drive the growth and evolution of our Property & Casualty (P&C) portfolio . This role focuses on the essential "bread and butter" products for SMEs: including General Liability, Professional Indemnity, and Property insurance. Unlike traditional PM roles, you won't just be managing features; you will be the "CEO" of your products. You will bridge the gap between complex insurance logic and a seamless digital user experience. You use your deep understanding of our customers and data native approach to translate technical policy wordings and insurance products into automated underwriting flows and digital-first customer journeys taking away the complexity for our customers. This is a perfect role for someone with a background in business operations, consulting, or insurance who wants to move into a high-growth tech environment and take tangible ownership of a product's performance. What you’ll be up to (some examples): Drive Product Strategy: Manage the roadmap for your products, ensuring they remain competitive, compliant, and easy to purchase online. Optimize the Funnel: Use data to identify friction points in the application process and work with Design and Tech to improve conversion rates. Scale New Markets: Support the launch of our digital proposition into new European markets, adapting local requirements into our scalable core platform. Stakeholder Management: Coordinate between Insurance, Tech, Marketing, and Customer Ops to ensure a unified product vision and smooth execution. Monitor Performance: Track loss ratios, retention, and customer feedback to iterate on the product and pricing strategy. This role is a strong fit if you are a "doer" who loves to solve puzzles. You can dive deep into the fine print of an insurance policy one hour and brainstorm a new UI flow with a developer the next. Specifically, you bring: 2–4 years of experience in a high-growth startup or strategy consulting (Insurance, Fintech, or E-commerce preferred). Analytical Rigor: You are comfortable with Excel/data tools and use metrics to back up your decisions. Product Curiosity: You don't need to be a coder, but you should be excited about how APIs, automated underwriting, and LLMs can transform insurance. Bias for Action: You prefer "shipping and iterating" over "analyzing and waiting." Communication: Excellent English skills (Dutch, German, or French is a major plus given our European footprint). Educational Background: A degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field. Who this is not for: You prioritize a 40-hour work week : We operate in a high-intensity 'startup-plus' environment. This isn't a standard 9-to-5; driving global impact here requires a level of dedication and 'always-on' spirit that goes well beyond the typical 40-hour work week. You prefer your comfort zone : We operate at the edge of our capabilities; if you aren't comfortable with constant change and being challenged, you won’t thrive here. You prefer to stay high-level : While this is a strategic role, no task is too small. If you aren't willing to roll up your sleeves and get into the "weeds" of execution, this isn't the right fit. A steep learning curve feels daunting : We move fast and use cutting-edge AI; you need to be an aggressive self-learner who can master new domains in days, not months. What we offer: Competitive compensation - we want to attract and retain the best so we are offering a compensation package that aligns with that. In-office - come join us in our HQ in the center of Amsterdam. Grow in a growing company - there’s no better place to develop your talents and learn new skills. Help us show the world that insurance can be simple, transparent and trustworthy. Experienced entrepreneurs - work with experienced and dedicated entrepreneurs as part of an international team. Energetic environment - as a start-up, we’re different from your usual insurers. We scale rapidly and you can pick your own initiatives, helping us grow as we help more and more customers across Europe. Our culture (read this carefully) We’re not just building a company, we’re building a category leader . That comes with ambition, responsibility, and pace. Our culture is defined by three things: High ownership People own problems end-to-end. If something is unclear or broken, we don’t wait - we step in and fix it. High pace Priorities shift, and decisions are made quickly. We value momentum and learning over perfection. High standards Outcomes matter more than optics. We care about results, quality, and follow-through. At the same time, you won’t be doing this alone . We believe great work happens through close collaboration . We work in-person, challenge each other’s ideas, and expect contributions from everywhere, regardless of title or tenure. The best ideas often come from unexpected places, and we create space for them to surface. This is a human-sized company . You’ll know the people you work with, you’ll be able to walk over to anyone to ask a question or test an idea, and you’ll be part of the day-to-day energy of building together: from whiteboard discussions to shared lunches, dogs in the office, and moments to pause and reset. We hire smart, ambitious people who think like owners, value intellectual honesty, and are motivated by impact rather than comfort. If you enjoy challenge, responsibility, and building something meaningful with others, you’ll likely thrive here. If you’re looking for predictability, narrow scopes, or a guaranteed 9-to-5, this likely won’t be the right fit - and that’s okay. We’d rather be honest upfront. Our team includes insurance pros, actuaries, and product ops experts working hand-in-hand with product, legal, and compliance to reshape insurance from the inside out. What you will be doing Pricing and Underwriting: Develop and refine pricing models, ensuring accurate underwriting and profitability while optimizing for growth. Dig for and leverage internal and external data to develop predictive models that enhance pricing strategies and improve portfolio performance. Evaluate and propose new ideas and collaborate with the team to develop and push in production innovative solutions (pricing elasticity and optimisation, behaviour and fraud scoring, exposure-based dynamic pricing…), Work with internal stakeholders to integrate actuarial insights into product, tech, regulatory compliance, and overall company strategy. Follow market trends to recommend adjustments to pricing and products. Lead relationships with risk carriers to drive impactful results. Be part, with the pricing team, of the development of our End-to-end, fully automated, pricing and analytics platform leveraging on data and innovative in-house proprietary solutions to scale in a sustainable and efficient way and always stay ahead of competition. What you'll need Actuarial diploma (or equivalent). 2–3+ years of experience in pricing and underwriting within Property & Casualty insurance or Life Insurance. Strong data analytics skills and a passion for leveraging data to drive innovation. A global mindset with exposure to developed insurance markets (e.g., UK, Germany, France) with a desire to disrupt a slow-moving industry. Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with a desire to build new things. Strong interpersonal skills—smooth communication and collaboration are key! Fluent in English Bonus points if you: Have experience with both risk and commercial price modeling. +2 points if you also have experience with survival models. Master in Python and/or R and/or SQL What we offer Competitive compensation - we want to attract and retain the best so we are offering a compensation package that aligns with that. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. title: Senior Backend Engineer, Backend Platform (PHP and Python)
description: WHO WE ARE 🌍 Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does. Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work. We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟 Want to own how the backend works for everyone, not just one corner of it? We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who works across PHP and Python and wants a say in the bigger picture. You’ll lead company-level projects like our Auth Service: one authorization layer for PHP and Python, so Python products can handle their traffic directly instead of going through PHP. When things are unclear, you’ll research first, weigh the trade-offs and write them down. Then you’ll ship in small, safe steps. You’ll also decide where code should live based on what’s best for the system, not on which language you know best. Product teams will come to you for advice, reviews, and a way through when they're stuck. The team is still taking shape, so you'll also help define ownership, standards, and how we work. If that mix of deep technical work and influence across teams sounds like you, keep reading. YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋 Meet the Backend Platform team: We're a small team of engineers from core PHP, Infra, and AI backgrounds. We lead technical initiatives across the whole backend and own its health. Product teams build and run their own components, and we give them the tools, standards, and expertise to do it well. Each of us leads our own project, from planning to agreeing with other teams to production. We work in weekly cycles and write our decisions down. Right now we're bringing PHP and Python platform work together into one common backend platform. WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀 Lead company-level technical projects end to end, from design and planning to rollout and support, such as completing our Auth Service development and shaping authorization as a separate layer for PHP and Python. Shape the shared PHP and Python platform, and decide where each module should live based on the needs of the whole system. Build the foundations that let new Python products launch and scale without being wired through PHP each time. Define clear ownership of technical components across the backend, including who owns monitoring and knowledge for each. Improve how we spot and handle problems: bug and incident management, less noise in alerts and error tracking, and Grafana Cloud dashboards for how services interact. Find root causes across PHP and Python services using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing. Make performance part of everyday work, not something we fix after incidents: clear performance metrics, tools that show where things slow down, and analysis of unusual user behavior that causes degradation. Make architecture decisions with high load in mind, working with databases, servers, proxies, and DNS alongside the Infra team. Work with the Security team to fix vulnerabilities, build in security practices, and keep libraries and dependencies up to date. title: IT Operations Engineer
description: <p>At IMC, technology is not a department; it’s at the heart of everything we do. Developed in-house, our innovative software makes millions of trading decisions daily, and we win by making better and faster decisions than our competition. Our on-site IT Support team helps us move at a higher pace and quality each day, from hands-on support for end users to configuring and automating our systems to scale our support capabilities.</p> <p>In this fully on-site position, you are the first person people come to with any IT issue, whether it’s a MacBook, a SaaS application, identity and access management, or hardware and AV. You support our growing Zug office and act as first- to third-line support. Our environment is predominantly macOS and cloud-based, with a small Windows footprint. You’ll work across a wide range of SaaS and custom systems. To succeed and grow, you take ownership, work autonomously, and keep improving an IT environment that runs smoothly and is ready to scale. </p> <p><strong>Your Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>First-to-third line support for our users, mainly on macOS.</li> <li>Managing and supporting our end-user platform, including Microsoft 365, Okta (SSO, MFA, lifecycle management), Slack and the Atlassian stack (Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management).</li> <li>Device management and patching: Jamf for macOS and Intune for phones, including enrollment, configuration profiles, app deployment and compliance.</li> <li>Onboarding and offboarding, including account provisioning, access management and device setup.</li> <li>Installing, setting up and servicing hardware and peripherals, including laptops, monitors, printers, and audio and video conferencing systems.</li> <li>Troubleshooting, escalating and documenting network and connectivity issues.</li> <li>Automating repetitive tasks and keeping knowledge base articles and runbooks in Confluence up to date.</li> <li>Organizing and performing desk moves, room setups and physical equipment moves.</li> <li>Everything else that keeps us moving.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>A degree in an ICT-related field (BSc level ideally), or an equivalent qualification such as Informatiker/in EFZ.</li> <li>At least one year of experience in a similar role in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Strong macOS knowledge and hands-on experience with JAMF (Pro).</li> <li>Experience with Microsoft 365 administration and Intune; working knowledge of Windows.</li> <li>Familiarity with Okta or a similar identity provider (SSO, SCIM, MFA).</li> <li>Experience administering or supporting Slack and the Atlassian suite.</li> <li>Scripting experience (Bash, Zsh, Python or PowerShell) is a plus, and so is Linux experience.</li> <li>Excellent troubleshooting and diagnostic skills, with the ability to solve problems creatively and proactively.</li> <li>Willingness to take on physical tasks such as desk moves and room setups.</li> <li>A strong drive to grow (at IMC we are committed to helping with that).</li> <li>You work autonomously, with a sense of urgency, and prioritize based on business needs.</li> <li>Available and willing to work on-site full-time in Zug.</li> <li>Proficient in written and spoken English; German is a plus.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Us</strong></p> <p><em>IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.</em></p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Software Engineer (f/m/d)
description: <p><strong>The role</strong></p> <p>Reporting directly to the VP Technology, you'll build new capability for Awin with AI at the core, free from the constraints of our established delivery model. You'll take ideas from concept to production quickly, prove what works, and turn the best of it into patterns the wider engineering organisation can adopt.</p> <p>You'll work closely with product and commercial leaders to find where AI changes the economics of our affiliate marketing platform: what we can build, how fast, and at what cost. You'll be hands-on most of the time, writing code, shipping and measuring results, rather than coordinating others.</p> <p>You'll know enough of our existing platform to connect new things to it safely, but you won't be absorbed into running it. Your job is to show what modern, AI-native engineering looks like at Awin, and make it real.</p> <p><strong>This is a step-up opportunity.</strong> We're looking for a bright, self-starting engineer who is ready for more scope than their current role allows. You might not have held a principal title yet. What matters is that you're already building this way, you learn fast, and you want the room to prove it. You'll have direct access to senior leadership, real problems with commercial weight, and the freedom to choose how you solve them.</p> <p><strong>Key tasks and accountabilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Build and ship</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, build and run AI-powered products, tools and services from prototype to production</li> <li>Own outcomes end to end: problem framing, architecture, implementation, evaluation, release and operation</li> <li>Run fast, time-boxed experiments; scale what works and stop what doesn't, with the evidence to back either call</li> <li>Set up and evolve the AI infrastructure these builds rely on: model access, evaluation tooling, observability and guardrails</li> </ul> <p><strong>Shape direction</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with the VP Technology to set Awin's engineering-specific AI direction, grounded in what has actually been built and measured</li> <li>Scope strategic opportunities early with product and commercial leaders, with effort, cost and value made explicit</li> <li>Make clear recommendations on build vs buy, model and vendor choice, and where AI should not be used</li> </ul> <p><strong>Architecture and design</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design new capability so it connects safely to the existing platform: APIs, events, data and identity</li> <li>Select tools and technologies, and define the patterns and practices for AI-native development at Awin</li> <li>Weigh long-term maintainability, economic viability and reuse against speed, and document the trade-offs</li> </ul> <p><strong>Spread what works</strong></p> <ul> <li>Turn proven builds into reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, and share them so other teams can adopt them without hand-holding</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ways of working</strong></p> <ul> <li>Works autonomously, guided by the VP Technology's priorities rather than team-level delivery processes</li> <li>Engages directly with engineering, product, data, security and commercial stakeholders as each build requires</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills & Expertise</strong></p> <p><strong>AI-native engineering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Builds with coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) as the default way of working. Can show how they decompose work, manage context and review agent output to get production-quality code at pace</li> <li>Has shipped LLM-powered features to production: prompt and context engineering, tool use and function calling, structured outputs, retrieval (RAG) and multi-step agent workflows</li> <li>Builds evaluations first: test sets, automated evals and regression checks for non-deterministic behaviour, with quality measured before and after release</li> <li>Connects models to enterprise systems and data safely, e.g. MCP servers, internal APIs and event streams, with clear permissions and audit trails</li> <li>Understands model selection, token economics, latency, caching and fallback strategies, and can explain cost and benefit trade-offs to commercial stakeholders</li> <li>Designs for AI-specific security and privacy risks: prompt injection, data leakage, PII handling under GDPR, and guardrails on what models can do</li> </ul> <p><strong>Engineering foundations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Expert in at least one modern language (Python or TypeScript ideal), and able to work in our existing Java, PHP and JavaScript estate when integrating</li> <li>Strong cloud-native and serverless architecture on AWS, with infrastructure as code (Terraform)</li> <li>Experience with event-driven and distributed systems (Kafka/MSK, SQS/SNS) and with relational and non-relational data stores</li> <li>Builds observability into everything: tracing, logging and monitoring, including LLM-specific telemetry</li> <li>Treats automated testing, CI/CD and secure-by-default design as standard, and automates as much of the delivery loop as possible</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ways of building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Takes an idea to a working prototype in days, then hardens it for production, and knows when to stop</li> <li>Leaves behind reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, not one-off solutions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Soft skills</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Bias to action:</strong> ships, measures and iterates rather than waiting for perfect requirements</li> <li><strong>Comfortable with ambiguity:</strong> frames vague opportunities into concrete, testable bets</li> <li><strong>Commercially minded:</strong> connects technical choices to revenue, cost and customer outcomes, and balances effort against value</li> <li><strong>Intellectually honest:</strong> kills their own ideas when the evidence says so, and says plainly where AI is not the answer</li> <li><strong>Clear communicator:</strong> explains technical trade-offs to executives, engineers and commercial teams in language each understands, in writing and in person</li> <li><strong>Influences without authority:</strong> gets teams to adopt new patterns because they work, not because they're mandated</li> </ul> <div class="TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium RichText3-paragraph--withVSpacingNormal RichText3-paragraph HighlightSol HighlightSol--buildingBlock"><strong>Our Offer</strong></div> <ul class="RichTextList-bulleted"> <li> <div class="TypographyPresentation TypographyPresentation--medium title: Media Strategy Manager
description: Company Description At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table. Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand. Job Description Reporting to our Media Strategy Director, you will lead the translation of client briefs into cross-channel digital media plans (programmatic, search, social, video) that deliver and accountable outcomes for our client, including budget and flighting recommendations, audience targeting recommendations, performance forecasts, and channel tactics Your responsibilities will include: Lead the translation of client briefs into cross-channel digital media plans (programmatic, search, social, video) that deliver effective and accountable outcomes for our clients including budget and flighting recommendations, audience targeting recommendations, performance forecasts and channel tactics In partnership with your client leads, you will maintain a working relationship with paid media client partners Lead the collaboration with Jellyfish specialists from market intelligence, investment analytics, and paid media teams to create unique ideas and experiment with new methods and technologies to solve complex issues. Use attribution, media mix modelling and planning tools (GWI, YouGov, Reach Planner, ComScore) to pull audience use, reports and forecast target goals Work with the wider planning and analytics team to create insightful campaign reports with optimisation recommendations while media is live Work with teams (Paid Search, Display, Analytics) to ensure planning follows platform and buying best practices Collaborate with channel and measurement leads on campaign performance reporting to drive results through testing and ongoing optimisation Maintain professional relationships with the publisher and partner community Proactively monitor the digital landscape and identify trends/partners for upcoming campaigns. Qualifications Experience in a media strategy or planning role, or in a cross-channel buying role within an agency or multinational client organization Demonstrated expertise in developing brand, digital marketing and planning strategies, with a fluency in digital media planning An expertise in the use of data and market insights to inform decisions and develop business strategies Experience in generating unique ideas and pushing the agenda or experimental approaches that progress our clients' marketing practices Experience working in close collaboration with diverse team members to achieve common goals, valuing and respecting diverse contributions Experience adapting and integrity to navigate unforeseen challenges Fluency in English is required Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English. Additional Information Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs. 💰 Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme. 💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours. 📈Growth, Your Way: Accumulate one paid day each month (2 hours per week) for self-development and access to Jellyfish Learn. title: Backend Software Engineer - Indexing
description: About us: DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry. Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage. Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied. At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it. About the Role: We’re looking for a Backend Software Engineer to join our team and take meaningful ownership from day one. You’ll work closely with smart, driven, and genuinely fun people who are passionate about tackling the complex challenges involved in building a high-performance product at scale. Our indexing system is the backbone of our search engine, processing queries over hundreds of millions of documents in fractions of a second. Building and maintaining these indices within tight time and resource constraints requires highly performant, scalable software. To achieve this, we rely on modern technologies in distributed and parallel computing, database systems, and cloud platforms. You’ll leverage the strengths of these technologies to meet demanding throughput and latency requirements. Your responsibilities will include: Design, develop, and maintain efficient, scalable backend services using modern tools and frameworks Take ownership of core components of our indexing infrastructure Collaborate with other engineers to define, design, and ship new features Optimize performance and scalability across our data processing pipelines Integrate with third-party data providers and effectively use their APIs Review code and contribute to a high standard of code quality and maintainability Participate in agile development processes, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives You're a great fit if you: Have a Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Have 2+ years of experience as a Backend Software Engineer, ideally in a scale-up or fast-growing environment Have strong experience with concurrent and parallel programming and understand how to write correct, efficient code under load Are highly proficient in Python, our primary backend language. Solid experience with Rust or Go is also very welcome, even if Python isn't your strongest language yet Have solid experience working with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL) Are comfortable with modern web architectures and cloud platforms Enjoy solving complex problems and thinking about performance at scale Communicate clearly and enjoy working in a collaborative team Take ownership and can work independently when needed Have experience with information retrieval or search systems (nice to have) What you can look forward to: Location: Office 5min walking distance from Zurich central station, where we primarily work on site Collaborative and supportive work environment Potential for professional growth and advancement within the company Ownership and ability to impact the company, product, and culture At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit. title: Workplace Operations Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. You will partner with regional leadership, cross-functional partners (IT, Physical Security, People Operations, Legal, and Executive Briefing Centers), and local service partners to maintain a highly functional workplace for our distributed team. Balancing local site ownership with regional alignment, you bring practical expertise in facilities coordination, vendor oversight, and day-to-day budget tracking, combined with a hospitality mindset that reflects Cloudflare’s values and culture.</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead Onsite Hub Operations & Space Readiness:</strong> Oversee day-to-day workplace operations across the Austin hub—directing front-of-house services, shipping and receiving, routine building maintenance, and space readiness to ensure a welcoming, functional, and organized environment.</li> <li><strong>Vendor Coordination & Service Quality:</strong> Oversee local vendor performance and daily service delivery across janitorial, culinary/catering, and maintenance partners. Review and reconcile local invoices, track monthly workplace spend, forecast site needs, and flag operational cost efficiencies.</li> <li><strong>Local Workplace Experience & Engagement:</strong> Champion workplace culture onsite by implementing regional programs and organizing high-touch local initiatives that support hybrid collaboration, community engagement, and day-to-day employee satisfaction.</li> <li><strong>Site Communications & Escalation:</strong> Serve as the primary local operational contact for Austin site leadership, cross-functional teams, and employees regarding facility updates, workplace protocols, and building announcements. Escalate site-level risks or operational roadblocks to NAMER leadership in a timely manner.</li> <li><strong>Workplace Metrics & Space Insights:</strong> Track, analyze, and report site-level operational data—including daily occupancy, badge swipes, space utilization trends, and ticket resolution times—to inform regional space planning and workplace decisions.</li> <li><strong>Amenities:</strong> Manage day-to-day workplace food and beverage operations, including lunch catering, micro-kitchen restocks, health and wellness amenities.</li> <li><strong>Internal Events & Onsite Logistics:</strong> Manage logistical planning and day-of execution for onsite gatherings, executive visits, team offsites, and cultural celebrations, partnering closely with the Global Events & Experiences team and local organizers.</li> <li><strong>Safety, Compliance & Preparedness:</strong> Serve as the onsite coordinator for facility safety and compliance. In partnership with Global Physical Security and building property management, facilitate local emergency response procedures, coordinate site safety team volunteers, lead routine drills, and maintain emergency readiness.</li> <li><strong>Team Leadership & Site Support:</strong> Supervise, coach, and mentor local workplace operations team members and contractors. Serve as the local operational partner for regional real estate and design teams for various hub related reconfigurations, refreshes, or buildout projects.</li> <li><strong>NAMER Regional Collaboration:</strong> Participate actively in regional operations syncs, sharing local operational insights, supporting peer site coverage across NAMER, and ensuring consistent policy rollouts across the region.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Requirements</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>5–6+ years of progressive workplace or facilities operations experience</strong>, preferably within a high-growth tech company or dynamic corporate setting.</li> <li><strong>3+ years of direct people management experience</strong>, with demonstrated success in coaching, supervising, and developing onsite workplace team members.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on vendor management experience</strong>, including monitoring day-to-day service deliverables, tracking SLA compliance, and collaborating with external facility providers.</li> <li><strong>Operational financial discipline</strong>, with practical experience tracking local budgets, reviewing vendor invoices, and monitoring site operational expenses (OpEx).</li> <li><strong>Familiarity with workplace tools & data</strong>, including integrated workplace management systems (IWMS), ticketing systems (e.g., Jira, Zendesk), visitor management platforms, and Google Workspace.</li> <li><strong>Strong cross-functional collaboration skills</strong>, with a track record of partnering effectively with local and remote teams including, but not limited to: IT, People Ops, Real Estate, and Physical Security.</li> <li><strong>Working knowledge of facility safety standards</strong>, including OSHA/EHS basics, local emergency response protocols, and building code considerations.</li> <li><strong>Clear verbal and written communication skills</strong>, with the confidence to communicate operational updates to local leaders and collaborate smoothly with regional managers.</li> <li><strong>Hospitality mindset & practical problem-solving</strong>, balancing high operational standards with a genuine dedication to delivering a supportive, employee-centric workplace.</li> <li><strong>Onsite presence:</strong> Required to be onsite full-time, 5 days per week at our Austin hub.</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. description: We are the platform turning browsing into shopping . We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands. We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases. In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company , creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia. Ready to spark your growth with us? WHO WE LOOK FOR 🦄 We’re expanding into the Netherlands – and you could be one of our very first team members! We are looking for a Digital Account Manager who combines hands-on campaign expertise , outstanding client communication , and an AI-first mindset . This is a highly client-facing role : you will work closely with our Performance and Paid Marketing teams, who handle most of the set-up and monitoring, and be ready to set up campaigns end-to-end and optimize them where needed and, above all, be the trusted point of contact for our clients throughout the whole campaign journey. You will own the operational execution and performance success of digital campaigns for our clients in the Netherlands, from the internal and client kickoff through optimization to periodic performance evaluations. The role goes well beyond campaign set-up: you will keep clients informed proactively , turn performance data into clear and convincing stories, and use AI , to work smarter, faster and with better insights. Your work directly impacts campaign performance, client satisfaction, and long-term customer partnerships. Client Communication: Excellent communication skills and a proactive approach. You feel at ease being the main point of contact, translating data into clear insights and building trusted relationships. AI Proficiency: Confident in using AI in your daily work, in particular Claude for generating reports and insights, and curious to keep exploring new ways to work smarter. Coordination & Organization: Strong coordination skills, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines and stakeholders at once. Optimization & Data Mindset: Curious about data, with a drive to achieve the best results for the client and the ability to make data-driven decisions. Digital Expertise: Strong knowledge of digital channels, trends, and tools (CRM systems like HubSpot, analytics tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, Looker; display advertising platforms; Meta Business Suite). Excel or similar skills (Pivot tables) are a must. Campaign Knowledge: Proven experience managing multi-channel campaigns, understanding KPIs, and optimizing performance. Languages: Native-level Dutch and fluent spoken English. Mindset: A positive, proactive attitude and the energy to keep campaigns, clients and colleagues moving. 👉 At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it — even if you don’t tick every single box in the requirements — we’d love to hear from you! NICE TO HAVE 🎆 Comprehensive understanding of retail marketing functions, including budgets, retail purchase cycles, and category-specific user behavior (e.g., FMCG, Grocery, Fashion). LOCATION 🌐 While you need to be based in the Netherlands , you can benefit from our flexible hybrid or full remote model, empowering you to work where you're most effective. WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SHOPFULLY 🤗 🌎 An opportunity to thrive in a rapidly scaling multinational company 🕶️ A vibrant, informal, and inclusive work environment 🧠 We champion autonomy, flexibility, and a hybrid work model, empowering you to own your work 📚 Access to learning opportunities and regular feedback sessions 🍓 Enjoy our central, modern offices featuring fresh snacks, coffee (including vegan options!), and ergonomic setups 🎉 Engage in meaningful team events: offsites, happy hours, company parties and celebrations that unite us beyond daily tasks 💻We provide all the necessary equipment for you to work effectively and set up your workspace, wherever you are 🧰 Benefit from additional country-specific advantages based on local contracts and practices WHO WE ARE 💜 We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities. We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us. TO FEEL AT HOME 🛋️ IN SHOPFULLY YOU NEED 🎯 Progress Over Perfection : We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results. Clarity Through Transparency : We bring each other along. We work in teams, not silos. Transparency gives context, and context enables action. That means we share decisions early, publish work in progress, and document outcomes so others can learn, move faster, and build better. Learn Loudly : We grow by doing and by daring. Big bets unlock big breakthroughs. But real innovation demands risk, and risk always carries the possibility of failure. That’s not a flaw. It’s the price of ambition. Fundierte Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb skalierbarer B2B-SaaS-Architekturen, inklusive Schnittstellen, Integrationen und Automatisierungen für anspruchsvolle Grosskunden. Praktische Erfahrung mit modernen KI-/ML-Technologien und Freude daran, KI-Capabilities von der Idee bis in die Produktion zu bringen. Die Chance, unsere KI-Strategie von Grund auf mitzugestalten und in wertstiftende Produkte zu übersetzen. Kurze Entscheidungswege, direkter Austausch mit dem CEO und enge Zusammenarbeit mit Customer Success und Entwicklung. Die Perspektive, dich mit wachsender Verantwortung in der Geschäftsleitung weiterzuentwickeln. Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit grundsätzlicher Erreichbarkeit während der Kernarbeitszeiten. Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit mindestens zwei Tagen pro Woche in unserem Büro in Zürich. Fünf Wochen Ferien sowie ein fixes Weiterbildungsbudget inklusive bezahlter Weiterbildungszeit. title: Anlageberater
description: Im Auftrag unseres Kunden Zurich, GA Howald & Scheidegger AG suchen wir eine Anlageberater Über den Job Du möchtest Kundinnen und Kunden dabei unterstützen, ihre finanziellen Ziele zu erreichen? Und du willst den Anlagebereich aktiv mitgestalten? Dann freuen wir uns, dich kennenzulernen. Die Zurich, Generalagentur Howald & Scheidegger AG baut ihr Spezialistenteam aus. Dafür suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit für die Anlageberatung. Bei uns verbindest du persönliche Beratung mit fundiertem Anlagewissen und der Stärke der Marke Zurich. Dafür stehen dir attraktive Anlage- und Vorsorgelösungen der Zurich Invest AG und der Zurich Versicherungs-Gesellschaft AG zur Verfügung. Du gewinnst neue Anlagekundinnen und Anlagekunden und bearbeitest den Markt aktiv. Du berätst deine Kundinnen und Kunden ganzheitlich und entwickelst bestehende Beziehungen weiter. Du analysierst ihre Vermögenssituation und Anlageziele. Darauf aufbauend entwickelst du passende Anlagestrategien und überprüfst diese regelmässig. title: Account Executive, Start Ups
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);"><strong>Available Locations</strong></span></h2> <hr> <p>Munich, Berlin or Frankfurt</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);"><strong>About the Role</strong></span></h2> <hr> <p>Cloudflare is looking for a Startup Account Executive to join our Digital Natives team in Germany and Austria. You'll build your own customer base from the ground up, mostly through your own prospecting or by working closely with your BDR. Your job is to find promising startups across the region, win them early and help them build on Cloudflare as they grow.</p> <p>You'll work with AI startups, developer tool companies and other young tech businesses, often in the first years after their funding. Their teams are small, and founders make most of the decisions. Often an engineer has been using Cloudflare long before anyone talks to sales. You know this world, and you're comfortable talking about technology with a founder or CTO. You don't need to know every spec, but you understand what they're building and what Cloudflare can change for them.</p> <p>The pace is high. You'll spend a good part of your week reaching out to founders and engineers, following up and booking first meetings. You'll also build your network in the startup scene. VC firms, accelerators and founder communities are often the fastest way to the right companies, and you'll become a familiar face there. If you enjoy the hunt and like seeing your own work turn into new customers, you'll like this job. </p> <p>Above all, we are looking for true team players. We win together, not as lone wolves with sharp elbows. You share what works, ask for help when you need it, and celebrate your colleagues' wins as much as your own. You see your BDR, Solutions Engineers and specialists as real partners, not as support functions, and you bring the same care to working with your colleagues as you do to working with your customers. If you believe the best results come from people who make each other better, you'll feel right at home on our team. </p> <p>AI tools are a big part of how we sell. Many of the startups you work with are building AI products themselves, and they notice when you work the same way. We expect you to use AI every way, from researching accounts to preparing for meetings.</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></span></h2> <hr> <ul> <li>Building your customer base: Find and win new startup customers across DACH, and build your book of business from the first deal. Hit or beat your quarterly targets for new customers.</li> <li>Pipeline generation: Own your pipeline from the first contact. Most of it will come from your own prospecting, such as cold outreach to founders and CTOs, LinkedIn and startup events. Your BDR supports you, but you set the pace.</li> <li>VC and accelerator relationships: Build relationships with VC firms, accelerators and startup programmes in DACH. Get to know their portfolios, find the companies where Cloudflare fits and get warm introductions to founders.</li> <li>Product-led growth: Find startups whose developers already use Cloudflare's free or self-serve plans, and turn that usage into a commercial relationship as the company grows.</li> <li>Founders and technical buyers: Have credible conversations with founders, CTOs and lead engineers about what they're building. Explain what Cloudflare changes for them, for example lower infrastructure costs or less time spent running infrastructure.</li> <li>AI startups: Position Workers AI, AI Gateway, Vectorize and R2 with startups building AI products. Understand their usual problems, such as inference costs and securing AI APIs.</li> <li>Fast sales cycles: Run short, efficient sales cycles with many deals at the same time. Follow up quickly, spend your time on the startups with the most potential and close with confidence.</li> <li>Long-term thinking: Choose startups that can grow into large customers, and set them up on Cloudflare in a way that lets them scale with us.</li> <li>Teamwork: Work closely with your BDR and Customer Engineers. Plan accounts together, bring them into conversations at the right moment and keep everyone up to date. Work with Sales Ops, Product and Customer Success to keep deals moving and get new customers off to a strong start.</li> <li>Pipeline and forecasting: Keep your pipeline in Salesforce accurate and give your manager forecasts they can rely on.</li> <li>AI in your daily work: Use AI tools every day for account research, personalised outreach, meeting prep and follow-ups. In the interview, we'll ask you how AI helps you get better results.</li> <li>Market insight: Share what you see in the DACH startup scene with the wider team, such as which funding rounds to watch and which technologies startups choose.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);"><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></span></h2> <hr> <p>Sales Experience</p> <ul> <li>2+ years in B2B technology sales with a quota, including at least one role you held for two years or more</li> <li>Met or beat your quota in your most recent full year</li> <li>Won new customers mainly through your own prospecting, such as cold email, calls and LinkedIn</li> <li>You enjoy prospecting and are used to a high volume of outreach every week</li> <li>Sold to startups or scale-ups, or worked closely with VC firms or accelerators</li> <li>Run full sales cycles with many deals at the same time</li> <li>Ideally sold to developers or CTOs before</li> <li>Worked with a structured sales method such as MEDDPICC</li> </ul> <p>Startup background</p> <ul> <li>Ideally you've worked at an AI or tech startup yourself</li> <li>You know how startups are funded (seed, Series A, Series B) and what each stage means for their budget and priorities</li> <li>You have a network in the DACH startup scene, or you know how to build one quickly</li> </ul> <p>Technical knowledge</p> <ul> <li>You can explain the basics of how the internet works: DNS, CDN, TLS, HTTP and APIs</li> <li>You know how startups typically build their products, using public cloud, serverless, open-source tools and AI APIs</li> <li>You have solid public cloud know-how. You understand how companies use AWS, GCP, Azure, including Kubernetes and serverless. What drives their cost and where Cloudflare complements or replaces them.</li> <li>You know how modern engineering teams ship software, including CI/CD and developer tooling such as GitHub, GitLab and AI coding tools like Claude Code. </li> <li>Knowing Cloudflare (Workers, R2, AI Gateway, Zero Trust) or a competitor such as AWS, Akamai, Fastly or Vercel is a plus</li> </ul> <p>Tools and ways of working</p> <ul> <li>You use Salesforce or a similar CRM every day and keep your pipeline accurate</li> <li>You already use AI tools in your sales work, for example ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini for research and writing, or Clay for account research. Be ready to show us how.</li> <li>You've worked in a team with BDRs and pre-sales engineers</li> </ul> <p>Other</p> <ul> <li>Fluent German and English, spoken and written</li> <li>Able to travel within DACH and to startup events</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Compensation</span></h3> <hr> <p>For Germany based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €152,000 - €209,000.</p> <p>This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare's Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.  </p> <p>Equity: This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faste
