Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are hiring a developer with a proven track record in Python and/or Go. As part of the Observability team, you will develop a cloud-native monitoring stack that composes best-in-class open-source monitoring tools. The stack is opinionated, resilient, and scalable, providing deep insights out of the box. The user experience is polished and seamless for the end-users, and its administrators will enjoy smooth, lightweight Day 1 and Day 2 operations. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This is an exciting opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, Kubernetes, and Observability. Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The monitoring stack will monitor applications running on a mix of cloud technologies such as Kubernetes and OpenStack, as well as bare-metal, virtual machines and containers. The stack will be capable of monitoring applications and infrastructure irrespective of whether they are operated by Juju, and will leverage multiple data sources at various levels of the architecture, including Juju itself, to contextualize the collected telemetry and insights delivered to the end-users.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">You can read more about the project </span><a href="https://grafana.com/blog/2021/10/28/open-source-done-right-why-canonical-adopted-grafana-loki-and-grafana-agent-for-their-new-stack/"><span style="font-weight: 400;">here</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and </span><a href="https://juju.is/blog/model-driven-observability-part-1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">here</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Location: </strong><em>This role will be based remotely in the EMEA and Americas regions</em></span></p> <h2><span style="font-weight: 400;">The role entails</span></h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed team</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Write, test and document high quality code to create new features</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Debug issues and interact with a vibrant community</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Review code produced by other engineers</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Attend conferences to represent Canonical and the Charmed Observability Stack</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events</span></li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-weight: 400;">What we are looking for in you</span></h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You love technology and working with brilliant people</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You are a skilled Python developer, preferably with a track record in open source</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You have a working knowledge of Go</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You have interest and experience with two or more of the following: Ubuntu Linux, container images, Debian packaging, snap, distributed systems.</span></li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-weight: 400;">What we offer colleagues</span></h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-weight: 400;">About Canonical</span></h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h2><span style="font-weight: 400;">Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</span></h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">#LI-remote </span></p>

title: Senior International Accounting Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p>ABOUT THE JOB:<br><br>We are on the lookout for an exceptional Senior International Accounting Manager to lead Anduril’s accounting operations across Continental Europe and the Middle East from our Amsterdam office. This role owns the month-end close, statutory reporting, audit deliverables, and accounting operations for the Company’s legal entities throughout the region, and is the senior accounting leader on the ground as that footprint expands.<br><br>You will stand up and scale the accounting function while partnering with Legal, Tax, Treasury, Payroll, and Operations as each new jurisdiction comes online. This is a leadership seat: you will hire, develop, and lead the accounting team in Amsterdam, and manage the outsourced providers supporting the countries where we do not yet have our own people.<br><br>The ideal candidate has run a multi-country close, is fluent in the difference between a US GAAP reporting package and a local statutory filing, and would rather design the process than inherit it. Join us in our mission to disrupt the defense industry and elevate your career with a team dedicated to making a significant impact on a global scale.<br><br>WHAT YOU’LL DO:</p> <ul> <li>Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close for the Company’s legal entities across Continental Europe and the Middle East, delivering to internal deadlines while ensuring the accuracy of financial data.</li> <li>Own statutory reporting across the region, including statutory financial statements, local reporting differences, and adherence to local filing deadlines in each jurisdiction.</li> <li>Manage local statutory audits end to end, acting as the primary point of contact for local auditors while coordinating with the HQ team.</li> <li>Review journal entries, account reconciliations, and fluctuation analyses; validate foreign currency remeasurement and translation impacts for the region’s entities.</li> <li>Own accounts payable operations and the procure-to-pay cycle for the region, from invoice receipt through payment disbursement, including vendor relationship management and payment performance.</li> <li>Hire, develop, and lead the regional accounting team in Amsterdam - including accounting managers and specialists - as the Company grows throughout the region, and manage outsourced accounting providers where local work is performed externally.</li> <li>Serve as the primary accounting liaison between the US parent company and the</li> <li>Own the accounting workstream on new entity and country launches, partnering with Legal on incorporation and registration and with Business Operations on site readiness.</li> <li>Ensure adherence to internal controls and accounting policies, and design and document new controls as entities and requirements come online.</li> <li>Partner with Tax, Treasury, and Payroll on VAT and local tax filings, transfer pricing support, intercompany settlement, cash forecasting, and payroll approvals across the region.</li> <li>Support the configuration and ongoing maintenance of the region’s legal entities within the Company’s ERP, including any local statutory reporting basis.</li> <li>Identify and execute opportunities for process improvement, including the adoption of automation and AI tools, so that the function scales faster than its headcount.</li> <li>Partner with regional operational and program leaders to support business decision-making.</li> <li>Work on ad-hoc projects with accounting and finance teams across the Company, from leases and fixed assets to inventory, intercompany, and tax provision support.</li> </ul> <p>WHO YOU ARE:</p> <ul> <li>10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 5+ years in a supervisory or management role.</li> <li>Experience owning the close and statutory deliverables for multiple legal entities in more than one country.</li> <li>Experience leading an accounting team across more than one country, including the development of other managers.</li> <li>Experience working within a global organization reporting to a US parent; public accounting experience a plus.</li> <li>RA, ACA, ACCA, CPA, or equivalent certification preferred.</li> <li>Strong understanding of US GAAP and IFRS, with practical experience in local statutory reporting requirements across European jurisdictions; Middle East exposure a plus.</li> <li>Experience managing local statutory audits and external accounting or audit providers.</li> <li>Advanced Excel skills and proficiency with ERP systems (Oracle Fusion Cloud preferred).</li> <li>Excellent leadership, team management, and interpersonal skills, with a track record of hiring and developing accountants.</li> <li>Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to keep multiple jurisdictions and workstreams on schedule.</li> <li>Comfortable building process where little exists today, with a proven ability to manage competing priorities in a high growth organization.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a mindset for continuous improvement.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with colleagues across time zones.</li> <li>Fluency in English; additional European languages a plus.</li> <li>Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.</li> </ul><div title: Software Engineer - Platforms & Productivity
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>About the Team and Role</h3> <p>The Developer Productivity team builds internal tools and platforms that improve the velocity and developer experience of Cloudflare's engineering teams. We own developer productivity (code commit to production), developer insights and ADLC metrics, developer infrastructure (CI/CD, build systems), AI-assisted development, and Cloudflare-on-Cloudflare dogfooding.</p> <p>This team is responsible for AI-assisted development across all of Cloudflare engineering. Adoption has grown 4–6x in the last year. It's a small team, so you'll have a big surface area and real ownership from day one.</p> <p>As a Software Engineer, you will help build and operate internal platforms that help Cloudflare engineers develop, deploy, and run software safely and efficiently. You’ll work across developer tooling, CI/CD, GitOps, and AI-assisted development, including MCP servers, agents, evals, and context engineering.</p> <p>You’ll also help govern and enforce Cloudflare’s Engineering Codex by turning engineering standards into automated guardrails, paved paths, and actionable feedback.</p> <h3>What You’ll Do</h3> <p><strong>Exp</strong>: 4-12yrs</p> <p>- Build developer productivity tools, MCP servers, and AI agents.</p> <p>- Automate Engineering Codex controls through CI/CD checks, templates, and policy-as-code.</p> <p>- Monitor Codex adoption, improve controls, and support remediation and exception workflows.</p> <p>- Improve GitOps, developer experience, platform security, and reliability.</p> <p>- Partner with product teams on architecture and platform adoption.</p> <p>- Respond to and prevent incidents affecting internal platforms.</p> <h3>What We’re Looking For</h3> <p>- Experience with TypeScript, Go, or Bash.</p> <p>- Strong debugging and source-control skills.</p> <p>- Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, or developer platforms.</p> <p>- Ability to break down complex problems and evaluate trade-offs.</p> <p>- Clear communication and a strong focus on developer experience.</p> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <p>- Experience with AI agents, MCP, evals, or LLM-based tooling.</p> <p>- Experience with policy-as-code or compliance automation.</p> <p>- Background in platform engineering or developer productivity.</p> <p>- Experience operating distributed or Kubernetes-based systems.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Account Executive

We build solutions that help data professionals securely manage the data and databases that their organizations depend on, a space that's only becoming more critical as systems scale, data regulations increase, and AI adoption accelerates. You'll find more detail on our typical hiring process below, so you know what's coming and why. Belonging at Redgate We believe that people do their best work in an environment built on respect, fairness, and trust, and that diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes. title: Verkaufsberater:in mit Stv. Funktion
description: Arbeitsbeginn Anfang März 2027 · 80–100 % Pensum · St. Gallen Bei alunir glauben wir an die kleinen magischen Momente im Alltag. Mit unseren bedeutungsvollen Schmuckstücken möchten wir nicht nur Freude schenken, sondern auch etwas Gutes bewirken. Für unseren bestehenden alunir Store in St. Gallen suchen wir eine herzliche, engagierte und verantwortungsbewusste Persönlichkeit, die unser Team bereichert und gemeinsam mit uns besondere Einkaufserlebnisse schafft. Als Verkaufsberater:in mit Stv. Funktion unterstützt du die Store Managerin bei der Führung und Organisation unseres neuen Standorts, übernimmst Verantwortung im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst gemeinsam mit deinem Team für ein besonderes Einkaufserlebnis. Deine Mission ✨ Du unterstützt die Store Managerin bei der operativen und organisatorischen Führung des Stores. Bei ihrer Abwesenheit übernimmst du die Verantwortung für das Tagesgeschäft und bist die erste Ansprechperson für dein Team. Du bist aktiv im Verkauf tätig und begeisterst unsere Kundinnen und Kunden mit persönlicher Beratung und echter Gastfreundschaft. Du unterstützt bei der Führung, Motivation und Einarbeitung der Mitarbeitenden und lebst unsere Werte und Qualitätsstandards vor. Du erkennst Handlungsbedarf, setzt Prioritäten und sorgst für reibungslose Abläufe im Store. Du kümmerst dich um das Waren- und Lagermanagement sowie eine ansprechende Warenpräsentation. Du unterstützt bei organisatorischen Aufgaben wie der Personaleinsatzplanung und bringst eigene Ideen zur Weiterentwicklung des Stores ein. Was du mitbringst 💫 Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Detailhandel, idealerweise in der Schmuck-, Mode- oder Lifestylebranche. Erste Führungserfahrung oder die Motivation, den nächsten Schritt in eine Führungsposition zu machen. Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Menschen zu motivieren und im Team zusammenzuarbeiten. Eine herzliche, offene Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Kundenorientierung. Selbstständigkeit, Organisationstalent und ein hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein. Ein gutes Gespür für Ästhetik und Warenpräsentation. Fliessende (Schweizer-)Deutschkenntnisse und gute bis sehr gute Englischkenntnisse. Flexibilität und Bereitschaft für regelmässige Samstagseinsätze. Und natürlich eine grosse Portion alunir Magie. ✨ Deine ersten Monate 🌙 Dein Abenteuer bei alunir beginnt Anfang März 2027 in unserem Store in St. Gallen. Während deiner sorgfältigen Einarbeitung lernst du unsere Schmuckstücke, Abläufe, Werte und die alunir Philosophie kennen. title: Systems Engineer - Data Security
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p>In this role, you’ll help build and maintain Data Security products as a Software Engineer. These products empower customers to gain deep visibility into Cloud/SaaS security opportunities and into trends in their network traffic and product use. As an engineer on the team, you will focus on building new functionality into our APIs and distributed code while ensuring the performance and reliability of our services which ingest millions of data points each day. You’ll be joining a team of bright, knowledge-seeking engineers who are truly missionaries in solving the security and network visibility challenges for our customers.</p> <p><strong>Technologies we use:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Products are written in Go, Python, and Typescript.</li> <li>Code runs on Kubernetes, Cloudflare Workers, AWS, GCP, Azure.</li> <li>We utilize Postgres as our data store, Redis as our cache, and Kafka as our message broker.</li> <li>Our frontend is written in Typescript and React.</li> <li>For service monitoring we use Prometheus and Grafana.</li> <li>For service logging we use Elasticsearch and Kibana.</li> <li>For product analytics we use Clickhouse and BigQuery. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge, and experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of professional experience building and managing reliable and performant software systems at scale, preferably with technologies like: Go, Python, Postgres</li> <li>Passion for making the digital world a more secure place</li> <li>Excellent debugging and optimization skills</li> <li>Willingness, curiosity, and enthusiasm to learn new programming languages, technologies and systems</li> <li>Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Caring and empathy are coveted traits here!</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus</strong></p> <ul> <li>Frontend programming experience in Typescript/Javascript</li> <li>Previous experience working with third-party API integrations</li> <li>Previous experience working on security products</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. title: Senior Mechanical Designer
description: You want to help build Europe’s resilience? You want to protect people and critical infrastructure? You want to take ownership of designs that move from early prototypes to reliable serial production? Join CDDS to turn ambitious engineering concepts into parts and assemblies that can be manufactured, assembled, and delivered at scale. CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones, including Mavics, FPV racers, and fast fixed wings. Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimizing risk to surroundings while countering threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments. Tasks Your Mission We are looking for an experienced Senior Mechanical Designer with strong expertise in injection molding and a track record of taking products from prototype to serial production. You will work hands-on in CAD, developing and refining parts and assemblies with manufacturing and assembly requirements built into the design from the start. You will collaborate directly with injection molding suppliers, resolve manufacturability issues, and follow your designs through tooling, first samples, and production ramp-up. Working closely with our mechanical, electrical, and production teams, you will help ensure that our designs perform in the field and can be produced and assembled consistently. We are looking for someone who have practical manufacturing knowledge and follows a design through until it works on the assembly line. Core Responsibilities Develop and refine 3D CAD models, assemblies, and production drawings, with a strong focus on injection-molded plastic parts. Take designs from functional prototypes through design release, tooling, initial production runs, and serial production. Apply design for manufacturing and assembly principles to improve part quality, reduce cost, and simplify production. Work directly with injection molding suppliers on feasibility reviews, tooling constraints, design changes, and first-sample evaluation. Design for efficient, repeatable assembly, including accessible fastening, clear part orientation, and mistake-proofing methods such as poka-yoke. Requirements Your Profile You bring practical experience turning designs into manufactured products. You understand how CAD decisions affect tooling, part consistency, assembly effort, and cost. You are comfortable discussing details with suppliers and working alongside the people who assemble your designs. At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in mechanical design or product development. Demonstrated experience taking at least one product or significant assembly from prototype through production ramp-up. Proficiency in professional 3D CAD software and the creation of complete manufacturing drawings. Strong understanding of injection molding constraints, including draft angles, wall thickness, ribs, bosses, undercuts, shrinkage, and warpage. Ability to work autonomously and collaborate closely with engineering, suppliers, and production teams. BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field, a Swiss apprenticeship as a Konstrukteur/in EFZ, or an equivalent relevant qualification. Nice-to-Have Proficiency in SolidWorks. Experience with composite materials and their manufacturing and assembly processes. Experience designing assembly fixtures, inspection aids, or production tooling. Familiarity with machining, sheet metal fabrication, and additive manufacturing. Experience with drones, robotics, aerospace, or other products combining mechanical and electronic systems. Benefits Why CDDS Direct impact on a mission-critical technology shaping Europe’s security landscape. Fast-moving startup environment with high ownership. Work with a highly technical, ambitious, and hands-on team. Real-world testing, deployments, and customer demonstrations. Attractive compensation. Details Location: Zürich Hardbrücke, on-site Start date: ASAP Environment: High-impact deep-tech startup working on real deployments If you are interested in the position, please apply via the application form. title: Principal, Customer Storytelling & Advocacy
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations:</strong></p> <ul> <li>San Francisco, CA</li> <li>Austin, TX</li> <li>London, UK</li> </ul> <p><strong>Role summary</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a visionary, hands-on storyteller to reinvent how Cloudflare brings customer impact to life. This person will combine the narrative instincts of an exceptional writer and editor, the technical fluency of a product marketer, the relationship skills of a customer advocate, and the creative eye of a producer. You'll interview customers and their executives, find out what was at stake for them, and explain what they built on Cloudflare in language a CFO and a developer can both follow.</p> <p>We welcome ideas no one has tried yet. You'll own the creative standard for video and content. You will raise the creative and production bar across video, case studies, campaigns, executive content, and onstage moments, helping make Cloudflare more relatable without sacrificing technical credibility. <li><strong>Interview customers and find the story: </strong>Work directly with customers and their executives to learn what problem they had and what changed after they solved it. </li> right.</li> <li><strong>Lead a few big moments each year:</strong> Own a few major storytelling projects a year, such as a film, a campaign, or a customer segment in a Cloudflare Connect keynote.</li> <li><strong>Come up with ideas that get noticed: </strong>Pitch creative concepts that make people stop scrolling, such as a surprising angle or a format no one else has tried.</li> <li><strong>Try new formats:</strong> Pilot formats beyond the case study, such as documentary-style series, live builds, short social video, interactive data stories, customer takeovers, and podcasts.</li> <li><strong>Set the quality standard: </strong>Decide what good looks like for customer stories in every format, and hold agencies, freelancers, and internal teams to it.</li> <li><strong>Supply executives with stories:</strong> Give Cloudflare leaders the customer stories and proof points they use in keynotes, briefings, social posts, and customer meetings.</li> <li><strong>Work across teams to get stories approved: </strong>Source stories with Sales and Product, and work with Marketing, Communications, and Legal to get approvals.</li> <li><strong>Use AI to scale: </strong>Build repeatable AI workflows for spotting story candidates, preparing interviews, drafting, and cutting one story into versions for each channel.</li> <li><strong>Track results: </strong>Decide how we measure story impact (sales usage, pipeline influence, reach, advocate engagement) and use the numbers to choose what to make next.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable skills, knowledge, and experience </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical fluency</strong>: You can read a product doc or architecture diagram and explain in plain language what a customer built and why it matters.</li> <li><strong>Reporter and editor instincts</strong>: You ask the follow-up question and find the detail other people missed. You can read a draft and say what's missing, and you write copy that works for a CISO and for a developer.</li> <li><strong>Creative judgment and taste</strong>: You can tell quickly whether a story will get attention or build credibility. You know good film, editorial, design, and social work when you see it, and you borrow ideas from outside tech, including media, sports, and entertainment.</li> <li><strong>Production experience</strong>: You've had some experience directing or producing customer video, documentary, podcast, or live content, and you can manage crews and agencies.</li> <li><strong>Executive presence and influence</strong>: You're comfortable interviewing a customer's C-suite and briefing a Cloudflare executive before a keynote. You can get Sales, Product, Marketing, Comms, IT, and Legal moving in the same direction, and you push back when a story isn't ready.</li> <li><strong>AI in your daily work: </strong>You already use AI tools for writing, research, interview prep, or production, and you can show us how.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>10-15 years of experience </strong>in one or more of the following: Developer Relations, Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, Journalism, or Video Production. B2B technology experience is strongly preferred.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.</li> <li><strong>Option to include customer stories</strong>, video, campaigns, or stage content you created or led, with a short note on what made each one work. Original creative concepts or formats that performed well, with results you can point to (for example reach, press coverage, or sales impact).</li> <li><strong>Experience producing stories with enterprise customers </strong>and their executives, including getting them through customer, Legal, and Comms approval.</li> <li><strong>Experience explaining complex technical products </strong>(infrastructure, security, developer platforms, or AI) to business and technical audiences.</li> <li>Experience producing video and live or stage content from start to finish.</li> <li>Experience building a content program or production workflow that other people could run is preferred</li> </ul> <div id="model-response-message-contentr_8ad1215988914a70" class="markdown markdown-main-panel md-content enable-luminous-fast-follows enable-updated-hr-color tutor-markdown-rendering"> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="1"> <li> <div> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location</p> <div> <ul> <li>For San Francisco Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $221,000 - $304,000.</li> </ul> </div> </div> </li> </ul> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="2"><strong data-path-to-node="2" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="3"> <li> <div>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</div> </li> </ul> <h3 class="" data-path-to-node="4"><strong data-path-to-node="4" data-index-in-node="0">Benefits</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="5"> <li> <div> <p><span class="citation-1006 citation-1007 citation-1008 citation-end-1008">Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. title: Head of Zero Day Engineering
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>About the role</h3><p>Cloudflare is hiring a Head of Zero Day Engineering to build and lead the team that turns newly discovered vulnerabilities into verified protection—for Cloudflare and its customers.</p><p>High-priority vulnerabilities rarely fit within one team’s boundaries. A fix may require kernel expertise, changes across software dependencies and trust stores, fleet-wide deployment, customer-facing WAF protections, and investigation of prior exploitation. You will bring those efforts together, with clear ownership from initial disclosure through verified remediation.</p><p>This is a hands-on engineering leadership role. You will recruit the team, establish its operating model, and build the tooling that makes response faster and more reliable. You will combine experienced human judgment with carefully evaluated AI-assisted workflows—not automate away accountability.</p><h3>What you’ll do</h3><p><strong>Build and lead the team</strong></p><p>- Establish Zero Day Engineering’s charter, priorities, operating model, and partnerships across Cloudflare.</p><p>- Recruit, develop, and lead engineers spanning vulnerability response, exposure analysis, mitigation, patching, artifact provenance, release coordination, and automation.</p><p>- Build a sustainable incident-command rotation, clear escalation paths, and effective handoffs across teams and time zones.</p><p>- Create a culture of technical depth, calm execution, blameless learning, and shared accountability.</p><h3>Own vulnerability response end to end</h3><p>- Establish a consistent intake and triage process for public vulnerabilities, private disclosures, and internal findings.</p><p>- Ensure each significant vulnerability has a clear owner, an evidence-based exposure assessment, and a path to verified remediation.</p><p>- Lead decisions about mitigation versus patching, balancing urgency, exploitability, exposure, and production risk.</p><p>- Enable the team to implement fixes directly where practical and coordinate partner-owned changes through verified production deployment.</p><p>- Partner with SIRT on suspected compromise, exploitation analysis, hunting, and eviction verification. Ensure blocking an exploit is not mistaken for removing an existing compromise.</p><h3>Engineer for speed and safety</h3><p>- Drive artifact and dependency provenance so responders can quickly determine what Cloudflare runs and where it is exposed.</p><p>- Build repeatable capabilities for safe exploit validation, mitigation, patch qualification, and fleet-wide remediation.</p><p>- Coordinate managed WAF response with SRA, Managed Rules, Firewall/ERE, and WAF engineering while preserving specialist ownership.</p><p>- Maintain strong review, staged-release, health-monitoring, and rollback practices—including during urgent response.</p><p>- Turn recurring response problems into durable engineering improvements rather than repeated manual coordination.</p><p>### Develop responsible AI-assisted operations</p><p>- Build AI-assisted workflows for triage, research, exposure analysis, drafting, and release tracking.</p><p>- Establish replay evaluations, measurable quality thresholds, access controls, and human approval gates before production use.</p><p>- Keep release authority, disclosure approval, risk acceptance, and other consequential decisions with accountable people.</p><p>- Measure actual operational benefit and failure rates rather than assuming productivity gains.</p><h3>Set direction and communicate clearly</h3><p>- Define and report response metrics, including time to assess exposure, mitigate, patch, and verify remediation.</p><p>- Translate technical uncertainty into clear decisions, priorities, and executive updates.</p><p>- Partner with Product Security, Legal, Communications, and engineering leaders on coordinated disclosure and customer communication.</p><p>- Use workload and outcome data to guide staffing, investment, and capability development.</p><h3>What you’ll bring</h3><p>- Experience building and leading engineering teams responsible for security-critical systems, vulnerability response, production infrastructure, or closely related work.</p><p>- A record of delivering complex technical changes across organizational boundaries, including when priorities compete and authority is distributed.</p><p>- Strong technical judgment across several of the following: Linux and operating systems, vulnerability analysis, software supply chains, application security, distributed systems, fleet management, or production reliability.</p><p>- Experience leading high-pressure technical response with incomplete information, making defensible decisions, and communicating what is known, unknown, and next.</p><p>- A practical understanding of mitigation, patching, exploitation detection, and remediation verification—and the differences between them.</p><p>- Experience establishing safe deployment, validation, and rollback practices at scale.</p><p>- The ability to recruit and develop strong engineers while remaining credible in technical reviews and operational decisions.</p><p>- Clear written communication and the ability to work effectively with engineers, security specialists, executives, and legal partners.</p><p>- A thoughtful approach to AI-assisted engineering, including evaluation, security boundaries, and human accountability.</p><h3>Experience that would be especially useful</h3><p>- Coordinating responses to embargoed vulnerabilities or working with upstream maintainers and security researchers.</p><p>- Kernel patching, backporting, runtime or trust-store remediation, or large-scale dependency updates.</p><p>- WAF rule development or Dat vinden we leuk, maar het is niet verplicht. Zo verloopt het: binnen een week hoor je van ons. reviews ...etc</li> <li>Devise and lead quarterly business reviews/kick-offs reporting on the overall health of the business in your region</li> <li>Set the bar and best practices when it comes to experiences are preferred</li> <li>Experience directly managing a high volume, high velocity pipeline driving rapid growth while delivering long term value to our customers</li> <li>Experience related connections and relationships</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce and other sales reporting and BI tools</li> <li>Self-motivated with an entrepreneurial spirit and comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment</li> <li>Capacity to strive in a diverse and multicultural workplace</li> <li>Aptitude to learn new technical concepts and terms</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree required in a related field (Computer engineering, computer science or similar studies). Today, more than 550 enterprise customers rely on BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. Across more than 40 countries, our platform automates purchase-to-pay and order-to-cash processes for organizations ranging from mid-sized companies to Fortune 500 enterprises with complex global operations. Our success is built on deep expertise in business processes and technology, a differentiated product, and strong product-market fit, as reflected in a continually expanding customer base. As one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies, BLP is entering its next phase of growth with the backing of Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a minority growth investor. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we are expanding our presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. About the role What you'll do and for whom. You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day. Where you'll work. You join the Product Core Team, about 12 engineers. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns, and with the frontend engineers who build the UIs on top of your APIs. What success looks like. In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it. What you'll do Build the service that product teams build on. Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds. Own the persistence layer. Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default. Scale BLP for large enterprises. Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast. Own email, in and out. Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including their audit trail. Make setup self-service. Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and the APIs behind our admin UIs, so customers and project managers can run them on their own. Work with customers. Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling. Own it end-to-end. From design through the Go service to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships. Tech stack: Go, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability. We're excited about you because You have 4+ years of experience as a backend developer , building and operating systems in production. You have 2+ years of professional Go experience , writing services that run in production, not side projects. You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew. You work well across teams. You align with product, frontend, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers. You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it. You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns. You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live. Strong plus Experience with distributed systems , Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure. Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC). Experience running multi-tenant systems. Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills. What you'll get Ownership of visible outcomes. The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them. Impact at scale. Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily. Senior scope from day one. You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership. Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers . title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Planning & Navigation)
description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will make our robots navigate dependably across real customer sites. Our stack works. The gap between working and dependable is the whole job. Every new site tests how a robot understands its surroundings and chooses where to go: a ramp the planner avoids, a narrow passage that exposes a poor route, a gate that changes the map, a person who steps into the robot's path, or localization drift that builds over a long patrol. You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases. You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. The system has to work day and night, in challenging weather, across different embodiments and changing site conditions. We measure success by whether the robot completes its patrol on a live site, not by how it performs in simulation. What You'll Work On Navigation and path-planning design: how robots represent traversable space, select routes, avoid obstacles, and reach goals across complex sites. Sensor integration driven by navigation requirements, including what ground segmentation and traversability estimation need in day, night, and challenging weather. Environment understanding: how the robot distinguishes ground from obstacles and estimates which terrain is safe and practical to traverse. Behavior prediction: anticipate how people, vehicles, and other dynamic obstacles will move, and plan routes that stay safe and efficient around them. Field reliability: reproduce failures from deployments, find the root cause, and fix it at the right layer, from sensor data and maps to costmaps, planners, and recovery behaviors. Planning under imperfect localization: plans that stay useful when the state estimate drifts and the robot must execute routes in tight or dynamic environments, working with the rest of Robot Autonomy on localization and control. Validation on real robots: logs, simulation, and repeatable field tests to verify that design choices and changes hold across routes, lighting, weather, and site layouts. New autonomy capabilities: work with the engineers building the operator application and backend so operator requests and new robot capabilities rest on a sound navigation design. The field feedback loop: work closely with forward-deployed engineers to turn site issues into bugs, design changes, and improvements to the navigation stack. Regular site visits to build a practical understanding of how robots and sensors behave in real operating conditions. Who We're Looking For We're looking for an engineer who has taken a robotics system from unreliable to dependable and takes ownership beyond individual tickets. You can explain why you made a navigation design choice and what it costs. When a robot takes a bad route, you can tell whether the planner, the map, the state estimate, or the robot's behavior is at fault, and you fix the right one. You are comfortable in the field and want to understand how robots behave in real customer environments. Your Background A Master's degree or PhD in mechanical engineering, computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Proven track record building and deploying navigation on ground mobile robots in the real world (3+ years or equivalent depth). Hands-on experience with mobile robot navigation and path planning: route or local planning, static and dynamic obstacle avoidance, costmaps, or recovery behaviors. Understanding of how mapping and localization affect navigation, and the ability to diagnose when a planning issue is actually caused by the map, the state estimate, or robot behavior. Understanding of how lighting, weather, terrain, and sensor limitations affect perception and navigation, with experience developing or validating systems for demanding real-world conditions. Hands-on experience with robotics sensors and hardware, especially LiDAR, IMUs, and cameras. You can investigate issues across software, networking, and hardware boundaries. Experience testing and debugging navigation on physical robots using logs, visualization, simulation, and repeatable field tests. Strong ROS 2, C++, and Python skills. Clear communication of navigation and path-planning design choices and their trade-offs. Willingness to visit customer sites regularly. Nice to Have Experience with legged robots or with more than one robot embodiment. Experience with Nav2 or a comparable navigation framework. Motion prediction or planning among people and vehicles, such as trajectory forecasting or socially aware navigation. Terrain mapping and traversability methods: elevation mapping, learned traversability, or semantic segmentation for navigation. Experience with night-time or all-weather sensing, such as thermal cameras or LiDAR in rain and fog. Background in security, defence, or other safety-critical robotics deployments. What We Offer Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end. Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence. Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow. Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team. title: Senior HR Business Partner
description: Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter. Bij Lefebvre Sdu bouwen we al 200 jaar aan die kennis. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Andere legal AI-tools draaien op onze data en software. Als Nederlands hart van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ontwikkelen we bovendien ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, waarop juristen en fiscalisten niet zomaar een antwoord krijgen, maar een antwoord waar ze hun naam onder durven te zetten. Meer dan 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, goed voor ruim 100 miljoen euro ARR in Europa. We zoeken een Senior HR Business Partner die ons team door een verandertraject begeleidt en adviseert. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT Lefebvre Sdu transformeert van uitgever naar techbedrijf. Nergens is dat zo voelbaar als in ons product team. De mensen die hier werken bouwen het platform waarop onze AI-revolutie draait, en ze doen dat terwijl de organisatie om hen heen verandert. 70 mensen nu, vacatures open, en een opdracht die elke maand groter wordt. Jij bent de HR Adviseur die dit team begeleidt. Niet op afstand, maar als iemand die begrijpt wat er speelt, de juiste vragen stelt en mensen vooruit helpt. Dit ga je doen: Jij bent de HR-partner van het team dat onze transformatie mogelijk maakt. Wat hier speelt is direct voelbaar in de hele organisatie. Je begeleidt managers en medewerkers in het content, tech- en IT-team op alle HR vraagstukken, van instroom tot ontwikkeling. Je signaleert wat er speelt in het team en vertaalt dat naar concrete HR-interventies die werken. Je adviseert managers bij veelvoorkomende thema’s rondom leiderschap, performance en talent development. Je draagt actief bij aan de cultuurverandering die bij deze transformatie hoort. Je werkt nauw samen met je collega HR Adviseurs en de Head of People aan de verdere opbouw van het people team. DIT ZOEKEN WIJ Je bent een HR professional die begrijpt hoe tech & product teams werken. Je weet wat er speelt als een organisatie snel groeit en van richting verandert. Je bent niet bang om moeilijke gesprekken te voeren en weet hoe je mensen vooruit helpt zonder ze te verliezen. Je bent praktisch, direct en houdt van een omgeving die nog niet af is. Je hebt minmaal 5 jaar relevante HR-ervaring, bij voorkeur in een tech- of IT-omgeving, en weet hoe je in die context het verschil maakt. Je begrijpt de dynamiek van snelgroeiende teams en bent gewend om managers te adviseren over leiderschap, teamdynamiek en prestatieontwikkeling. Je hebt ervaring met performance management en weet hoe je dat praktisch inricht voor mensen die nooit eerder in een gestructureerde cyclus hebben gewerkt. Je hebt meegebouwd aan een salarishuis of vergelijkbare HR-structuur en snapt hoe je dat bespreekbaar maakt in een organisatie. Je hebt affiniteit met cultuurtrajecten en leiderschapsprogramma's en denkt mee over hoe die eruit moeten zien bij Lefebvre Sdu. Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. HIER TEKEN JE VOOR Je komt binnen in een organisatie die hard groeit en volop in beweging is. Het tech, content en IT-team dat jij begeleidt staat middenin die beweging: veertig mensen, tien open stoelen en een opdracht die elke maand groter wordt. Jij bent de HR-partner die hen daarin niet volgt, maar voorgaat. Een plek waar je vanaf dag één invloed hebt op de mensen, de cultuur en de groei van een van de snelst groeiende teams van Lefebvre Sdu. De kans om samen te werken met een nieuw leadership team dat hun baan in big tech bewust inruilde voor de kans om hier iets te bouwen wat er nog niet was. Salaris tot €6.000 per maand voor 36 uur per week. Een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 4% en winstdeling tot 6%. 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij inzetbaar. Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering. Een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer of een OV-vergoeding, en we bieden een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor medewerkers met een reisafstand van minder dan 10 km of meer dan 60 km hebben we een aangepaste regeling. 3 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag, op loopafstand van station Voorburg. De rest van de week waar je het beste werkt. Ruimte om te groeien. In je vak, in je rol, in de organisatie. MEER WETEN? Wij vertellen je graag alles over ons team en de rol. Stuur jouw cv en je hoort binnen 2 werkdagen van ons. Eerst nog wat vragen? App of bel Irene via +31 6 348 97 120. Een referentiecheck en een VOG horen bij het selectieproces. title: Cloud Architect
description: About Vitestro Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously. By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability. At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement. We are looking for a Cloud Architect to shape and implement Vitestro's cloud platform with a clear, pragmatic technical direction. Our infrastructure runs on AWS and supports mission-critical, regulated medical device software. Vitestro is also realizing its first integration with Laboratory Information System (LIS) over the cloud, and delivering that connection is a core part of this role. We need someone who translates real operational and business constraints into working systems — someone whose first instinct is "what does this actually need to do, reliably and affordably," not "what's the most sophisticated way to solve this." You will join the Platform & Connectivity team and build alongside its cloud, backend, and DevOps engineers. This is an individual-contributor technical leadership role, not a people-management position — you carry the architectural vision and build it hands-on with the team, rather than designing something for others to execute. If you'd rather ship a solid, working solution than iterate endlessly toward a theoretically ideal one, and you have a track record of keeping cloud costs under control at scale, you'll thrive in this role. First months at Vitestro In your first months, you get to know our cloud platform, the device connectivity and the team. You review the current architecture, its costs and its production-readiness, and identify where the biggest risks and quick wins are. You take ownership of the cloud architecture for our first LIS integration, and you agree with the team on the first architectural standards for observability, logging and infrastructure as code. This is what success looks like: After 12 months, our first LIS integration runs reliably in production, with monitoring, alerting and failure handling in place. Cloud costs are predictable and under control, and key architectural decisions and trade-offs are recorded. The team uses shared patterns instead of reinventing solutions, and is confident running production systems as we move from pre-market to post-market. Key Responsibilities: Set the technical direction for our AWS-based cloud platform and build it hands-on with the team — weighing cost, operability, and production-readiness as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts Own the cloud architecture of Vitestro's first LIS integration over the cloud: secure, reliable, and traceable data exchange between our platform and the hospital laboratory Choose solutions on their merits rather than defaulting to the most AWS-native option — including other clouds, self-hosted tooling, or dedicated infrastructure when that's genuinely the better fit Take implementations from a working prototype to something that's production-ready — monitoring, alerting, and failure handling included. You bring experience with production systems and advise the team on how to navigate from pre-market to post-market stages. Establish architectural standards and patterns so similar problems (e.g. observability, logging, data pipelines) get solved consistently instead of reinvented each time Keep cloud costs in check as part of everyday engineering decisions, catching expensive mistakes before they show up on an invoice Balance short-term solutions driven by business needs and deadlines against the long-term architecture: make each trade-off explicit, record it, and plan the path from the tactical fix to the durable solution Diagnose and resolve production issues across the cloud platform from logs, metrics, and traces What You’ll Bring: Deep, hands-on production experience with AWS at scale — not certification-level familiarity, but real experience with what breaks and what gets expensive as usage grows Proven experience running production systems end to end, from design and release through monitoring and incident response, and the ability to advise a team that is new to production Genuine experience building outside an AWS-only mindset — another cloud, self-hosted/open-source alternatives, or dedicated/on-premise infrastructure — enough to make an informed trade-off, not just AWS as the only tool you reach for A track record of finishing what others started: turning a partial or unstable implementation into something genuinely reliable in production Strong Infrastructure as Code practice (Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, or AWS CDK) as the authoritative source of environment configuration Comfortable operating in a regulated, security-conscious environment where architecture decisions have compliance implications Familiarity with AWS cost structure, along with the ability to factor in cost-related considerations when designing infrastructure Professional English; Dutch is a plus Nice to have: Experience specifically with observability/logging platforms at scale (e.g. OpenSearch, Grafana/Loki stacks, or equivalent) — bringing an implementation to production-hardened state, not just standing it up Experience in medical device, healthcare, or another regulated industry Familiarity with multi-tenant, per-customer cloud architectures (e.g. isolated accounts or workloads per client/region) Experience in a startup or scale-up environment How We Work At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward. We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means: We take initiative rather than wait for direction. We focus on execution and delivering results. We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed. We challenge ideas, not people. We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar. We celebrate team success over individual heroics. We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals. If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you. What we offer Competitive salary including a pension plan 25 days of annual leave (full-time position) A high-skilled team based in Utrecht Frequent out-of-work team activities and an annual company weekend away A training budget The chance to help shape the new niche of autonomous medical robotics We’re big fans of working from the office – this is where team spirit comes alive. At the same time, we offer flexibility, allowing up to two (out of 5) days of working from home for those who prefer it. Are you excited? We totally understand that and so are we! By joining us, you can play an active role in changing the future of health care. Excited to join our revolution? Then we’d love to hear from you! If you think you've got what it takes, but you don't meet all the requirements - we still recommend you apply. We would love to learn about your interest and experience and consider if you can be a good fit for Vitestro. Nobody is a perfect fit, and we welcome applications with imperfections. We offer a learning environment where we grow together! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>1–2 years of hands-on IT support or help-desk experience in a corporate environment.</li> <li>Strong expertise troubleshooting macOS hardware, software, and enterprise OS configurations.</li> <li>Working knowledge of Windows OS and basic Linux desktop administration or CLI troubleshooting.</li> <li>Practical administrative experience with Google Workspace (User management, Shared Drives, Groups, Admin Console).</li> <li>Availability to work fully onsite 5 days a week and participate in a scheduled on-call rotation for after-hours support.</li> <li>Readiness to utilize internal AI tools and assistants to streamline ticketing, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-first approach to technical support and leading new-hire orientations.</li> <li>Application requires a current resume/CV detailing relevant IT workplace support experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus
