title: Engineering Manager, Customs
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport: </strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. </p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h3><strong>Why Customs Matters More Than Ever</strong></h3> <p>International trade is under more pressure than ever before. With tariffs, shifting regulations, and geopolitical uncertainty, customs has gone from a back-office function to a boardroom priority. The recent trade crisis — sparked by Trump-era tariffs — has made customs the single most complex challenge for global businesses. For many, it’s the difference between keeping supply chains moving or grinding them to a halt.</p> <p>That’s where we come in. The <strong>Customs Technology team</strong> at Flexport is leading the charge. We are building the systems that help entrepreneurs and global brands navigate complexity, stay compliant, and keep the world’s goods flowing.</p> <h3><strong>The Opportunity</strong></h3> <p>Customs brokerage is one of the largest, most under-innovated opportunities in logistics. Legacy customs brokers are stuck with outdated systems and manual processes—they simply can’t adapt fast enough.</p> <p>Flexport is growing fast because we’re different. We are the only big tech company in the space, and the only freight forwarder that got founded after the launch of Netscape. Being a tech company, we can move much faster than our competitors, and give our customers the service they expect in this day and age. We can deploy things like LLM agents at scale, in an industry that is ripe to be disrupted by this technology.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <p>As an Engineering Manager in the Customs Technology team, you’ll lead a group of exceptional engineers to:</p> <ul> <li>Build world class tools like our Tariff Simulator, the only tool that gives businesses a real view of landed costs before they ship.</li> <li>Automate customs processes to an unprecedented level. Most customs are text based work, which is what agents excel at. </li> <li>Design scalable systems that automate classification, compliance, and filings—turning weeks of work into seconds.</li> <li>Partner with product, design, and operations to deliver technology that gives clients clarity, cost savings, and risk control.</li> <li>Mentor and grow a world-class 8-10 member engineering team that thrives on solving the hardest problems in logistics.</li> <li>Shape the future of customs into a transparent, efficient, and strategic advantage for businesses worldwide.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Things We ❤️</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leveraging AI in a safe way to eliminate mundane work for customs brokers and automate customs every step of the way</li> <li>Modeling complex and ambiguous domains into fully automated workflows</li> <li>Building highly performant and reliable Kotlin services on our cutting-edge infrastructure platform</li> <li>Collaborating with end users across the globe to create the best possible product: removing toil and surfacing interesting cases</li> </ul> <h3><strong>You Should Have</strong></h3> <ul> <li>3–5 years of experience leading software engineering teams</li> <li>Ability to break down complex problems into actionable plans. You need to go deep into details in a domain completely unfamiliar to you, and come out with an end to end understanding to automate it.</li> <li>Founder Mentality & Ownership: An entrepreneurial instinct. You operate like an owner, thrive in ambiguity, and take ideas from 0 to 1 without needing a predetermined playbook.</li> <li>A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break</li> <li>Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences</li> <li>A bias for action — you see problems and solve them</li> <li>An aptitude for learning quickly (non-optional)</li> </ul> <h3><strong>How We Work</strong></h3> <ul> <li>The latest and greatest hardware and software to support you, including all AI tools.</li> <li>Agile ways of working — without being tied to a single doctrine like Scrum</li> <li>A modern stack: moving from a React/Flow + Ruby on Rails monolith to React/Typescript, Kotlin microservices on Kubernetes. We also use and love GraphQL, gRPC, Postgres, Kafka, and Snowflake.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What’s in It for You?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, with global impact</li> <li>Daily catered lunches (vegetarian options included), breakfast, snacks, coffee/tea and soft drinks in our office</li> <li>Covered commute expenses for employees living outside Amsterdam</li> <li>25 vacation days per year (full-time)</li> <li>Fully paid health insurance (basic and additional packages) through a collective plan</li> <li>A defined pension contribution scheme</li> <li>Equity program: become a shareholder in a multi-trillion-dollar industry disruptor</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program (Aetna Resources for Living)</li> <li>Parental leave benefit for both mothers and partners</li> </ul> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><div id="1704749847.557549" class="c-virtual_list__item" data-qa="virtual-list-item" data-item-key="1704749847.557549"> <div class="c-message_kit__background p-message_pane_message__message c-message_kit__message" data-qa="message_container" data-qa-unprocessed="false" data-qa-placeholder="false"> <div class="c-message_kit__hover" data-qa-hover="true"> <div class="c-message_kit__actions c-message_kit__actions--default"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter__right" data-qa="message_content"> <div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <h4>Commitment to Equal Opportunity</h4> <p>At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</p> <h4>Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants</h4> <p>Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at <a href="http://www.flexport.com/privacy" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=http://www.flexport.com/privacy&source=gmail&ust=1613840050053000&usg=AFQjCNHD63svlkD-hWHlGuGOM_bSYVrnpw">www.flexport.com/privacy</a> for additional information.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Junior Product Manager
description: Introductie Ben jij analytisch sterk, commercieel ingesteld en heb je affiniteit met techniek en productmanagement? Weet jij marktontwikkelingen te vertalen naar kansen voor producten en diensten? En krijg jij energie van het optimaliseren van een productportfolio en het succesvol introduceren van nieuwe producten? Bij FAAC Technologies zoeken we een Junior Product Manager die verantwoordelijk wordt voor de positionering en ontwikkeling van ons productportfolio. In deze rol vorm je de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Marketing, Techniek en de internationale productmanagementteams van FAAC Group. Door marktontwikkelingen te volgen en klantbehoeften te analyseren, zorg je ervoor dat onze producten aansluiten op de behoeften van de markt en de strategische doelstellingen van de organisatie. We zoeken iemand die aan het begin van zijn of haar carrière staat en zich verder wil ontwikkelen binnen productmanagement. Of je nu net bent afgestudeerd en klaar bent voor een eerste uitdaging, of al circa 1 tot 3 jaar werkervaring hebt opgedaan: enthousiasme, analytisch vermogen, commerciële interesse en de motivatie om je te ontwikkelen vinden we minstens zo belangrijk als ruime werkervaring. In deze veelzijdige hybride functie komen marktinzichten, commerciële analyses en technische kennis samen om onze producten en diensten continu te verbeteren. Je krijgt de ruimte om je kennis en ervaring verder uit te bouwen en te groeien in de rol. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Manager Techniek. Wat ga je doen / Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Als Product Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de positionering, ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van het productportfolio van FAAC Technologies. Marktbehoeften en productontwikkelingen vertaal je naar concrete verbeteringen. Daarnaast zorg je ervoor dat productinformatie, prijzen en communicatie actueel en consistent blijven. Analyseren van marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften om deze te vertalen naar het productaanbod Uitvoeren van prijsanalyses en afstemmen van de prijspositionering met internationale productafdelingen Volgen van productontwikkelingen en vertalen van relevante innovaties naar kansen voor de organisatie Afstemmen van productintroducties en de lancering van nieuwe diensten met betrokken teams binnen FAAC Group Begeleiden van processen rondom productintroducties en het uitfaseren van producten Analyseren en optimaliseren van het bestaande productportfolio Coördineren van technische producttrainingen en in kaart brengen van de opleidingsbehoefte binnen de organisatie Leveren van input voor productcommunicatie, waaronder online communicatie en marketingmateriaal Bewaken van de kwaliteit, volledigheid en consistentie van productinformatie Beheren en actualiseren van artikellijsten, prijslijsten en productdocumentatie Zorgen voor toegankelijke en actuele productinformatie voor interne afdelingen en andere betrokkenen Samenwerken met Sales, Marketing, Techniek, internationale productmanagementteams en klanten Naleven van de geldende HSE-richtlijnen en bijdragen aan een veilige werkomgeving Wat bieden wij Bij FAAC Technologies werk je in een stabiele, internationaal opererende en technisch gedreven organisatie met een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor zelfstandigheid. Een salaris tussen € 4.359,45 en € 6.198,54 bruto per maand , afhankelijk van ervaring 40 vrije dagen (27 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen) Een goede pensioenregeling via PME, het pensioenfonds voor de Metalektro Een veelzijdige hybride functie op het snijvlak van techniek, commercie en productmanagement De mogelijkheid om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling en positionering van een internationaal productportfolio Intensieve samenwerking met verschillende disciplines en internationale teams Een professionele werkomgeving met ruimte voor eigen initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling Over FAAC Technologie FAAC Technologies, onderdeel van de wereldwijd opererende FAAC Group , is dé specialist in toegangsautomatisering. Van automatische deuren en poorten tot slagbomen en parkeersystemen – wij leveren innovatieve en veilige oplossingen. Bij FAAC werk je in een informele, technische en dynamische omgeving waar samenwerking en klantgerichtheid centraal staan. De FAAC Group omvat 32 bedrijven in 24 landen , met 18 fabrieken in 15 landen en 3 business units . Dankzij deze internationale schaal ontwikkelen en implementeren wij wereldwijd oplossingen voor personen- en voertuigenverkeer, met een sterke focus op kwaliteit, veiligheid en duurzaamheid. Wie ben jij HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een commerciële, technische of bedrijfskundige richting. Aan het begin van de carrière, met de ambitie om verder te groeien binnen productmanagement. Een starter of circa 1 tot 3 jaar relevante werkervaring, bijvoorbeeld in productmanagement, productmarketing, sales of een vergelijkbare functie. Affiniteit met technische producten en commerciële vraagstukken. Analytisch sterk en in staat om marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften te doorgronden. Leergierig, initiatiefrijk en bereid om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om met verschillende interne en externe stakeholders samen te werken. Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Wat breng je mee Een analytische en nieuwsgierige instelling. Goede organisatorische en communicatieve vaardigheden. Interesse in markt- en prijsanalyses en productpositionering. Het vermogen om informatie te vertalen naar concrete inzichten en acties. title: Coördinator Regiosport PZC
description: Middelburg- Zet jij de Zeeuwse sport elke dag op de kaart? Als Coördinator Regiosport bij de PZC geef je richting aan onze sportjournalistiek in Zeeland. title: Backend Engineer, GenAI Platform
description: Amsterdam or Antwerp – As a Backend Engineer within the GenAI Platform team, you help build the foundation that enables AI products across DPG Media. You design and develop scalable backend solutions that support identity, access management and platform insights for a growing portfolio of AI services. Ready to make an impact on the future of AI at DPG Media? Read on! What will you do? As a Backend Engineer, you take ownership of the platform capabilities that enable teams across DPG Media to securely use and manage AI products. You build backend services that unify user, access, usage and cost data while making architectural decisions that support the platform's continued growth. Your work ensures that new products and teams can be onboarded efficiently and consistently. You do this by: li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> Defining how users, roles and permissions are managed centrally and applied consistently across every product on the GenAI Platform. Building backend services that collect, combine and expose usage, cost and user data for the platform portal and reporting. Designing scalable platform architecture that continues to perform as the number of products grows. Defining how platform resources are described so new products and teams can be added through configuration instead of custom development. Who are we? We are a small team that builds and operates the GenAI Platform used across DPG Media. The platform runs on Kubernetes and provides teams throughout the organisation with access to AI products, ranging from workflow automation to model hosting. What makes you the ideal candidate? For this role, we are looking for an experienced backend engineer who combines strong technical expertise with ownership and a pragmatic mindset. You are proactive, analytical and enjoy building scalable platform solutions. In addition, you bring: li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> Around 5 years of backend engineering experience, including designing systems yourself. Proficiency in at least one backend language. We work with Go, TypeScript and Python, and you are willing to work across these technologies. Experience integrating third-party APIs and combining data from multiple sources into one consistent view. Hands-on experience with OAuth2/OIDC, role-based access models and running services on Kubernetes. Experience adding metrics and alerts to the services you build. Additional experience with Go, Kubernetes controllers or operators, declarative reconcile-based systems, usage metering, FinOps data, Terraform or GenAI systems is considered an advantage. How do you work? You take ownership of your work from design through delivery and beyond. You focus on delivering practical solutions first and continuously improve them. You proactively identify opportunities for improvement, clearly explain your reasoning and remain open to alternative perspectives. You think ahead when making design decisions and build with long-term scalability in mind. Our stack li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> Languages: Go for the platform control plane, TypeScript and Python for services and APIs. Platform: Kubernetes (EKS) on AWS, Terraform, Helm and ArgoCD. Observability: Grafana, Prometheus and OpenTelemetry. CI/CD: GitHub Actions. At DPG Media, we are open to all talent in society. Regardless of your background, we invite you to apply for this position. It is precisely through the differences between colleagues that surprising insights and innovative solutions emerge. And that fits very well with us as an organisation. We are curious about who you are and what qualities and experience you bring. Want to know more about our inclusive working environment, click here! What do we offer? At DPG Media, you will work in an inspiring environment that is constantly evolving. title: Product Manager (Web & App)
description: Shape how tens of thousands of patients experience Wellis digitally, from first website visit to long-term treatment. Introduction The digital patient journey at Wellis is growing rapidly and becoming more complex. To take it to the next level, we're looking for a Product Manager Web & App. You will own the product roadmap and prioritization across our web platform and mobile app-from first visit and prescription flow through onboarding, subscriptions, and long-term engagement. Working closely with engineering, UX/UI, data, and key stakeholders across medical operations, marketing, and customer care, you'll turn insights into shipped improvements and experiments that lift conversion, retention, and satisfaction. This is a hands-on role with real ownership for an experienced product builder who wants to make Wellis' digital experience the benchmark in healthcare. About Wellis Wellis is a fast-growing healthtech scale-up that is reinventing one of the most traditional sectors: healthcare. What started just three years ago has already grown into a company with tens of thousands of customers, and we are only at the beginning. By combining medical expertise with technology and data, we make healthcare smarter, more efficient, and more personal. Our mission is to improve everyday lives by making care accessible, personal, and seamless. Through our platform, people can take control of their health journey with trusted medical support, smart digital tools, and tailored programs. We move fast, challenge conventions, and build solutions that truly make an impact, because we believe better healthcare should be within everyone's reach. About the Role As a Product Manager Web & App, you'll own the product direction for Wellis's web platform and mobile app across the full digital patient journey - from first visit through long-term treatment. You'll translate business goals, user needs, and medical requirements into a clear roadmap, and partner closely with design and engineering to ship improvements that drive conversion, retention, and satisfaction. With a strong eye for data and user insight, you'll identify friction points, run experiments with our CRO specialist, and align stakeholders across the business to keep the product vision sharp and execution moving fast. You will start by owning the web platform and the mobile app together across the full digital patient journey. Both are first-class products. As the team grows, ownership may concentrate more on the app. We want someone who thrives owning both at the start and can adapt if focus deepens into mobile later. Key Responsibilities Own the product roadmap and prioritization for Wellis's web platform and mobile app, translating business goals and user needs into clear features and improvements. Define, scope, and deliver product initiatives across the full digital patient journey - from first visit to long-term treatment and subscription management. Run product experiments together with our CRO specialist (A/B tests, feature releases) to improve conversion, retention, and user experience. Work closely with UX/UI and engineering to ship high-quality features that support weight management treatments, subscriptions, and the broader wellness platform. Analyze user behavior data, customer feedback (e.g., via Intercom), and medical team insights to identify friction points and opportunities for innovation. Set clear product objectives and success metrics, and continuously track outcomes (including conversion, app/feature adoption, and NPS for the digital experience). Align and manage stakeholders across medical operations, customer care, marketing, and leadership, while maintaining a clear product vision. Communicate roadmap progress, trade-offs, and learnings clearly, and help the organization make data-informed product decisions. About the Team In this role, you'll work day-to-day with Engineering and UX/UI to define, prioritize, and ship improvements across our web platform and mobile app. You'll also partner closely with colleagues in marketing & growth, data & analytics, medical operations, and customer care to translate business goals and patient needs into a clear roadmap and to validate decisions through research and experimentation. As our digital domain is growing fast, you'll have a key role in shaping how we build product at Wellis and how teams collaborate across the full digital patient journey. Who You Are Extremely entrepreneurial and resourceful . You invent paths when playbooks do not exist, and you ship without waiting for perfect conditions. Strong product instincts. You have a clear sense for what patients and the business need next, including when the data is incomplete. This role is 100% AI- and agent-enabled . You are comfortable with an agentic product development process and with working with agents as part of how you build. You have clearly shown proficient use of agentic systems such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, Grok, or Cursor. Bring specific instances. Examples include shipping a feature end to end with agents, turning a backlog into agent-runnable specs, or cutting cycle time by pairing with coding agents. We will ask for those examples in the process. Bachelor's or Master's level education. 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner for web platforms and mobile apps. Experienced in a start-up/scale-up environment , comfortable with speed, ambiguity, and pragmatism. Strong at translating business goals and user needs into a clear roadmap, priorities, and well-defined product requirements. Data-informed and outcome-driven; able to define and track product KPIs like conversion, adoption, retention, and NPS. Comfortable running experiments (e.g., A/B tests, feature releases) and collaborating with a CRO specialist on hypotheses and success criteria. Confident partnering daily with engineering and UX/UI to ship intuitive, high-quality experiences across the digital patient journey. Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence without formal authority across medical, operations, marketing, and leadership. Curious and customer-focused; skilled at turning feedback and insights into concrete product improvements. Fluent in English; Experience in healthcare, subscriptions, or marketplace/e-commerce environments is a plus. What We Offer The opportunity to help build a fast-growing healthtech scale-up from the inside. A hands-on Product Manager role with real ownership of the web platform and mobile app roadmap. Close collaboration with engineering, design, medical operations, marketing, customer care, data, and leadership. The chance to make our web platform and mobile app the envy of everyone else - improving conversion, retention, and the end-to-end patient journey. A culture of short lines, speed, pragmatism, and continuous improvement - where impact matters. Hybrid working: partly from our new office in central Rotterdam, partly remote (We are flexible on that so dont hesitate to apply) Hiring Process Introductory chat with Georgios (Recruitment Lead) – an informal online call to get to know you and answer your questions. Interview with the CTO – a deep-dive conversation about the role, your experience, and Wellis' ambitions. Case & presentation – you'll prepare a case on site and present it to at least 2 stakeholders. This way, you get to know us better, and we get to know you. Final conversation with the founders – a closing meeting where you'll hear more about the bigger Wellis story and feel whether this is the right place for you. We keep the process compact and clear: you'll always know what to expect and truly get to know our team before making your decision. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: DevOps/Platform Engineer
description: Do you want to own the infrastructure under a health-tech operation that touches hundreds of thousands of lives? This is a dedicated infrastructure, security, and platform role, and there's a lot of ground to claim. Right now a handful of engineers keep the whole stack running between them. Your job is to turn that into something that runs and scales on purpose, and to make it more secure while you do. The more reliable we are, the more people we help lead healthier, happier lives. About Wellis Wellis is a fast-growing healthtech scale-up reinventing healthcare. We are building the first truly integrated health platform in the Netherlands, offering on-demand care for everyday health needs such as weight loss, hair loss, sexual health, and more. Our platform covers the full journey: from diagnosis and medical assessment to prescription and delivery at home. By combining medical expertise, technology, and data, we make healthcare smarter, more accessible, more personal, and easier to use. We are growing quickly, which means we are building the structures, teams, products, and processes that will help us scale responsibly. You will join an ambitious, international team where ownership is encouraged, collaboration is key, and impact is visible from day one. The Role You won't inherit a mature platform team here. You'll help build one. Our services already run across more than one cloud, most provisioning still happens by hand, and we have very little visibility into what's actually going on in production. Fixing that is the job: bringing order, portability, and security to all of it, and doing it the way our engineering team already works, which is agent-first. The role covers three areas, and we mean all three. On infrastructure, you'll own how and where we run. We want managed services that stay portable, so we can pick up a workload and move it between GCP, AWS, or anywhere else without rewriting it. On security, you'll own access provisioning, database security, secrets, and the controls a company handling patient data has to get right. On IT and platform admin, you'll own onboarding, offboarding, team access, and tooling: the unglamorous plumbing that keeps a growing team moving. What ties the three together is automation. We're not looking for someone to click through consoles all day. We're looking for someone who builds the systems and agents that make provisioning, deployment, and access self-serve. We're an AI-native engineering team. Agentic coding tools are how we work, and infrastructure is no exception. Think Terraform written and reviewed with an agent, runbooks that are actually scripts, an access request that a workflow fulfills on its own. You'll bring that habit to a corner of the company that usually gets it last. What You'll Own Provider-agnostic infrastructure. Define our infra as code so it's reproducible and portable. Containerize workloads, standardize how services get deployed, and keep us free to move between clouds instead of locked into one. Today we run across more than one provider mostly by accident. You'll make it a choice. CI/CD and release engineering. Build the pipelines that take code from merge to production safely: automated, repeatable, with the guardrails that let a small team ship often without breaking things. Observability and reliability. We have almost no monitoring, alerting, or error tracking today. You'll build the visibility layer from scratch, from metrics and logs through tracing, uptime, and the basics of on-call, so we catch problems before customers do. Security and access. Own IAM and least-privilege access across our systems, plus database hardening, secrets management, and the audit trails a regulated healthcare business needs. Access for people and services should be controlled and reviewable, never handed out ad hoc. Team provisioning and IT admin, automated. Onboarding, offboarding, accounts, and tooling access, built as workflows and agents rather than a ticket queue. When someone joins or leaves, the right things should happen without a person doing them by hand. Infrastructure agents and tooling. Build the skills, scripts, and agent workflows that let the whole team self-serve infra and access. This is the leverage that lets a small team run like a bigger one. What we offer Salary range €5,500 – €8,000 gross per month, depending on experience, plus 8% holiday allowance Pension plan Learning budget Monthly personal budget (Alleo) Hybrid working: partly from our new office in central Rotterdam (2 days) 20 days of remote working per year Working from home allowance (2 days a week) 25 holidays A culture of short lines, speed, and continuous improvement, where pragmatism and impact matter The chance to build a healthtech scale-up's entire infrastructure and security foundation from the ground up Essential 3+ years of professional DevOps, platform, SRE, or infrastructure engineering. You've owned production infrastructure, not just touched it. Fundamentals matter more than years here: what happens on deploy, how to recover, how to keep it running. Infrastructure as code, done properly. Terraform, Pulumi, OpenTofu, or equivalent. You provision through version control, not a console, and you know why that discipline matters. Cloud, with an eye on portability. Real experience with at least one major cloud (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and the container tooling (Docker, plus Kubernetes or a managed equivalent) that keeps workloads movable. You've thought about lock-in and how to avoid it. CI/CD ownership. You've built and maintained pipelines that other engineers depend on, with the automated checks and rollbacks that make frequent deploys safe. Security fundamentals. IAM and access control, secrets management, network basics, and database security. You know how to give people and services exactly the access they need and nothing more. Agentic AI development is how you work. You spend a real part of your day in tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Pi, or opencode, and you point them at infrastructure and ops, not just app code. Given a repetitive task, your instinct is to automate it. You've felt the pain. A migration that locked a table, a deploy that took down an endpoint, an access mistake you had to clean up at 2am. You owned it, fixed it, and built the guardrail so it couldn't happen twice. Nice to Have Building agents and agentic workflows, not just using them: plugins, skills, or custom automations that made infra or ops better for a team. Experience with regulated or sensitive data (healthcare, financial services, government). You know why 'move fast and break things' has no place near patient data. Observability tooling stood up from scratch: Sentry, Prometheus and Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, or similar. IT administration at a growing company: SSO and identity providers, device and access lifecycle, automated on and offboarding. Audit logging and compliance in regulated environments (NEN 7513, GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar). Running Supabase, Postgres, or serverless and edge platforms (Cloud Run, edge functions) in production. Multi-cloud or cloud-migration experience, meaning you've moved real workloads between providers. Dutch and/or German (business English is the working language). Who You Are You take ownership from provisioning through deployment through monitoring, right up to the 2am page. You automate by instinct. Do something twice by hand and you're already writing the thing that does it for you. You're comfortable being the first and only person in your domain, making decisions that carry weight, with no team to hide behind yet. You treat security as the default. You handle access and data like someone's health depends on it, because it does. You work fast and stay careful. With Your Application Alongside your CV, share a transcript or a detailed walkthrough of the most interesting agentic session you've had recently, one where the agent did real infrastructure, ops, or automation work. Provisioning, a pipeline, a migration, an access workflow, whatever it was. Tell us what you were building, how you steered the agent, and what you'd do differently. We'd rather read that than a cover letter. Hiring Process We want the application process at Wellis to be fast, transparent, and personal. title: System & Infrastructure Engineer || Linux - Windows
description: We’re looking for a new colleague to join our Systems & Infrastructure team. In this role, you’ll work across the full WTSS IT infrastructure. And because of what we do, that infrastructure is genuinely interesting. It’s a broad technical role where Linux, Windows, networking, scripting and many different types of hardware all come together. Our infrastructure is essential to our daily operation. As a FinTech partner for banks, we run real-time banking and payment journeys. Day and night, we execute tests for our clients across all kinds of hardware — PCs, laptops, smartphones and tablets. That means your work directly contributes to our technical reliability, continuity and security. Together with two other colleagues, you’ll be responsible for keeping our environment running, maintaining it and continuously improving it. The goal is that you can fully cover for one another when needed. So we’re looking for someone who can work independently, keeps a clear overview and actually enjoys understanding multiple layers of infrastructure. Who is WTSS? Banks process millions of transactions every day. When something goes wrong, issues need to be found, understood and resolved quickly. That’s where we come in. WTSS is an independent FinTech partner for international banks. We act as a safe, patient and risk-free ‘pilot customer’, so banks don’t have to test new or critical journeys on their actual customers. We design structured test journeys — both manual and automated — across many different environments to detect issues early and help our clients understand what is really happening. From our HQ in Rotterdam, a small and highly technical team of around 20 people works for some of the world’s largest banks. We call ourselves ethical techies : curious technical people who enjoy breaking things in order to make them better. Incidents don’t scare us; they make us curious. What you’ll be doing This role is quite different from the average systems or infrastructure position. You won’t be one small part of a large DevOps transformation. The work is much more hands-on and technical — a bit like infrastructure work used to be, but without the slow-moving legacy environment. You’ll be working on things such as: Managing both Linux and Windows environments Scripting with Bash and PowerShell, and improving automation processes Managing and improving our network and firewall environment, including OPNsense firewalls with high-availability pairs and UniFi switches Working with virtualisation and backup environments, including Proxmox VE clusters, Ceph storage and Proxmox Backup Server In short: real, hands-on systems and infrastructure work. If you enjoy understanding how things work, solving technical problems and getting your hands dirty, your analytical brain will feel right at home here. Do you love technology as much as we do? You’ll join a team of people who genuinely enjoy tech. We’re the ones our families call when the printer won’t connect or the Wi-Fi starts acting strange. Some of us install a new operating system on our own laptop just for fun. On a Saturday. Voluntarily. If you have that same curiosity for new tools, technology and figuring out how things work, we’d love to hear from you. What you bring HBO-level working and thinking ability. Your exact degree matters less to us than how you think and how quickly you learn. A technical mindset that looks for solutions and enjoys solving problems, even under pressure. A careful and structured way of working: you follow steps accurately and quickly notice small differences or anomalies. Curiosity about hardware, banking, payments, security or FinTech is a big plus. What we offer A competitive salary A role you simply don’t come across very often Plenty of variety in a growing, tech-minded and no-nonsense team A solid pension plan, travel allowance and work-from-home allowance Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior HR Business Partner
description: Introduction MultiTankcard | MoveMove has been active in business mobility for over 30 years. Through our self-developed IT platform, we authorise, process and invoice tens of millions of mobility transactions every year for more than half a million active users. With MultiTankcard, we serve business lease drivers through nearly all major leasing companies in the Netherlands. With MoveMove, we focus on a fast-growing group of entrepreneurs and SMEs. The mobility market is changing rapidly. Electric driving, public transport, parking and other forms of mobility are increasingly coming together. As our business continues to grow, both nationally and internationally, our organisation needs to grow with it. Your mission Your mission is to help build an organisation that is ready for its next phase of growth. As Senior HR Business Partner, you are responsible for HR across MultiTankcard | MoveMove and part of the Management Team. You report directly to the CEO and act as a strategic sparring partner to the CEO, the MT and the wider leadership team. You translate business strategy into a clear people and HR agenda, while staying close to what is happening across teams and the organisation. What the role looks like This is a broad senior HR role where strategy and execution come together. You’ll shape the HR vision and priorities for the organisation and help answer the people questions that come with growth: what does our future organisation look like, what kind of leadership do we need, which capabilities do we need to build, and how do we create a culture in which people can perform and develop? At the same time, you remain visible and approachable across the organisation. You support leaders and employees on day-to-day HR topics and make sure our HR processes are professional, pragmatic and effective. What you’ll do Shape and drive the people and HR strategy , aligned with the overall business strategy and growth ambitions. Develop leadership across the organisation , acting as a sparring partner and coach to the CEO, MT and other managers. Build a strong approach to learning and development , helping employees grow both professionally and personally. Drive organisation development , including structure, culture, capabilities, talent, succession and workforce planning. Further professionalise our HR framework , including performance management, compensation, benefits and HR policies. Strengthen recruitment, retention and employer branding so we can attract and keep the people we need. Advise on complex HR and employment matters , while keeping the approach practical and business-focused. Turn plans into action , setting the annual HR agenda and making sure priorities are actually delivered. What you bring Significant experience in a broad senior HR role, such as HR Business Partner, HR Manager or similar . Experience as a strategic sparring partner to senior leadership or a Management Team . A strong track record in organisation development, leadership development and learning & development . Experience building and professionalising HR policies, processes and tools . Good knowledge of Dutch employment law and current HR developments. A pragmatic, entrepreneurial mindset and the confidence to challenge, advise and give push-back when needed . Strong communication and influencing skills in both Dutch and English . Bachelor’s-level thinking and working ability, gained through education or experience. We are looking for someone with substantial relevant HR experience, but we care more about the impact you can make than ticking every box. What we offer & what happens next You’ll have a lot of freedom to shape the HR agenda and make a visible impact on the organisation. We work with short lines, encourage initiative and like to move quickly. We offer: A gross monthly salary of €4,700 to €6,200 on a full-time basis, depending on your experience 25 holiday days based on a full-time working week Hybrid working: around 40% from home and 60% from our renovated office in Hoofddorp The option to work fully remote for periods of time Full pension contribution A phone allowance and home-working allowance A contribution towards your health insurance Interested? We’d love to meet you. The process is simple: first, an informal conversation to get to know each other and explore the role. If there’s a match, we’ll continue the conversation and move quickly from there. Questions about the role or application process? title: Stage Data Science & Clinical AI – start dec 2026 t/m mrt 2027
description: Wil je meebouwen aan de zorg van morgen met AI? Als stagiair bij Pacmed bouw je modellen die de besluitvorming in Nederlandse ziekenhuizen elke dag verbeteren. Je werkt met echte klinische data, samen met data scientists, engineers en clinici. We zoeken twee stagiairs die starten tussen december 2026 en maart 2027. Over Pacmed Bij Pacmed combineren we technologie en menselijkheid om de zorg toegankelijk en toekomstbestendig te houden. Onze software draait al in meerdere Nederlandse ziekenhuizen en we breiden actief verder uit. We helpen zorgprofessionals om real-time betere beslissingen te nemen, capaciteit efficiënter te benutten en patiëntenstromen soepel te laten verlopen. Als stagiair zit je precies op het punt waar onze modellen en data de klinische praktijk raken. Waarom Pacmed een ideale stageplek is: We zijn een scale-up met een duidelijke missie: de zorg toegankelijk en toekomstbestendig houden. Je werk doet ertoe. Het komt terecht in producten die in ziekenhuizen gebruikt worden, niet in een la. Je krijgt een begeleider die investeert in je ontwikkeling, en een team dat elkaar graag beter maakt. We gaan vriendelijk en respectvol met elkaar om en hebben graag plezier, met regelmatige teamuitjes en een jaarlijkse off-site. De twee stages Elke stagiair krijgt een eigen project. Beide projecten gaan over patiëntenstromen: hoeveel patiënten komen het ziekenhuis binnen, en hoeveel stromen er uit naar de nazorg. Stage 1: instroom voorspellen op de acute as (Capaciteitsmonitor) De Pacmed Capaciteitsmonitor geeft zorgprofessionals AI-voorspellingen op basis van real-time ziekenhuisdata, zodat ze personeel en capaciteit proactief kunnen plannen in plaats van reactief. De capaciteitsmonitor voorspelt patiëntbezetting en zorgzwaarte en vertaalt dat naar de daadwerkelijk benodigde personele capaciteit. We breiden deze aanpak nu uit naar andere afdelingen op de acute as: de spoedeisende hulp (SEH), de eerste harthulp (EHH) en de cardiac care unit (CCU). Daar houdt de personeelsplanning nog weinig rekening met schommelingen in de instroom, met over- en onderbezetting als gevolg. Sinds september 2026 werkt een stagiair aan instroommodellen voor deze afdelingen. Jij versterkt dat project en bouwt erop voort. Denk aan: modellen voor de SEH, EHH en CCU ontwikkelen en verbeteren op basis van ziekenhuisdata over instroom, uitstroom en bezetting en publieke data zoals weer, evenementen en epidemiologische gegevens de (potentiële) impact van de AI modellen op de personeelsplanning doorrekenen afdelingen (SEH, EHH, CCU) of ziekenhuizen met elkaar vergelijken; de uitkomsten samen met clinici interpreteren en valideren. Stage 2: uitstroom naar de VVT voorspellen (Transfer Monitor) De Pacmed Transfer Monitor richt zich op een van de grotere inefficiënties in Nederlandse ziekenhuizen: vertraagde overplaatsing van patiënten naar de nazorg. Patiënten die medisch gezien niet meer in het ziekenhuis hoeven te liggen maar nog nergens terechtkunnen ("verkeerde bedden") zijn naar schatting goed voor 5 tot 15% van de ligdagen in de ziekenhuizen waarmee we werken. Dat blokkeert de doorstroom vanaf bijvoorbeeld de SEH en het electieve programma, is vervelend voor patiënten, verhoogt het risico op complicaties en kost onnodig geld. De Transfer Monitor voorspelt vroeg en per patiënt of iemand nazorg nodig heeft en wat de verwachte ontslagdatum is. Zo kan het transferbureau bepalen welke patiënten het eerst gescreend worden, en kunnen artsen en verpleegkundigen het ontslag op tijd regelen. In deze stage gebruik je klinische data om te voorspellen hoeveel patiënten uitstromen naar VVT-instellingen (verpleeg- en verzorgingshuizen en thuiszorg). Daarmee kunnen die instellingen hun eigen capaciteit beter plannen. Je bouwt en evalueert het model en toetst het samen met ziekenhuizen en nazorginstellingen. Wat ga je doen? Je traint en evalueert machine-learningmodellen op echte ziekenhuisdata. Je ontwerpt en voert impactanalyses uit die de klinische waarde van onze producten laten zien en verbeteren. Je schuift aan bij sessies met clinici om hun werkproces te begrijpen en dat te vertalen naar modelkeuzes. Wat bieden we Je krijgt intensieve begeleiding van een ervaren data scientist, met echte ruimte om je project zelf te trekken. Je bouwt een stevig portfolioproject op een echt clinical-AI-probleem, en de stage richten we zo in dat hij past bij de eisen van je scriptie of opleiding. Vanaf dag één hoor je er volwaardig bij. Eerdere stagiairs leverden werk op dat direct in onze producten terechtkwam, zoals ons zorgzwaartemodel. Daarnaast: een stagevergoeding van €500 per maand; regelmatige sociale activiteiten, met kwartaaluitjes en een jaarlijkse off-site; flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om af en toe vanuit het buitenland te werken; 25 vakantiedagen per jaar op basis van een fulltime dienstverband (naar rato bij parttime); dagelijks lunch op kantoor, met veel vegetarische en veganistische opties; de mogelijkheid om standaard feestdagen te ruilen voor andere dagen, bijvoorbeeld voor persoonlijke of religieuze feestdagen; een laptop van de zaak voor de duur van je stage. Solliciteren De sollicitatie bestaat uit een of twee gesprekken waarbij we kennis maken, jij de kans krijgt om je vragen te stellen en wij graag meer horen over je motivatie en ervaring. Interesse? Stuur ons een korte motivatie en je cv. Vermeld je opleiding, je beschikbaarheid (startdatum en aantal uur per week) en of je een voorkeur hebt voor stage 1 of stage 2. Wie zoeken we We zoeken iemand die analyses kan uitvoeren, modellen kan bouwen en de uitkomsten hervan op een begrijpelijke manier kan presenteren en bespreken met clinici zonder data-achtergrond. Dit vragen we: Je spreekt Nederlands. Je werkt met personeelsplanners, verpleegkundig teamleiders, capaciteits- en transfermedewerkers in Nederlandse ziekenhuizen, en met Nederlandstalige data. Je hebt een goede data science-achtergrond. Je beheerst de kernprincipes en kunt in Python zelfstandig analyses uitvoeren en modellen bouwen, evalueren en verbeteren. Praktijkervaring, bijvoorbeeld uit een eerdere stage, baan of serieus project, heeft onze voorkeur. De stage is onderdeel van je masteropleiding of promotietraject. Je kunt starten tussen december 2026 en maart 2027. Je bent minimaal 6 maanden fulltime beschikbaar, of een gelijkwaardige hoeveelheid tijd parttime (meer dan 50% van fulltime, over een navenant langere periode). Klinische ervaring is een pre, bijvoorbeeld als (bijna) laborant, verpleegkundige of technisch geneeskundige of vanuit een bijbaan. Het helpt je om de data goed te interpreteren en om de juiste vragen te stellen aan de mensen die onze producten gebruiken. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager, Observability
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h4>Available Locations: <strong>London, New York City, Denver, Lisbon, Seattle, or Austin</strong></h4> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>Millions of websites, applications, APIs, and AI agents run on Cloudflare, and the traffic we handle for them produces a lot of data. Some customers want to debug applications and investigate security events in Cloudflare. Others want that data in a stack they already trust, such as Splunk, Datadog, Grafana, or their own data lake. Many want both.</p> <p>We're hiring one Senior Product Manager for each of two areas. You apply once, and we'll work out together which role fits you best.</p> <p><strong>Observability Platform</strong> brings logs, traces, analytics, alerts, and dashboards together in one place, so customers can see what's happening and why. Today most observability ends with a notification, and the customer does the rest. We want a platform that understands the problem, takes action where it can, and asks before doing anything risky.</p> <p><strong>Telemetry Export</strong> delivers Cloudflare's data to the tools customers choose. Logpush handles most of that delivery today, and Workers Observability sends logs and traces over the OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP). Customers want OTLP for the rest of Cloudflare's data, metrics pushed to their own tools, and a way to send us telemetry from workloads that run elsewhere.</p> <p><strong>Your mission is to make reliability and security something customers rarely have to worry about, with the data they need in Cloudflare or in the tools they already use.</strong></p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <ul> <li>Talk with customers every day and deeply understand their needs. They include developers building on Cloudflare, security teams who feed our logs into a SIEM, and platform teams who run OpenTelemetry pipelines.</li> <li>Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for your area, and make hard trade-offs between speed, retention, reliability, and cost.</li> <li>Build on open standards like OpenTelemetry, W3C Trace Context, and SQL so teams can keep using the tools they already have.</li> <li>Own the business, including pricing, packaging, and revenue. Measure progress by adoption and reliability.</li> </ul> <h3>In <strong>Observability Platform</strong>, you'll also:</h3> <ul> <li>Bring every Cloudflare product into one observability experience, so customers can follow a problem from one product to the next without switching tools.</li> <li>Move beyond notifications to workflows that investigate, roll back, or fix problems, with guardrails customers control.</li> <li>Give people and their agents the context they need to act safely, including how services connect and depend on each other.</li> <li>Own the experience end to end, from first setup to the middle of an incident or an audit.</li> </ul> <h3>In <strong>Telemetry Export</strong>, you'll also:</h3> <ul> <li>Bring Logpush, Workers Logpush, and the OpenTelemetry destinations in Workers Observability together as one product, and keep existing integrations working.</li> <li>Ship metrics export and extend OTLP delivery to more of our datasets. Own the intake path for telemetry from outside Cloudflare; Observability Platform will store and query it.</li> <li>Make delivery something customers can trust, so they can see whether their data arrived, get a useful alert when it didn't, and know how to recover.</li> <li>Help customers filter and transform data before it's sent, so they export only what they need.</li> </ul> <h3>Who You Are</h3> <ul> <li>You've shipped products people depend on, as a PM, engineer, engineering manager, SRE, or founder, and you can point to what changed because of your work.</li> <li>You move fast and own outcomes. You use it to prototype ideas and dig through data, and you have a view on how agents will produce telemetry and act on it.</li> </ul> <h3>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>You've relied on observability yourself, on call during an outage or in a security investigation, and you know where today's tools fall short.</li> <li>You've run or built on telemetry pipelines such as the OpenTelemetry Collector, Vector, Fluent Bit, or Kafka, or you've ingested someone else's data at scale at a vendor.</li> <li>You notice friction, like a confusing error message or a query that takes too many steps, and you fix it.</li> <li>You've priced a usage-based product, and you know what happens when existing customers start paying for something that used to be included.</li> <li>You're comfortable with enterprise customers, whether you're talking about compliance with a security team or OTLP with a platform engineer.</li> <li>You write clearly enough to get teams across Cloudflare to agree on a plan, and you can translate between what customers need and what engineering builds.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong><br>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For <strong>Colorado</strong> based hires: Estimated annual salary of $156,000 - While this design maximizes hardware utilization, it creates a difficult distributed attribution problem. Machine-level telemetry tells us how loaded a server is, but not which product, customer, or upstream service is responsible for that load.</p> <p><br>MAPS (Metrics and Analytics for Product Segmentation) is a newly formed team building the core instrumentation, collection, and data platform to solve this from the ground up. We are architecting a system to continuously measure CPU, network bandwidth, memory, and storage utilization across the entire global fleet without sampling—attributing resource consumption both to the underlying system service and to the specific product, account, and zone being served.</p> <p><br>The data MAPS produces serves two critical functions at Cloudflare:</p> <ol> <li>Real-Time Control Plane: MAPS is the primary telemetry input for Cloudflare’s next-generation global load balancer, shifting traffic management from open-loop heuristics to closed-loop routing driven by real-time, per-service resource capacity and consumption (within seconds).</li> <li>Fleet Economics & Capacity Planning: MAPS provides the long-term analytical dataset in ClickHouse used to map product demand forecasts to physical hardware requirements, calculate true cost-to-serve per product, and drive multi-year infrastructure investments.</li> </ol> <h2>What You’ll Do</h2> <p>You will work across the full lifecycle of a greenfield, high-throughput telemetry system running on every machine at the Cloudflare edge:</p> <ul> <li>Host-Level Instrumentation ("Outside View"): Build and maintain per-request resource usage and product attribution over local Unix domain sockets.</li> <li>Edge Aggregation & Streaming: Build the per-machine collector daemon that ingests millions of events per second, performs bounded in-memory time-window aggregation, serves low-latency gRPC streams to the global load balancer, and flushes batch rollups to ClickHouse.</li> <li>Reconciliation & Correctness: Solve complex attribution problems—such as reconciling kernel-level cgroup measurements against application-reported metrics, and attributing resource usage when one multi-tenant service executes work on behalf of another.</li> <li>Cross-Team Architecture: Partner directly with the engineering teams behind Cloudflare’s core proxies, runtimes, and storage engines to instrument their critical paths without degrading tail latency.</li> </ul> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <ul> <li>Strong systems programming experience in Rust, Go, or C, with a solid grasp of memory layout, concurrency, and performance-critical code paths.</li> <li>Experience designing and operating latency- and resource-sensitive server infrastructure or high-throughput data pipelines at scale.</li> <li>Strong rates.</li> <li>Background in profiling, benchmarking, and debugging performance bottlenecks in production Linux environments (perf, PMU counters, flamegraphs).</li> </ul><div title: Release Engineer, Salesforce
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An Overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Senior Release Engineer to help design, standardize, and operate reliable enterprise application delivery across the Enterprise Technology & AI team. This role will establish scalable CI/CD practices for business-critical platforms such as Salesforce, Zuora and other Business Systems while enabling engineering teams to ship changes safely, quickly, and with clear operational controls.</p> <p>The ideal candidate combines strong release engineering and automation skills with practical experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications. You will build and maintain GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines, develop reusable scripts and deployment tooling, improve release governance, and partner with application, security, compliance, and business teams across the release lifecycle. Daily use of approved AI-assisted engineering tools, including Claude, Duo Agent Platform or comparable enterprise-approved tools, is a mandatory expectation for DevOps, troubleshooting, documentation, testing, and automation activities.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines for enterprise applications, including validation, testing, packaging, deployment, promotion, rollback, and post-release verification.</li> <li>Develop reusable automation using scripting languages such as Python to reduce manual release activities and improve repeatability.</li> <li>Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude or similar tools every day to accelerate pipeline development, scripting, test creation, troubleshooting, documentation, release analysis, and operational automation.</li> <li>Define and implement CI/CD patterns for platforms such as <strong>Salesforce, Zuora, </strong>and other <strong>Business Systems.</strong></li> <li>Establish environment and promotion strategies across development, test, staging, and production, including configuration management and deployment sequencing.</li> <li>Implement quality gates, automated checks, approvals, audit trails, and policy controls appropriate for enterprise application releases.</li> <li>Partner with application owners and development teams to define branching, versioning, release cadence, and rollback standards.</li> <li>Improve release observability through deployment dashboards, pipeline metrics, change records, notifications, and operational reporting.</li> <li>Investigate failed deployments and release issues, lead root-cause analysis, and implement durable corrective actions.</li> <li>Contribute to release calendars, change planning, blackout-period coordination, and risk-based release decision-making.</li> <li>Build documentation, runbooks, reusable templates, and enablement materials so teams can adopt consistent delivery practices.</li> <li>Coach engineers and application teams on GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD tools, release automation, trunk/branching strategies, testing, and operational readiness.</li> <li>Collaborate with security, compliance, architecture, and enterprise application stakeholders to meet control requirements without creating unnecessary delivery friction.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science,Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>7+ years of experience in release engineering, DevOps or a related discipline.</li> <li>Experience in Release & deployments for enterprise SaaS applications such as <strong>Salesforce, Zuora or Business Systems.</strong></li> <li>Strong hands-on experience designing and operating GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines in production environments.</li> <li>Proficiency in at least one scripting language, such as Python, with the ability to write maintainable automation and integrations.</li> <li>Mandatory hands-on experience using AI-assisted development and automation tools such as Claude or comparable enterprise-approved tools as part of day-to-day DevOps and release engineering work.</li> <li>Experience with source control, branching and merging strategies, artifact management, automated testing, deployment orchestration, and rollback practices.</li> <li>Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication patterns, and integration troubleshooting.</li> <li>Experience managing releases across multiple environments with strong attention to configuration, dependencies, access controls, and auditability.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot pipeline failures, deployment issues, integration defects, and environment inconsistencies.</li> <li>Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, business, security, compliance, and operations teams.</li> <li>Enterprise application releases become more predictable, repeatable, and transparent.</li> <li>Manual deployment effort and avoidable release errors decrease through automation and standardization.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>ETA teams adopt reusable GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD patterns for Salesforce, Zuora, and other enterprise platforms.Release quality improves through automated validation, testing, policy checks, and post-deployment verification. Deployment, change, and compliance evidence is available through reliable pipeline records and operational reporting. Application teams can move faster while maintaining appropriate controls for business-critical systems. AI-assisted DevOps adoption measurably improves engineering throughput, troubleshooting speed, automation coverage, and documentation quality without reducing delivery controls.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. title: Senior Data Engineer, Cloudforce One

datasets for threat researchers, data scientists, analysts, and customers.</p> <p>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Design, build, and operate scalable batch data pipelines on Kubernetes-hosted Airflow and Spark clusters that extract, enrich, and publish marts, including data modeling, partitioning, and schema evolution.</li> <li>Strong Python for data engineering, including testing and maintainable, well-structured code.</li> <li>Strong SQL, S3.</li> <li>Experience with ClickHouse or a comparable columnar analytical database.</li> <li>Experience with CI/CD, version control, and containerized deployments.</li> <li>Clear communication and the ability to turn ambiguous requirements from researchers and analysts into well-defined data products.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with security, threat intelligence, fraud, or trust & safety / abuse data.</li> <li>Solid understanding of how the Internet works (DNS, HTTP, TLS, BGP).</li> <li>Experience supporting data science or ML workflows (feature stores, training datasets).</li> <li>Experience with Cloudflare’s developer platform (Workers, R2, R2 Data Catalog).</li> <li>Trino/Presto or other distributed query engines.</li> <li>Experience using You’ll use AI models to improve how DLP detects, classifies, and protects sensitive data at Cloudflare scale.</p> <p><strong>Technologies we use</strong></p> <ul> <li>Core edge services are written in Rust and deployed globally to 300+ data centers.</li> <li>Our REST API is also written in Rust, runs on Kubernetes, and uses Postgres as a data store.</li> <li>For service monitoring we use Prometheus and Grafana</li> <li>For service logging we use Elasticsearch and Kibana</li> <li>For product analytics we use Clickhouse and BigQuery</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Knowledge we’d love for you to have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Solid Rust coding experience (the entire product is written in Rust)</li> <li>Experience with a variety of AI models.</li> <li>Container orchestration (e.g. k8s) </li> <li>Distributed systems (performance, consistency, observability, resilience) </li> <li>Advanced data/document classification (e.g. statistical, ML)</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support (Detachering / ZZP)
description: Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren. Wie ben jij Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen. Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten. Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn. Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers. Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers. Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat. Wat ga je doen Wat breng je mee? Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen. • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst; Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen; • Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn; • Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee; • Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren; • Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn; • Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving; • Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is; • Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau. Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré. Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en prioritering van onze werkplek- en supportdienstverlening. Daarbij staat één vraag centraal: hoe zorgen we dat onze collega's prettig, veilig en efficiënt kunnen werken én snel en goed geholpen worden wanneer ondersteuning nodig is? We willen vooral sneller en voorspelbaarder worden in wat we leveren en tegelijkertijd de gebruikerstevredenheid verder verhogen. Jij vertaalt die ambitie naar concrete keuzes en verbeteringen. • ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de visie, roadmap en backlog voor Werkplek & Support; • prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen; • vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten; • richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening; • sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid, kwaliteit en gebruikerstevredenheid; • onderhouden van nauw contact met stakeholders, waaronder Regionale Univé's en decentrale beheerders, en hen meenemen in keuzes en veranderingen; • afstemmen met engineers, architecten, security, servicemanagement, leveranciers en andere IT-teams; • samen met het team operationeel aansturen van de externe servicedesk en andere relevante leveranciers en verbeteringen realiseren; • signalen en terugkerende vragen vanuit Support gebruiken om de werkplek structureel te verbeteren; • richting geven aan lifecyclemanagement, upgrades, migraties en vernieuwingen van de werkplek en randapparatuur; • kansen rond onder andere automatisering, selfservice en AI vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen; • organiseren en voorbereiden van Scrum-activiteiten binnen het team, waaronder sprintplanning, reviews en retrospectives. Je krijgt daarbij ruimte om zelfstandig richting te geven. Dat betekent ook dat we verwachten dat je bestaande keuzes kritisch bevraagt en de teammanager durft te challengen wanneer jij denkt dat het beter kan. Wat bieden wij Je krijgt een functie binnen IT Kern Services voor 36–40 uur per week met veel ruimte om zelf richting te geven. Werkplek & Support wordt dagelijks door duizenden collega's gebruikt. De keuzes die jij maakt zijn dus direct merkbaar in de organisatie. Ontwikkeling vinden we bij Univé belangrijk. Dat geldt voor de dienstverlening waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent, maar ook voor jezelf. Het team werkt hybride vanuit Zwolle en Assen. Er is één vaste teamdag per week, afwisselend in Zwolle en Assen. De overige dagen werk je veelal vanuit je standplaats of thuis. Wie wij zijn Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie. Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé. IT Kern levert het IT-fundament waarmee Univé haar doelen kan realiseren. Binnen IT Kern richt Services zich onder andere op werkplekdiensten, eerstelijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy. Binnen Werkplek & Support werk je samen met functioneel beheerders, IT-specialisten en een Business Informatie Analist. De servicedesk en het lokale beheer in Zwolle en Assen worden momenteel geleverd door een externe partner. Je komt terecht in een team met verschillende achtergronden en ervaringsniveaus, binnen een organisatie met veel verschillende belangen en afhankelijkheden. Dat maakt de omgeving soms complex, maar geeft je als Product Owner ook veel ruimte om verbinding te leggen en zichtbaar verschil te maken.
