title: Customer Support Coach
description: <div class="content-intro"><p data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">What Makes Cloudbeds Unique</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="1">At <a href="https://www.cloudbeds.com/">Cloudbeds</a>, we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.</p></div><p><strong>How You'll Make an Impact: </strong></p> <p>As a Customer Support Coach, you will be the voice of and advocate for our customers, providing exceptional support. By resolving questions and troubleshooting issues across multiple channels, you’ll ensure a seamless experience for our hotel partners. Your contributions will strengthen client relationships, promote software adoption, and shape the future of our platform by sharing valuable feedback. You'll also play a key role in creating training materials, updating support resources, and staying ahead of system updates, making a lasting impact on our customers and team.</p> <p><strong>Our Customer Support Team:</strong></p> <p>Join a dynamic, fully remote team of over 60 global Customer Support professionals united by our goal of delivering exceptional customer experiences across live chat, email, and phone. We pride ourselves on our supportive, diverse, and collaborative culture, where continuous learning, growth, and innovation drive everything we do. Be part of a team that values connection, celebrates success, and always strives to exceed expectations!</p> <p><strong>What You Bring to the Team:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assist and support our existing customers (hotel properties) daily in the use of our software</li> <li>Resolve customers' inquiries via phone, email, chat, or any other media that Cloudbeds uses to help customers</li> <li>Troubleshoot and make outbound calls for escalated issues</li> <li>Foster strong customer relationships with empathy to drive loyalty, retention, and increased software adoption.</li> <li>Gather customers' feedback and requirements for future releases of the software</li> <li>Use training materials and attend company-wide online training sessions to keep up-to-date with the latest system updates</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Sets You Up for Success: </strong></p> <ul> <li>1+ years of hands-on, front-of-house hospitality operations experience at a hotel or resort — Front Desk, Night Auditor, Guest Services, Revenue Manager, Assistant Manager, or similar role at a quality property. (Airline, event, or food & beverage-only experience does not meet this requirement.)</li> <li>Previous experience in customer service or similar is a plus</li> <li>Native or Fluent in English</li> <li>Native or Fluent in Spanish/Portuguese/French/German</li> <li>Excellent communication skills and a positive attitude</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving skills and emotional intelligence</li> <li>Great levels of learning agility</li> <li>A compatible graduation course or more than 2 years of proven experience in the area</li> <li>Skill with computers and systems</li> <li>Excellent internet/wifi connection</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Work Authorization:</strong> Please note that applicants must be currently authorized to work in the location where the position is located without requiring visa sponsorship. At this time, Cloudbeds is unable to provide sponsorship for work visas.</p> <p data-path-to-node="1"><strong data-path-to-node="1" data-index-in-node="0">What to Expect - Your Journey with Us</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="2">Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ team members across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, hoteliers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.</p> <p data-path-to-node="3">Learn more online at <a href="https://www.cloudbeds.com/">cloudbeds.com</a></p> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong data-path-to-node="4" data-index-in-node="0">Cloudbeds <a href="https://www.cloudbeds.com/press/?press_type=company-news&news_category=awards">Awards</a>:</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="5"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="5,0,0">Winner – Hotel Management Software | HotelTechAwards (2026)</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="5,1,0">Overall 10 Best Places to Work | HotelTechAwards (2026)</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="5,2,0">Overall Top 10 Hotelier's Choice | HotelTechAwards (2026)</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="5,3,0">Finalist – Property Management Systems (PMS) & Channel Managers | HotelTechAwards (2026)</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="5,4,0">Most Loved Workplace® Certified (2024)</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="5,5,0">Deloitte Technology Fast 500 (2024)</p> </li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="6"><strong data-path-to-node="6" data-index-in-node="0">Discover our Benefits:</strong></p> <ul data-path-to-node="7"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="7,0,0">Remote First, Remote Always</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="7,1,0">PTO in accordance with local labor requirements</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="7,2,0">Fully Paid Parental Leave</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="7,3,0">Home office stipend based on country of residency</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="7,4,0">Professional development courses in Cloudbeds University</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="7,5,0">Access to professional development, including manager training, upskilling, and knowledge transfer</p> </li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="8"><strong data-path-to-node="8" data-index-in-node="0">Everyone is Welcome - title: Product Owner
description: Bouw mee aan eerlijke, betrokken en goed presterende teams Wij geloven dat iedereen een eerlijke kans verdient om te groeien en beloond te worden voor wat hij of zij bijdraagt. Daarom bouwt Learned software die organisaties helpt met heldere rollen, eerlijke en objectieve beoordelingen, gerichte ontwikkeling en transparante beloning. Dat gebeurt in één doorlopend proces. Honderden bedrijven, van scale-ups tot corporates, werken al met Learned en dat worden er nog veel meer. Daarom zoeken we versterking in team Product. Jouw impact als Product Owner Als Product Owner speel je een sleutelrol in de verdere ontwikkeling van ons platform. Jij zorgt dat onze ambitieuze roadmap niet op papier blijft, maar écht landt. Je vertaalt strategie, klantbehoeften en ideeën naar productverbeteringen die het verschil maken voor onze klanten. Wat je doet Samen met de Product Lead bepaal je en bewaak je de roadmap. Je kiest ook wat níét gebeurt. Je houdt vier development squads op koers: planning, kwaliteit en voortgang. Je ontwerpt zelf prototypes op basis van prompts en ons design system, en stemt de details zorgvuldig af met UX. Businessbehoeften vertaal je naar scherpe requirements en heldere prioriteiten. Stakeholders houd je aangehaakt bij releases en voortgang. Risico’s en afhankelijkheden zie je aankomen voordat ze een probleem worden. Jij verbindt strategie, development, design en business, en zorgt dat iedereen dezelfde kant op beweegt: richting de groei van onze klanten. Wie ben jij? Je weet hoe je complexe productontwikkeling in een softwareomgeving tot een goed einde brengt. Je houdt overzicht als er veel tegelijk gebeurt, je let op details zonder het grote plaatje te verliezen, en je krijgt mensen Wat je meebrengt Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring als Product Owner bij voorkeur in B2B SaaS Je hebt een 'AI-first' mindset en gebruikt AI (zoals Claude) handig voor het ontwikkelen van prototypes en het opzetten van features. Je hebt meerdere squads tegelijk begeleid in een multidisciplinaire omgeving met development, design en business Je bent sterk in stakeholdermanagement en durft nee te zeggen als het product daar beter van wordt Je werkt vanzelfsprekend agile (Scrum of Kanban) en kent tools als Jira of Productboard Je beslist op basis van data en klantinzichten, niet op onderbuikgevoel Je woont in of rondom Utrecht en werkt minimaal 3 dagen per week op ons kantoor Wat kun je van ons verwachten? Een salaris tussen €4.500 en €5.500 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur en afhankelijk van ervaring) Een duidelijk groeipad naar Senior Product Owner Bij contractverlening de mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan een aandelenregeling Een MacBook en alles wat je nodig hebt om je werk goed te doen 25 vakantiedagen op fulltime basis Reiskostenvergoeding Pensioenopbouw via Brand New Day: 10%, waarvan wij 50% bijdragen Een jaarlijks persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget van €1.000 (o.b.v. fulltime) Een ambitieuze, internationale werkomgeving (meer dan 7 culturen!) waar we elkaar scherp houden én successen vieren Uiteindelijk komen we maar op één manier erachter of het klikt? Solliciteer snel en dan drinken we een (digitale) kop koffie! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Computational Biologist
description: About Proxima Proxima (formerly VantAI) is advancing an AI-native approach to drug discovery by making protein interactions programmable. Our platform brings together foundation-model machine learning, a scalable data generation engine, and a partnership track record exceeding $5B in collaborations across the world’s leading biopharma and tech organizations. We’ve recently closed an oversubscribed seed round partnering us with an elite group of sophisticated and dedicated VCs including DCVC, Nvidia’s Nventures, AIX, Yosemite among others. Neo-1 is our all-atom foundation model that combines state-of-the-art structure prediction and molecular generation in a single system. Neo-1 enables rapid exploration of chemical and structural space for high value, previously intractable targets, and in particular unlocks small molecule proximity therapeutics like molecular glues with AI for the first time. title: People Business Partner
description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. The opportunity: People Business Partner As a People Business Partner at myTomorrows, you are a trusted advisor to senior leaders and the Leadership Team. You will partner closely with leaders across the organization to strengthen leadership effectiveness, organizational design, performance, engagement, and talent development. title: Social & Follower - Product Manager
description: We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting), with 25+ nationalities and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our collective travel belts. What we have in common, beyond very well-worn passports, is this: We want to change the way people travel. That's exactly what we're doing, with the app that lets you plan, track, and relive every trip. Polarsteps has over 20 million users already. For us, this is just the beginning. Your expedition: Product & Growth This role is about the heartbeat of Polarsteps, the social layer that keeps travelers connected to the people who care about their journeys. You'll own the Social & Follower experience. Your users are followers & travelers; think about features that help travelers share what they're experiencing and help followers stay close from a distance. You are responsible for the engagement mechanics; think about how to make followers feel involved, not just informed, turning a passive audience into a real homefront community. While innovating on this engagement, you will also be owning one of the most important growth loops of our business: the social viral loop. Here you'll be working closely working together with other teams that use the share flow, while also closely collaborating with our Growth & Marketing team who are in contact with resources like our Polarsteps Pioneers . The social viral loop is one of Polarsteps' core growth engines, and it deserves both love (features that make sharing feel fun and effortless - like our route sharing feature ) and brains (the thinking to optimize the numbers behind it). This is a role for someone who gets excited about optimizing the % in a growth loop and, in parallel, wants to grow product strategy skills on an important part of the travel experience while delivering a great experience to users. Your itinerary What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day. You will: Own the Social & Follower experience end-to-end, from sharing functionality and growth loops to follower engagement features, likes, comments, and trip interaction. Drive growth for key metrics: MAU, sharing rates, and social engagement, setting the bar and holding yourself to it. Design and run experiments to validate ideas fast. You won't guess when you can test. Work hand-in-hand with Growth & Marketing to align product initiatives with acquisition and retention goals, no silos, just shared wins. Translate messy, complex problems into small, testable stories, making outcomes clear for everyone on the team. Celebrate the small wins as much as the big ones. Incremental progress is still progress. The equipment in your backpack What we're hoping you'll bring with you. ✅ 5+ years of PM experience, ideally with time spent in a Growth PM role ✅ Genuinely data fluent; you move from hypothesis to experiment to decision without losing momentum. You treat every dataset as a chance to get sharper, not just to confirm what you already know. ✅ A solid understanding of UX/UI and creating a great (app) experience to drive product growth ✅ Experience working on app-first consumer products (B2C is your world) ✅ Growth and marketing-minded, you understand funnels, loops, and what makes people come back ✅ Humble, collaborative, and energized by team wins, this role doesn't work in a silo ✅ Bonus: experience with social or community features, or products where sharing is core to the experience 1st class extras Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet. Salary range: Between EUR 70.000 - 80.000 (medior level) and EUR 85.000 - 95.000 (senior level) gross per year incl 8% holiday allowance (based on 40 hours/week). Where you land in the range depends on your experience and skills, to be evaluated during the interview process. Equity: You'll be able to participate in our Polarsteps SAR Plan A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here. A shiny MacBook to work your magic on. Hybrid working, our way. Work from home and the office, we ask everyone to be in the office 2 days a week. It’s how we stay flexible, focused, and meaningfully connected in person. An extensive home office set-up, everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk. 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you). Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar. The option to switch up your Zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year. A personal development budget for that curious mind of yours! A pension plan to help you save for those around-the-world retirement trips. Delicious daily team lunches. Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away. A lively office in downtown Amsterdam, with travel costs reimbursed. Free Polarsteps Travel Books to contain all your far-flung adventures. At Polarsteps, we believe the best products are built by people as diverse as the travelers using our apps! That's why we specifically encourage people underrepresented in the tech industry to apply for a role with us. Because we believe that diversity, be it age, race, sexual orientation, physical ability, ethnicity, or gender identity, makes both the world and the workplace better. Think this is the path for you? Find out more about how we hire. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Advise on best practices.</li> </ul> <h3 style="line-height: 2;">Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Previous experience as a Solutions Engineer or other customer-facing technical role, ideally selling to or working with developer-led, cloud-native, or startup organizations.</li> <li>A genuine "builder" mindset and the personality to match: you enjoy talking to developers, you're curious, and you naturally gravitate toward technical problem-solving conversations.</li> <li>The ability to speak engineers' language credibly — you can hold your own on architecture, APIs, and platform design — <strong>without</strong> this being a hands-on, code-every-day developer role.</li> <li>Strong technical discovery instincts: you know how to draw out requirements, qualify fit early, and separate real needs from noise.</li> <li>A good mix of pre-sales / technical sales experience and comfort operating in an agile, fast-moving environment (joining Slack channels, iterating quickly, engaging in early-stage calls, and qualifying deals from the start).</li> <li>Solid communication, written and presentation skills, with the range to talk to both a hands-on developer and a CTO in the same day.</li> <li>Ability to work on several projects and activities concurrently.</li> <li>Highly driven, curious, team-oriented, and able to work with a sense of urgency.</li> <li>You've built web applications before, or contributed to existing web applications in a meaningful way — enough to have real empathy for how developers work.</li> <li>Polished communication and executive presentation skills with the ability to drive a discussion with a broad range of stakeholders (from the web developer to the CTO/CISO).</li> <li>Relationship building: a proven track record of building deep technical relationships with engineers and technical founders. title: Hardware Systems Engineer, AI Hardware
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. worldwide fleet of GPU servers.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Contribute to the technical requirements and end-to-end delivery of AI infrastructure — compute, networking, designs seamlessly align with delivery schedules.</li> <li>Thrive as a deeply self-motivated engineer in ambiguous environments, demonstrating a strong bias for action and the ability to drive initiatives forward without close supervision.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with major AI server ODMs/OEMs and their qualification and customization processes</li> <li>Exposure to hyperscaler or cloud infrastructure design — understanding how GPU capacity is provisioned, allocated, and operated at scale</li> <li>Experience with RDMA title: hbo-stage Analyseren kwaliteit bouwvergunningen BAG
description: hbo- afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij die nieuwsgierige en enthousiaste student die graag in data duikt en op zoek gaat naar opvallende patronen en verbanden? Krijg jij energie van het ontrafelen van complexe vraagstukken, het ontdekken van inzichten en het vertalen van data naar betekenisvolle resultaten? Dit is jouw uitdaging Het CBS ontvangt maandelijks van de 342 gemeenten in Nederland informatie over verleende bouwvergunningen. Gemeenten leveren deze gegevens aan via enquêtes en registreren de bouwvergunningen daarnaast in de Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen (BAG). Sinds 2025 publiceert het CBS de cijfers over bouwvergunningen op basis van de BAG. Er is echter een groot en toenemend verschil tussen de cijfers uit de BAG en de tellingen uit de enquêtes. Er is reeds onderzoek gedaan naar deze toenemende verschillen. Als stagiair ga je dit verder onderzoeken, door middel van een diepgaande analyse van de tijdigheid en kwaliteit van de registratie van gegevens in de BAG. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces om beter inzicht te krijgen in hoe de BAG zich verhoudt tot de werkelijkheid. Je onderzoekt onder andere: Hoe lang wachten gemeenten met registraties? Worden registraties doorlopend geregistreerd, of opgespaard en in korte tijd geregistreerd in de BAG? Verandert de kwaliteit en tijdigheid door de tijd heen? Om deze vragen te beantwoorden duik je in een grote database, waar je met behulp van SQL en R of Python trends gaat waarnemen, data visualiseert, en samenvattingen maakt. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces, en hoe dit is geïmplementeerd bij gemeenten. Voor deze taak is al eerder onderzoek gedaan, en is er ook al meer informatie beschikbaar. Je verzamelt deze resultaten in een rapport met een overzicht van de huidige stand van zaken. Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag Ons team bestaat uit 24 enthousiaste collega’s, die met veel passie en plezier werken aan statistische informatie over vastgoed en de woningmarkt. We maken statistieken over (bouw)vergunningen, ontwikkeling van de woningvoorraad, (gemiddelde) WOZ-waardes, eigendomsverhoudingen, tijdelijke woningen, woningtransformaties en nog heel veel meer. We doen statistisch onderzoek op verzoek van organisaties in de publieke sector. En we beheren en verwerken data voor CBS-collega’s en werken samen met diverse organisaties, waaronder het Kadaster, de ministeries van BZK, VRO en EZK en Eurostat. We publiceren regelmatig over de dynamiek van de Nederlandse vastgoed- en woningmarkt. Onze nieuwsberichten halen regelmatig journaals, nieuwssites en voorpagina’s van landelijke dagbladen. En daar zijn we trots op! Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een hbo opleiding in de studierichting toegepaste wiskunde, data science of sociale wetenschappen. Je hebt affiniteit met de woningmarkt. Je hebt kennis en wellicht ervaring met R/rmarkdown en/of Python en SQL databases. Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en enthousiast om met data aan de slag te gaan. Je vindt het leuk om nieuwe dingen te ontdekken, neemt graag initiatief en denkt actief mee. Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt ook graag de samenwerking op. Je deelt gemakkelijk je ideeën en bevindingen en staat open voor nieuwe inzichten en feedback. Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk. Dit kun je van ons verwachten Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je: samenwerkt met ervaren experts binnen hun vakgebied; gaat werken met grote databases (SQL); kennis opbouwt van de BAG en het registratieproces bij bronhouders; analyses samenvat in data visualisaties en overzichtelijke tabellen. Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week). Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken. Dit zijn onze voorwaarden Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken. Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking. title: Senior Customer Success Manager (with Ed-Tech experience)
description: Are you passionate about transforming how large organizations learn and develop? Imagine being the trusted advisor to some of the world's most prestigious brands, guiding them through learning journeys that change how their HR teams perform. At AIHR, we are looking for a full-time Senior Customer Success Manager / Learning Consultant (with Ed-tech experience) who will turn every learning initiative into a clear story of performance improvement and organization-wide impact. Join us and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of the HR industry! About AIHR Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world's market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, including companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. Our goal is to upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR professionals. We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. We strive to provide the world's best courses and excellent support to our customers, while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players. As a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility, with countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and to craft your own role. Role and Responsibilities As a Senior Customer Success Manager (with Ed-tech experience) , you enable AIHR's largest B2B clients to run successful learning initiatives and build a culture of learning. At AIHR, we call this role Learning Consultant rather than Customer Success Manager, because your focus goes beyond account management. You act as a strategic advisor, guiding customers in designing and implementing learning journeys that drive measurable impact. You own a dedicated portfolio of our largest and most complex enterprise customers, from onboarding to adoption, all the way to renewal. What does that look like in practice? Strategic partnership: You build strong, multi-level relationships with senior stakeholders (CHROs, VPs and Heads of HR, Heads of L&D) and make sure AIHR stays aligned with their business objectives. Joint Impact Plans: You diagnose customer needs and co-create a Joint Impact Plan that connects our learning solutions to their business goals, with clear metrics to show return on investment (ROI). Enterprise onboarding and adoption: You onboard large customers and design the change management and communication strategy that embeds the AIHR platform in their learning culture. Portfolio health: You take full ownership of your portfolio's health. You use the Customer Health Score in HubSpot to spot risks early and act before they turn into churn. Commercial partnership: You co-own commercial goals with our Growth Account Executives. Your deep customer knowledge shapes the renewal and expansion strategy for your accounts. Team excellence: You mentor other Learning Consultants and help develop the team's best practices and playbooks. You are successful when your clients' learners show improved work performance, not just when they complete a program, and when AIHR's impact makes them want to grow the partnership. Ultimately, your client's success is your success. Your goal is to develop their learners into T-shaped HR professionals . On a typical day You arrive at our beautiful office in Rotterdam or Amsterdam, grab a coffee, and after a quick chat with colleagues, you fire up your MacBook to check your calendar. You start by reviewing your portfolio in HubSpot, our single source of truth, paying close attention to the Customer Health Score to prioritize your actions for the day. Your morning starts with a Quarterly Strategic Check-in with the VP of HR at one of your key accounts. You present a clear story of their progress and ROI, using learning and engagement data you analyzed with the help of an AI skill. Afterward, you have a 1-1 with your manager, Emilie , to build a multithreading strategy for an account where you only have one champion. Later, you spend time with Dieter, one of our superstar SMEs, to plan a thought leadership session for your customer's HR leadership team. After a delicious lunch in the office with the team, you dedicate time to a new enterprise client, Ahold Delhaize, documenting their business objectives to build their Joint Impact Plan and rollout communication strategy. You then join Jessica, our Growth Account Executive, to align on the commercial strategy for an upcoming multi-year renewal, so you show up as one team. Next, you sit down with a newer Learning Consultant to prepare a difficult conversation with one of their customers. Before the day ends, you contribute to an internal project, sharing customer feedback about new features and improvements with the product team, including insights you summarized by feeding call transcripts into Gemini. To wrap up the week, you join the team for a drink during our weekly activity, celebrating joint successes and getting to know new colleagues. Who you are Helping large clients roll out complex learning initiatives is nothing new for you. You've done it many times, and you know your value goes further. You are the strategic advisor senior HR leaders call first, because you know that when they experience impact with AIHR, they see real skill development, better performance, and a lasting change in their learning culture. Furthermore, you have: 7+ years of experience in a client-facing role, such as a (Learning) Consultant, L&D Professional, or Customer Success Manager, specifically within the Ed-Tech or E-learning industry; A proven track record of managing a portfolio of large, complex enterprise accounts and prioritizing to maximize impact; Demonstrable experience building and maintaining relationships with multiple senior stakeholders at the same account (multithreading), up to C-level; Strong English proficiency, with the ability to discuss proposals, write clear copy, and push back on or challenge senior customers constructively; A natural ability to ask insightful follow-up questions to diagnose core challenges and co-create solutions with clients; Expertise in adult learning principles, change management, and designing effective L&D strategies for large organizations; The ability to think commercially, identify growth opportunities, and connect HR initiatives to overall business performance and ROI; Strong skills in using data from tools like HubSpot and Excel to derive insights and present a clear story of progress and value to executives; Hands-on experience using generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) for tasks like analysis, content creation, and workflow automation. This is essential; A genuine desire to help develop colleagues and raise the capabilities of the whole team. To set you up for success in this role, we are specifically looking for candidates with external-facing customer experience (not in-house L&D roles) and a background in education, e-learning, or ed-tech. We believe many skills can be learned on the job, but these experiences are essential. They provide the foundation you need to drive impact in our environment. We offer A key role in shaping the education of tens of thousands of HR professionals from all over the world through our courses; Competitive, benchmarked compensation; The opportunity to shape your own day-to-day work; Regular growth talks and support to reach your career goals; Flexible working hours and working-from-home arrangements after your onboarding; A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team; A key role in a fast-growing scale-up company; A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Millenniumtoren) and a brand new office in Amsterdam; 26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for every year you work here + you can exchange any 2 public holidays for 2 other days of your choice; Pension plan; 5 mental health days per year; Access to the OpenUp mental health platform; Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read; All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card); MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work; Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities; Free access to the office gym. Get a taste of the AIHR experience and check out our AIHR Benefits Guide ! Apply for the job Do you want to join our team as our new Senior Customer Success Manager / Learning Consultant (with Ed-tech experience) ? Then we'd love to hear from you! You don't meet every single point above, but think you have what it takes? Please still apply! We are hiring for this role as soon as we find the right candidate. P.S. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women tend to apply only when they meet 100% of them. We'd love to consider you and see if you could be a great fit. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Regional Sales Director, Startups – AI & Digital Natives (East)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: NYC, Boston, Atlanta, Miami OR Carolinas</strong></p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare's North America Startups segment is growing its U.S. East go-to-market team. The goal is to win the fastest-growing AI-native and digital native companies early and grow with them as they scale. A new generation of companies is building AI models, agents, AI apps and developer tools, and many of them can go from seed funding to global scale in under two years. Cloudflare wants to be the platform they build, run and secure on from their first line of code through their IPO.</p> <p>As the Senior Regional Sales Director, Startups – East, you will lead the managers and Account Executives (AEs) covering venture-backed AI and digital native companies across the eastern U.S., including New York, Boston, the DC area, Atlanta and Miami. You'll own revenue, hiring and Cloudflare's reputation in the East Coast startup and venture community, while keeping the Cloudflare culture. This role suits builders who like speed, technical buyers and the challenge of turning fast usage growth into lasting, multi-million-dollar customer relationships.</p> <p>You'll set strategy for the region and lead a team that sells to founders, CTOs and heads of engineering and infrastructure. Your team will:</p> <ul> <li>Move fast deals forward without losing sight of the long-term account</li> <li>Turn companies already on Cloudflare's free and pay-as-you-go plans into committed contracts</li> <li>Work with Product, Developer Speedboat, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success and the Cloudflare for Startups program to make Cloudflare the default choice for AI-native builders</li> </ul> <p>Success means startups that love Cloudflare and recommend it, have grown alongside us from early stage to scale, and run their most important workloads on our Developer Platform, AI products, application security and network.</p> <h2>What You'll Do</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Drive revenue growth</strong> across new customers, expansion and conversion of pay-as-you-go accounts to contracts. Build a sales motion where usage growth opens the door to the next use case.</li> <li><strong>Lead a team of Regional Sales Directors</strong> and their Startup Account Executives. Also lead indirectly, the Solutions Engineers, Business Development Reps, Customer Success and Field Marketing teams who support startup accounts.</li> <li><strong>Build the East Coast startup sales team.</strong> Work with your Ecosystem and Recruiting to hire people who are technical, sharp about the business and comfortable talking with founders and engineers.</li> <li><strong>Spot breakout companies early.</strong> Use funding rounds, usage data, hiring and developer adoption signals to find likely winners, then win them before they lock into AWS, GCP, Azure, Vercel or other platforms.</li> <li><strong>Make venture investors a growth channel.</strong> Build relationships with VC firms, accelerators and startup programs across the East Coast, working with the Cloudflare for Startups and Workers Launchpad teams to bring in companies at the earliest stages.</li> <li><strong>Help shape the product roadmap.</strong> Bring what AI-native customers need back to Product and Engineering, and run design-partner relationships with leading startups that influence what Cloudflare builds next.</li> <li><strong>Adapt our sales process for startups.</strong> Use and influence Cloudflare's sales methodology for faster deals with technical buyers. Bring discipline to forecasting usage-based revenue, contracts sized for growth and expansion planning.</li> <li><strong>Balance short-term and long-term revenue.</strong> Close fast deals while also building multi-year relationships with companies expected to become tomorrow's large enterprise customers. Work with Enterprise leaders on clean handoffs when accounts move to that segment.</li> <li><strong>Represent Cloudflare in the East Coast startup scene</strong> at founder events, AI meetups, investor portfolio sessions and developer communities.</li> </ul> <h2>What You'll Bring</h2> <ul> <li>12+ years of sales experience, including 3+ years managing managers (second-line leadership), with a track record of beating targets in a high-growth segment</li> <li>Experience selling cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, application security or data and AI infrastructure to startups, digital natives or high-growth tech companies</li> <li>Proven success in usage-based businesses, including converting product-led or pay-as-you-go customers to committed contracts and expanding from there</li> <li>Credibility with technical buyers: comfortable at the whiteboard with CTOs and founders talking about how their AI systems are built, latency, how they scale and what it costs per request or token</li> <li>Strong ties to the East Coast venture and startup community</li> <li>A history of hiring and developing great AE managers and AEs, and building a team people want to join</li> <li>Disciplined forecasting and pipeline management in fast-moving, high-volume deal environments</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity and the drive to build processes, programs and playbooks where none exist</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,1,0">For New York City and Boston based hires: Estimated annual salary of $418,000 - $575,000 OTE</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Turn market signals into GTM strategy for Marketing. Notion is a collaborative AI workspace for teams and companies, operating in a market where AI is changing how teams evaluate software and get work done. This role will help Marketing understand how customers, competitors, and the broader market are responding, including shifts in brand perception, then turn that understanding into sharper messaging, growth strategy, and audience strategy. You’ll own the market research relationship with GTM partners across global markets and regional teams, and expand Notion’s thought-leadership research capability through original work on topics like AI transformation and ROI. This role is based in New York City or San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. title: Senior Solutions Engineer (German/Dutch speaker)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Strength in Trust </h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. description: The Practical Detail Location : Amsterdam Hybrid model Why this role matters We are looking for a commercially minded Head of Consumer & Market Insights Europe to ensure that consumers are at the heart of the decisions shaping the future growth of our great brands. Your work will help the business anticipate shifts in taste, nutrition, and consumer needs, ensuring Flora Food Group stays one step ahead. Partner with senior marketing and cross-functional leaders to shape strategy and commercial decisions with clear, evidence-based consumer perspectives. Build and manage a focused learning agenda aligned with Flora's six strategic growth priorities, supporting innovation and market acceleration. Integrate qualitative and quantitative data, market intelligence, and emerging technologies to create a holistic view of consumer behaviour. Lead a lean, high-impact insights team, optimizing resources and fostering curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning. title: Test Engineer
description: Wij zijn op zoek naar een test engineer met een brede technische interesse die techniek graag combineert met organiseren en samenwerken. Hoe mooi is het om als eerste een installatie aan te zetten en te testen of alles werkt zoals bedoeld en voldoet aan de verwachtingen van de opdrachtgever? Je werkt met uiteenlopende systemen, zoals camerasystemen, branddetectie, luchtbehandeling, voedingsverdeelkasten, verlichting, netwerken en waterinstallaties. Kortom: een compleet technisch gebouw, waarbij jij helpt om alles goed en aantoonbaar werkend op te leveren. Dit wordt jouw baan Je brengt samen met de testmanager in kaart wat er getest moet worden, stelt testplanningen en -protocollen op en bewaakt de voortgang. Je bereidt onder andere FAT-, PAT- en iFAT-testen voor, zorgt dat de juiste mensen, systemen en componenten beschikbaar zijn en begeleidt de daadwerkelijke testuitvoering. Bevindingen leg je zorgvuldig vast en je bewaakt dat deze worden opgevolgd. Je hoeft daarbij niet vanaf dag één specialist te zijn in alle systemen. Je werkt samen met ervaren testmanagers, testcoördinatoren, engineers en technische specialisten en krijgt de ruimte om je inhoudelijk verder te ontwikkelen. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Hier zit je op je plek Je wordt onderdeel van de vakgroep Technische Installaties binnen het cluster Ontwerp van Dura Vermeer Infra Landelijke Projecten. Samen met circa 140 collega's werk je aan de grootste multidisciplinaire infrastructurele projecten van Nederland, zoals tunnels, bruggen, sluizen, energieprojecten, waterzuiveringen en hoogspanningsinstallaties. Binnen het project werk je nauw samen met collega's uit ontwerp, uitvoering en projectbeheersing. Je krijgt veel ruimte om richting te geven aan het testproces en kunt daarbij terugvallen op ervaren collega's en technische specialisten. Afhankelijk van het project werk je op locatie, vanuit een Dura Vermeer-kantoor of vanuit huis. Als eerste opdracht voorzien we een rol op het project Landstations, waarbij we de locatie realiseren waar de wind energie vanuit windparken op zee wordt omgezet naar het landzijdige nationale elektriciteitsnet. Je werk daarmee direct mee aan de verduurzaming van onze elektriciteitsvoorziening. Dit breng jij mee Een hbo / wo opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in elektrotechniek, werktuigbouwkunde, industriële automatisering of een vergelijkbare richting; Een brede interesse in technische installaties en de motivatie om verschillende systemen te leren doorgronden; Je kunt technische tekeningen en documentatie lezen of bent gemotiveerd om dit verder te leren; Je werkt gestructureerd en kunt technische informatie vertalen naar een praktische aanpak; Je communiceert makkelijk met verschillende partijen en vindt het leuk om techniek en coördinatie te combineren; Ervaring met testen, commissioning, FAT/SAT of technische projectcoördinatie is een pré. Dit bieden wij jou Het salaris voor deze functie ligt tussen € 4.291,63,- en € 5.364,54,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Het exacte salaris is afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring. Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra). 43 verlofdagen volgens de Cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen; Een laptop en een smartphone; Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap; Je hebt de keuze tussen een mobiliteitsbudget, NS Business Card of een elektrische leaseauto ; Bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd kun je een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets uitzoeken dankzij onze samenwerking met lease-a-bike; Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar bijvoorbeeld ook op het gebied van vitaliteit; Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland; Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij een flexibelwerkenbeleid en soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of sabbatical; Voor verse vaders en partners: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens de vijf weken van het aanvullend geboorteverlof, in plaats van de standaard 70%. title: HR Business Partner / Senior HR Advisor
description: HR Business Partner Contract: Full-time, Permanent Location: Breda, North Brabant | Hybrid working, combining office and home Salary: Up to €6.000 per month, depending on experience, plus company benefits The opportunity Kinly is a leading global provider of audio-visual and unified communications solutions, helping organisations create secure, flexible and engaging workplace and meeting experiences. We are looking for an HR Business Partner to join our collaborative local and global HR team in Breda. This is a broad, hands-on HR role that could suit either an existing HR Business Partner looking for their next opportunity, or an experienced HR Advisor ready to take the next step into a Business Partner role . Primarily supporting our Netherlands business, you will partner with managers and employees across a wide range of people matters, from employee relations and performance to organisational change, engagement and talent. You will also support smaller employee populations across Central Europe, giving you the opportunity to broaden your international HR experience and develop your knowledge of HR practices across different countries . You will also manage and develop the HR Advisor based in Breda. What you'll be doing Partnering with managers: Providing practical HR advice, coaching and constructive challenge on people and organisational matters. Employee relations: Managing employee relations cases including performance, grievances, disciplinary matters and employment terminations. Performance and talent: Supporting performance management, talent and development activity and coaching managers through key people processes. Works Council: Building an effective relationship with the Dutch Works Council (OR) and supporting consultation and information processes. Sickness absence: Managing long-term sickness absence cases in line with the Dutch Gatekeeper Improvement Act (Wet verbetering poortwachter). Engagement and workforce insights: Using HR data and employee feedback to identify trends and support actions around engagement, retention, absence and turnover. HR projects and change: Supporting regional and global HR initiatives, organisational change and continuous improvement. Recruitment and onboarding: Partnering with Talent Acquisition and managers to support recruitment, onboarding and the employee experience. International HR: Providing practical HR support to smaller teams across Central Europe, working with regional HR colleagues and local specialists where required. HR operations: Supporting payroll checks, HR reporting, compliance and the consistent application of HR policies and processes. People management: Coaching and developing our HR Advisor in Breda. What we're looking for We are interested in hearing from established HR Business Partners as well as experienced HR Advisors who are ready to progress into a broader Business Partner role . Ideally, you will bring: Strong, practical HR experience gained in the Netherlands, operating at Dutch HBO level or equivalent. Good working knowledge of Dutch employment law and sickness absence management. Experience handling employee relations matters and advising managers with confidence. Practical experience working with a Dutch Works Council. Experience of performance management, organisational change and stakeholder management. Strong communication, coaching and influencing skills. An analytical approach, with the ability to turn HR data and emerging issues into practical actions. Fluency in both Dutch and English , written and spoken. An interest in developing your international HR experience and supporting colleagues across Central Europe. Experience supporting employees in other European countries, particularly Germany and/or Switzerland, would be an advantage, but is not essential . Experience with SAP SuccessFactors would also be useful, but isn't required. Why this role? This is an opportunity to take ownership of a varied HR remit while being part of a wider international HR team. You'll have the chance to build on your HR Business Partnering skills, manage and develop an HR colleague and broaden your experience beyond the Netherlands through exposure to HR matters across Central Europe . Whether you're already working as an HR Business Partner or are an experienced HR Advisor looking for the opportunity to make that next career move, we'd be pleased to hear from you. Inclusion and accessibility Kinly is committed to providing equal opportunities in employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, gender identity, pregnancy, colour, race, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, religion or any other protected characteristic. title: Afstudeerstage AI Adoption
description: Wil jij helpen om AI van technologie naar dagelijks werk te brengen? Bij HG geloven we dat technologie mensen sterker maakt. Daarom hebben we de afgelopen periode een stevig fundament gelegd voor AI binnen onze organisatie. Microsoft Copilot is geïntroduceerd, er zijn verschillende AI-initiatieven gestart en steeds meer collega’s ontdekken wat AI voor hun werk kan betekenen. De volgende stap is opschalen. Want AI beschikbaar maken is één ding. Zorgen dat mensen het daadwerkelijk goed gebruiken, er nieuwe vaardigheden mee ontwikkelen en hun manier van werken aanpassen, is waar de echte transformatie plaatsvindt. Als afstudeerstagiair AI Adoption help je ons om die volgende stap te zetten. Je komt terecht in een internationale organisatie waar samenwerking, initiatief en nieuwsgierigheid centraal staan. Je begint dus niet vanaf nul. Je bouwt verder op wat er al staat en helpt ons te ontdekken welke aanpak nodig is om AI-adoptie verder te versnellen. Je combineert onderzoek met praktijk. Je analyseert hoe AI wordt gebruikt, vertaalt data naar concrete acties, ontwikkelt en geeft trainingen voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus en helpt collega’s om AI steeds beter toe te passen in hun dagelijkse werk. De exacte onderzoeksopdracht bepalen we samen, zodat deze aansluit bij jouw opleiding, interesses en afstudeereisen. HG is een compacte, snelgroeiende en internationale organisatie waar je direct de impact van je werk ziet. Dit vraagt om eigenaarschap, initiatief en een pragmatische, resultaatgerichte houding. De cultuur is open en stimuleert het delen van ideeën, constructieve samenwerking en verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Alles wat we doen is gebaseerd op onze kernwaarden: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected. Wat ga je doen? Binnen HG zijn de eerste stappen in AI-adoptie al gezet. Er is dus een fundament om op voort te bouwen. Tijdens jouw stage help je ons om naar brede, structurele adoptie te gaan. Concreet ga je onder andere: Praktische en inspirerende Copilot-demo’s geven aan verschillende groepen medewerkers. Bestaande adoptiedata analyseren en vertalen naar inzichten en concrete acties om gebruik en impact te vergroten. Onderzoeken waar adoptie achterblijft en welke interventies kunnen helpen om medewerkers verder te brengen. AI-trainingsprogramma’s ontwerpen en uitvoeren voor verschillende AI-maturiteitsniveaus, van collega’s die net beginnen tot ervaren gebruikers. Trainingen, workshops, oefeningen en praktische hulpmiddelen ontwikkelen waarmee medewerkers AI direct in hun eigen werk kunnen toepassen. De Copilot Academy op ons intranet verder ontwikkelen en actueel en relevant houden. Medewerkers meenemen in de bredere AI-transformatie en concreet maken wat AI voor hun eigen werkzaamheden betekent. Het AI Champions-programma ondersteunen en verder helpen ontwikkelen. Feedback en behoeften van medewerkers ophalen en vertalen naar verbeteringen in trainingen, communicatie en andere adoptie-initiatieven. Onderzoeken welke activiteiten daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan meer gebruik, betere AI-vaardigheden en waarde voor de organisatie. Jouw onderzoek en werkzaamheden helpen HG om AI niet alleen beschikbaar te maken, maar daadwerkelijk onderdeel te maken van de dagelijkse manier van werken. Je werkt rechtstreeks samen met onze AI Transformation Lead en hebt veel contact met collega’s uit verschillende afdelingen binnen de organisatie. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van zowel de menselijke als bedrijfskundige kant van AI-transformatie. Omdat HG actief is in meer dan 45 landen, werk je bovendien in een internationale omgeving waarin verschillende functies, perspectieven en niveaus van AI-volwassenheid samenkomen. “We beginnen bij HG niet meer vanaf nul met AI. Er ligt een fundament en steeds meer collega’s werken ermee. De interessante vraag is nu: hoe zorgen we dat AI voor veel meer mensen écht onderdeel wordt van hun dagelijkse werk? Ik zoek iemand die het leuk vindt om daar samen met mij de volgende stap in te zetten.” – Els Marchal, AI Transformation Lead Wie ben je? Je volgt een relevante hbo-opleiding, zoals Technische Bedrijfskunde, Business IT & Management, ICT, Business Informatics, Data & Business, Human Resource Management, Learning & Development, Communicatie of vergelijkbaar. Je hebt interesse in AI én de manier waarop mensen nieuwe technologie adopteren . Je vindt het leuk om voor groepen te staan en anderen iets nieuws te leren. Je kunt complexe onderwerpen op een eenvoudige en praktische manier uitleggen. Je werkt zelfstandig en gestructureerd. Je bent nieuwsgierig en stelt kritische vragen. Je vindt het interessant om data te analyseren en inzichten te vertalen naar concrete acties . Je kunt goed schakelen tussen verschillende doelgroepen en niveaus van AI-ervaring. Je vindt het leuk om trainingen, materialen en nieuwe manieren van leren te ontwikkelen. Je durft initiatief te nemen en ideeën in de praktijk uit te proberen. Ervaring met tools zoals Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT en Power BI is een pre. Belangrijker is dat je nieuwsgierig bent naar AI en enthousiast wordt van de vraag: hoe zorgen we ervoor dat mensen AI daadwerkelijk goed gaan gebruiken? Wat bieden wij jou? Een afstudeeropdracht met directe impact op de organisatie. Intensieve begeleiding door de AI Transformation Lead. Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ondernemerschap. De kans om ervaring op te doen met AI-adoptie en organisatieverandering . Praktijkervaring met het ontwikkelen en geven van AI-trainingen, demo’s en workshops. De mogelijkheid om met echte adoptiedata te werken en te onderzoeken welke interventies daadwerkelijk effect hebben. Een actieve rol binnen het AI Champions-programma. Werken aan actuele AI-vraagstukken binnen een internationale organisatie. Een hybride werkomgeving vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Almere. Een informele en betrokken werksfeer waarin samenwerking centraal staat. Stagevergoeding van €450,- bruto per maand (obv 32 uur). Aan het einde van je stage heb je niet alleen een sterke afstudeerscriptie, maar ook praktische ervaring opgedaan met AI-adoptie, training en organisatieverandering binnen een internationale organisatie . Je hebt zelf trainingen en demo’s gegeven, met echte adoptiedata gewerkt en gezien wat ervoor nodig is om medewerkers daadwerkelijk mee te krijgen in een AI-transformatie. Wij zijn HG! Bij HG, een toonaangevend Europees merk in specialistische reinigings- en onderhoudsproducten, geloven we dat een huis een plek moet zijn waar je zorgeloos kunt leven. Met aandacht voor de plek waar je woont en voor de spullen die je omringen. Daarom ontwikkelen wij onze producten zo dat ze veilig doen wat ze beloven. De missie van HG is om jou te helpen optimaal van je huis te genieten, zonder je zorgen te maken over wat er mis kan gaan. Dit realiseren wij met onze zeer effectieve, veilige en specialistische reinigingsoplossingen, gecombineerd met deskundig advies. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Almere zetten wij ons dagelijks in voor superioriteit, innovatie, kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid. Met een sterke aanwezigheid in Europa en daarbuiten blijven wij continu investeren om een nog grotere impact te maken. HG doet wat het belooft. Nog vragen? Onze collega Ilse de Groot (Corporate Recruiter) neemt alle tijd om antwoord te geven. title: Senior Technical Account Manager (Austin, Seattle, Denver)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, Denver, Seattle, </p> <h4><strong>About the Department</strong></h4> <p>The Technical Account Team plays a crucial role in ensuring a seamless experience for Cloudflare users, ranging from individual developers to Fortune 500 enterprises. By providing expert technical support and resolving complex issues across multiple channels, the team enhances customer satisfaction and drives product improvement.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, Technical Account Managers (TAMs) serve as trusted advisors, delivering high-touch technical guidance and advocacy for our top Enterprise customers. Acting as the eyes and ears of the company, TAMs capture valuable customer insights to influence service enhancements and future product development.</p> <h4><strong>About the Role</strong></h4> <p>As a Technical Account Manager, you will own the post-sales support experience for Cloudflare’s largest Enterprise customers, ensuring smooth operations and proactive technical guidance. As the primary technical point of contact, you will manage support interactions, troubleshoot issues, drive escalations, and advocate for customer needs. </p> <p>You will act as an architectural governance partner, continuously mapping customer environments against industry best practices and Cloudflare's Well-Architected framework. By proactively identifying security gaps, single points of failure, and performance bottlenecks, you will prevent incidents before they impact production. </p> <p>Working closely with Account Teams, Product, Engineering, and partnering with Customer Support, you will align technical solutions with customer roadmaps and business objectives. This role requires a mix of technical expertise, customer service excellence, and strategic problem-solving to ensure high customer satisfaction and retention.</p> <p>For TAMs specializing in Network Services, you will focus on optimizing customer Cloudflare configurations, ensuring the reliability and security of their network infrastructure.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary technical support contact for assigned Enterprise customers.</li> <li>Build and maintain strong cross-functional relationships with Product, Engineering, Account Executives, Professional Services, and Partners to support every phase of the customer journey.</li> <li>Leverage AI-driven tools and workflows to optimize daily operations, including incident summarization, case prioritization, and automated handover documentation, to increase team productivity and focus on strategic customer advocacy.</li> <li>Collaborate with internal teams to ensure high customer satisfaction, delivering world-class technical support and advocacy.</li> <li>Provide actionable customer feedback to Product and Engineering teams to help shape product improvements.</li> <li>Maintain a comprehensive understanding of customer environments and Cloudflare deployments, ensuring proactive issue resolution and long-term optimizations.</li> <li>Develop and maintain a rolling Technical Risk & Gap Register for each enterprise account, tracking architectural drift, legacy configurations, and emerging security threats, while prioritizing remediation paths with customer stakeholders. </li> <li>Conduct Quarterly Support Reviews, including SLA adherence, incident reviews, and deep-dive analysis of top ticket drivers, as well reviewing future-state resilience, capacity planning, and proactive feature adoption. </li> <li>Act as a point of escalation during business hours and provide backup support for global TAMs in other time zones.</li> <li>Partner with the account team to drive strategic customer engagements, including technical planning, roadmap alignment, and incident response.</li> <li>Partner with Cloudflare’s Threat Intelligence and Product teams to proactively evaluate customer environments against newly discovered vulnerabilities (Zero-Days, emerging DDoS vectors), ensuring defensive configurations are deployed ahead of potential exploits. </li> <li>Ensure timely resolution of support tickets, working with backend teams as needed.</li> <li>Establish continuous drift-detection workflows to ensure customer configurations don't deviate from established security baselines, compliance standards, or optimal performance thresholds. </li> <li>Travel up to 25% of the time to support customer engagements.</li> <li>Ability to work one weekend per month.</li> <li>Utilize AI-powered analytics to conduct proactive configuration health checks and architectural reviews, identifying systemic risks and providing strategic infrastructure optimization recommendations.</li> <li>Streamline the creation of technical documentation—including HLDs, LLDs, and post-incident reports—by leveraging AI workflows to ingest and summarize technical data, ensuring consistent, high-quality deliverables.</li> <li>Deploy AI-assisted incident management tools to enhance communication precision, including real-time impact assessment, automated status updates, and rapid synthesis of complex technical event details.</li> </ul> <h4>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h4> <p>We are seeking a highly motivated customer-focused technical expert with the following skills and experience:</p> <h4><strong>Technical Expertise</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of networking concepts, including Layer 7 technologies and routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, IPSec, and GRE.</li> <li>Experience with security technologies (Firewalls, IPS, DDoS mitigation, WAF).</li> <li>Knowledge of system integration, multi-vendor environments, and data center deployments.</li> <li>Proficiency in diagnostic and troubleshooting tools (traceroute, WireShark, dig, cURL).</li> <li>Familiarity with the OSI Model, proxies, application & network security.</li> <li>Passion for Cloudflare’s products and a strong desire to help customers succeed.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Customer & Business Acumen</strong></p> <ul> <li>Minimum 8 years of experience in a customer-facing, technical support, or account management role.</li> <li>Proven ability to work with Fortune 500 companies and senior leadership.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills, ability to work independently, and handle multiple priorities.</li> </ul> <p>This role is an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of Cloudflare’s Enterprise customer experience, helping businesses optimize their network performance and security while shaping the future of our products.</p> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Denver based hires: Estimated annual salary of $114,000 - $157,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. title: Data Analyst (EN)
description: Help launch our new temping product and drive commercial impact! At YoungOnes, data is at the start of every decision. Take the lead in tracking the progress of this new proposition; Define the KPIs and funnel that show whether the proposition is working; Analyse the full journey of workers and clients, from onboarding to repeat shifts; Spot problems early and actively steer where you see them; Translate insights into concrete improvements together with product and development; Work in a select team that operates as a startup within the company. We want someone who takes the lead, sees problems before others do and makes sure something is done about them. What do we offer? A gross salary between €4,300 and €6,100 based on full-time employment; 25 vacation days, 6.5 ADV days and 1 additional holiday per calendar year, based on a 40-hour workweek; 8% vacation pay, a pension plan, and (if you live more than 10 km from the office) a travel allowance; We prioritize mental well-being in collaboration with our partner OpenUp; Great perks such as: a yearly fitness budget, a freshly prepared healthy lunch every day, snacks, biweekly afternoon drinks, XL borrels every three months, sport tournaments, and much more; A leading role in a new proposition that is key to our strategy; One of the best data environments to work in, with Databricks and AI built in; A company that is truly data driven, where your insights shape decisions; A high level of autonomy, freedom and responsibility.
